They know that the odds are 60 percent or better that the market will try to have a more complex correction, like two legs up, that lasts for about 10 or more bars. So, if the pattern has a good signal bar, reasonable shape, adequate buying pressure, and is not a tight bear channel, they will consider buying the reversal up from the third push down.


楔形可以是回调，也可以是反转。楔形回调在第2册的第18章和第19章讨论。当它们是趋势中的回调时，就是顺趋势建仓形态，在第一个信号处入场是合理的。楔形反转是要反转一段趋势的尝试，因此是逆势建仓形态。一般来说，做逆势交易时，最好等第二个信号。比如，如果空头趋势里出现一个楔形底部，只有当形态特别强时才在信号K线上方买入。更好的做法通常是先等着看市场是否出现强劲的多头突破，然后再找回调买入，这个回调可以是更高的低点，甚至可以是更低的低点。如果这波多头突破一路直上好几根K线、中途没有回调，交易者就应该像交易任何其他突破那样去交易它，第2册里讨论过这一点。楔形回调和楔形反转的另一个区别在方向上。楔形牛旗朝下倾斜，而多头趋势顶部的楔形反转朝上倾斜。空头趋势里的楔形回调朝上倾斜，而空头趋势里的楔形底部朝下倾斜。另外，楔形旗形通常是小一些的形态，大多数持续大约10到20根K线。因为它们是顺趋势建仓形态，所以不必完美；很多都很难察觉，看起来根本不像楔形，但有三次回调。一次反转通常需要有至少20根K线的长度，还要有一条清晰的趋势通道线，才能强到足以反转一段趋势。


> Wedges can be pullbacks or reversals. Wedge pullbacks are discussed in Chapters 18 and 19 in the second book. When they are pullbacks in trends, they are with-trend setups and it is reasonable to enter on the first signal. A wedge reversal is an attempt to reverse a trend and it is therefore a countertrend setup. In general, it is better to wait for a second signal when trading countertrend. For example, if there is a wedge bottom in a bear trend, buy above the signal bar only if the pattern is exceptionally strong. It is usually better to wait to see if the market has a strong bull breakout and then look to buy a pullback, which can be a higher low or even a lower low. If the bull breakout goes straight up for several bars without a pullback, then traders should trade it like any other breakout, as discussed in the second book. Another difference between wedge pullbacks and reversals is their direction. A wedge bull flag points down, whereas a wedge reversal at the top of a bull trend points up. A wedge pullback in a bear trend points up, but a wedge bottom in a bear trend points down. Also, wedge flags are usually smaller patterns, and most last about 10 to 20 bars. Since they are with-trend setups, they don’t have to be perfect, and many are subtle and look nothing like a wedge, but have three pullbacks. A reversal usually needs to be at least 20 bars long and have a clear trend channel line to be strong enough to reverse a trend.


趋势常常以对极值的一次测试收尾，而这次测试往往有两个行情段，每一段都走到更远的极值（多头趋势里就是一次两段式的更高的高点，空头趋势里就是更低的低点）。第一个极值加上随后这两个行情段，构成三次推进，这是一个被广泛认可的反转建仓形态，有很多名字。有时它呈楔形（多头趋势里是上升三角形，空头趋势里是下降三角形），但通常不是。交易者在这些变体之间细分出细微差别没什么用，因为它们的相似之处足够多，交易方式也一样。为了简便，把这些三次推进形态都当成楔形来看，因为它们大多以高潮式的、类似楔形的一个尖点收尾。记住，楔形不过是一个有三段推进的趋势通道，而且其中趋势线和趋势通道线常常收敛。三次推进形态里的趋势线和趋势通道线可以像楼梯形态那样平行，可以像楔形那样收敛，也可以像扩张三角形那样发散。这无关紧要，因为它们表现相似，交易方式也一样。它们全都是高潮，而且经常呈抛物线形状，有时这种形状还很细微。比如，如果有一个多头楔形，连接第二段和第三段行情顶部的趋势通道线，比连接前两段行情高点的线更陡，那么这个楔形就是抛物线楔形。这是高潮行为（上一章讨论过），而如果市场反转下跌，通常会用大约两个行情段、10根K线来完成。


> Trends often end with a test of the extreme, and the test often has two legs, each reaching a greater extreme (a two-legged higher high in a bull trend or lower low in a bear trend). The first extreme and then those two legs make three pushes, which is a well-recognized reversal setup with many names. Sometimes it takes a wedge shape (an ascending triangle in a bull trend or a descending triangle in a bear trend), but usually it does not. It is not useful for a trader to draw subtle distinctions among the variations because there are enough similarities that they trade the same. For simplicity, think of these three-push patterns as wedges since most of them end in a climactic wedgelike point. Remember, a wedge is simply a trend channel where there are three pushes and often the trend line and trend channel lines converge. A trend line and trend channel line in a three-push pattern can be parallel like a stairs pattern, convergent like a wedge, or divergent like an expanding triangle. It does not matter because they all behave similarly and you trade them the same. They are all climaxes and frequently have a parabolic shape, which at times can be subtle. For example, if there is a bull wedge and the slope of the trend channel line drawn across the tops of the second and third legs is steeper than the line drawn across the highs of the first two legs, the wedge is parabolic. This is climactic behavior (discussed in the last chapter), and if the market reverses down, it will usually do so in about two legs and 10 bars.


通道呈楔形，是因为市场有紧迫感（如果呈抛物线楔形，那就是极度的紧迫感），而且常常会带来一次高潮反转。比如，在楔形顶部里，趋势线的斜率大于趋势通道线的斜率。趋势线是顺趋势交易者入场、逆势交易者离场的位置，而在趋势通道线处发生的是相反的情形。所以，如果趋势线的斜率更大，就意味着多头在更小的回调处买入，空头在更小的抛售处离场。最早把楔形与两条线平行的通道区分开的，是第二次回调。一旦第二次向上推进开始转跌，交易者就可以画出一条趋势通道线，再用它作一条平行线。当他们把这条平行线拖到第一次回调的底部时，就得到了一条趋势线和一条趋势通道。这告诉多头和空头支撑在哪里：多头会在那里找机会买入，空头会在那里找机会止盈。但如果多头开始在那个位置上方买入，而空头提前平掉空单，市场就会在触及趋势线之前重新转涨。双方这么做都是因为他们感到紧迫，害怕市场不会跌到那个支撑位。这意味着双方都认为趋势线应该更陡，这波上涨趋势也更强。


> When a channel has a wedge shape, it is due to urgency (and if it has a parabolic wedge shape, it is due to extreme urgency), and often leads to a climactic reversal. For example, in a wedge top, the slope of the trend line is greater than the slope of the trend channel line. The trend line is where the with-trend traders enter and the countertrend traders exit, and the opposite happens at the trend channel line. So if the slope of the trend line is greater, that means that the bulls are buying on smaller pullbacks and the bears are exiting on smaller sell-offs. What first distinguishes a wedge from a channel where the lines are parallel is the second pullback. Once the second push up has begun to reverse down, traders can draw a trend channel line and then use it to create a parallel line. When they drag that parallel line to the bottom of the first pullback, they have created a trend line and a trend channel. That tells bulls and bears where support is, and bulls will look to buy there and bears will look to take profits there. However, if the bulls begin to buy above that level and the bears exit their shorts early, the market will turn back up before it reaches the trend line. Both are doing so because they feel a sense of urgency and are afraid that the market will not drop down to that support level. This means that both feel that the trend line needs to be steeper and that the trend up is stronger.


市场一旦转涨，交易者就会重新画趋势线。他们不再用趋势通道线的平行线，而是可以用前两次回调的底部画出一条趋势线。这时他们看到这条线比上方的趋势通道线更陡，于是开始认为市场正在形成楔形——他们知道，楔形往往是反转形态。交易者会为这条更陡的新趋势线作一条平行线，并把它拖到第二次向上推进的顶部，以防市场形成的是一个更陡的平行通道，而不是楔形。多头和空头都会盯着看：这波上涨行情是被原来那条趋势通道线挡住，还是会走到那条新的、更陡的线上。如果原来那条线挡住了这波上涨、市场随之转跌，交易者就会认为：尽管第二次回调处的买入更显紧迫，这种紧迫感在第三次向上推进时并没有延续。多头在原来那条更平缓的趋势通道线处止盈，也就是说他们比本可以离场的时间更早离场了。多头本指望市场涨到那条更陡的趋势通道线，现在则失望了。空头做空心切，又怕市场到不了那条更陡、更高的趋势通道线，于是就在原来那条线处开始做空。现在轮到空头有紧迫感，轮到多头害怕了。交易者会看到市场从楔形顶部转跌并卖出，而多数人会等到至少走出两段下跌之后，才去找下一个重要的向上或向下信号。


> Once the market turns up, traders then redraw the trend line. Instead of using the parallel of the trend channel line, they now can draw a trend line using the bottoms of the first two pullbacks. They now see that it is steeper than the trend channel line above and they begin to believe that the market is forming a wedge, which they know is often a reversal pattern. Traders will draw a parallel of that new steeper trend line and drag it to the top of the second push up, in case the market is forming a steeper parallel channel instead of a wedge. Both the bulls and the bears will watch to see whether the original trend channel line will contain the rally or the new, steeper one will be reached. If the original one contains the rally and the market turns down, traders will think that although there was more urgency in the buying on the second pullback, that urgency did not continue on the third push up. The bulls took profits at the original, shallower trend channel line, which means that they exited earlier than they could have. The bulls were hoping that the market would rally to the steeper trend channel line, but are now disappointed. The bears were so eager to short that, afraid that the market would not reach the steeper, higher trend channel line, they began to short at the original line. Now it is the bears who have a sense of urgency and the bulls who are afraid. Traders will see the turndown from the wedge top and sell, and most will wait for at least two legs down before they look for the next major signal up or down.


市场一旦走出第一个下跌行情段，就会跌破楔形。到了某个时点，空头会止盈，多头会再次买入。多头想让这个楔形顶部失败。当市场上涨去测试楔形顶部时，空头会再次开始卖出。如果多头开始止盈，说明他们认为自己无法把市场推升到前高之上。一旦他们的止盈与空头的新卖盘合在一起达到某个临界量，就会压垮剩下的买盘，市场随之转跌、走出第二段行情。到了某个时点，多头会回来、空头会止盈，双方都会看到这是一次两段式回调，并想弄清多头趋势是否会重启。到这时候，楔形已经走完，市场会开始寻找下一个形态。


> Once the market makes its first leg down, it will break below the wedge. At some point, the bears will take profits and the bulls will buy again. The bulls want to cause the wedge top to fail. When the market rallies to test the wedge top, the bears will begin to sell again. If the bulls begin to take profits, they believe that they will be unable to push the market above the old high. Once their profit taking combined with the new selling by the bears reaches a critical mass, it will overwhelm the remaining buyers, and the market will turn down for that second leg. At some point, the bulls will return and the bears will take profits, and both sides will see the two-legged pullback and wonder if the bull trend will resume. At this point, the wedge has played itself out and the market will be looking for the next pattern.


市场常常在对趋势极值做一次测试之后反转。比如，多头趋势最强的时候，多头会在前高上方买入，因为他们相信会有一次成功的突破，还会有再一次向上推进。不过，随着多头趋势走弱、双向交易变多，强劲的多头会把新高看成止盈的位置，而不是加多的好位置，他们只会在回调时买入。随着卖压累积，强劲的空头会在下一个新高处占据上风，并设法把这个更高的高点变成这波上涨行情的顶部。如果他们能用一段强劲的空头急速行情把市场压下去，交易者就会仔细盯住随后那波上涨，看它涨回前高附近之后是否会转跌。反转可能出现在更低的高点、双顶或更高的高点处。如果市场涨到略高于他们做空入场价的位置，或者涨到那个更高的高点上方，多数人会买回空单。不过他们清楚有形成楔形顶部的可能，所以如果突破第二个高点的那波走势看起来不太强，他们就会再次找机会做空。


> Markets often reverse after a test of the trend’s extreme. For example, when a bull trend is at its strongest, bulls will buy above the prior high since they believe that there will be a successful breakout and another leg up. However, as the bull trend weakens and gets more two-sided trading, the strong bulls will see a new high as a place to take profits instead of a good location for more longs, and they will buy only on a pullback. As selling pressure builds, strong bears will dominate at the next new high and will try to turn this higher high into the top of the rally. If they are able to push the market down in a strong bear spike, traders will watch the following rally carefully to see if it reverses down once it gets back up to around the old high. The reversal might come at a lower high, a double top, or a higher high. Most will buy back their shorts if the market rallies to just above their short entry price or above that higher high. However, they are aware of the possibility of a wedge top, and if the breakout above the second high does not look too strong, they will look to short again.


当上下波段特别凌厉，而且第一次或第二次向下推进没有明确跌破一条重要的多头趋势线、也没有站稳在移动平均线下方时，空头会认为这波下跌反转很弱。不过，这两次向下推进代表卖压，它们告诉所有人：空头也许能接管市场。空头知道，市场也许需要第三次向上推进才会耗尽力气。不过，他们已经看到自己在第二次向上推进的新高处成功让市场转跌，因此相信自己也许能再来一次。多头在第一个高点上方止盈了，等市场升到第二个高点上方时，他们很可能止盈得更快。如果多头趋势非常强，多头本会在突破第一个高点时加仓买入。而当交易者看到市场反而出现抛售时，他们就知道强劲的多头在止盈，而不是在买入这次突破；这告诉他们：强劲的多头并不认为市场能在没有更多回调的情况下继续上涨。


> When the up and down swings are especially sharp and when the first or second push down doesn’t clearly break below a major bull trend line or hold below the moving average, the bears will see the reversal down as weak. However, those two pushes down represent selling pressure, and they tell everyone that the bears might be able to take control of the market. The bears know that the market might need a third push up to exhaust itself. However, they saw that they were able to turn the market down at the new high on the second push up and they believe that they might be able to do it again. The bulls took profits above the first high and will likely be quicker to take profits as the market goes above the second high. If the bull trend was very strong, the bulls would have bought more on a breakout above the first high. When traders instead see the market sell off, they know that the strong bulls are taking profits instead of buying the breakout, and this tells them that the strong bulls do not believe that the market is going up without more of a pullback.


多头和空头都知道，市场常常在第三次向上推进之后反转，所以他们需要一次远远越过第二个高点的强劲突破，才会相信市场没有在筑顶。他们把第二个高点看成一个大型的低2做空建仓形态。如果这个低2失败，而突破低2顶部的走势很强，市场很可能至少还会走出两个上涨行情段。如果不强，市场可能会形成楔形顶部。突破第二个高点的走势常常很凌厉，但如果多头和空头认为它是在筑顶、而不是新一轮突破，它就会很快转跌。向上刺穿第二个顶部的那一下之所以凌厉，可能更多来自空头回补，而不是强劲多头的激进买入；如果没有立刻出现后续行情，交易者就会认定强劲的多头只会买很深的回调。如果强劲的多头在袖手旁观，空头就有信心大力做空。如果他们能把市场压得足够深、足够快，多头也许会等一波更持久的抛售之后才考虑买入。这可能造出下跌真空：市场快速下跌，直到跌到交易者愿意再次买入的价位（多头开出新多单，空头止盈）。如果市场涨到楔形顶部下方就滞涨，多头在那里对新多单止盈，市场就会形成一个更低的高点，而且很可能至少还会走出第二次向下推进。强劲的空头会在那个更低的高点加码做空，而那正是强劲的多头平掉多单的位置。这个位置总会是在某个阻力区域，那里汇集了多个卖出理由。


> Both the bulls and the bears know that markets often reverse after a third push up, and they will need a strong breakout well beyond the second high for them to believe that the market is not topping. They view the second high as a large low 2 short setup. If the low 2 fails and the breakout above the low 2 top is strong, the market will likely have at least two more legs up. If it is not strong, the market will probably form a wedge top. The breakout above the second high is often sharp, but it will reverse down quickly if the bulls and the bears think that it is forming a top instead of a new breakout. The sharp poke above the second top might be due more to short covering than to aggressive buying by the strong bulls, and if there is not immediate follow-through, traders will assume that the strong bulls will buy only a deep pullback. If the strong bulls are stepping aside, then the bears will have the confidence to short aggressively. If they can push the market down far and fast enough, the bulls might wait for a more protracted sell-off before looking to buy. This can create a sell vacuum where the market falls quickly until it reaches a price at which traders are willing to buy again (the bulls initiating new longs and the bears taking profits). If the bulls take profits on their new longs on a rally that stalls below the top of the wedge, the market will form a lower high and it will likely fall for at least a second push down. The strong bears will be shorting more at the lower high, exactly where the strong bulls are covering their longs. It will always be at a resistance area where there is a confluence of reasons to sell.


这种又快又走出很多点的反转，体现的是所有人感到的紧迫感；这也常常让交易者难以足够快地做出交易决定、拿到最好的入场点。不过，如果交易者明白市场在做什么，他们往往能在下跌反转的极早期做空。下跌常常很快，而在第一个强劲的下跌行情段和随后的更低的高点之后，他们可以把止损移到保本价。


> These fast reversals that quickly cover a lot of points represent the urgency that everyone is feeling, and this often makes it difficult for traders to make their trading decisions fast enough to get the best entry. However, if traders understand what the market is doing, they can often get short very early in the reversal down. The move down is often fast and they can move their stops to breakeven after the first strong leg down and the subsequent lower high.


大多数三次推进形态都在对趋势通道线过靶之后反转，仅凭这一点就足以成为入场的理由，即使形态本身并不是楔形。不过，三次推进往往比趋势通道线过靶更容易看见，这就使得把它与其他趋势通道线失败形态区分开来变得有价值。这些形态很少形状完美，而且常常要把趋势线和趋势通道线调整一番，才能把这个形态突显出来。比如，楔形可能只体现在蜡烛线实体上，那么为了画出能突显楔形形状的趋势线和趋势通道线，你就得忽略影线。还有些时候，楔形的终点不会触到趋势通道线。要灵活：如果一波大行情末端出现三次推进形态，即使这个形态并不完美，也把它当成楔形来交易。不过，如果它过靶了趋势通道线，这笔逆势交易成功的概率就更高。另外，大多数趋势通道线过靶都呈楔形，但它常常被拉得太长，长到不值得去看。如果形态很强，仅凭过靶之后的反转就足以构成入场的理由。


> The majority of three-push patterns reverse after overshooting a trend channel line and that alone can be a reason to enter, even if the actual shape is not a wedge. However, the three pushes are often easier to see than is the trend channel line overshoot, and that makes the distinction from other trend channel line failures worthwhile. These patterns rarely have a perfect shape, and often trend lines and trend channel lines have to be manipulated to highlight the pattern. For example, the wedge might be only with the candle bodies, so to draw the trend line and trend channel line in a way to highlight the wedge shape, you have to ignore the tails. Other times, the end point of the wedge won’t reach the trend channel line. Be flexible and if there is a three-push pattern at the end of a big move, even if the pattern is not perfect, trade it as if it is a wedge. However, if it overshoots the trend channel line, the odds of success with the countertrend trade are higher. Also, most trend channel line overshoots have a wedge shape, but it is often so stretched out that it is not worth looking at it. The reversal from the overshoot can be reason enough to enter if the pattern is strong.


要记住：楔形反转是逆势建仓形态。因此，更好的做法通常是等一次二次入场，比如楔形顶部之后的更低的高点（较少见的是更高的高点突破回调做空建仓形态），或者楔形底部之后的更高的低点（较少见的是更低的低点）。这与交易楔形回调不同，那时你是顺着更大趋势的方向入场。那种情况下，在第一个信号处入场是可靠的做法。一般来说，如果你在交易楔形反转，而它没有你希望的那么强，最好在做这笔交易之前等第二个信号。如果最初的突破很强，那么在回调处入场成功的几率更高。如果交易区间里出现楔形反转，它看起来和表现起来可能更像楔形回调，因为没有趋势可反转。在这种情况下，做第一个信号通常是有利可图的做法。


> It is important to remember that a wedge reversal is a countertrend setup. It is therefore usually better to wait for a second entry, like a lower high (less often, a higher high breakout pullback short setup) after a wedge top or a higher low (less often, a lower low) after a wedge bottom. This is unlike trading wedge pullbacks where you are entering in the direction of the larger trend. Then, entering on the first signal is a reliable approach. In general, if you are trading a wedge reversal and it is not as strong as you would like, it is better to wait for a second signal before taking the trade. If the initial breakout is strong, entering on the pullback has a higher chance of success. If there is a wedge reversal in a trading range, it may look and act more like a wedge pullback because there is no trend to reverse. When that is the case, taking the first signal is usually a profitable approach.


如果楔形触发了一次入场，但随后失败，市场越过楔形极值又走了一个或多个最小报价单位，它常常会快速跑到一个按楔形高度测算的等距运动目标位。有时它刚失败就反转回来，形成第二次反转趋势的尝试；出现这种情况时，新趋势通常持续较久（至少10根K线），而且通常至少有两个行情段。这个新极值可以看成一次突破回调。比如，如果楔形顶部开始转跌，向下的突破失败，随后多头趋势重启、并在一个新高处再次转跌，那么这个新高就是跌破楔形之初那波走势之后的一次更高的高点回调。


> If a wedge triggers an entry, but then it fails and the market extends one or more ticks beyond the wedge extreme, it will often run quickly to a measured move based on the height of the wedge. Sometimes, just after failing, it reverses back and creates a second attempt at reversing the trend; when this happens, the new trend is usually protracted (lasting at least 10 bars) and it usually has at least two legs. The new extreme can be thought of as a breakout pullback. For example, if there is a wedge top that begins to reverse down and the downside breakout fails and then the bull trend resumes and reverses down again at a new high, that new high is a higher high pullback from the initial break below the wedge.


当楔形反转失败、市场走到一个新极值时，要观察市场是否会在这次第四次推进上反转。有时在多数交易者眼里，看起来的第四次推进其实只是第三次推进。如果在第一次推进之后的回调过后，市场走出一次特别强的第二次推进，许多交易者就会重新计数，把它当作新的第一次推进。结果就是，许多交易者不会在第三次推进之后找反转，而是等到第四次推进才去找反转交易。事后回看，多数交易者有没有重新计数一目了然；但你在交易时，并不能总是确定。第二次推进的动能越强，市场重新计数的可能性就越大，出现第四次推进的可能性也越大。


> When the wedge reversal fails and the market reaches a new extreme, watch to see if the market reverses on this fourth push. Sometimes what appears to be a fourth push is really just a third push in the eyes of most traders. If, after the pullback from the first push, the market creates an especially strong second push, many traders will reset the count and consider it to be the new first push. The result is that many traders won’t look for a reversal after the third push and instead will wait for the fourth push before looking for a reversal trade. In hindsight, the decision about whether most traders reset the count is clear, but when you are trading, you cannot always be certain. The stronger the momentum is on the second push, the more likely it is that the market will have reset the count and the more likely it is that there will be a fourth push.


在任何新趋势的第一个行情段之后，对旧极值的测试有时会呈楔形；而从新趋势第一个行情段展开的那次楔形回调，可能越过旧趋势的极值，也可能不越过。无论哪种情况，交易者都应该在这个楔形回调重新转回新趋势方向时，找机会顺着这个可能的新趋势入场（比如在新的多头趋势里，这个楔形回调可以是更高的低点，也可以是更低的低点）。


> After the first leg of any new trend, the test of the old extreme sometimes assumes a wedge shape, and the wedge pullback from that first leg of the new trend may or may not exceed the extreme of the old trend. In either case, a trader should be looking to enter in the possible new trend as the wedge pullback reverses back in the direction of the new trend (for example, in a new bull trend, the wedge pullback can be a higher low or a lower low).


头一个小时里出现趋势时，市场常常会走出一段持续数小时的交易区间，随后在尾盘重新恢复这段趋势。这段交易区间常常有三次推进，但通常不是楔形。比如，在一个趋势重启型的空头趋势日里，这段交易区间可能是一条略微上倾的空头通道，它可能有三次推进，但不是楔形。把它叫作低3做空建仓形态还是楔形，都无所谓；重要的是要意识到，这一天可能会在尾盘重启空头趋势，而这波三次推进、动能不足的上涨行情也许就是做空的建仓形态。把它看成一种楔形，因为它有三次推进，常常出现过靶趋势通道线，有时还呈楔形形状，而且它的表现和楔形一样。记住，如果你看什么都看灰色地带，你会成为好得多的交易者。


> When there is a trend in the first hour, the market often has a trading range that lasts for several hours, followed by a resumption of the trend into the close. That trading range will often have three pushes, but usually not a wedge shape. For example, in a trend-resumption bear trend day, the trading range might be a bear channel that slopes up slightly, and it might have three pushes but not a wedge shape. It does not matter whether you call it a low 3 short setup or a wedge, but it is important to be aware that the day might have a bear trend resumption into the close and that this three-push, low-momentum rally might be the setup for the short. View this as a type of wedge because it has three pushes, there is often a trend channel line overshoot, it sometimes has the shape of a wedge, and it has the same behavior as a wedge. Remember, if you see everything in shades of gray, you will be a much better trader.


当推进有三次或更多、而且每一次突破都比上一次小的时候，它除了是楔形，还是一个收缩的楼梯形态。比如，如果多头趋势里有三次向上推进，第二次推进比第一次高10个最小报价单位，第三次只比第二次高7个最小报价单位，这就是一个收缩的楼梯形态。它是动能在减弱的信号，也提高了会出现两段式反转的概率。多头止盈得更早，而空头在比上一次更小的突破处就做空，因为他们认为这次市场的突破幅度可能没那么大。强趋势里有时会有第四级或第五级台阶，但由于动能在减弱，通常已经可以做逆势交易了。相反，如果第三级台阶明显越过第二级、随后又反转，这就很可能变成一次趋势通道线过靶及反转的建仓形态。


> When there are three or more pushes and each breakout is smaller, then this is a shrinking stairs pattern in addition to being a wedge. For example, if there are three pushes up in a bull trend and the second push was 10 ticks above the first and the third was only seven ticks above the second, then this is a shrinking stairs pattern. It is a sign of waning momentum and increases the odds that there will be a two-legged reversal. The bulls are taking profits sooner and the bears are shorting at less of a breakout than last time because they believe the market might not break out as much this time. Sometimes there will be a fourth or fifth step in a strong trend, but since the momentum is waning, countertrend trades can usually be taken. In contrast, if the third step is significantly beyond the second and then reverses, this is likely to become a trend channel line overshoot and reversal setup.


如果在触发入场之后，突破走不远，趋势重启并越过楔形，那么这个楔形顶部就是失败的。比如，如果出现一个楔形顶部，市场跌破信号K线、触发了做空入场，但紧接着一波上涨行情升到楔形顶部上方，那么这个楔形就失败了。当交易者不确定第二次向上推进是否强到足以重新计数时，他们会观察这次突破是不是那个以第二次推进为起点的楔形的第三次推进。当一个楔形非常清晰、而且交易者原本预期顶部会守住时，许多交易者会在楔形顶部上方挂止损单反手做多。楔形顶部兑现时，第一个目标是对楔形底部的一次测试，下一个目标是从那里向下的一段等距运动。楔形顶部失败时，第一个目标是向上的一段等距运动，同样用楔形的高度来测算。记住，楔形是一个双向交易的区域，所以它的表现像交易区间，因而会形成突破模式的局面。无论突破向上还是向下，目标都是一段大约等于楔形高度的等距运动。和任何突破一样，它也可能失败。比如，如果楔形顶部触发了入场，但市场很快反转向上、突破到楔形顶部上方，那么这个楔形就失败了。不过，这次多头突破应该像任何其他突破那样看待。如果它很强，很可能跟随一段向上的等距运动。如果它很弱，很可能会失败，市场会反转回落。如果真是这样，楔形上方这波多头突破就只是跌破楔形最初那次突破之后的一次更高的高点回调。


> A wedge top fails if, after triggering the entry, the breakout fails to go far and the trend resumes and goes beyond the wedge. For example, if there is a wedge top and the market falls below the signal bar and triggers a short entry, but this is soon followed by a rally that goes above the top of the wedge, then the wedge has failed. When traders are unclear about whether the second push up was strong enough to reset the count, they will watch to see if the breakout is actually the third push of the wedge that began with that second push. When a wedge is very clear and traders were expecting the top to hold, many traders will reverse to long on a stop above the top of the wedge. When a wedge top succeeds, the first target is a test of the bottom of the wedge, and the next target is a measured move down from there. When a wedge top fails, the first target is a measured move up, again using the height of the wedge. Remember, a wedge is an area of two-sided trading, so it acts like a trading range and therefore sets up a breakout mode situation. Whether the breakout is above or below, the target is a measured move equal to about the height of the wedge. As with any breakout, it could fail. For example, if the wedge top triggers, but the market quickly reverses back up and breaks out above the wedge top, the wedge has failed. However, the bull breakout should be viewed like any other breakout. If it is strong, it is likely to be followed by a measured move up. If it is weak, it will likely fail and the market will reverse back down. If that happens, the bull breakout above the wedge becomes simply a higher high pullback from the original breakout below the wedge.


在 Emini 小型合约里，如果出现楔形顶部、随后是一段短暂抛售，这波回调常常会精确到最小报价单位地测试楔形顶部，形成一个完美的双顶。如果市场反转回落，这就是一个二次入场做空的机会。在 SPY 和许多股票里，回调有时会越过楔形几个最小报价单位，交易者不会把这看成失败。但如果它冲过楔形很多个最小报价单位，这就是交易者在激进买入的信号：他们要的是一段强劲的上涨行情，而不再是在找顶部。出现这种情况时，要迅速寻找买入机会，抓住这波快速突破。大多数失败的楔形顶部都非常陡、非常窄，而且出现在强劲的多头趋势里。多头趋势强劲时，它总会不断形成趋势通道线过靶和三次推进形态，只是推进之间的回调很小，而推进本身非常强。在强趋势里找反转是个错误，因为大多数反转尝试都会失败。不要看什么都像可能的楔形顶部，而要在每一个新高之后的回调处找买入机会。另外，强多头趋势里的楔形顶部常常以两段横盘行情修正到移动平均线，从而形成高2买入建仓形态。这是一个可靠的入场点。以横盘方式修正的楔形，说明趋势非常强。楔形底部的情况正好相反。和任何突破一样，这次突破也可能失败。比如，如果楔形顶部触发了入场，但市场很快反转向上、突破到楔形顶部上方，那么这个楔形就失败了。不过，这次多头突破应该像任何其他突破那样看待。如果它很强，很可能跟随一段向上的等距运动。如果它很弱，很可能会失败，市场会反转回落。如果真是这样，楔形上方这波多头突破就只是跌破楔形最初那次突破之后的一次更高的高点回调。


> In the Emini, if there is a wedge top and then a brief sell-off, the pullback often tests the top of the wedge to the exact tick, forming a perfect double top. If the market reverses back down, this is a second-entry short opportunity. In the SPY and in many stocks, the pullback will sometimes go above the wedge by a few ticks and traders will not see this as a failure. However, if it races above the wedge by many ticks, this is a sign that traders are buying aggressively and they are looking for a strong leg up and no longer looking for a top. When this is happening, look to buy quickly to catch this fast breakout. Most wedge tops that fail are very steep and tight and occur in strong bull trends. When a bull trend is strong, it will always be forming trend channel line overshoots and three-push patterns, but the pullbacks between the pushes are small and the pushes are very strong. It is a mistake to be looking for reversals in strong trends, because most reversal attempts fail. Instead of seeing everything as a possible wedge top, look to buy the pullback from each new high. Also, wedge tops in strong bull trends often correct in two sideways legs to the moving average, setting up a high 2 buy. This is a reliable entry. A wedge that corrects sideways is a sign that the trend is very strong. The opposite is true for wedge bottoms. As with any breakout, the breakout could fail. For example, if the wedge top triggers, but the market quickly reverses back up and breaks out above the wedge top, the wedge has failed. However, the bull breakout should be viewed like any other breakout. If it is strong, it is likely to be followed by a measured move up. If it is weak, it will likely fail and the market will reverse back down. If that happens, the bull breakout above the wedge becomes simply a higher high pullback from the original breakout below the wedge.


楔形最常失败的原因，是交易者过于急切地做逆势入场，没有等一次清晰的趋势线突破和逆势力量的显现，就去反向操作刚出现的第一个小型三次推进形态。仅凭三次推进，尤其是小的三次推进，在之前没有趋势线突破、也没有一次重要的趋势通道过靶及反转的情况下，很少能反转一段趋势。如果通道很窄，即使它呈楔形，也几乎总是以不在反转处入场为好。更好的做法是等反转出现，看突破有多强。如果它很强，就当成任何其他突破来交易。通常最好的做法是在突破回调处入场，但当急速行情非常强时，交易者会在这几根K线的收盘价处、甚至用市价单入场。如果突破很弱，交易者会认为它会失败，转而去等通道延续。这时他们会顺着这个楔形通道的方向入场，而不是逆势方向。比如，如果空头趋势里出现一个楔形底部，但向上的突破很弱，交易者就会去找这波向上突破失败所形成的低1或低2做空。这些聪明的交易者会在逆势交易者将要止损离场的位置入场。


> Wedges most often fail when traders are overly eager to enter countertrend, do not wait for a clear trend line break and countertrend strength, and fade the first small three-push pattern that appears. Three pushes alone, especially when small, will rarely reverse a trend in the absence of a prior trend line break or a major trend channel overshoot and reversal. If the channel is tight, even if it has a wedge shape, it is almost always better not to enter on the reversal. Instead, wait for the reversal and see how strong the breakout is. If it is strong, trade it like any other breakout. It is usually best to enter on a breakout pullback, but when the spike is very strong, traders will enter on the closes of the bars and at the market. If the breakout is weak, traders assume that it will fail and they look for the channel to continue. They will then enter in the direction of the wedge channel and not in the countertrend direction. For example, if there is a wedge bottom in a bear trend but the upside breakout is weak, traders will look to short the low 1 or low 2 that is created by the failed upside breakout. These smart traders will enter where the countertrend traders will be taking their losses.


楔形常常是开盘反转形态。开盘反转可能出现在头一个小时左右的极强走势之后；有时会出现一个非常陡的楔形，前两次推进之后只有轻微的停顿，可市场却会突然反转，并在当天剩下的时间里走出一段趋势。第一次停顿可能是一个小的最终旗形，而在第二次推进之后还有一个更小的最终旗形。尽管在头一两个小时之后，绝不该指望从这样陡、这样窄的楔形上找反转，但它们可以是很可靠的开盘反转建仓形态。


> Wedges are often opening reversal patterns. Opening reversals can follow very strong moves in the first hour or so, and sometimes there will be a very steep wedge with only slight pauses after the first two pushes, yet the market will abruptly reverse and trend for the rest of the day. The first pause might be a small final flag, and then there is an even smaller final flag after the second push. Although you should never look for a reversal from such a steep, tight wedge after the first hour or two, they can be reliable opening reversal setups.


微型楔形是由连续三根K线、或连续四五根K线中的三根构成的楔形。由于形态这么小，它通常只会带来一次小级别修正。这些K线通常带影线，可以沿着这些影线画出一条微型趋势通道线，而且在1分钟图这类更小的时间级别上通常能看到一个清晰的楔形。比如，如果市场正在抛售，先是一根下方带中等长度影线的空头趋势K线，接着又是一根低点略低、下方影线明显的空头趋势K线，然后第三根K线再创新低并带影线，这就是一个微型楔形反转形态。如果空头趋势很强，你不应该在这第三根K线的高点上方买入，因为那很可能会亏钱。如果这个微型楔形出现在交易区间日、靠近区间底部，而且第三根K线是一根多头反转K线，那也许是一个合理的做多剥头皮建仓形态。


> A micro wedge is a wedge that is formed by three consecutive bars or three out of four or five consecutive bars. Since the pattern is so small, it usually results in only a minor correction. Usually the bars have tails and a micro trend channel line can be drawn across those tails, and there usually is a clear wedge on a smaller time frame like a 1 minute chart. For example, if the market is selling off and has a bear trend bar with a moderate tail on the bottom, and this is followed by another bear trend bar with a slightly lower low and an obvious tail on the bottom, and then by a third bar with a lower low and a tail, this is a micro wedge reversal pattern. If the bear trend is strong, you should not buy above the high of the third bar, because it will likely lead to a loss. If the micro wedge forms in a trading range day near the bottom of the range and the third bar is a bull reversal bar, this might be a reasonable setup for a buy scalp.


有一种特殊的楔形，它其实只是一个三次推进形态，通常并不呈楔形，但它很重要，因为它是一个可靠的突破建仓形态。如果市场处在交易区间里，先是比一个小级别摆动高点或低点高出一个最小报价单位的突破，随后反转，可能走上3到20根K线，然后市场又出现一次突破，幅度同样是一个最小报价单位，有时是两个最小报价单位，并且再次回调，这三次推进就构成了这个形态。如果市场随后再次突破那个第二次小级别突破位，通常会带来一次像样的突破，以及一段大致等于该形态高度的等距运动。这就好像这三次推进构成了一个楔形，而这个楔形并没有带来反转，而是失败了。和所有失败的楔形一样，市场通常会突破，并走出与楔形底部到顶部点数大致相同的行情。有时市场只是越过了一次单独的一个最小报价单位的失败之后就突破。


> There is a special type of wedge that is really just a three-push pattern and usually does not have a wedge shape, but it is important because it is a reliable breakout setup. If the market is in a trading range and then has a one-tick breakout beyond a minor swing high or low that reverses for maybe three to 20 bars, and then the market again has another one-tick or sometimes a two-tick breakout that once again pulls back, those three pushes set up the pattern. If the market then breaks again beyond that second minor breakout, it usually leads to a significant breakout and an approximate measured move equal to the height of the pattern. It is as if the three pushes constitute a wedge, and then, instead of leading to a reversal, the wedge failed. As is the case with all failed wedges, the market typically breaks out and runs for about the same number of points as there are from the bottom to the top of the wedge. Sometimes the market breaks out after only going beyond a single one-tick failure.


一个相关的形态是双顶或双底的突破失败。比如，如果出现一个双顶，随后市场突破双顶上方，但又在几根K线之内反转回落，这就可以起到楔形顶部的作用（楔形是一种三角形，有些交易者会把它叫作三角形）。前两次向上推进是双顶的两个高点，第三次向上推进是突破双顶上方的那次突破。如果市场反转下跌，它通常会走出足够远、至少能剥一次头皮。双顶是一个交易区间，而这次突破失败只是交易区间的一次突破失败，它后面通常只是更多横盘交易。它通常会跌得够剥一次头皮，但有时会跟着一次对交易区间另一侧的快速突破，以及一段按交易区间高度测算的向下等距运动。这种情况下，那些买入突破、又在反转时被止损的多头，只有在出现一次大幅回调之后才会考虑再次买入。


> A related pattern is a failed double top or bottom breakout. For example, if there is a double top and then the market breaks above the double top but reverses back down within a few bars, this can function like a wedge top (a wedge is a type of triangle, and some traders would call it a triangle). The first two pushes up are the highs of the double top, and the third push up is the breakout above the double top. If the market reverses down, it will usually go far enough for at least a scalp. A double top is a trading range, and the failed breakout is just a failed breakout of a trading range that is usually followed by just more sideways trading. It usually falls enough for at least a scalp, but sometimes it will be followed by a quick breakout of the opposite side of the trading range and a measured move down based on the height of the trading range. In this case, the bulls who bought the breakout and were stopped out on the reversal will look to buy again only after a substantial pullback.


![图 5.1](figures/fig-05-01.jpg)


**图 5.1　楔形顶部**


如图 5.1 所示，60分钟 Emini 小型合约图走出了一个楔形反转顶部，随后是一次更小的楔形回调，涨到一个更低的高点或双顶，之后是两段下跌，一直跌到第20根K线。


> As shown in Figure 5.1, the 60 minute Emini had a wedge reversal top and then a smaller wedge pullback to a lower high or double top, followed by two legs down to bar 20.


楔形不必形状完美才能有效。比如，这里的趋势通道线是一条从第6根K线高点连到第10根K线高点的最佳拟合线，而第8根K线那个第二次向上推进位于这条线上方。市场从第10根K线向下反转、跌到第12根K线之后，又形成了一个同样形状不完美的楔形熊旗。这三次向上推进分别是当天开盘时第11根K线的高点，以及随后的第13根和第14根K线。它的高点略低于第10根K线的高点。你把它叫作双顶还是更低的高点，都无所谓。重要的是你要看到那三次大幅向上推进，以及随后的反转下跌。


> A wedge does not have to have a perfect shape to be effective. For example, the trend channel line is a best fit line from the bar 6 high to the bar 10 high, and the bar 8 second push up is above the line. After the market reversed down from bar 10 to bar 12, it formed a wedge bear flag that also had an imperfect shape. The three pushes up were the high of bar 11 on the open of the day and then bars 13 and 14. The high was slightly below the bar 10 high. It does not matter if you call this a double top or a lower high. What matters is that you see the large three pushes up and then the reversal down.


这同时也是一段急速与通道式的多头趋势：先是一段急速上涨行情冲到第4根K线，然后是一条陡峭的通道延续到第6根K线。从第3根K线低点到第6根K线的那段走势处在一条窄得离谱的通道里，以至于它本身就成了一段大的急速行情。引发这条通道的第7根K线回调，后来被跌到第20根K线的抛售测试了一次。这条多头通道有三次推进，并且呈楔形，这在急速与通道形态里很常见。


> This is also a spike and channel bull trend where there was a sharp spike up to bar 4 and then a steep channel to bar 6. The move from the bar 3 low to bar 6 was in such a tight channel that it became a large spike. The bar 7 pullback that led to the channel was tested by the bar 20 sell-off. The bull channel had three pushes and a wedge shape, which is common in spike and channel patterns.


![图 5.2](figures/fig-05-02.jpg)


**图 5.2　头一个小时的楔形**


如果一段三次推进走势太陡，它通常不是好的反转形态，除了在头一个小时里有时例外——那时它能形成一次开盘反转。如图 5.2 所示，市场从第11根K线到第12根K线以三次推进强劲上涨，尽管这是一条很陡的通道，它仍是一次可以接受的抛物线楔形开盘反转。第12根K线突破到第8根和第10根K线那个双顶上方，随后出现的是一根空头内包K线。第12根K线既是对那个双顶的一次突破失败，也与这两个高点中的任意一个构成双顶。这波上涨到的是一个昨天卖方多次出现的价位，所以有理由认为他们今天可能再次回到昨天那个交易区间的顶部附近。


> If a three-push move is too steep, it is usually not a good reversal pattern except sometimes in the first hour when it can create an opening reversal. As shown in Figure 5.2, the market rallied strongly from bar 11 to bar 12 in three pushes, and although this was a steep channel, it was an acceptable parabolic wedge opening reversal. Bar 12 broke above the bar 8 and bar 10 double top and was followed by a bear inside bar. Bar 12 was both a failed breakout of the double top and a double top with either of those bars. The rally was to a price level where sellers came in several times yesterday, and it was reasonable to think they might return again today around the top of the trading range from yesterday.


在交易区间市场里，反向操作突破是一个好策略。做空的人，在区间顶部附近那根失败K线下方一个最小报价单位处用止损单入场；做多的人，在区间底部附近那根突破失败的K线上方一个最小报价单位处用止损单买入。突破到任何一个摆动高点或低点之外，即使它属于更早一段方向相反的趋势，也是强势的信号，是一个潜在的交易建仓形态。这两天里有很多突破失败和反转的例子，包括趋势线突破失败和趋势通道线突破失败。


> In trading range markets, fading breakouts is a good strategy. For the shorts, enter on a stop at one tick below the failure bar near the top of the range, and for longs, buy on a stop at one tick above the failed breakout bar near the low of the range. Breaking out beyond any swing high or low, even if it was part of an earlier and opposite trend, is a sign of strength and a potential trade setup. There were many examples of failed breakouts and reversals over these two days, including failed trend line and failed trend channel line breakouts.


第2、3、6根K线还构成一个收缩的楼梯形态，这常常会带来一次不错的反转。你也可以把它叫作楔形，因为这里有三次向上推进（第2根和第3根K线是前两次，而从第4根K线算起它也是第三次向上推进）。在收缩的楼梯形态里，第二次突破比第一次小，说明动能在流失。这里，第3根K线比第2根K线高19美分，而第6根K线只比第3根K线高12美分。只要出现收缩的楼梯形态，这笔交易成功的可能性就更大，而且它通常预示强趋势中即将出现一次两段式回调。


> Bars 2, 3, and 6 also represent a shrinking stairs pattern, which often leads to a good reversal. You could also call it a wedge, because of the three pushes up (bars 2 and 3 were the first two, and it was also the third push up from bar 4). With shrinking stairs, the second breakout is smaller than the first, indicating loss of momentum. Here, bar 3 was 19 cents above bar 2, but bar 6 was only 12 cents above bar 3. Whenever shrinking stairs are present, the trade becomes more likely to be successful and usually signals an imminent two-legged pullback in a strong trend.


第4根和第7根K线构成一个双底，而第9根K线是这个双底下方的一次突破失败。第4根和第7根K线是两次向下推进，第9根K线是第三次向下推进，因而是一次向上反转，这是楔形底部的一个变体。


> Bars 4 and 7 formed a double bottom, and bar 9 was a failed breakout below that double bottom. Bars 4 and 7 were two pushes down, and bar 9 was a third push down and therefore a reversal up, which is a variant of a wedge bottom.


![图 5.3](figures/fig-05-03.jpg)


**图 5.3　收缩的楼梯形态**


如图 5.3 所示，在收缩的楼梯形态里，每一次突破的延伸幅度都小于上一次，这标志着动能在减弱，也提高了那笔有利可图的逆势交易即将来临的概率。在第4根K线那一级台阶之后，涨到第5根K线的走势突破了趋势线，为一次对低点的测试和一波很可能出现两段的上涨行情做好了铺垫（这波上涨出现在第6根K线创出更低的低点、以及一个两根K线反转之后）。动能的流失说明趋势正在走弱、双向交易越来越多，这就提高了它转入交易区间的可能，这里也正是如此。


> As shown in Figure 5.3, shrinking stairs, with each breakout extending less than the prior one, signal waning momentum and increase the odds that a profitable countertrend trade is near. After the bar 4 step, the move to bar 5 broke the trend line, setting the stage for a test of the low and a likely two-legged rally (which occurred after the bar 6 lower low and two-bar reversal). The loss of momentum is a sign that the trend is weakening and becoming more two-sided, which increases the chances that it will transition into a trading range, as it did here.


第3根到第5根K线构成一个小型楔形熊旗。第一次向上推进之后，跟出了第4根K线那个更低的低点，这是楔形很常见的一个变体。涨到第5根K线的走势里包含了另外两次小幅推进。第4根K线是一次成功的最终旗形剥头皮，而这个形态后来长成了到第5根K线才结束的更大的最终旗形（一个楔形），这种情况经常发生。


> Bars 3 to 5 formed a small wedge bear flag. The first push up was followed by the bar 4 lower low, which is a common wedge variant. The move up to bar 5 had the other two small pushes. Bar 4 was a successful final flag scalp, and the pattern grew into the larger final flag that ended at bar 5 (a wedge), which is a frequent occurrence.


当第一次向下推进之后的回调过后出现强劲突破时，接下来是只再走两次推进，还是动能强到足以重新开始计数，并不清楚。比如，第3根K线算第三次向下推进，还是你应该在跌到第2根K线那波强劲下跌时重新开始计数？事后回看，答案很清楚；但你交易的时候，并无法确定。向下的动能越强，多数交易者重新计数的可能性就越大，出现第四次推进的可能性也越大。那次跌到第4根K线的第四次向下推进，其实只是那个以跌到第2根K线的急速行情为起点的楔形底部的第三次向下推进。


> When there is a strong breakout after the pullback from the first push down, it is unclear whether there will be only two more pushes or the momentum is strong enough to restart the count. For example, is bar 3 the third push down, or should you have restarted the count on the strong move down to bar 2? In hindsight, the answer is clear, but when you are trading, you cannot be certain. The stronger the downward momentum is, the more likely it is that the most traders will reset the count and the more likely it is that there will be a fourth push. That fourth push down to bar 4 was really just the third push down in the wedge bottom that began with the spike down to bar 2.


第6根K线跌破楔形的第4根K线底部之后，这个楔形底部就失败了。第6根K线应该像任何其他突破那样看待。它后面紧跟着一根多头反转K线，构成了一个两根K线反转和一次突破失败。有些交易者把这个买入建仓形态看成一次更低的低点主要趋势反转，另一些交易者则把它看成对第4根K线楔形底部那波突破之后的一次更低的低点回调。它同时还是一个收缩的楼梯形态做多建仓形态，以及一次交易区间下方的突破失败。最后，它还是一次小型最终旗形反转（第6根K线之前有一个两根K线熊旗）。这些都是交易者可以考虑在第6根K线之后那根多头K线上方买入的合理理由。


> Once bar 6 fell below the bar 4 bottom of the wedge, the wedge bottom failed. Bar 6 should be viewed like any other breakout. It was immediately followed by a bull reversal bar, setting up a two-bar reversal and a failed breakout. Some traders saw this buy setup as a lower low major trend reversal, while others saw it as a lower low pullback from the breakout above the bar 4 wedge bottom. It is also a shrinking stairs buy setup and a failed breakout below a trading range. Finally, it is a small final flag reversal (there was a two-bar bear flag before bar 6). All of these are reasonable reasons for traders to consider buying above the bull bar that followed bar 6.


![图 5.4](figures/fig-05-04.jpg)


**图 5.4　楔形更低的高点**


如图 5.4 所示，SPY 的日线图在2000年3月见顶，随后是一波三次推进的上涨行情，涨到第8根K线那个更低的高点。第8根K线还与第2根K线构成一个双顶熊旗（它略微超过了第2根K线的高点）。第8根K线差一点没触到那条虚线画出的空头趋势通道线。这个楔形熊旗之后跟着一波巨大的多头趋势。在它形成的当时，并不清楚是否正在发生趋势反转；但在涨到第1根K线的三次向上推进之后，市场很可能至少会有两次向下推进。跌到第3根K线的那段是第一次，因此涨到第8根K线的这波上涨行情就是那次回调，它为至少再走一个下跌行情段的那波抛售做了铺垫。虽然多头趋势之后的大多数交易区间在更高时间级别的图上只是牛旗，但大多数趋势反转都从交易区间中产生。市场通常必须先转入一个双向交易的市场，然后才会改变方向。


> The daily SPY topped in March 2000 and then there was a three-push rally to the bar 8 lower high, as shown in Figure 5.4. Bar 8 also formed a double top bear flag with bar 2 (it slightly exceeded the bar 2 high). Bar 8 did not quite reach the dashed bear trend channel line. This wedge bear flag was followed by a huge bull trend. At the time that it formed, it was unclear whether a trend reversal was taking place, but following the three pushes up to bar 1, the market was likely to have at least two pushes down. The move down to bar 3 was the first, and the rally to bar 8 was therefore the pullback, setting up the sell-off to at least one more leg down. Although most trading ranges after bull trends are simply bull flags on higher time frame charts, most trend reversals come from trading ranges. The market usually has to transition into a two-sided market before it changes direction.


当市场从第8根K线开始下跌时，它更可能在这个正在形成的交易区间的底部、也就是第3根K线低点附近找到支撑。但是，跌到第3根K线下方的那段行情段太陡，以至于明显可以看出买盘不多，市场必须走得更低才能找到愿意买入的交易者。强劲的多头直到2003年初那次双底回调和更高的低点主要趋势反转时才出现。


> As the market began to fall from bar 8, it was more likely to find support around the bar 3 low at the bottom of the developing trading range. However, the leg to below bar 3 was so steep that it was clear that there were not many buyers and that the market had to go lower to find traders willing to buy. Strong bulls did not appear until the double bottom pullback and higher low major trend reversal in early 2003.


![图 5.5](figures/fig-05-05.jpg)


**图 5.5　道指里的楔形更低的高点**


如图 5.5 所示，道琼斯工业平均指数日线图上，在跌破多头趋势线之后出现的一个楔形熊旗更低的高点，最终引出了1987年股灾。跌到第6根K线的那段下跌很强，明显跌破了趋势线和移动平均线。有些交易者把这个楔形熊旗的第一次向上推进看成第5根K线之后的那波上涨行情，把第二、第三次向上推进看成涨到第7根K线的三次向上推进中的任意两次。另一些交易者把第7根K线看成一次两段式的更低的高点主要趋势反转，因而是一个低2做空建仓形态，其中第一个上涨行情段是第5根K线之后的那波上涨行情。还有一些交易者把涨到第7根K线的三次小幅向上推进，看成第6根K线起那波小幅急速上涨行情之后形成的一条小型通道。多数交易者看到了所有这些因素，只是各自看重的点不同。


> A wedge bear flag lower high in the daily Dow Jones Industrial Average following the break below the bull trend line led to the 1987 crash, as shown in Figure 5.5. The move down to bar 6 was strong and broke well below the trend line and the moving average. Some traders saw the first push up of the wedge bear flag as the rally after bar 5, and the second and third pushes up as any two of the three pushes up to bar 7. Others saw bar 7 as a two-legged lower high major trend reversal and therefore a low 2 short setup, with the first leg up being the rally after bar 5. Still others saw the three small pushes up to bar 7 as a small channel that followed the small spike up from bar 6. Most traders saw all of these factors and attached a different significance to each.


第1根K线是一个楔形牛旗的第一次向下推进。之后又有两次向下推进，接着是一次小幅突破，随后是回落到第3根K线的一次更高的低点突破回调。有些交易者把第3根K线看成与这个楔形牛旗底部构成的双底牛旗。很多楔形牛旗都是失败的头肩形态顶部，这里就是如此。


> Bar 1 was the first push down of a wedge bull flag. There were two more pushes down and then a small breakout, and this was followed by a higher low breakout pullback to bar 3. Some traders saw bar 3 as a double bottom bull flag with the bottom of the wedge bull flag. Many wedge bull flags are head and shoulders tops that fail, as was the case here.


第1根K线那波抛售之前的上涨行情有四次向上推进，正好说明：仅凭三次推进并不构成反转建仓形态。当这三次推进处在一段窄幅多头通道里时，出现第四次或第五次向上推进的可能，比出现反转的可能更大。涨到第4根K线的通道在最后一段里有三次推进，而且同样处在一条窄幅多头通道里。通道很窄时，空头不应该在第三次向上推进之后的下跌反转处做空。他们应该先等着看空头突破有多强。


> The rally up before the bar 1 sell-off had four pushes up and was an example of how three pushes alone do not provide a reversal setup. When the three pushes are in a tight bull channel, it is more likely that there will be a fourth or fifth push up than a reversal. The channel up to bar 4 had three pushes in the final segment and again was in a tight bull channel. When the channel is tight, bears should not short the reversal down from the third push up. They should wait to see how strong the bear breakout is.


第1根K线是一段强劲的空头急速行情，随后许多交易者在第2根K线那个更高的高点做空，他们把它看成跌到第1根K线那波空头突破之后的一次更高的高点回调。第1根K线突破了多头趋势线，所以交易者要找机会做空对多头高点的一次更高的高点或更低的高点测试。


> Bar 1 was a strong bear spike, and many traders then shorted the higher high at bar 2, which they saw as a higher high pullback from the bear breakout down to bar 1. Bar 1 broke the bull trend line, so traders were looking to short a higher high or lower high test of the bull high.


第5根K线对这条多头通道的突破强到明确跌破了多头趋势线，所以交易者要找机会做空这次突破回调。这次回调的高点出现在第7根K线的一个更低的高点上，它与第5根K线之后那波小上涨行情构成双顶。多头趋势里的大多数交易区间都会变成牛旗，在更高时间级别的图上就只是一次回调。尽管市场不一定非要从第3根K线向上反转，但那是最可能的结果，因为第3根K线位于多头趋势里一个交易区间的底部。市场本可以从第2根K线之后形成的那个更低的高点主要趋势反转继续下跌（当时有一个双顶熊旗和更低的高点），但大多数主要趋势反转之后跟着的都是交易区间，而不是真正反转成反向趋势。整个这个建仓形态与第7根K线那处很相似，而后者之后跟随的是一段大的空头趋势。


> The bar 5 breakout of the bull channel was strong enough to clearly break the bull trend line, so traders were looking to short the breakout pullback. It was a lower high at bar 7, which formed a double top with the small rally after bar 5. Most trading ranges in bull trends become bull flags and are just pullbacks on higher time frame charts. Although the market did not have to reverse up from bar 3, that was the most likely outcome, since bar 3 was at the bottom of a trading range in a bull trend. The market could have continued to fall from the lower high major trend reversal that formed after bar 2 (there was a double top bear flag and lower high), but most major trend reversals are followed by trading ranges and not actual reversals into opposite trends. This entire setup was similar to that at bar 7, which was followed by a big bear trend.


![图 5.6](figures/fig-05-06.jpg)


**图 5.6　差一点没到趋势通道线的反转**


当空头一方感到紧迫时，他们会就在趋势通道线下方大力做空。他们怕市场到不了这条线上方，不想冒错过这波抛售的风险。在图 5.6 中，第3、4、5根K线形成一个楔形顶部，但第5根K线没有过靶趋势通道线。由于这是一个楔形反转建仓形态，更好的做法是等第二个信号，比如一个更低的高点。第5根K线和它后面那根K线构成一段小幅空头急速行情。第6根K线是这个失败高2上的二次入场，而且第6根K线还是一段更大的、三根K线的空头急速行情的起点。在一根K线的回调之后，出现了一段五根K线的空头急速行情，市场随之崩跌进入强劲的空头趋势。由于从第2根K线起的上升通道里有大幅波段，因而存在大量双向交易，所以这个急速与通道式的多头并不是一段强趋势。那段急速行情就是从当天低点涨到第1根K线的那一段。当出现明显的交易区间特征时，激进的交易者可以在第一个入场点做空，也就是第5根K线处的那个两根K线反转。顺便说一句，楔形顶部的第1根K线高点是一个微型楔形顶部，而跌到第2根K线的那波抛售，与这个楔形的底部构成了双底牛旗，那里也是这个楔形通道的起点。第2根K线还测试了当天第一根K线上方的那次突破。


> When there is urgency on the part of the bears, they will short aggressively just below the trend channel line. They are afraid that the market will not get above the line and they don’t want to risk missing the sell-off. In Figure 5.6, bars 3, 4, and 5 formed a wedge top, but bar 5 did not overshoot the trend channel line. Because this was a wedge reversal setup, it was better to wait for a second signal, like a lower high. Bar 5 and the bar after it formed a small bear spike. Bar 6 was a second entry on the failed high 2, and bar 6 was the start of a larger, three-bar bear spike. After a one-bar pullback, there was a five-bar bear spike and a collapse into a strong bear trend. Since the channel up from bar 2 had large swings and therefore had a lot of two-sided trading, this spike and channel bull was not a strong trend. The spike was the low of the day up to bar 1. When there is significant trading range behavior, aggressive traders could short the first entry, which was the two-bar reversal at bar 5. Incidentally, the bar 1 high at the top of the wedge was a micro wedge top, and the sell-off to bar 2 was a double bottom bull flag with the bottom of the wedge, which was the start of the wedge-shaped channel. Bar 2 was also a test of the breakout above the first bar of the day.


第7、8、9根K线构成一个三次推进的做多建仓形态，入场点在第9根K线那根多头反转K线上方，尽管它的收盘价位于区间中部。这一天显然不是趋势日，所以一根较弱的反转K线也算合理。这个形态的两条线是发散的，不过它并不是扩张三角形，因为第8根K线之后的高点低于第7根K线之后的高点。第9根K线没有过靶趋势通道线，但在一个交易区间日里它仍然是一个不错的做多建仓形态。如果你担心在跌到第7根K线那波强劲抛售之后这样做有风险，本可以等一个更高的低点再去做多。三根K线之后那根外包上涨K线就是一个更高的低点；但在外包K线上入场必须快，因为它们常常很快就反转向上。


> Bars 7, 8, and 9 created a three-push long setup with an entry above the bar 9 bull reversal bar, even though the close was midrange. The day was clearly not a trend day, so a weaker reversal bar was reasonable. This pattern had diverging lines, although it was not an expanding triangle since the high after bar 8 was below the high after bar 7. Bar 9 did not overshoot the trend channel line, but it was still a good long setup on a trading range day. If you were concerned that it was risky after the strong sell-off down to bar 7, you could have waited for a higher low before going long. The outside up bar three bars later was a higher low, but when entering on outside bars, you have to be fast because they often reverse up quickly.


第9根K线之前那根K线是一根大的空头趋势K线，因此是一次突破尝试。不过，下一根K线上没有后续卖盘跟随。相反，它是一根小的多头K线，因此是突破失败之后的做多建仓形态。尽管它跌破了第8根K线低点，但它之前那波上涨行情有五到六根连续的多头实体，因此是一次相当强的多头突破尝试。那波抛售只是对这波多头突破的一次短暂、凌厉的回调。突破回调有时会形成一个更低的低点，这里就是如此。绝不要被单独一根大的空头趋势K线吓住。永远把每一根趋势K线都看成一次突破，并且要明白：大多数突破尝试都会失败。


> The bar before bar 9 was a big bear trend bar and therefore a breakout attempt. However, there was no follow-through selling on the next bar. Instead, it was a small bull bar and therefore a buy setup for a failed breakout. Even though it fell below the bar 8 low, the rally that preceded it had five or six consecutive bull bodies and therefore was a reasonably strong bull breakout attempt. The sell-off was simply a brief, sharp pullback from that bull breakout. A breakout pullback sometimes forms a lower low, as it did here. Never be frightened by a single big bear trend bar. Always view every trend bar as a breakout, and realize that most breakout attempts fail.


![图 5.7](figures/fig-05-07.jpg)


**图 5.7　抛物线楔形**


如图 5.7 所示，Emini 小型合约从第5根K线那个更高的高点向下反转，并形成一个交易区间，但随后市场强劲突破这个区间，并且突破了多头通道的 B 线顶部。记住，每一次反转都不过是某个东西的一次突破失败。它随后在第9根K线向下反转，那是第三次向上推进。这个楔形的斜率在增大，因此是抛物线形的（从第5根K线到第9根K线的趋势通道线，比从第3根K线到第5根K线的那条线更陡）。和任何楔形顶部一样，很可能会有两次向下推进。


> As shown in Figure 5.7, the Emini reversed down from the bar 5 higher high and formed a trading range, but the market broke out strongly from the range and above the line B top of the bull channel. Remember, every reversal is simply a failed breakout of something. It then reversed down at bar 9, which was the third push up. The slope of the wedge increased and was therefore parabolic (the slope of the trend channel line from bar 5 to bar 9 was steeper than the slope of the line from bar 3 to bar 5). As with any wedge top, two pushes down was likely.


涨到第9根K线的强劲上涨行情突破了多头通道（虚线那条），但在跌到第10根K线的那波抛售中又反转回到通道内。只要出现突破多头通道、随后又强劲反转回到通道内的情况，这个空头波段大约有50%的概率会延续并跌破多头通道的底部——这里就发生了这种情况。当一次突破注定要失败时，它通常会在突破通道之后的约五根K线之内失败，这里也是如此。空头买回了空单，激进的多头则在第16根K线附近做多；第16根K线与当天第6根K线的低点构成双底，也是到达目标位（刺穿通道下方一次）之后的第一次反转。


> The strong rally to bar 9 broke above the bull channel (dashed line), but then reversed back into the channel on the sell-off to bar 10. Whenever there is a breakout above a bull channel and then a strong reversal back into the channel, there is about a 50 percent chance that the bear swing will continue and break below the bottom of the bull channel, as it did here. When a breakout is going to fail, it usually does so within about five bars of breaking above the channel, as it did here. The bears bought back their shorts and aggressive bulls went long around bar 16, which formed a double bottom with the bar 6 low of the day, and was the first reversal after reaching the target (a poke below the channel).


第8根K线之前那根K线的实体比它前面那根小，说明动能在减弱。第8根K线的实体很大。这意味着什么？第8根K线是在一次停顿之后再次给趋势加速的尝试。许多交易者把第8根K线的大实体理解为高潮行为，其中那次停顿也许就是这波上涨行情里的最终旗形，之后就是一次两段式回调。交易者在第8根K线的收盘价卖出、在它高点上方卖出，尤其是第9根K线的收盘价和它低点下方卖出，因为那根空头收盘价说明卖方正在变强。多头卖出以了结多单止盈，一些空头做空去剥一次头皮，预期在这个小型买入高潮（那个小的最终旗形）之后会出现一次相对较大的回调（也许五到10根K线）。另一些空头则依据这个抛物线楔形做空，博一段向下波段。


> The bar before bar 8 had a smaller body than the bar before it, which meant that the momentum was waning. Bar 8 had a big body. What did this mean? Bar 8 was an attempt to accelerate the trend again after a pause. Many traders interpreted the large size of bar 8 as indicating climactic behavior, with the pause perhaps being the final flag in the rally, before a two-legged pullback. Traders sold the close of bar 8, above its high, and especially the close of the bar 9 and below its low, because the bear close indicated that the sellers were getting strong. Bulls sold to take profits on their longs and some bears shorted for a scalp, expecting a relatively large (maybe five to 10 bars) pullback after the small buy climax (the small final flag). Other bears shorted for a swing down, based on the parabolic wedge.


第16根K线是第二段下跌的底部，第8根K线是第一段。在更高时间级别的图上，这会是一个很明显的高2回调。它同时也是对当天低点的一次双底测试，那个低点出现在第6根K线。空头本以为这一天会收成反转日，但多头杀了进来，压过了空头。尾盘这波上涨行情测试了结束于第9根K线的那段极强多头急速行情的顶部。尽管这波上涨行情不强、跌到第8根K线的抛售也很深，在日线图上这一天仍是一个多头趋势日。


> Bar 16 was the bottom of a second leg down, where bar 8 was the first. This would be an obvious high 2 pullback on a higher time frame chart. It was also a double bottom test of the low of the day, which occurred at bar 6. The bears were hoping for a reversal day, but the bulls came in and overwhelmed the bears. The rally into the close tested the top of the very strong bull spike that ended at bar 9. Although the rally was not strong and the sell-off to bar 8 was deep, the day was a bull trend day on the daily chart.


![图 5.8](figures/fig-05-08.jpg)


**图 5.8　多头与空头抛物线楔形**


如图 5.8 所示，左边这张图处在交易区间里，并在第4根K线下方触发了一次低2做空。多数交易者不会去做空这个弱势建仓形态，因为第4根K线是一根十字星K线，而且它之前连续六根K线都没有空头实体。第6根K线形成一个高2做多建仓形态（同时也是第5根K线之后那个高1和失败低2的突破回调做多建仓形态），并带来一波强劲的多头突破。一波上涨行情总会到达某个阻力区域，比如一个等距运动目标位或一条趋势线；在那里交易者会部分或全部止盈，而激进的空头会做空去剥一次向下的头皮。这波上涨行情过靶了一个等距运动目标位两个最小报价单位，但这一带很可能还有其他目标位。多头和空头都只预期一次回调，而且双方都打算在回调结束时买入（回调总会结束在某个支撑位，而这个支撑位不一定明显）。行情之所以会在目标位结束，是因为大多数交易是由计算机完成的，而它们的算法建立在数学与逻辑之上。它们只在支撑位买、只在阻力位卖。这些潜在价位通常是有经验的交易者能看到的。


> As shown in Figure 5.8, the chart on the left was in a trading range and triggered a low 2 short below bar 4. Most traders would not have shorted this weak setup, because bar 4 was a doji bar and it followed six consecutive bars without a bear body. Bar 6 formed a high 2 buy setup (also a breakout pullback buy setup from the high 1 and failed low 2 that followed bar 5), which led to a strong bull breakout. A rally always reaches some resistance area, like a measured move or a trend line, where traders will take partial or full profits, and aggressive bears will short for a scalp down. This rally overshot a measured move target by a couple of ticks, but there were probably other targets in the area as well. Both the bulls and the bears expected only a pullback, and both planned to buy when the pullback ended (which would always be at a support level, which may not be obvious). The reason moves end at targets is that most trades are being done by computers, and their algorithms are based on math and logic. They only buy at support and sell at resistance. These potential levels are usually visible to experienced traders.


从第4根K线到第7根K线的趋势通道线，比从第2根K线到第4根K线的那条更陡，这意味着这波上涨是抛物线形的。第7根K线之前那根K线有一根大影线，这通常意味着在那根K线收盘价买入的交易者只想要一次向上剥头皮，然后就等一次回调。第7根K线的高点是第二次向上推进。下一根K线是一根空头内包K线，也是这笔做空的信号K线。在第4根K线那个失败低2之后出现了这么强的力量，多数交易者正确地推断还会有第二次向上推进——这种情况发生的概率超过60%。市场在一个牛旗里回调了六根K线（这里是一条空头微型通道），但这个旗形没有向上突破，而是在第8根K线之后那根K线上向下突破了。这个牛旗于是就成了这波上涨行情的最终旗形，而它向下的突破就是一次最终旗形反转，尽管这个旗形从未有过向上突破。机敏的交易者意识到了这种可能，在第7根K线之后那根空头K线下方做空，并在跌破第8根K线的那次突破处做空。做第一个入场点的交易者知道它的成功率只有大约40%，但他们要的是一次向下的反转，以及至少两倍于风险的回报，因此有一个正的交易者等式。在向下突破处做空的交易者——无论是在那根K线形成过程中、还是在它的收盘价上、或者在随后任何一根K线的收盘价上做空——都有了市场正在下行的证据，因此他们的空单至少有60%的成功率（对他们来说，他们只要求回报至少与风险一样大）。他们用更小的利润换来了更高的概率，交易者等式同样为正。


> The trend channel line from bar 4 to bar 7 was steeper than the one from bar 2 to bar 4, which means that the move up was parabolic. The bar before bar 7 had a big tail, which usually means that traders who bought the close of that bar were looking for just a scalp up and then a pullback. The high of bar 7 was a second push up. The next bar was a bear inside bar and the signal bar for the short. With that much strength after the failed low 2 at bar 4, most traders correctly assumed that there would be a second push up, which happens in over 60 percent of the cases. The market pulled back for six bars in a bull flag (here, a bear micro channel), but instead of breaking out to the upside, the flag broke to the downside on the bar after bar 8. This bull flag was then the final flag of the rally, and its downside breakout was a final flag reversal, even though the flag never had an upside breakout. Astute traders were aware of this possibility and shorted below the bear bar that followed bar 7, and on the breakout below bar 8. The traders who took the first entry knew that it had only about a 40 percent chance of success, but they were looking for a reversal down and a reward that was at least twice the size of their risk, and therefore had a positive trader’s equation. The traders who shorted on the downside breakout, either as the bar was forming or on its close, or on the close of any of the following bars, had proof that the market was going down, and therefore their shorts had at least a 60 percent chance of success (for them, they wanted a reward that was at least as large as their risk). They traded off a smaller profit for a higher probability, and their trader’s equation was also positive.


右边这张图是一个抛物线楔形底部。第15根K线是在一个双底处的强劲多头反转K线，也是从第14根K线下方突破的那个低2最终旗形反转向上的做多建仓形态。第14根K线可以看成一个二次入场的低2做空，也可以看成对前一根K线上触发的那个低2做空的一次突破回调，还可以看成一个三角形做空（这三次向上推进分别是第13根K线之后两根K线处形成的那根十字星的高点、随后那根多头内包K线，以及第14根K线顶部的影线）。空头把第16根K线看成对这个空头三角形突破之后的一次回调。多头和空头都在第16根K线下方卖出，也在第15根K线之后那根多头入场K线下方以及第15根K线那个买入信号K线下方卖出。多头在平掉多单，空头在开新空单。当多头在从双底向上反转的做多中被止损打出来时，他们通常预期会有一波突破和一段等距运动，而且在接下来几根K线里都不会考虑再买入。这让市场得以快速下跌。


> The chart on the right is a parabolic wedge bottom. Bar 15 was a strong bull reversal bar at a double bottom, and a buy setup for a reversal up from the low 2 final flag that broke out below bar 14. Bar 14 can be viewed as a second entry low 2 short, a breakout pullback from the low 2 short that triggered on the prior bar, or as a triangle short (the three pushes up were the high of the doji that formed two bars after bar 13, the bull inside bar that followed, and the tail at the top of bar 14). The bears saw bar 16 as a pullback from the breakout of the bear triangle. Both bulls and bears sold below bar 16, the bull entry bar after bar 15, and the bar 15 buy signal bar. The bulls were exiting their longs and the bears were initiating shorts. When bulls get stopped out of a bull reversal up from a double bottom, they often expect a breakout and measured move, and don’t look to buy again for at least a couple of bars. This allowed the market to fall quickly.


第17根K线在下端带一根影线，这提醒交易者：市场可能只剩一次向下推进，之后就会形成回调。它的收盘价也落在中部，这使它成为一根反转K线，虽然很弱。这是从一段急速行情（一种微型通道）向上反转的第一次尝试，而第一次反转尝试通常会失败。不出所料，第17根K线上方的卖方多于买方。剥头皮交易者在第17根K线的收盘价做空，指望在回调开始之前再来一次小幅向下推进。由于很可能只有一次向下的剥头皮，在下一根K线下方做那个低1是有风险的。市场在第18根K线处以一个小的双底转涨（第17根K线是第一次向下推进）。第18根K线的低点在第17根K线收盘价下方四个最小报价单位处，所以那些在该K线收盘价做空的人大多被套，并在第18根K线上方买回了空单。第18根K线有一根强劲的多头实体，多数交易者预期会向上反转，涨到移动平均线附近，也许还能到第15根K线的高点。第15根K线是一个合理的买入信号，所以一些多头在更低的价位分批建仓，并计划在第一次入场的位置——也就是第15根K线的高点——把整个仓位全部平掉。多头认为这波上涨行情可能到达第16根或第14根K线的高点。第18根K线的低点位于一个或多个支撑位上，虽然没有在这里画出来。


> Bar 17 had a tail on the bottom, which alerted traders that the market might have only one more push down before forming a pullback. It also had a close in the middle, which made it a reversal bar, although weak. This was the first attempt to reverse up from a spike, which is a type of micro channel, and first attempts to reverse usually fail. There were more sellers above bar 17 than buyers, as expected. Scalpers shorted the close of bar 17, hoping for one more small push down before a pullback began. Because only a scalp down was likely, shorting the low 1 below the next bar was risky. The market turned up in a small double bottom at bar 18 (bar 17 was the first push down). The low of bar 18 was four ticks below the close of bar 17, so most of those shorts from the close of that bar were trapped and bought back their shorts above bar 18. Bar 18 had a strong bull body and most traders expected a reversal up to around the moving average and maybe to the high of bar 15. Bar 15 was a reasonable buy signal, so some bulls scaled in lower and planned to exit their entire position at their first entry, which was the high of bar 15. The bulls thought that the rally could reach the bar 16 or bar 14 highs. The bar 18 low was at one or more support levels, although none are shown here.


跌到第18根K线的这段走势越过了某个合理的等距运动目标位，这意味着那些计算机在看别的东西。大多数等距运动目标位并不会带来反转，但把它们画出来仍然有帮助，因为所有反转都发生在支撑位和阻力位上。当反转发生在这些价位之一、而且这个价位特别明显时，那就是趋势交易者止盈的好位置，也常常是逆势交易者做反转交易的合理位置。当天的最终低点也是在一个支撑位上，不管这个支撑位是否明显。第21根K线的低点在当天较早那个低点下方一个最小报价单位处，而第21根K线的收盘价正好在当天的开盘价上。


> The move down to bar 18 went beyond a reasonable measured move target, which meant that the computers were looking at something else. Most measured move targets do not lead to reversals, but it is still helpful to draw them, because all reversals happen at support and resistance levels. When a reversal happens at one of these levels, and the level is especially obvious, it is a good place for trend traders to take profits and often a reasonable place for countertrend traders to take reversal trades. The final low of the day was also at a support level, whether or not it was obvious. The low of bar 21 was one tick below the earlier low of the day and the close of bar 21 was exactly at the open of the day.


因为这波上涨是一次高潮反转，所以它大约有60%的概率会走出至少两个上涨行情段、并持续10根K线。这意味着它有40%的概率达不到这两个目标。


> Because the move up was a climactic reversal, it had about a 60 percent chance of having at least two legs up and lasting 10 bars. This means that it had a 40 percent chance of not reaching those goals.


由于第18根K线是一个相当强的买入信号，多数交易者都在它的高点上方入场。这就使得市场上涨过程中愿意买入的交易者更少。第18根K线顶部的影线以及随后那根十字星K线，都是市场对多头缺乏紧迫感的迹象，也就是说这个做多建仓形态没有它本可以达到的那么强。当多头没能造出强势迹象时，交易者止盈就会更快。第19根K线最高走到第18根K线高点上方14个最小报价单位处，并以空头收盘。这意味着许多多头恰好在3个点的位置止盈。市场上涨时遇到的不是新买盘，而是在移动平均线处、以及在第13根K线之后两根K线处触发的那笔低2做空下方两个最小报价单位处，遇到了止盈的人。空头把这看成一次突破回测——它离那些保本止损只差一个最小报价单位没碰上——因此也说明空头在积极守住自己的止损位。尽管回调到一个更高的低点之后继续走第二段上涨行情的概率仍然占优，多数多头还是在第19根K线期间及其下方平掉了多单，而且只打算在回调中某一根K线的高点上方用止损单再买回来。这个更高的低点始终没有出现，市场跌破第17根K线那段空头急速行情的低点，并收在当天低点上。多头赚到的利润没有他们当初做这笔交易时希望的多，但这种情况经常发生，并不令人意外。交易者入场时总有一个计划，但如果前提变了，他们就会改变计划。很多交易最终的利润或亏损都比交易者入场时预期的要小。好的交易者只是拿走市场给他们的东西，然后转向下一笔交易。


> Since bar 18 was a reasonably strong buy signal, most traders entered above its high. This left fewer traders to buy as the market went up. The tail on the top of bar 18 and the doji bar that followed were signs that the market lacked urgency for the bulls, which means that the buy setup was not as strong as it could have been. When the bulls fail to create signs of strength, traders are quicker to take profits. Bar 19 reached 14 ticks above the bar 18 high and had a bear close. This means that many bulls took profits at exactly three points. Instead of finding new buyers as the market rallied, it found profit takers at the moving average, and two ticks below the low 2 short that was triggered two bars after bar 13. The bears saw this as a breakout test that missed the breakeven stops by one tick, and therefore a sign that the bears were aggressively defending their stops. Although the odds still favored a second leg up after a pullback to a higher low, most bulls exited their longs during and below bar 19, and were only looking to buy again on a stop above the high of a bar in the pullback. The higher low never formed and the market fell below the bar 17 bear spike low and closed on the low of the day. The bulls did not get as much profit as they had hoped to make when they took their trade, but this often happens and is not a surprise. Traders always have a plan when they enter a trade, but if the premise changes, they change their plan. Many trades end up with smaller profits or losses than what traders expected when they entered. Good traders just take what the market gives them and then move on to the next trade.


交易者特别警惕尾盘出现一波抛售的可能，因为市场在日线图上两天前出现了空头突破，而在此之前它已经涨了两年。当市场在日线图上可能正在向下反转时，许多交易者会去找尾盘的抛售（就像在多头趋势里他们会去找尾盘的上涨行情一样）。这让交易者在市场跌到第19根K线下方时不愿意用限价单买入。他们很谨慎，只想在一根反转K线形成之后再买。在一个空头日、市场尾盘抛售的过程中，愿意用限价单买入的交易者这么少，那根更高的低点信号K线始终没有出现。


> Traders were especially wary of the possibility of a sell-off into the close of the day, because the market had a bear breakout on the daily chart two days earlier after rallying for two years. When a market might be reversing down on the daily chart, many traders look for a sell-off into the close (just like they look for a rally into the close in a bull trend). This made traders unwilling to buy on limit orders as the market traded down below bar 19. They were cautious and only wanted to buy after a reversal bar formed. With so few traders willing to buy on limit orders as the market was selling off into the close on a bear day, the higher low signal bar never formed.


![图 5.9](figures/fig-05-09.jpg)


**图 5.9　失败的楔形**


当出现一个底部建仓形态、而市场没有上涨而是横盘时，说明市场在接受更低的价位，而不是拒绝它们，因此它可能处在这波走势的中段，而不是在底部。失败的楔形常常会走出一段向下的等距运动。


> When there is a bottom setup and the market goes sideways instead of up, the market is accepting the lower prices instead of rejecting them and therefore might be in the middle of the move instead of at the bottom. A failed wedge often falls for a measured move.


如图 5.9 所示，市场试图形成一个楔形反转，但第3根K线是连续第四根与前一根K线大部分重叠的K线。这是对更低价格的接受，而不是拒绝，所以它使向上反转变得不太可能。另外，向下的通道很陡；在这种情况下，通常更安全的做法是先等一个更高的低点再去做多。第3根K线那根入场K线是一根外包上涨K线，它把那些忽略了空头趋势通道线的陡峭、只看到三次推进的多头套了进去。有耐心的交易者不会买入这个楔形，因为没有更高的低点。


> As shown in Figure 5.9, the market tried to form a wedge reversal, but bar 3 was the fourth consecutive bar that mostly overlapped the prior bar. This was acceptance of the lower price and not rejection, so it made a reversal up unlikely. Also, the channel down was steep, and when this is the case, it is usually safer to wait for a higher low before going long. The bar 3 entry bar was an outside up bar that trapped bulls who overlooked the steepness of the bear trend channel line and only saw the three pushes. Patient traders would not have bought this wedge, because there was no higher low.


当楔形失败时，随后的走势通常是一段大致等于楔形高度的等距运动。这里，跌破第3根K线的那段下跌，点数与从第1根K线之后不久的楔形顶部到第3根K线低点这个底部之间的距离大致相同。


> When a wedge fails, the move will usually be an approximate measured move equal to the height of the wedge. Here, the move down below bar 3 was about the same number of points as there were from the top of the wedge just after bar 1 to the bottom at the low of bar 3.


![图 5.10](figures/fig-05-10.jpg)


**图 5.10　过于窄的楔形**


空头趋势里处在窄幅通道中、而且此前没有多头力量显现的楔形底部，不是做多建仓形态。如图 5.10 所示，在一个跳空低开日里，市场从开盘起就处在空头趋势中。过于急切的多头会给自己找理由去买第6根K线那个楔形反转，说服自己这是两段式下跌的终点，而且第3根K线处有一次趋势线突破。不过，第3根K线是一次趋势线突破失败，并不代表多头带着任何动能接管了市场。第6根K线那个楔形做多、在内包K线上方入场，是一次成功的剥头皮，但不是那种有可能发展成更多东西的建仓形态。


> A wedge bottom that is in a tight channel in a bear trend and without prior bull strength is not a buy setup. As shown in Figure 5.10, the market was in a bear trend from the open on a gap down day. Overly eager bulls would have rationalized buying the bar 6 wedge reversal by convincing themselves that it was the end of a two-legged move down and there was a trend line break at bar 3. However, bar 3 was a failed trend line break and did not represent the bulls taking control of the market with any momentum. The bar 6 wedge long entry above the inside bar was a successful scalp, but not a setup that would likely turn into anything more.


跌到第6根K线的那段下跌，中间既没有一次有意义的趋势线突破，也没有向上的动能，因此看起来更像是窄幅空头通道里由两个更小的行情段组成的一个单一下跌行情段。在跌破空头趋势线之后，很可能还会有第二个下跌行情段。有些交易者把第6根K线看成一个楔形的终点：第一次向下推进是第2根K线，第二次向下推进是第4根K线，最后一次向下推进是第6根K线。它还是一个由第4、5、6根K线构成的、长达五根K线的微型楔形。由于可以沿着这些K线的低点画出一条趋势通道线，这个小形态可以看成一个小楔形，因此它的表现本应像楔形一样，本应走出一段修正，大致到达楔形的起点——也就是造出第一次向下推进的那根K线的顶部。


> The move down to bar 6 did not have a meaningful trend line break or upward momentum in the middle and therefore looked more like a single leg down made up of two smaller legs in a tight bear channel. There was likely to be a second leg down after a break of the bear trend line. Some traders saw bar 6 as the end of a wedge with its first push down as bar 2, its second push down as bar 4, and the final push down as bar 6. It was also a five-bar-long micro wedge formed by bars 4, 5, and 6. Since a trend channel line can be drawn across the bottoms of the bars, this small pattern can be thought of as a little wedge and therefore should have behaved like one and should have had a correction that reached to about the start of the wedge at the top of the bar that created the first push down.


随后在第8根K线处出现了一次低2做空。这波小上涨确实突破了一条趋势线，所以买方可以在一个新低失败处找一次向上剥头皮的机会，这个机会出现在第9根K线。不过，在没有一根强劲多头反转K线的情况下，这笔做多很可能会失败——它在第10根K线那个低2做空处确实失败了——随后市场向下破位，进入结束于第12根K线最终旗形一个最小报价单位假突破的第二段空头行情。第10根K线那笔做空与第8根K线构成双顶，同时是一个20均线缺口K线（20 gap bar）做空建仓形态，它带来了一段重启趋势的空头行情，一路跌到当天低点。


> There was then a low 2 short at bar 8. This little rally did break a trend line, so buyers could look for a scalp up on a failed new low, which occurred at bar 9. However, in the absence of a strong bull reversal bar, this long was likely to fail, which it did at the bar 10 low 2 short, and the market then broke down into the second bear leg that ended at the bar 12 final flag one-tick false breakout. The bar 10 short was a double top with bar 8 and a 20 gap bar short setup, and it resulted in a trend-resumption bear trend down to the low of the day.


![图 5.11](figures/fig-05-11.jpg)


**图 5.11　楔形但是窄幅通道**


楔形底部处在窄幅空头通道里时，并不是买入信号。如图 5.11 所示，第9根K线是一次空头趋势通道线过靶后的反转，也是第三次向下推进（一个楔形）。不过它不是一根强劲的多头信号K线，因为它处在一段窄幅空头通道里、与前一根K线重叠太多，而且收盘很弱（多头实体小）。这里没有对过度卖出做出明确的拒绝，而且你绝不该买入窄幅空头通道的第一次突破尝试，因为大多数在走得够剥一次头皮之前就失败了。最好的做法是先等一个二次入场再买入。强劲的交易者会在空头通道里、在前一根K线的高点及其上方做空，他们不会去找买入机会。


> A wedge bottom is not a buy signal when it is in a tight bear channel. As shown in Figure 5.11, bar 9 was a bear trend channel line overshoot reversal and a third push down (a wedge). However, it was not a strong bull signal bar because it was in a tight bear channel, it overlapped the prior bar too much, and it had a weak close (small bull body). There was no clear rejection of excessive selling, and you should never buy the first breakout attempt of a tight bear channel since most fail before going far enough to make a scalp. At best, you should wait for a second entry before buying. Strong traders would short at and above the high of the prior bar in a bear channel, and they would not be looking to buy.


任何买入了这个楔形的交易者，都会在第10根K线上遇到一个最小报价单位的失败。它是第三根横盘K线，所以聪明的交易者现在看到的是一段空头趋势里的交易区间，而这通常是持续形态。相互重叠的K线意味着市场在接受这些更低的价位，而不是拒绝它们。在空头趋势里买入之前，你需要一个拒绝的信号。依据「市场早该修正了」这种想法去做交易，是一种亏钱的做法。趋势能走得比大多数交易者所能想象的远得多。


> Bar 10 was a one-tick failure for any traders who bought the wedge. It was the third sideways bar, so smart traders were now seeing a trading range in a bear trend, which is usually a continuation pattern. Overlapping bars mean that the market is accepting these lower prices, not rejecting them. You need a sign of rejection before you buy in a bear trend. Basing a trade on a belief that the market is overdue for a correction is a losing approach to trading. Trends can go much further than most traders could ever imagine.


交易者本可以在第11根K线处做空那个低1，但这是一段交易区间，如果没有更强的多头陷阱，聪明的交易者不会在它的低点做空。这是第二次出现一个最小报价单位的突破失败。另外，楔形通常会有两次上涨尝试（两个上涨行情段），所以他们只会在这个楔形失败（也就是跌破第9根K线低点）时，或者第二次上涨尝试失败时才做空。


> A trader could have shorted the low 1 at bar 11, but this was a trading range and smart traders would not have shorted at its low without a stronger bull trap. It was a second one-tick failed breakout. Also, a wedge usually makes two attempts to rally (two legs up) so they would have shorted only if the wedge failed (i.e., fell below the bar 9 low), or if the second attempt to rally failed.


第12根K线是连续第三次出现一个最小报价单位的突破失败，但这一次它前面有两个上涨行情段（第9根和第11根K线），而且它是一个低2做空。这是聪明的交易者会做的第一笔交易，因为它是熊旗里的一个低2。让它格外好的是，让这个楔形向上反转的尝试失败了两次（第10根和第12根K线），而且两次都失败了。这两次代表了从楔形起的两个上涨行情段，而且它们明显很弱。另外，连续出现三次一个最小报价单位的失败非常罕见，所以接下来的走势很可能会跑起来。


> Bar 12 was a third one-tick failed breakout in a row, but this time it followed two legs up (bars 9 and 11) and was a low 2 short. This was the first trade that smart traders would have taken, because it was a low 2 in a bear flag. What made it especially good was that there were two failed attempts to make the wedge reverse upward (bars 10 and 12) and both failed. These represented the two legs up from the wedge and they were clearly weak. Also, it is very rare to have three one-tick failures in a row, so it was likely that the next move would run.


交易者也可以等到第9根K线的低点下方再做空，因为只有到那时这个楔形才算确定失败。突破时的巨大成交量（1分钟图上14,000手合约）证实，许多聪明的交易者都是等到那一刻才做空的。失败的楔形底部常常会走出一段大致相当于等距运动的下跌，这里就是如此。


> A trader could also have waited to short below the low of bar 9, because it was only then that the wedge definitively failed. The heavy volume on the breakout (14,000 contracts on the 1 minute chart) confirmed that many smart traders waited until that point to short. A failed wedge bottom often falls for about a measured move, as it did here.


要做多，你首先需要一次趋势线突破，而且最好有一根反转K线。由于第9根K线是一根很弱的反转K线，而你更倾向于在趋势通道线过靶并反转之后买入，所以本可以等第二次做多入场。第12根K线是二次入场，但它是在一个四根K线交易区间的顶部买入，而在空头趋势里你绝不该在熊旗上方买入。那个弱势的二次入场一旦失败，空头就接管了市场。那才是你该做的交易，而不是花太多精力说服自己那些做多建仓形态已经够格了。


> To buy, you first needed a trend line break and it was better to have a reversal bar. Since bar 9 was a weak reversal bar and you would be more inclined to buy after a trend channel line overshoot and reversal, you could have waited for a second long entry. Bar 12 was a second entry, but it was a purchase at the top of a four-bar trading range, and you should never buy above a bear flag in a bear trend. Once that weak second entry failed, the bears took control. That was the trade that you needed to take instead of spending too much energy convincing yourself that the long setups were adequate.


在第2根K线那个双顶的突破之后不久，交易者就会认出这一天是趋势性交易区间日。在这类空头趋势日里，通常两个方向都可以安全地交易，但做多是逆势的，所以建仓形态必须很强，比如第3根K线处，以及第4根K线之后两根K线处（二次入场做多）。跌到第7根K线的那段走势是一次突破，但市场没有形成多少第三段交易区间，而是形成了一条窄幅空头通道，随后再次向下破位。这成了从跌到第7根K线那段急速行情以来的一条向下空头通道。另一些交易者把那段急速行情看成第2根K线到第3根K线的走势，把通道看成第5根K线起的下跌走势。只要你能认出这一天是空头趋势、并努力保持空头仓位，怎么划分都无所谓。


> Traders would have recognized this day as a trending trading range day shortly after the breakout from the double top at bar 2. It is usually safe to trade in both directions on this type of bear trend day, but the longs are countertrend so the setups must be strong, like at bar 3 and two bars after bar 4 (second-entry long). The move down to bar 7 was a breakout, but instead of forming much of a third trading range, the market formed a tight bear channel and then broke to the downside again. This became a bear channel down from the spike down to bar 7. Other traders saw the spike as the move from bar 2 to bar 3 and the channel as the move down from bar 5. It does not matter as long as you recognize the day as a bear trend and work hard to stay short.


顺便说一句，第2根K线之前构成那个摆动低点的三根十字星K线形成了一个微型楔形。


> Incidentally, the three doji bars that formed the swing low before bar 2 created a micro wedge.


![图 5.12](figures/fig-05-12.jpg)


**图 5.12　连续的一个最小报价单位突破**


一个最小报价单位的突破可能很重要，尤其是连续出现两个的时候，因为那会构成一个三次推进形态。在图 5.12 中，第4根K线比第3根K线高一个最小报价单位，第5根K线比第4根K线高1个最小报价单位。如果随后出现一次回调或一段横盘，然后市场走到第5根K线上方，那就很可能出现一次向上突破，而这个微型楔形也就没能反转市场。


> One-tick breakouts can be important, especially if there are two in succession, because that creates a three-push pattern. In Figure 5.12, bar 4 was one tick above bar 3, and bar 5 was 1 tick above bar 4. If there was then a pullback or some sideways trading and then the market moved above bar 5, there would likely have been an upside breakout and the micro wedge would have failed to reverse the market.


第2根K线比第1根K线低两个最小报价单位，第6根K线比第2根K线低一个最小报价单位。又过了几根K线之后，第7根K线跌破第6根K线低点，带来一次向下突破。当市场从这些微型三次推进形态中突破出来时，通常至少会有一段等距运动，测量时用这个交易区间的顶部到底部。这里，这波突破走得远得多。


> Bar 2 was a couple of ticks below bar 1, and bar 6 was one tick below bar 2. After several more bars, bar 7 fell below the bar 6 low and led to a downside breakout. When the market breaks out of these micro three-push patterns, there is usually at least a measured move, using the top to the bottom of the trading range for the measurement. Here, the breakout went much further.


第8根K线是一个微型楔形底部，构成了一个单根K线的熊旗。它是市场正在停顿的信号；在强空头趋势里，它不是反转形态。


> Bar 8 was a micro wedge bottom, setting up a one-bar bear flag. It was a sign that the market was pausing; it was not a reversal pattern in a strong bear trend.


# 第 6 章　扩张三角形

*6. Expanding Triangles*


扩张三角形既可以是反转形态，也可以是持续形态，它由至少五段波段组成（有时七段，极少九段），每一段都比前一段更大。它的力量有一部分来自这一点：每一次新的突破都会把交易者套住。既然它是三角形，它就是一个交易区间，而交易区间里的大多数突破尝试都会失败。这种倾向就造就了扩张三角形。在多头反转（扩张三角形底部）中，它有足够的力量上涨到最后一个更高的高点之上，把多头套在场内；随后它崩跌到第三个低点，把多头关在场外，并在那个更低的低点上把空头套在场内；然后它向上反转，逼着多头和空头都追着市场往上买。这个新低就是第三次向下推进，可以看作一种三次推进形态，也可以看作一次突破回调——市场向上突破了最后一个摆动高点，随后又回调到一个更低的低点。在空头反转（扩张三角形顶部）中，它的表现正好相反。空头先被一个更低的低点套在场内，随后被迫离场；多头又被一个更高的高点套在场内；接着市场最后一次向下反转，双方都不得不追着往下卖。最初的目标是向三角形另一侧突破，而市场常常在那里再次尝试反转。如果这次反向反转成功，那么原来的反转就失败了，这个形态就变成原趋势中的一个持续形态。


> An expanding triangle can be either a reversal or a continuation pattern and is made of at least five swings (sometimes seven, and rarely nine), each one greater than the prior one. Part of its strength comes from its trapping traders on each new breakout. Since it is a triangle, it is a trading range, and most breakout attempts in a trading range fail. This tendency results in the expanding triangle. In a bullish reversal (an expanding triangle bottom), it has enough strength to rally above the last higher high, trapping longs in; it then collapses to a third low, trapping longs out and bears in on the lower low, and then reverses up, forcing both sides to chase the market up. The new low is the third push down and can be thought of as a type of three-push pattern, and it can also be thought of as a breakout pullback—the market broke above the last swing high and then pulled back to a lower low. In a bear reversal (an expanding triangle top), it does the opposite. Bears are trapped in by a lower low then are forced out, and bulls get trapped in by a higher high, and both then have to chase the market as it reverses down for the final time. The initial target is a breakout beyond the opposite side of the triangle, where the market often tries to reverse again.
