If it succeeds, then the reversal fails, and the pattern becomes a continuation pattern in the original trend.


比如，如果多头趋势中出现一个扩张三角形顶部（一种反转形态），第一个目标是向该形态下方突破；多数情况下，交易也就到此为止。如果突破成功，向下反转的下一个目标是一段等距运动，其高度大致等于三角形中最后一段向上行情的高度。如果突破失败、市场转而向上，那么这个三角形就变成一个持续形态——在这种情况下就是扩张三角形牛旗，因为它是多头趋势中的一个三角形。这时最初的目标是创出新高，通常交易也就差不多走到这里为止。如果这次突破成功，下一个目标是一段向上的等距运动，幅度大约是三角形中最后一段向下行情的大小。如果突破失败、市场转而向下，它现在就变成一个更大的扩张三角形顶部，有七段行情，而不是原来的五段。到了某个时点，要么是某次突破成功、市场走出一次大致的等距运动，要么是这个三角形演变成一个更大的交易区间。


> For example, if there is an expanding triangle top (a reversal pattern) in a bull trend, the first objective is a breakout below the pattern; in most cases, that is as far as the trade goes. If the breakout succeeds, the next objective in the reversal down is a measured move that is approximately the same height as the last leg up in the triangle. If the breakout fails and the market reverses up, then the triangle becomes a continuation pattern, which in this case would be an expanding triangle bull flag, since it is a triangle in a bull trend. The initial target would be a new high, and usually that is about as far as the trade goes. If the breakout succeeds, the next target is a measured move up that is about the size of the last leg down in the triangle. If the breakout fails and the market turns down, it is now a larger expanding triangle top with seven legs instead of the original five. At some point, either a breakout succeeds and the market makes an approximate measured move or the triangle evolves into a larger trading range.


三角形这个叫法容易让人误解，因为这个形态常常看上去一点都不像三角形。关键的一点是：它是一连串逐渐加大的更高的高点和更低的低点，不断把突破交易者套住；到某个时点，他们认输出局，于是所有交易者都站到同一边，趋势由此形成。它包含三次推进，可以看作三次推进反转形态的一个变体，只不过它的回调很深。比如，在空头趋势底部的多头反转中，两次回调都形成更高的高点；而在楔形底部（一个指向下方的收缩三角形）这类常规的三次推进形态里，两次回调都会形成更低的高点（也就是说，它不是扩张形态）。


> The term triangle is misleading, because the pattern often does not look anything like a triangle. The salient point is that it is a series of progressively greater higher highs and lower lows that continue to trap breakout traders, and at some point they capitulate and then all of the traders are on the same side, creating a trend. It has three pushes and can be viewed as a variation of a three-push reversal pattern, but with deep pullbacks. For example, in a bull reversal at the bottom of a bear trend, both pullbacks form higher highs; however, in a conventional three-push pattern like a wedge bottom (a contracting triangle that is pointing down), both pullbacks would form lower highs (i.e., not an expanding pattern).


所有扩张三角形都是主要趋势反转的变体，因为最后一次反转总是紧跟在一段强劲的行情之后。比如，在扩张三角形底部中，从最后一个低点开始的那波上涨行情，前面是一波强到能升破之前某个摆动高点的上涨行情，而那段上涨行情总会突破某条重要的空头趋势线。至少，第二次向下推进之后的那波上涨行情会向上突破限制那第二段下跌的空头趋势线，因此第三次向下推进就成了一个更低的低点主要趋势反转买入建仓形态。涨到第一段或第二段行情的那波上涨，通常也会突破另外某条重要的空头趋势线。


> All expanding triangles are variants of major trend reversals, because the final reversal always follows a strong leg. For example, in an expanding triangle bottom, the rally from the final low follows a rally that was strong enough to go above a prior swing high, and that rally always breaks some significant bear trend line. At a minimum, the rally from the second push down breaks above the bear trend line that contained that second leg down, and the third push down is therefore a lower low major trend reversal buy setup. The rally to the first or second leg usually also breaks above some other major bear trend line.


![图 6.1](figures/fig-06-01.jpg)


**图 6.1　Emini 小型合约中的扩张三角形底部**


空头趋势里的扩张三角形底部，往后常常会试图变成一个扩张三角形熊旗。在图 6.1 中，Emini 小型合约（Emini）从一次开盘反转处起涨，那次开盘反转来自第6根K线对移动平均线和昨日收盘价所做的缺口回调测试。第5根K线处的昨日低点与第1、2、3、4根K线一起，构成了一个扩张三角形底部。这是一个反转形态，因为在三角形出现之前趋势是向下的。第一个目标是创出一个新的摆动高点，它在第7根K线处达到。接着，市场通常会试着形成一个扩张三角形熊旗，那是持续形态，因为它是空头趋势中的一个交易区间。市场在第7根K线向上过靶多头趋势通道线时完成了这件事（这个三角形由第2、3、4、5、7根K线构成）。在趋势通道线突破失败之后，尤其是出现扩张三角形的时候，通常会出现一段两段式下跌。顺便说一句，扩张三角形不必有完美的形状，也不必碰到趋势通道线（第5根K线就没碰到）。


> An expanding triangle bottom in a bear trend often later tries to become an expanding triangle bear flag. In Figure 6.1, the Emini ran up off an opening reversal from the bar 6 gap pullback test of the moving average and yesterday’s close. Yesterday’s low at bar 5 formed an expanding triangle bottom with bars 1, 2, 3, and 4. This was a reversal pattern, since the trend was down prior to the triangle. The first objective was a new swing high, which was reached at bar 7. Then the market usually tries to form an expanding triangle bear flag, which is a continuation pattern since it is a trading range in a bear trend. It did that at the bar 7 overshoot of the bull trend channel line (the triangle was formed by bars 2, 3, 4, 5, and 7). After a trend channel line fails breakout, especially when there is an expanding triangle, there is usually a two-legged move down. Incidentally, expanding triangles don’t have to have a perfect shape and they do not have to touch the trend channel lines (bar 5 fell short).


涨到第7根K线的那波上涨行情非常强，但在这种情形下，交易区间顶部那个低2做空是值得一做的。第8根K线是连续第二根十字星，而十字星代表空头与多头之间的平衡。既然双方处于平衡，那个平衡点常常就是这波下跌的中点，也是一个大致的参考：市场为了找到足够的买盘把价格重新推上去，还可能再往下走多少。目标在第9根K线处被触及，但市场直到过靶空头趋势通道线、并在第10根K线那个楔形牛旗信号K线处向上反转之后，才开始上涨。第10根K线还精确到最小报价单位，回测了第6根K线信号K线上方那个最初的做多入场点（一次完美的突破回测）。


> The rally up to bar 7 was very strong, but the low 2 short at the top of the trading range was worth taking under these circumstances. Bar 8 was the second doji in a row, and dojis represent equilibrium between bears and bulls. Since they are in balance, that balance point is often the midpoint of the move down, and is a rough guide for how much further down the market might go in its search for enough buying power to swing the market back up. The target was hit at bar 9, but the market did not rally until after overshooting the bear trend channel line and reversing up at the bar 10 wedge bull flag signal bar. Bar 10 also tested the original long entry above the bar 6 signal bar to the exact tick (a perfect breakout test).


![图 6.2](figures/fig-06-02.jpg)


**图 6.2　扩张三角形底部反转**


在扩张三角形这种反转形态里，低点不断变得更低，高点不断变得更高。通常，反转之前会有五次转折，但有时会有七次，就像图 6.2 中那张 SPY 的 5分钟图一样。每一段行情通常都有充分的理由去剥头皮（比如在交易区间里，每一段都是一个新摆动高点或新摆动低点），但第五段走完之后，就可能会发展出一段更大的趋势，这时明智的做法是把一部分仓位拿去做波段。另外，这个形态一旦走完，它通常会构成一个反方向的扩张三角形。如果第一个是反转形态，那么这个形态的下一部分（方向相反）如果发展出来，就会是持续形态；反过来也一样。


> In an expanding triangle reversal pattern, the lows keep getting lower and the highs keep getting higher. Typically, there are five turns before the reversal, but sometimes there are seven, like in the 5 minute SPY chart presented in Figure 6.2. There are usually valid reasons to scalp each leg (for example, each leg is a new swing high or low in a trading range), but once the fifth leg is complete, a larger trend can develop and it is wise to swing part of the position. Also, once the pattern completes, it usually sets up an expanding triangle pattern in the opposite direction. If the first was a reversal pattern, then the next part of this pattern (which will be in the opposite direction), if it develops, will be a continuation pattern and vice versa.


第5根K线是第五段行情（第1根K线是第一段），因此是一个至少能向上走两段行情的买入建仓形态。不过，第6根K线是一个突破失败的做空建仓形态，也是一个小楔形（它是第5根K线急速上涨之后那段通道里三次小幅推进中的第三次）。这构成了一个扩张三角形熊旗，其中五段波段的第一段是第2根K线。


> Bar 5 was the fifth leg (bar 1 was the first) and therefore a buy setup for at least two legs up. However, bar 6 was a failed breakout short setup and a small wedge (it was the third of three small pushes in the channel after the spike up from bar 5). This created an expanding triangle bear flag, where the first of the five swings was bar 2.


第七段行情在第8根K线处出现了二次入场。第7根K线是新低处的第一个建仓形态，但它失败了——这也在意料之中，因为那次入场处在一个铁丝网形态里，多数交易者会等第二个信号。第8根K线也是第6根K线急速下跌之后那段小空头通道里的一个高3买入建仓形态，而第三次向下推进常常标志着急速与通道空头趋势形态的结束。


> The seventh leg had a second entry at bar 8. Bar 7 was the first setup at a new low, but it failed, as was expected since the entry was in a barbwire pattern and most traders would have waited for a second signal. Bar 8 was also a high 3 buy setup in the small bear channel after the spike down from bar 6, and the third push down often signals the end of a spike and channel bear trend pattern.


第10根K线测试了第8根K线的低点，但它的低点要高一个最小报价单位。它类似于扩张三角形的第九段行情（在交易中，相似通常就已经够了）。它既是对昨日低点的双底测试，又是交易区间底部的一个高2买入建仓形态，因此是一个不错的开盘反转买入建仓形态。


> Bar 10 tested the bar 8 low, but its low was one tick higher. It was similar to a ninth leg of an expanding triangle (in trading, similar is usually good enough). As a double bottom test of yesterday’s low and a high 2 buy setup at the bottom of a trading range, it was a good opening reversal buy setup.


第11根K线是向上突破开盘价高点之后的突破回调，尽管它并没有突破三角形中第9根K线的高点。它出现在一段可能是新多头趋势的走势中，前面是一波由五根K线组成的强劲多头急速行情，它是一个高1做多，因此也是一个可靠的买入建仓形态。


> Bar 11 was a breakout pullback from taking out the high of the open, even though it did not break above the bar 9 high of the triangle. It was a high 1 long after a strong five-bar bull spike in a possible new bull trend and therefore a reliable buy setup.


第12根K线是交易区间顶部的一个低2（扩张三角形本身就是交易区间），在这张 SPY 图上还是一次只差一个最小报价单位的空头突破失败。不过，Emini 小型合约的图（未给出）守在了那根反转K线的低点上方，没有触发这个形态。Emini 给出的虚假信号更少，因为它的一个最小报价单位相当于 SPY 的 2.5 个最小报价单位。由于上涨动能强到可能已经有一段多头趋势正在展开，交易者应当先等着看是否形成更低的高点，再考虑做空。


> Bar 12 was a low 2 at the top of a trading range (an expanding triangle is a trading range) and a one-tick bear breakout failure on this SPY chart. The Emini chart, however (not shown), held above the reversal bar’s low and did not trigger the pattern. The Emini gives fewer false signals because each tick is equivalent to 2.5 ticks in the SPY. Since the up momentum was strong enough so that a bull trend might be underway, traders should have waited to see if a lower high formed before considering taking shorts.


第13根K线是第9根K线上方那个突破失败做空的二次入场，但这波上涨行情之前同样没有出现趋势线突破，所以在之前没有出现任何空头力量的情况下做空并不明智。空头应当等到出现更低的高点再做空。


> Bar 13 was a second entry for the breakout failure short above bar 9, but again there was no trend line break earlier in the rally, so it would have been unwise to short in the absence of some earlier bear strength. Bears should have waited for a lower high before shorting.


第12根K线和第13根K线并不是突破失败，而是一段新多头趋势中的突破回调。


> Instead of breakout failures, bars 12 and 13 were breakout pullbacks in a new bull trend.


![图 6.3](figures/fig-06-03.jpg)


**图 6.3　扩张三角形反转中的二次入场**


如图 6.3 所示，第1根到第5根K线构成了扩张三角形底部的五段行情。入场点设在第5根K线那个更低的低点上方一个最小报价单位处。第6根K线在跌到新低之前，没能突破第4根K线的高点。第7根K线是这个扩张三角形上的第二次入场机会，但第5根与第7根之间隔了这么多根K线，三角形已经失去了影响力，这里只是当日新低处的一次双底反转。


> As shown in Figure 6.3, bars 1 to 5 created the five legs of the expanding triangle bottom. The entry was one tick above the bar 5 lower low. Bar 6 failed to take out the high of bar 4 before dropping to a new low. Bar 7 was a second-chance entry at the expanding triangle, but with this many bars between bars 5 and 7, the triangle had lost its influence and this had become just a double bottom reversal from a new low on the day.


第8根K线形成了一个更高的低点，它同时又是对第5根和第7根K线双底的一次双底回调做多。


> Bar 8 formed a higher low that was also a double bottom pullback long from the bars 5 and 7 double bottom.


在到达创出新摆动高点这个目标之后，第9根K线构成了一个扩张三角形熊旗（第2、3、4、7、9根K线），这笔空单的目标是跌到第7根K线低点下方。不过，这些越来越大的三角形，终究会有一个失败，趋势也就随之启动。顺便说一句，第二天开盘时市场跳空到第7根K线下方，到达了目标。由于第4根与第9根之间的间隔比第2根与第4根之间大得多，比例关系很差。当形态如此不寻常时，信任它的交易者会更少，这削弱了这个形态。不过，交易者仍然把第9根K线看作空头交易区间的顶部、与昨日高点构成的双顶熊旗，以及对昨日高点上方缺口的测试，这些理由已经足够做空了。


> After reaching the target of a new swing high, bar 9 set up an expanding triangle bear flag (bars 2, 3, 4, 7, and 9), and this short had a target of below the bar 7 low. Eventually, however, one of these increasing larger triangles fails and a trend begins. Incidentally, the market gapped below bar 7 on the open of the next day, reaching the target. The proportionality was bad since the spacing between bars 4 and 9 was so much greater than between bars 2 and 4. When the shape is that unconventional, fewer traders will trust it and that weakens the pattern. However, traders still saw bar 9 as the top of a bear trading range, a double top bear flag with yesterday’s high, and a test of the gap above yesterday’s high, and those are reasons enough to go short.


# 第 7 章　最终旗形

*7. Final Flags*


趋势一旦结束，交易者回头看走势图，就能看出这段趋势里的最终旗形。最终旗形反转很常见，因为每一次反转都跟在某种旗形之后，所以它本身也是一种最终旗形反转。如果交易者明白，是什么让一面旗形很可能成为趋势反转前的最后一面旗，他就有条件预判并交易这次趋势反转。


> Once a trend ends, traders can look at the chart and see the final flag in the trend. Final flag reversals are common because every reversal follows some kind of flag and therefore is a type of final flag reversal. If a trader understands what makes a flag likely to be the last one before the trend reverses, he is in a position to anticipate and trade the trend reversal.


以下是最终旗形中常见的几个特征：


> Here are several characteristics that are common in final flags:


这面旗形出现在一段已经走了几十根K线的趋势里；因此趋势交易者可能开始止盈，逆势交易者可能变得更激进。双方都会认为这段趋势已经走过了头，因此容易出现一次更大的两段式修正，并演变成更大的交易区间甚至反转。这面旗形大体横盘，并且带有强烈的双向交易迹象，比如有若干根反方向的趋势K线、带明显影线的K线、若干次反转，以及与前一根K线重叠至少50% 的K线。第2册讲交易区间的第四部分给出了更多双向交易的迹象。微型趋势线的突破回调属于一根K线或微型最终旗形。例如，当价格向上突破一条空头微型趋势线、随后市场转跌时，那一两根K线的突破往往就成了微型空头趋势中的最终熊旗。如果这波抛售在一两根K线之内就失败，随后市场从一个更低的低点、双底或更高的低点转涨，那么最后这波抛售就是突破回调，而原先那波小突破则成了微型空头趋势中的最终旗形。如果突破最终旗形之后出现反转，但市场只回调几根K线就恢复原趋势，这次回调就变成了仍在延续的趋势中的突破回调，而不是反转，这面最终旗形也就没能让市场反转。


> The flag occurs in a trend that has gone on for dozens of bars; therefore the trend traders might begin to take profits and the countertrend traders might become more aggressive. Both will believe that the trend is overdone and is therefore prone to have a larger two-legged correction and evolve into a larger trading range or even a reversal. The flag is mostly horizontal and has signs of strong two-sided trading, such as several trend bars in the opposite direction, bars with prominent tails, several reversals, and bars that overlap the previous bar by at least 50 percent. Part IV in book 2 on trading ranges gives more signs of two-sided trading. A micro trend line breakout pullback is of a one-bar or micro final flag. For example, when there is a break above a bear micro trend line and the market reverses down, that one-or two-bar breakout often becomes the final bear flag in the micro bear trend. If the sell-off fails within a bar or two and then the market reverses back up from a lower low, double bottom, or higher low, this last sell-off is the breakout pullback and the original small breakout becomes the final flag in the micro bear trend. If there is a reversal after breaking out of a final flag, but it only pulls back for a few bars and then the trend resumes, the pullback has become a breakout pullback in an ongoing trend instead of a reversal, and the final flag has failed to reverse the market.


最终旗形有时只带来短暂反转，随后又形成一面更大的旗形，而这面更大的旗形可能突破，也可能反转。在这种演变发生之前，你通常能从最终旗形反转的入场点赚到一笔剥头皮交易者的利润，而演变后的形态通常会再给出一个做多或做空的信号。有时会出现连续两面横盘旗形，第二面更小，而从第二面旗形的突破可能带来一次楔形反转。如果最终旗形形成于一次高潮之后，这次突破失败可能不会越过先前的趋势极值。例如，如果出现一次空头高潮，随后在低点上方形成一个横盘交易区间，它就可能成为一面最终旗形，突破之后市场会从一个更高的低点或一个更低的低点转涨。有时一面最终旗形可能只有一两根K线长，形成于一波强劲急速行情之后，而这波急速行情由几根异常大的趋势K线组成（一次潜在的衰竭高潮）。从这面小旗形的突破往往在一两根K线后反转，并且通常带来一次持续10根K线以上的两段式回调。这是一个可交易的逆势建仓形态，但它并不会可靠地带来趋势反转。那些大趋势K线所显示的强劲动能，常常在10到20根K线之内引来一次对趋势极值的测试。一根K线的最终旗形可以是任何类型的停顿K线。例如，如果市场刚刚出现连续两次卖出高潮，而接下来的一根K线是一根多头十字星，那么即使它的低点低于卖出高潮的低点，这根十字星也可以成为空头趋势中的最终旗形。如果接下来的一两根K线是一波大的空头急速行情、随后市场转涨，那么这根停顿K线就是一根K线的最终旗形。窄幅交易区间常常成为最终旗形。任何横盘交易都有磁力。由于突破通常会失败，市场通常会被拉回区间——在那里，多头和空头都认同存在价值。有时根本不会突破，最终旗形干脆长成了一段新趋势。这种情况常常发生在连续高潮之后的反转中。交易者看到市场已经走过了头，预计不久就会有一次修正，但又认为这次突破能走得足够远、够再做一次剥头皮。于是他们在潜在最终旗形的突破处入场，但一入场就想着尽快离场，而不愿意持仓做波段。人人都想赚小钱，突破很快就反转了。


> Final flags sometimes reverse briefly only to form a larger flag, which can break out or reverse. You will usually be able to make a scalper’s profit off the final flag reversal entry before the evolution takes place, and the evolved pattern will typically result in another signal in either direction. Sometimes there will be two consecutive horizontal flags with the second one being smaller, and the breakout from the second one can lead to a wedge reversal. If the final flag forms after a climax, the failed breakout may not exceed the prior trend extreme. For example, if there is a bear climax and then a horizontal trading range above the low, this could become a final flag with the breakout reversing up after either a higher low or a lower low. Sometimes a final flag can be only one or two bars long and develop after a strong spike that is composed of several unusually large trend bars (a potential exhaustive climax). The breakout from that small flag often reverses after a bar or two and usually results in a two-legged pullback that lasts for 10 bars or more. This is a tradable countertrend setup, but it does not reliably lead to a trend reversal. The strong momentum demonstrated by those large trend bars frequently is followed by a test of the trend extreme within 10 to 20 bars. The one-bar final flag can be any type of pause bar. For example, if the market just had two consecutive sell climaxes, and the next bar is a bull doji, even if its low is below the low of the sell climax, the doji can become the final flag in the bear trend. If the next bar or two is a large bear spike and then the market reverses up, the pause bar is a one-bar final flag. Tight trading ranges often become final flags. Any sideways trading has a magnetic pull. Since breakouts usually fail, the market usually gets drawn back into the range where both bulls and bears agree that there is value. Sometimes there is no breakout, and the final flag just grows into a new trend. This often happens as a reversal after consecutive climaxes. Traders see that the market is overdone and expect a correction soon, but think that the breakout will go far enough for one more scalp. They therefore enter on the breakout of the potential final flag, but are looking to exit soon after entering, rather than being willing to hold for a swing. With everyone looking to take small profits, the breakout quickly reverses.


回头看任何一张出现过趋势反转的走势图，你都会发现，那段趋势是由一连串急速行情和回调组成的，而这些回调就是旗形。如果你研究那段趋势里的最终旗形，就会发现它给出了线索：趋势即将结束，变成交易区间，或者变成一段反方向的趋势。交易区间可以走出很长的行情段，看起来像趋势反转，但在更大时间级别的走势图上，它通常只是变成一次大幅回调。不过，这些行情段通常大得足以做一笔盈利的波段交易。交易者并不确定这次反转会是一段新趋势还是一次大修正，而他们对待两者的交易方式是一样的。他们在第一段或第二段之后部分或全部止盈，并打算在回调中加仓。如果出现一波顺着原趋势方向的强劲行情，他们可能会继续持仓，去测试老趋势的极值。


> When you look at any chart where there is a trend reversal, you see that the trend was made up of a series of spikes and pullbacks, which are flags. If you study the final flag in that trend, you will discover that it gave clues that the trend was about to end and become either a trading range or an opposite trend. The trading range can have protracted legs and appear to be a trend reversal, but usually becomes just a large pullback on a higher time frame chart. However, those legs are usually big enough for a profitable swing trade. Traders are not certain if the reversal will be a new trend or a large correction, and they trade both the same way. They take partial or full profits after the first or second leg and look to add on during a pullback. If there is a strong move in the direction of the original trend, they might hold on to their position for a test of the old trend’s extreme.


每一次回调都有双向交易，但当这波回调大体横盘、许多K线大幅重叠、区间内出现多次反转、并且有多根K线的实体方向与趋势相反时，双向交易就格外明显。最终旗形可以是任意大小的交易区间，甚至只有一根K线，不过它通常至少有5到10根K线。双向交易意味着多头和空头都认同：在这个价位建仓有价值。空头在大力做空，因为他们相信交易区间会向下突破；多头在大力买入，因为他们相信突破会向上。每当价格飘到交易区间顶部，或者向上突破区间顶部并连走几根K线，空头就认为这里更值得卖，做空也更狠。多头则认为区间顶部略微偏贵，买得就更少。结果空头能把价格压回去。当价格走到区间底部或向下突破时，情况正好相反：多头觉得价值更好，空头却觉得价格已经太低、不适合大力做空。这又让市场重新回到区间中部。所有交易区间里都在发生同样的过程，牛旗和熊旗也不例外。结果是这些交易区间的中部产生一种磁力效应，多数突破尝试都走不远，就被拉回交易区间里。


> Every pullback has two-sided trading, but when the pullback is mostly horizontal, has many bars that largely overlap, has several reversals within the range, and has several bars with bodies in the direction opposite to the trend, then the two-sided trading is especially pronounced. The final flag can be a trading range of any size, including just a single bar, although it usually has at least five to 10 bars. The two-sided trading means that both the bulls and the bears agree that there is value at this level to initiate trades. The bears are shorting aggressively because they believe that the trading range will break to the downside, and the bulls are buying aggressively because they believe that the breakout will be to the upside. Whenever the price drifts to the top of the trading range or breaks out of the top of the range and runs for several bars, the bears see it as an even better value, and they short even more strongly. The bulls see the top of the range as a little expensive, and they buy less. This results in the bears being able to push the price back down. When it gets to the bottom of the range or has a downside breakout, the opposite happens and the bulls think that the value is even better, but the bears think that it is getting too low to short heavily. This makes the market work back up into the middle of the range. The same process takes place in all trading ranges, including bull and bear flags, and the result is that there is a magnetic effect in the middle of these trading ranges, and most breakout attempts do not go far before the market is pulled back into the trading range.


这样的旗形出现在一段已经走了几十根K线的趋势之后时，它往往就成了这段趋势的最终旗形。突破之后，顺趋势的交易者更关心止盈、并等一次深度修正之后再入场；逆势交易者则会在趋势试图恢复时反向操作，因为他们预期至少有一次两段式修正。例如，如果有一段已经走了几十根K线的多头趋势，它可能已经准备好来一次更大的修正甚至反转，交易者就会留意它是否形成一面大体横盘的牛旗。由于多头趋势仍然有效，交易者愿意买入突破，但只想要一次剥头皮，而不是波段。旗形形成期间在做空的空头会买回空单。他们的买盘推动了这波上涨，但他们一心想着在市场到达某个阻力位时再次做空——这个阻力位可能是他们预计多头会剥头皮离场的某个固定最小报价单位数，也可能是某个等距运动目标位。多头则在入场后不久就为了小赚一笔迅速卖掉多单。激进的空头和多头看到的是同一件事，于是开始在多头卖出的位置照样卖出。多头和空头都预期价格走低，就再没有人留下来买入，市场于是转跌，至少够做一次剥头皮。如果这波下跌很强，多头就不愿买入，空头也不急着止盈，直到出现修正即将结束的信号。这次反转可能带来一次回调、一次更大的修正（比如交易区间），或者一次趋势反转。


> When one develops after a trend has gone on for a few dozen bars, it often becomes the final flag in the trend. After the breakout, the with-trend traders are more interested in taking profits and waiting for a deep correction before entering again, and the countertrend traders will fade the attempt at trend resumption since they expect at least a two-legged correction. For example, if there is a bull trend that has been going on for dozens of bars and it might be ready for a larger correction or even a reversal, traders will watch to see if it forms a bull flag that is mostly horizontal. Since the bull trend is still in effect, traders are willing to buy the breakout, but are looking for only a scalp, not a swing. The bears who were shorting during the flag will buy back their shorts. Their buying contributes to the move up, but they are eager to short again once the market reaches some resistance level, which might be a fixed number of ticks where they think the bulls will scalp out of longs or might be some measured move target. The bulls quickly sell out of their longs for a small profit soon after entering. Aggressive bears see the same thing as the bulls and begin to sell exactly where the bulls are selling. With the bulls and the bears both expecting lower prices, there is no one left to buy and the market reverses down, at least for a scalp. If the move down is strong, the bulls will not be willing to buy and the bears will not be eager to take profits until there are signs that the correction is ending. The reversal can lead to a pullback, a larger correction (like a trading range), or a trend reversal.


正如前面第 3 章讨论双底与双顶时所说，最终旗形由同样的基本行为造成。例如，如果多头趋势里出现一个潜在最终旗形，那么在旗形形成之前会先有一波向上推进。旗形向上的突破就是对那个多头高点的测试。如果市场向上测试时卖方多于买方，市场就会从这第二次向上推进处转跌。尽管背后的力量相同，最终旗形的外观却足够不同，并且有若干独特性质，值得把它单独归为一种形态。空头趋势里的最终旗形同样如此，它无非是两波下跌之后转涨。最终旗形的向下突破就是第二波下跌，也是对空头趋势力度的测试——这段趋势正是因为停顿下来形成最终旗形才被打断的。


> As was discussed earlier in Chapter 3 about double bottoms and tops, final flags are caused by the same basic behavior. For example, if there is a potential final flag in a bull trend, there is a push up just before the flag forms. The upside breakout of the flag is a test of that bull high. If more sellers than buyers come in as the market tests up, the market will reverse down from this second push up. Although the underlying force is the same, a final flag looks sufficiently different and has several distinctive properties that warrant its being classified as a separate pattern. The same is true of a final flag in a bear trend, which is just a pair of moves down and then a reversal up. The bear breakout of the final flag is the second move down and a test of the strength of the bear trend that paused to create the final flag.


许多多头和空头会在牛旗向上突破后不久就卖出，如果人数够多，市场就会开始反转。如果出现一个空头反转建仓形态，交易者会更加确信随后会有一次更大的修正；更多多头会卖掉多单，更多空头会开始做空。如果向下的反转以跌破空头反转K线一个最小报价单位的方式触发，市场就会被拉回那面最终旗形里。它可能就此停住，但市场通常至少会走出一次两段式的横盘到下跌修正，而且常常会走成趋势反转。如果旗形里（或更早之前）出现过一段强劲的空头行情且大幅跌破多头趋势线——那是卖压的信号——趋势反转的可能性就更大。如果原趋势持续了50到100根K线，那么这次反转更可能演变成一面大旗形，而不是一段反方向的趋势。记住，趋势有巨大的惯性，倾向于抵抗所有反转尝试。不过，每一次反转往往都比上一次更大，最终总会有一次成功，把趋势反转为反方向的趋势。


> Many bulls and bears will sell soon after the bull breakout of a bull flag, and if enough do, the market will begin to reverse. If a bear reversal setup develops, traders will become more confident that a bigger correction will follow; more bulls will sell out of their longs, and more bears will begin to short. If the reversal down triggers by moving one tick below the bear reversal bar, the market will get drawn back into that final flag. It may stop there, but the market usually forms at least a two-legged sideways to down correction and often a trend reversal. The trend reversal is more likely if there was a strong bear leg (a sign of selling pressure) in the flag, or earlier, that broke well below the bull trend line. If the original trend lasted for 50 to 100 bars, then the reversal will more likely evolve into a large flag rather than a trend in the opposite direction. Remember, trends have tremendous inertia and tend to resist all reversal attempts. However, each reversal tends to be larger than the one before, and eventually one will succeed in reversing the trend into an opposite trend.


持续时间长的高潮，常常在短暂最终旗形的突破之后结束。例如，如果出现一波强劲的四根K线多头急速行情，实体都很大，而第四根异常大，它往往会引来短暂的抛售，因为交易者会把这波急速行情看作一次潜在买入高潮。多头和空头都在等这样的大K线。多头会利用这份强势，在很高的价位上部分止盈；激进的空头则卖出，开始做空剥头皮。结果往往是一次回调。不过，由于这波多头急速行情太强，通常在前一根K线低点处及其下方会有强劲买盘。多头在买，是要重建自己完整的多单；空头在买，是在买回他们的空头剥头皮。结果这次回调只持续一到几根K线，就变成一个高1或高2的买入建仓形态。多头会在前一根K线高点上方买入，如果市场突破原先那波多头急速行情的顶部，许多人也会买入。


> Protracted climaxes often end after breakouts from brief final flags. For example, if there is a strong four-bar bull spike and if the bodies are large and the fourth one is unusually large, it will often lead to brief selling because traders will see the spike as a potential buy climax. Both the bulls and the bears wait for big bars like this. The bulls will use the strength as an opportunity to take partial profits at a very high price, and aggressive bears will sell to initiate short scalps. The result is often a pullback. However, since the bull spike was so strong, there will usually be strong buying at and below the low of the prior bar. The bulls are buying to reestablish their full long positions, and the bears are buying back their short scalps. The result is that the pullback only lasts from one to a few bars and becomes a high 1 or 2 buy setup. Bulls will buy above the high of the prior bar, and many will also buy if the market breaks above the top of the original bull spike.


由于这面旗形跟在可能走得太远、太快的一波强劲多头急速行情之后，许多交易者会只把牛旗突破当作一次剥头皮。他们会迅速赚走剥头皮的那点利润。他们的止盈，加上激进空头的做空，可能在牛旗突破一两根K线之后就把市场打回去。这段短暂的突破往往由一根或多根强劲的多头趋势K线组成，因此又是另一次潜在的买入高潮。如果有足够多的交易者把它看作连续买入高潮（原先那波多头急速行情是第一次），许多人就只会在回调形成之后才考虑再次买入——这次回调至少要有两段，并持续大约10根K线。许多人会做空，预期这次更大的回调。如果向下的反转正好出现在一个重要的阻力位，许多交易者会把这波上涨仅仅看作对阻力位的一次上涨真空测试，并且愿意接受趋势反转的可能。他们会观察这波下跌的力度。如果它又慢又弱，交易者会预期它变成一次回调，并指望多头趋势不久就恢复。如果它带有很多空头实体，他们就不急着买入，市场于是不得不向下试探去找买家。有时市场会进入空头趋势，而即使原先那波多头急速行情非常强、最终旗形只有一根K线，这种情况也可能发生。许多反转发生在第二次向上推进之后，这实际上构成了一个双顶。两个顶部常常价位不同，形成的是更高的高点或更低的高点，但合起来表现得像一个双顶，因此永远都该被看作同一价格行为的不同表现形式。


> Since the flag followed a strong bull spike that might have gone too far, too fast, many traders will treat the bull flag breakout as only a scalp. They will quickly take their scalper’s profit. Their profit taking, along with shorting by aggressive bears, can quickly turn the market back down after a one-or two-bar breakout of the bull flag. This brief breakout is often made of one or more strong bull trend bars, and therefore is another potential buy climax. If enough traders see this as consecutive buy climaxes (the original bull spike was the first), many will only look to buy again after a pullback forms that has at least two legs and lasts about 10 bars. Many will short, expecting the larger pullback. If the reversal down came at a significant resistance level, many traders will see the move up as simply a buy vacuum test of the resistance level and will be open to the possibility of a trend reversal. They will watch the strength of the move down. If it is slow and weak, traders will expect it to become a pullback and will look for the bull trend to resume before long. If it has many bear bodies, they will not be eager to buy, and the market then has to probe lower to find buyers. Sometimes the market will enter a bear trend, and this can happen even if the original bull spike was very strong and the final flag was only a single bar. Many reversals happen after a second push, which essentially forms a double top. The two tops are often at different prices and form either a higher high or a lower high, but together behave like a double top and should always be considered to be different manifestations of the same price action.


当市场处在强劲急速行情中，随后出现一根带影线或反方向实体的K线时，交易者往往预期还会有一次小的最后推进，然后是一次回调。例如，如果有一波强劲的空头急速行情，由连续四根大的空头趋势K线组成、大多收在低点附近，许多交易者会在每根K线的收盘处附近做空。如果接下来那根K线在底部有一根长影线，或是一根多头实体，那么空头趋势仍然完好，但交易者相信回调近在眼前。许多人会在这根K线的收盘处做空，但只打算持到剥头皮的目标，认为这笔交易是这波急速行情里的最后一次剥头皮。正因为把它看作最后一次剥头皮，他们之后就不打算再卖，至少要等到一次小幅回调。既然没人愿意继续在急速行情底部卖出，市场就会上涨，去寻找一个高得足以让空头再次做空的价位。激进的空头明白这一点，于是会在急速行情底部、也就是他们判断空头会买回最后一次空头剥头皮的地方买入。多头和空头同时买，市场就往上走。这波上涨通常至少够多头剥头皮离场，但也可能持续5到10根K线。由于它是这波强劲空头急速行情里的第一次回调，上方会有卖家。当市场走到前一根K线高点上方时，多头和空头都会卖出，凭任何其他小小的理由也会卖，因为他们都确信回调会很短暂的概率很高。多头和空头一起卖出，带来至少再一波向下推进，这波下跌甚至可能走成一个通道，并按这波急速行情的高度达到一次等距运动。而另一种极端情况下，它也可能只是一次最终旗形突破，随后引出一波向上反转。那么，这波五根K线的空头急速行情和最终旗形有什么关系？急速行情底部的那根影线或那根多头K线告诉交易者：在回调之前还会有一次向下推进，它会跌得足够远、够做一次剥头皮，但市场很可能会很快转涨。这意味着他们把那个影线或那根多头实体看成了一个微型最终旗形，而它在更小时间级别的走势图上肯定是一面最终旗形。交易者不必去看更小时间级别的走势图来验证这一点，因为他们知道事情必然如此，否则那根影线或那根多头实体就不会形成。


> When the market is in a strong spike and it then has a bar with a tail or opposite body, traders often expect one small final push and then a pullback. For example, if there is a strong bear spike with four consecutive large bear trend bars mostly closing near their lows, many traders will short around the close of each bar. If the next bar has a big tail on the bottom or a bull body, the bear trend is intact, but traders believe that a pullback is imminent. Many will short the close of this bar, but will hold only for a scalp, expecting the trade to be the final scalp in the spike. Because they see this as the final scalp, they will then not look to sell again until there is at least a small pullback. With no one willing to continue to sell at the bottom of the spike, the market will move up in search of a price that is high enough for the bears to once again short. Aggressive bulls know this and will buy at the bottom of the spike exactly where they think that the bears will be buying back their final short scalp. With both the bulls and the bears buying, the market moves up. The move up is usually at least enough for the bulls to scalp out of their longs, but it might last for five to 10 bars. Since it is the first pullback in a strong bear spike, there will be sellers above. Both the bulls and the bears will sell as the market moves above the high of the prior bar, and for any other small reason, because both are confident that the probability that the pullback will be brief is high. The selling by both the bulls and the bears results in at least one more push down, and the move down might even become a channel that reaches a measured move, based on the height of the spike. At the other extreme of possibilities, it also might be only a final flag breakout that leads to a reversal up. So how is that five-bar bear spike related to final flags? That tail or bull bar at the bottom of the spike told traders that there would be one more push down before a pullback and that it would go far enough down for a scalp, but that the market would likely reverse up quickly. This means that they saw the tail or the bull body as a micro final flag, and it was certainly a final flag on a smaller time frame chart. Traders don’t have to look at smaller time frame charts to verify this, because they know that it has to be the case, or else that tail or bull body would not have formed.


最终牛旗有三种突破方式。第一，突破可以强到越过多头趋势的前高，随后市场以更高的高点反转的形式转跌。第二，突破可以弱一些，市场在先前高点下方以更低的高点反转的形式转跌。第三，可能根本没有多少突破，甚至完全没有向上突破。例如，牛旗可能形成一个高2或高3的买入信号，但入场K线只在信号K线上方走了一两个最小报价单位就转跌；或者它根本不曾越过前一根K线的高点，就直接向下突破。如果牛旗向下突破，这波突破通常是一段急速行情，随后跟着一条空头通道，延伸到某种等距运动。如果没有明确的突破，牛旗只是一路长成一条更大的空头通道，那么到某个时点，交易者就会放弃牛旗这个前提，把这条通道看作空头趋势。这种情况发生时，通常起头至少有一根一根K线的空头急速行情。当那根空头趋势K线形成时，有经验的交易者会琢磨它是否强到足以带出一条空头通道，许多人会一直试图在前几根K线的高点上方做空，以防真的形成空头趋势。这面牛旗虽然从未向上突破，却正是多头趋势中的最终旗形。


> A final bull flag has three ways to break out. First, the breakout can be strong enough to go above the old high of the bull trend and then the market reverses down in a higher high reversal. Alternatively, the breakout can be weaker, and the market can reverse down below the prior high in the form of a lower high reversal. Finally, there might not be much of a breakout at all, or even no upside breakout. For example, the bull flag might form a high 2 or a high 3 buy signal, but the entry bar reverses down after going only a tick or two above the signal bar, or it could simply break to the downside without ever going above the high of the prior bar. If there is a downside breakout of the bull flag, the breakout is usually a spike that is then followed by a bear channel that extends for some type of measured move. If there is no clear breakout and the bull flag just keeps growing into a larger bear channel, at some point traders will give up on the bull flag premise and see the channel as a bear trend. When this happens, there will usually have been at least a one-bar bear spike at the start. When that bear trend bar formed, experienced traders would have wondered if it was strong enough to lead to a bear channel, and many would have been shorting above the highs of the previous bars, just in case a bear trend developed. The bull flag, even though it never broke out to the upside, was the final flag in the bull trend.


面对任何一面牛旗，做回调的交易者都会买入，并打算在市场测试趋势极值（最近的高点）时离场。他们更愿意在前高上方止盈，但会仔细观察市场是否在前高下方停顿。如果停顿，他们就迅速止盈，而且只有再出现一次回调时才会重新买入。他们的卖出，以及他们为了等回调至少几根K线之内不愿买入，造成了一个更低的高点，而不是更高的高点。由于剥头皮交易者通常就在前高处及其上方一点点止盈，多头趋势里的多数新高遇到的是止盈者，而不是新买家。于是多数新高之后跟着的是回调，而不是长久的突破和新的一段上涨。不过，由于多数反转尝试都会失败，多数新高并不会带来转成空头趋势的反转。反转看上去往往很强，但通常之后只是又一面牛旗。多头会买这波回调，空头会为自己的空头剥头皮止盈，市场会再次测试那个高点。最终，总会有一面牛旗是最终牛旗，它之后会跟着一次更大的修正或一次反转；如果有迹象显示这将要发生，有经验的交易者就会做空。


> With any bull flag, pullback traders buy and look to exit on a test of the trend’s extreme (the most recent high). They prefer to take profits above the old high, but watch carefully to see if the market stalls below it. If so, they quickly take profits and will buy again only if there is another pullback. Their selling, and their unwillingness to buy for at least a couple more bars while they wait for a pullback, results in a lower high instead of a higher high. Because scalpers usually take profits at and just above the prior high, most new highs in bull trends find profit takers instead of new buyers. This results in most new highs being followed by pullbacks instead of protracted breakouts and new legs up. However, since most reversal attempts fail, most new highs do not result in reversals into bear trends. The reversal often looks strong, but is usually followed by just another bull flag. Bulls will buy the pullback and bears will take profits on their short scalps, and the market will test the high again. Eventually, one will be the final bull flag and it will be followed by a bigger correction or a reversal, and if there are signs that this will happen, experienced traders will go short.


同样，空头趋势里的最终旗形也可以向下突破、并从一个更低的低点或更高的低点转涨；也可以压根没有向下突破，只是直接向上突破。可能出现一次失败的低2或低3做空，随后以一根大号多头趋势K线的形式转涨。这波多头急速行情成为一段新多头波段行情的起点，而那个熊旗此时就会被看作空头趋势里的最终旗形，尽管它从未向下突破。这波向上的突破是一个信号：交易者认为始终入场交易已经从做空翻转为做多。


> Similarly, the final flag in a bear trend can also break out to the downside and reverse up from a lower low or a higher low, or it can simply break out to the upside without ever breaking out to the downside. There can be a failed low 2 or low 3 short and then a reversal up in the form of a large bull trend bar. This bull spike becomes the beginning of a new bull swing, and the bear flag will then be seen as the final flag in the bear trend, even though it never had a downside breakout. The bull breakout is the sign that the traders believe that the always-in trade has flipped from short to long.


如果有理由相信一段空头波段行情可能即将结束，随后市场开始形成一面熊旗，交易者可能会认为这面熊旗给出的低1或低2做空入场会失败。如果他们预期这面熊旗不会出现显著的向下突破，反而认为市场会套住空头、然后向上突破，他们就可以反向操作低1和低2建仓形态。例如，如果在一个交易区间日出现一个楔形底部并且开始转涨，交易者会预期楔形的低点守得住。由于他们认为趋势现在可能转为向上，他们就想买回调。回调可以小到只有一根K线。由于上涨大概会有两段，第一段下跌就不应该走远。那笔低1做空应该失败，变成新多头行情段里一次小幅更高的低点回调，而这些多头会预期至少有一波两段式上涨、持续10根K线以上。低1做空唯一可靠的时候，是强空头趋势的急速行情阶段，绝不是在反转形态之后。那笔低1做空入场很可能无力跌破楔形低点，转而在两段式向上的修正中形成一个小幅更高的低点。正因如此，交易者会把限价买单挂在那个做空信号K线的低点处，或者低点下方一到三个最小报价单位，预期形成的是一个小幅更高的低点，而不是一笔盈利的低1做空。在 Emini 小型合约上，他们通常只需冒四个最小报价单位的风险。


> If there are reasons to believe that a bear swing might be ending and it then begins to form a bear flag, traders might think that the low 1 or low 2 short entries from that bear flag will fail. If they are expecting no significant bear breakout from this bear flag and instead think that the market will trap bears and then break out to the upside, they can fade the low 1 and low 2 setups. For example, if there is a wedge bottom on a trading range day that is beginning to reverse up, traders will expect the low of the wedge to hold. Since they believe that the trend might now be up, they want to buy pullbacks. A pullback can be as small as a single bar. Since there will probably be two legs up, the first leg down should not go far. That low 1 short should fail and become a small higher low pullback in the new bull leg, and these bulls will expect at least a two-legged rally that will last 10 or more bars. The only time that a low 1 short is reliable is in the spike phase of a strong bear trend, and never after a reversal pattern. That low 1 short entry will likely fail to fall below the low of the wedge and will instead form a small higher low in the two-legged correction up. Because of that, traders will place a limit order to buy at the low or one to three ticks below the low of that short signal bar, expecting a small higher low to form instead of a profitable low 1 short. In the Emini, they usually can risk as few as four ticks.


随着向上反转延续，他们可能认为会形成一个低2做空建仓形态。不过，由于他们相信趋势已经反转为多头趋势，他们预期这个低2同样会失败，随后价格会更高。他们仍处在买回调的模式里，而这可以包括像低2这样的小回调。这里同样，他们会把限价买单挂在低2信号K线低点处或下方，在 Emini 小型合约上冒大约四个最小报价单位的风险。他们预期这面熊旗向下突破走不了超过几个最小报价单位，反而指望市场继续向上爬进一条多头通道。这是一种最终熊旗，因为它是空头趋势的最后一面旗。空头把它看作一面熊旗，但只能把它打到空头信号K线下方一两个最小报价单位，随后这面旗形继续向右上方生长，直到交易者意识到它现在成了一条多头通道。到某个时点，当足够多的交易者明白发生了什么，空头就会回补，通常会出现一波向上突破，随后是一段向上的等距运动。


> As the reversal up continues, they might think that a low 2 short setup could form. However, since they believe that the trend has reversed into a bull trend, they expect that low 2 to fail as well and be followed by higher prices. They are still in the buy pullbacks mode, and that can include a small pullback like a low 2. Here again, they will place limit orders to buy at or below the low of the low 2 signal bar and risk about four ticks in the Emini. They are expecting this bear flag to fail to break out for more than a few ticks, and instead they look for the market to continue to work up into a bull channel. This is a type of final bear flag because it is the final flag of the bear trend. The bears thought of it as a bear flag, but were able to break it below the bear signal bar by only a tick or two, and then the flag continued to grow up and to the right until traders realized that it was now a bull channel. At some point, when enough traders realize what is happening, the bears cover, and there will usually be an upside breakout and then a measured move up.


一旦空头相信市场已经到达交易区间的顶部，或者相信多头趋势正在转跌，他们就会寻找高1和高2信号K线，并把限价空单挂在这些K线高点处或略上方。他们想卖出上涨行情，哪怕像高1或高2这样非常小的上涨。多头则会在交易区间底部、以及空头趋势底部寻找低1和低2入场，只要他们觉得市场正在反转为一段多头波段行情。


> Once the bears believe either that the market has reached the top of a trading range or that the bull trend is in the process of reversing down, they will look for high 1 and high 2 signal bars and place limit orders to short at or just above the highs of those bars. They are looking to sell rallies, even very small ones like a high 1 or a high 2. Bulls will look to buy low 1 and low 2 entries at the bottom of a trading range and at the bottom of a bear trend when they feel that the market is in the process of reversing into a bull swing.


如果高2很可能失败，那它一开始为什么会触发？它之所以触发，是因为空头更愿意在K线上方做空，而不太愿意在K线高点下方一点点做空。他们把限价空单挂在K线前高处及其上方。由于愿意在K线高点下方一点点做空的空头相对较少，多头无人阻挡，得以把市场推到前一根K线高点上方，指望大量多头用买入止损单进场。K线的高点像一块磁铁，这波推到高点上方就是一次微型上涨真空。多头发现，那里有压倒性数量的空头等着做空，还有许多在更低位买入的多头在那里止盈。结果是高2触发了，但市场立刻转跌。那些在最后几个最小报价单位里买入的多头很快看到了前一根K线高点上方没有后续上涨。因为市场没有按他们预期的走，他们就离场，而且至少几根K线之内不会再想买入。他们卖掉多单，加重了这波抛售。


> If the high 2 is likely to fail, why would it ever trigger in the first place? It triggers because the bears are looking to short above bars, and less so just below the highs of bars. They place limit orders to short at and above the high of the prior bar. With a relative lack of bears willing to short just below the high of the bar, the bulls are unopposed and are able to push the market above the high of the prior bar, hoping that lots of bulls will enter on buy stops. The high of the bar acts as a magnet, and the push above the bar is a micro buy vacuum. The bulls find that there is an overwhelming number of bears waiting to short there, and there are lots of bulls, who bought lower, taking profits there. The result is that the high 2 triggers, but the market immediately turns down. Those bulls who bought over the last several ticks quickly see the lack of a rally above the high of the prior bar. Because the market is not doing what they expected, they exit and will not look to buy again for at least a few bars. Their selling out of their longs contributes to the sell-off.


如果一次最终旗形反转触发了，但反转在一两根K线之内就失败，这就算一次最终旗形失败。最终旗形失败是原趋势恢复的建仓形态，因此也是突破回调。市场突破潜在最终旗形之后，曾试图反转，却只是稍稍回调了一下，随后趋势就恢复而非反转。例如，如果市场处在多头趋势中，有一个潜在最终牛旗向上突破后开始转跌，但那根做空入场K线很快变成一根强劲的多头反转K线，这就是一个突破回调做多的建仓形态。那根多头反转K线就是潜在最终旗形突破之后的一次回调；如果多头趋势走得足够远，超出了最终旗形的磁力范围，交易者就会寻找其他形态。如果这波上涨只走了一两根K线就再次转跌，它就从原来的潜在最终旗形形成了一个二次入场做空。如果这次反转成功，它就是一次最终旗形反转。如果它失败、市场再次转涨，那么市场很可能处在一条多头通道里，而通道可以持续很多根K线。


> If a final flag reversal triggers but the reversal fails within a couple of bars, this becomes a failed final flag. A failed final flag is a setup for a resumption of the original trend and therefore is a breakout pullback. After the market broke out of the potential final flag, it tried to reverse, but instead just pulled back a little and then the trend resumed instead of reversed. For example, if the market was in a bull trend and had a potential final bull flag that broke to the upside and then began to reverse down, but the short entry bar quickly became a strong bull reversal bar, this is a setup for a breakout pullback long. That bull reversal bar was a pullback from the breakout of the potential final flag, and if the bull trend goes far enough, it will be beyond the magnetic pull of the final flag and traders will look for other patterns. If the rally goes for only a bar or two and reverses down again, it sets up a second entry short from the original potential final flag. If the reversal succeeds, it is a final flag reversal. If it fails and the market again turns up, the market is likely in a bull channel, and channels can last for many bars.


![图 7.1](figures/fig-07-01.jpg)


**图 7.1　最终旗形反转**


一段持续很久的空头趋势之后形成的卖出高潮，往往跟着一次最终旗形反转和至少一波两段式上涨。在图 7.1 中，第1根K线结束了自开盘以来的两段下跌行情，因此可能是当天的低点。它在一波长时间的行情之后向上突破了横盘熊旗，所以这可能是一面最终旗形，可能带来一波向上反转。第1根K线是一根不错的反转K线，触发了这次最终旗形做多，让交易者预期至少有两段上涨。最好的反转中，有些就出现在反转后的第一段上涨延伸到最终旗形之外时，正如这里的情形。接着，在老熊旗上方往往会出现一面横盘旗形，然后新的多头趋势继续。有时只是短暂回调进老熊旗里，有时新的一段多头行情连停顿都没有，就靠一连串多头趋势K线组成一段强劲急速行情、一路飙升。看到这种反转时，重要的是把部分或全部仓位拿来持有做波段，因为你能拿到意外之利的胜算很高。


> A sell climax that forms after a bear trend has gone on for a long time is often followed by a final flag reversal and at least a two-legged rally. In Figure 7.1, bar 1 ended two legs down from the open and was therefore a possible low of the day. It broke out of a sideways bear flag after a protracted move, so this could have been a final flag and it could have led to a reversal up. Bar 1 was a good reversal bar, triggering the final flag long, causing traders to expect at least two legs up. Some of the best reversals come when the first leg up from the reversal extends beyond the final flag, as it does here. There is then often a sideways flag above the old bear flag, and then the new bull trend continues. Sometimes there is just a brief pullback into the old bear flag and other times there is not even a pause in the new bull leg as it soars higher in a strong spike made of a series of bull trend bars. When you see this type of reversal, it is important to swing some or all of your position because the odds are good that you could receive windfall profits.


从太平洋时间上午大约7:30到大约9:30的那个交易区间，有两个小时的双向横盘交易，是一面更大的最终旗形。双向交易会产生一种磁力，倾向于在突破之后把市场拉回这个价位。


> The trading range from about 7:30 to about 9:30 a.m. PST had two hours of two-sided, horizontal trading and was a larger final flag. Two-sided trading exerts a magnetic pull that tends to draw the market back to that level after a breakout.


第1根K线之后的那根入场K线，收盘价高于前六根K线的高点、也高于前七个收盘价，因此反转了许多高点和收盘价。在那几根K线期间做空的交易者，要么不得不回补空单，要么正拿着亏损单，而这些单子他们大概很快就会以亏损平掉。此外，他们至少好几根K线之内不会想再次做空，多数人会先等一波至少两段式的上涨，才考虑再次做空。这让市场变成单边，而单边通常带来一波至少有10根K线、分成两段的上涨行情。


> The entry bar after bar 1 closed above the highs of the prior six bars and above the prior seven closes, and therefore reversed many highs and closes. Traders who shorted during those bars either had to cover their shorts or were holding losing positions, which they would soon likely cover with a loss. Also, they would not have been looking to short again for at least several bars, and most would have waited for at least a two-legged rally before considering shorting again. This made the market one-sided, which usually leads to a rally that has at least 10 bars and two legs.


![图 7.2](figures/fig-07-02.jpg)


**图 7.2　窄幅交易区间成为最终旗形**


一波上涨行情之后的窄幅交易区间，往往会成为最终牛旗。在图 7.2 中，第4根K线向上突破开盘价时带着强势，并促成了一个窄幅交易区间的形成。这里，旗形的强劲突破在第7根K线结束，那是一波两段式上涨（第5根K线是第一段），也是一个楔形顶（当天第一根K线是第一次向上推进，第4根K线是第二次）。旗形中走出的两段式行情，常常造就一次主要反转，而主要反转通常至少有两段。跌到第10根K线的这波下跌是两段的，但它只有一根逆势K线（第9根K线），这意味着它很可能只是两个更大段中的第一段。当两段式行情走在一条狭窄通道里时，整条通道通常就是第一段。无论如何，如果做空的交易者拿不准，他们本可以在市场跌到移动平均线处的第10根K线之后把止损移到保本位。


> A tight trading range after a rally often becomes the final bull flag. In Figure 7.2, the bar 4 breakout above the open was on strength, and led to the formation of a tight trading range. Here, the strong breakout of the flag ended at bar 7, which was a two-legged move up (bar 5 was the first leg), and a wedge top (the first bar of the day was the first push up and bar 4 was the second). Two-legged moves out of flags often set up a major reversal that typically has at least two legs. The move down to bar 10 was in two legs, but it had only a single countertrend bar (bar 9), which meant that it was likely going to be just the first leg of two larger legs. When the two-legged move is in a tight channel, the entire channel usually becomes the first leg. In any case, if short traders were unsure, they could have moved their stops to breakeven after the move down to bar 10 at the moving average.


第9根K线升到那根小多头十字星K线的高点上方，触发了一次高1买入，但有经验的交易者预期它在一次买入高潮和一次最终旗形顶部之后会失败。第8根K线以及随后两根K线构成一面更小的最终旗形，第9根K线则是这面三根K线最终旗形的一个更低的高点突破失败。这里出现了一次微型上涨真空，把市场吸到那根高1信号K线上方一两个最小报价单位处。强劲的空头预期这个高1会失败，正等着看有没有机会在信号K线的高点处或上方做空。因此，当市场还在该K线高点下方一两个最小报价单位时，许多人就停止做空了，而愿意卖出的人一少，市场就被吸得更高去寻找空头。一旦市场到达他们的目标（高1信号K线处及其略上方），空头就大力做空，压过多头，把市场打下去。在高1信号K线高点处及其略上方买入的多头，立刻看到市场停顿并正在反转，于是卖掉多单，帮着把市场往下压。他们认定短期顶部已经成立，至少好几根K线之内不会再考虑买入。买家没了，市场迅速跌到移动平均线的支撑和最终旗形（从第4根K线开始的交易区间）的中部，那里空头会买回部分空单，多头也会重新开始买入。由于这波抛售很强，愿意买的人极少，市场无力上涨。这些买家很快又变成卖家（多头卖掉刚建的多单，空头再次做空），市场继续下跌，去寻找一个低得足以吸引买家的价位。


> Bar 9 went above the high of the small bull doji bar to trigger a high 1 buy, but experienced traders expected it to fail after a buy climax and a final flag top. Bar 8 and the two bars that followed became a smaller final flag, with bar 9 being a lower high failed breakout of the three-bar final flag. There was a micro buy vacuum that sucked the market to a tick or two above that high 1 signal bar. Strong bears expected the high 1 to fail and were waiting to see if they would get an opportunity to short at or above the signal bar’s high. Many therefore stopped shorting when the market was a tick or two below the high of the bar, and this absence of traders willing to sell sucked the market higher in search of bears. Once the market reached their target (at and just above the high 1 signal bar), the bears aggressively shorted and overwhelmed the bulls, driving the market down. The bulls who bought at and just above the high 1 signal bar’s high immediately saw that the market stalled and was reversing, so they sold out of their longs, helping to push the market down. They became convinced that the short-term top was in and would not consider buying again for at least several bars. With no buyers left, the market fell quickly to the support of the moving average and the middle of the final flag (the trading range that began at bar 4), where bears would buy back some of their shorts and bulls would start buying again. Since the sell-off was strong, there were very few buyers, and the market was unable to rally. These buyers quickly became sellers (the bulls sold out of their new longs and the bears shorted once again), and the market fell further in search of a price that was low enough to attract buyers.


第10根K线及其后面那根K线在移动平均线处构成一个两根K线反转的高2买入信号。有经验的交易者不会买这个高2，因为它前面跟着四根强劲的空头K线（一条微型通道）。第11根K线是这次高2牛旗突破失败的信号K线。这是常见的情形。有些多头把从第7根K线高点跌到移动平均线的这波回调看作一面牛旗。然而，一旦市场跌破第10根K线，多头就放弃了这个想法，认定市场很可能要先跌出大约一次等距运动、走完两段，才会形成下一个买入建仓形态。两根K线的空头急速行情（第11根K线及其后一根）之后跟着一条空头通道。事后看，第4根K线那个交易区间在自第1根K线起的这波多头上涨中变成了最终旗形，但聪明的交易者本会预见到这种可能，并拿部分空单做波段。第9根K线之前那根K线也是一面最终牛旗，第10根K线之后两根触发的那次高2同样如此。


> Bar 10 and the bar after it formed a two-bar reversal high 2 buy signal at the moving average. Experienced traders would not have bought this high 2 because it followed four strong bear bars (a micro channel). Bar 11 was the signal bar for the failed breakout of the high 2 bull flag. This is a common situation. Some bulls saw the pullback from the bar 7 high to the moving average as a bull flag. However, once the market broke below bar 10, the bulls gave up on that notion and decided that the market was likely to drop for about a measured move and two legs before forming another buy setup. The two-bar bear spike (bar 11 and the next bar) was followed by a bear channel. In hindsight, the bar 4 trading range turned into a final flag in the bull move up from bar 1, but smart traders would have anticipated this possibility and swung part of their shorts. The bar before bar 9 was also a final bull flag, as was the high 2 that triggered two bars after bar 10.


第2根K线那个低2更低的高点也是类似情形。空头把它看作自开盘以来这波抛售中的一面熊旗，可能是一个更低的高点、一段空头趋势的起点，至少也可能是一个交易区间的顶部。做空一旦触发、随后市场又涨到第2根K线高点上方，空头就知道自己的前提错了。这面熊旗失败了，空头于是预期会出现一波至少两段、并且达到大约一次向上等距运动的上涨行情。


> The low 2 lower high at bar 2 was a similar situation. The bears saw it as a bear flag in the sell-off from the open, a possible lower high and start of a bear trend, and at least the top of a possible trading range. Once the short triggered and then the market rallied above the high of bar 2, the bears knew that their premise was wrong. The bear flag failed and the bears expected a rally that would last at least two legs and reach about a measured move up.


第7根K线也是当天第三次向上推进，其中当天第一根K线是一段向上跳空的急速行情，第4根K线则是这条结束于第7根K线的楔形通道中的第二次推进。


> Bar 7 was also the third push up on the day where the first bar of the day was a gap spike up, and bar 4 was the second push in the wedge channel that ended at bar 7.


当第9根K线升到它前面那根多头K线上方时，市场正试图制造一次最终旗形失败，那是一个突破回调买入建仓形态。不过，由于这个潜在做多的信号K线以及之前三根K线中的两根都带着明显的影线，做空的交易者本会一直把保护性止损留在第8根信号K线高点上方，直到市场下跌。等第9根那根强劲的空头趋势K线收盘后，他们本会把止损移到这根K线的高点上方。这是一个很弱的高1买入建仓形态，很可能失败，因此它算不上买入建仓形态。多数交易者本会在它的高点处或上方做空，而这里显然就是这样。他们不会做多，也不会平掉自己的空单。


> As bar 9 went above the bull bar before it, the market was attempting to create a failed final flag, which is a breakout pullback buy setup. However, since the signal bar for this potential long and two of the prior three bars had prominent tails, shorts would have kept their protective stops above the bar 8 signal bar high until the market move down. Once the strong bar 9 bear trend bar closed, they would have moved their stops to above its high. This was a weak high 1 buy setup and likely to fail, and therefore it was not a buy setup. Most traders would have shorted at or above its high, which clearly happened here. They would not have gone long and they would not have exited their shorts.


第12根K线是一个微型最终旗形的例子。交易者当时在下跌急速行情里做空空头K线的收盘价，但第12根K线之前那根K线带着很长的影线。这提醒交易者：一次小幅回调可能就在眼前。激进的空头在那根K线的收盘处做空，但只预期做一次剥头皮，随后就回调。他们在入场后的那根K线上买回了自己盈利的空头剥头皮，他们的买盘造就了第12根K线这根反转K线。激进的多头明白正在发生什么，于是在他们判断空头会买回空头剥头皮的地方买入。这些多头只想要一次向上的剥头皮。持空单做波段交易的交易者也预期会有这波回调，因此买回部分仓位止盈。所有手里浮盈很大的交易者都会一路部分止盈，而他们通常在预期会出现小幅回调的地方这么做。他们的买盘推动了这次回调。当多头卖掉多头剥头皮、空头在回调顶部做空时，市场如预期那样再次下跌。V 形底部很罕见，所以人人都急着卖出，因为他们知道至少还有一波向下推进的概率很高。交易者用限价单挂在前一根K线高点上方卖出，也在前一根K线低点下方用止损单卖出。在其他每个时间级别、其他每种走势图上，也都有卖出的理由。还有交易者做空第12根K线之后四根触发的那次低2（有人在多头K线下方做空，有人在两根K线空头反转形态下方做空）。那些不切实际地期待更大上涨的早期多头，在低2处卖掉多单，而且至少再跌几根K线之内都不愿再买。没有人想买，市场几根K线之内就迅速下跌。


> Bar 12 is an example of a micro final flag. Traders were shorting the closes of the bear bars in the spike down, but the bar before bar 12 had large tails. This alerted traders to the possibility that a small pullback was imminent. Aggressive bears shorted the close of that bar, but were expecting only a scalp and then a pullback. They bought back their profitable scalps on the bar after entry, and their buying created the bar 12 reversal bar. Aggressive bulls understood what was going on, so they bought where they thought that the bears would be buying back their short scalps. The bulls were looking for only a scalp up. Bear swing traders also expected the pullback, so they bought back part of their positions to take profits. All traders with large open profits take partial profits along the way, and they usually do so where they expect a small pullback to form. Their buying contributes to the pullback. When the bulls sold out of their long scalps and the bears shorted at the top of the pullback, the market sold off again, as expected. V bottoms are rare, so everyone was eager to sell, knowing that the probability of at least one more push down was high. Traders sold above the high of the prior bar on limit orders and on stops below the low of the prior bar. There were also reasons to sell on every other time frame and every other type of chart. Other traders shorted the low 2 that triggered four bars after bar 12 (some shorted below the bull bar, while others shorted below the two-bar bear reversal). Early bulls who were unrealistically hoping for a bigger rally sold out of their longs on the low 2 and were not willing to buy again for at least a couple more bars down. With no one looking to buy, the market quickly fell for several bars.


![图 7.3](figures/fig-07-03.jpg)


**图 7.3　三角形成为最终旗形**


当多头动能异常强劲时，最好只找买入建仓形态，而不做空，直到空头给出一些明显的强势迹象之后再说。


> When the bullish momentum is exceptionally strong, it is better to look only for buy setups and not shorts until after there has been some significant sign of strength by the bears.


如图 7.3 所示，欧元兑美元外汇（Euro/U.S. Dollar Forex）在第2根K线处出现一个最终旗形做空建仓形态，但向上动能很强，而这面旗形只有四根K线长；因此它并没有突破一条重要的多头趋势线。单单一根空头趋势K线，强度不足以抵消那么强的向上动能，市场很可能先横盘修正、再上涨创出新高。这次反转很可能失败，最终只是自第1根K线两根K线反转上方突破之后的一次回调。当最终旗形建仓形态没能让市场反转时，它就变成最终旗形失败，也就是一个突破回调建仓形态。这里发生的就是这样。第1根K线那个潜在最终旗形，在第2根K线两根K线反转处出现了反转信号。反转入场触发了，但市场没有跌远。它反而横盘走出另一个买入建仓形态，这使得在第3根K线上方买入成为最终旗形失败建仓形态的一次入场。市场突破第1根K线那面旗形，回调，然后再次向上突破。


> As shown in Figure 7.3, the Euro/U.S. Dollar Forex had a final flag short setup at bar 2, but the upward momentum was strong and the flag was only four bars long; it therefore did not break a significant bull trend line. That single bear trend bar was not strong enough to negate that much upward momentum, and it was likely that the market would correct sideways and then rally to a new high. This was likely to fail to reverse the market and instead become just a pullback from the breakout above the bar 1 two-bar reversal. When a final flag setup fails to reverse the market, it becomes a failed final flag, which is a breakout pullback setup. This is what happened here. The bar 1 potential final flag had a reversal signal at the bar 2 two-bar reversal. The reversal entry triggered, but the market did not fall far. Instead, it went sideways and formed another buy setup, and this made buying above bar 3 an entry from a failed final flag setup. The market broke above the bar 1 flag, pulled back, and then broke to the upside again.


第3根K线的两根K线反转构成一次高2做多，并与第1根K线构成双底，在强多头趋势里，这些理由足以买入。保守的交易者把第3根K线看作自第2根K线起一条小型下跌通道的一部分，他们本会在第3根K线两根K线多头反转前后那几根K线所构成的小型双顶熊旗上方买入。第3根K线上方的突破很弱，市场回调到一个小幅更高的低点。这是一个突破回调建仓形态，它把这个形态变成了一面楔形牛旗（第1根和第3根K线是前两次向下推进），也变成了一个三角形（一旦出现第三次向下推进，这个交易区间就成了三角形）。这个三角形是横盘的，而且形成于一波长时间上涨之后。它可能有足够的双向交易，产生足够的磁力，把任何突破都拉回交易区间里。有些交易者把第4根K线看作自第3根那根多头趋势K线以及下一根K线高2入场之后的突破回调。这面牛旗是一个潜在最终旗形，而第5根K线是反转建仓形态。它是第三次向上推进，也是一根K线回调的突破，而那根一根K线的回调本身是个一根K线的最终旗形。不过，向上的动能依然很强，横盘修正比反转更可能。市场随后进入一个窄幅交易区间，从这里它本可以再次向上突破，也可以转跌。如果向上突破，这个窄幅交易区间本可以成为最终旗形。


> The bar 3 two-bar reversal set up a high 2 long and a double bottom with bar 1, and these are reasons enough to buy in a strong bull trend. Conservative traders saw bar 3 as part of a small channel down from bar 2, and they would have bought above the small double top bear flag formed by the bars just before and after the bar 3 two-bar bull reversal. The breakout above bar 3 was weak and the market pulled back to a small higher low. This was a breakout pullback setup, and it turned the pattern into a wedge bull flag where bars 1 and 3 were the first two pushes down, as well as into a triangle (as soon as there was a third push down, the trading range was a triangle). The triangle was horizontal, and it formed after a protracted rally. It could have enough two-sided trading to generate sufficient magnetic pull to draw any breakout back into the trading range. Some traders saw bar 4 as a breakout pullback from the bar 3 bull trend bar and the high 2 entry on the next bar. This bull flag was a potential final flag, and bar 5 was the reversal setup. It was the third push up and a breakout of a one-bar pullback, which was a one-bar final flag. However, the momentum up was still so strong that a sideways correction was more likely than a reversal. The market entered a tight trading range from which it then could have broken out to the upside again or reversed down. If it broke to the upside, the tight trading range could have become the final flag.


![图 7.4](figures/fig-07-04.jpg)


**图 7.4　最终旗形，然后是更低的高点**


有时最终旗形的突破会在一个更低的高点处反转，而不是更高的高点。在图 7.4 中，涨到第2根K线的这波上涨很强、呈抛物线状，因此很可能跟着一次至少两段式、持续至少10根K线的回调（多头趋势中的回调可以是横盘的，也可以是下跌的）。它在移动平均线上方形成一个横盘交易区间，并在第3根K线处向上突破。然而突破失败了，市场在两根K线反转中转跌。第3根K线的突破是一个更低的高点，而不是更高的高点，但它仍然是多头趋势中的最终旗形。交易者本会在那两根K线反转下方做空。第3根K线还与第2根K线之后那个小幅更低的高点构成双顶熊旗。第2根K线没能升到开盘价的高点上方，而第3根K线是第二次试图突破当天新高、又告失败。当市场两次尝试做同一件事、两次都失败时，它通常会朝反方向走出趋势。


> Sometimes a final flag breakout reverses at a lower high instead a higher high. In Figure 7.4, the rally up to bar 2 was strong and parabolic and therefore was likely to be followed by at least a two-legged pullback (pullbacks in a bull trend can be sideways or down) that would last at least 10 bars. It formed a horizontal trading range above the moving average from which it broke out at bar 3. However, the breakout failed and the market reversed down in a two-bar reversal. The bar 3 breakout was a lower high instead of a higher high, but it was still the final flag in the bull trend. Traders would have shorted below the two-bar reversal. Bar 3 was also a double top bear flag with the small lower high that followed bar 2. Bar 2 failed to go above the high of the open, and bar 3 was a second failed attempt to break out to a new high of the day. When the market tries to do something twice and fails both times, it usually trends in the opposite direction.


开盘时有一波巨大的两根K线卖方急速行情，随后是一根多头K线。任何一根趋势K线或一连串趋势K线，都同时构成突破、急速行情、缺口和高潮。这波最初的卖出高潮之后，在第1根K线处又出现第二次。连续卖出高潮往往会带来长时间的修正，有时还会带来反转，这里就是如此。跌到第1根K线这波抛售中的最终旗形，就是紧挨在第1根K线之前形成的那根一根K线的停顿K线。这根K线成了这波抛售中一根K线的最终旗形；尽管它是一根多头反转K线，而且它的低点还低于它前面那波巨大两根K线空头急速行情的低点，它仍是空头趋势中的一次停顿，因此是一面熊旗。像这样自由落体的市场里，连续卖出高潮往往会有一面一两根K线的最终旗形，随后跟着一次大修正甚至反转。知道连续卖出高潮通常带来大幅回调的交易者，在看到那根一根K线的停顿K线后，愿意在当天低点买入这波向上反转。低点处已经没有人再卖了。剩下的空头只会在一次回调时卖出，而且至少要等到一波10根K线以上的上涨之后。第1根K线打断了这轮抛售，把它变成了两次独立的卖出高潮，而不是一次高潮。如果没有它，抛售在第1根K线之后很可能还会继续，至少再走一两根K线。许多空头本会在第1根K线的收盘处买回空单，预期会有一波上涨，涨到某个他们愿意再次做空的价位。激进的多头本会在第1根K线的收盘处做多，冒着大约相当于第1根K线高度那么多最小报价单位的风险，目标先是测试第1根K线的高点，随后可能还有一段按第1根K线高度测算的向上等距运动。第1根K线的成交量为93,000手合约，大约是过去几天清淡K线平均成交量的10倍，因此支持一次急速行情与高潮型的向上反转。急速与通道型趋势的急速行情与高潮变体，在第1册里讨论过。这里先是一波向下急速行情，一次停顿，然后又来一次卖出高潮（第1根K线），它在急速与通道形态里起到一根K线通道的作用。


> There was a huge two-bar sell spike on the open and then a bull bar. Any trend bar or series of trend bars forms a breakout, a spike, a gap, and a climax. This initial sell climax was followed by a second one at bar 1. Consecutive sell climaxes often lead to protracted corrections and sometimes reversals, as occurred here. The final flag in the sell-off down to bar 1 was that one-bar pause that formed just before bar 1. This bar became a one-bar final flag in the sell-off; even though it was a bull reversal bar and its low was below the low of the huge two-bar bear spike before it, it was a pause in the bear trend, and therefore a bear flag. Consecutive sell climaxes in a freely falling market like this often have a one-or two-bar final flag that is followed by a large correction or even a reversal. Traders who knew that consecutive sell climaxes usually lead to big pullbacks were willing to buy the reversal up at the low of the day after they saw that one-bar pause. There was no one left who would sell at the low. The remaining bears would have sold only a pullback and only after at least a 10-bar rally. Bar 1 interrupted the selling and turned it into two separate sell climaxes instead of a single climax. Had it not been there, the selling would have probably continued after bar 1, at least for a bar or two. Many bears would have bought back their shorts on the close of bar 1, expecting a rally to a level where they would consider shorting again. Aggressive bulls would have gone long at the close of bar 1, risking about as many ticks as bar 1 was tall, looking for a test of the bar 1 high and then possibly a measured move up, based on the height of bar 1. Bar 1 had 93,000 contracts, which was about 10 times the average volume of quiet bars over the past couple of days, and was therefore supportive of a spike and climax type of reversal up. Spike and climax variations of spike and channel trends are discussed in book 1. There is a spike down, a pause, and then another sell climax (bar 1), which acts like a one-bar channel in a spike and channel pattern.


第1根K线之后的横盘交易区间也是一面最终旗形，尽管它从未向下突破。卖出高潮之后，市场往往会形成一面熊旗，可以是横盘的，也可以处在一条多头通道里；有时它会像这里一样带有一个低1或低2的做空建仓形态，但没有后续行情，因此也就没有向下突破。这面熊旗反而向上突破——这是趋势反转常见的方式。在连续卖出高潮之后，那些十字星信号K线都是很弱的做空信号K线，激进的交易者本会在它们的低点处或下方买入。由于它是最后一面熊旗，它属于最终旗形。它同时还是一次自一根K线最终旗形的向上反转，而那根一根K线的最终旗形就是第1根K线那根大号卖出高潮K线之前的多头反转K线。太平洋时间上午8:05，市场以一根多头趋势K线向上突破这面熊旗，完成了这次反转。


> The horizontal trading range after bar 1 was also a final flag, although it never broke out to the downside. After a sell climax, the market often forms a bear flag that can be horizontal or in a bull channel, and sometimes it will have a low 1 or a low 2 short setup as it did here, but there is no follow-through and therefore no bear breakout. Instead, the bear flag broke out to the upside, which is a common way for trends to reverse. The doji signal bars were weak signal bars for shorts after consecutive sell climaxes, and aggressive traders would have bought at or below their lows. Since it was the last bear flag, it was a type of final flag. It was also a reversal up from a one-bar final flag, which was the bull reversal bar before the large bar 1 sell climax. The bull trend bar breakout above the bear flag at 8:05 a.m. PST completed the reversal.


![图 7.5](figures/fig-07-05.jpg)


**图 7.5　最终旗形有时不先突破就反转**


有时最终旗形不会突破，而只是继续回调，最终变成一段反方向的趋势。如图 7.5 所示，市场从急速行情与高潮一路跌到第14根K线，而第14根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线。有些交易者认为那波急速行情起于第6根K线、止于第9根K线；另一些人则认为第9根K线和它前面那根空头K线构成了关键的急速行情，或者认为第10根K线之后两根形成的那波两根K线急速行情才是关键。所有这些空头急速行情都是卖压的重要信号，至于可能是哪一段主要造成了跌到第14根K线这波高潮性抛售（一次急速行情与高潮型的急速与通道空头趋势），并不重要。随后在跌到第14根K线的抛物线运动中出现了三次向下推进（第9根和第11根K线是前两段）。这往往会带来一波长时间的上涨行情，但这波上涨通常是从一条多头通道开始的，这里就是如此。多头通道就是一面熊旗。


> Sometimes the final flag does not break out and instead just continues to pull back, eventually becoming a trend in the opposite direction. As shown in Figure 7.5, there was a spike and climax down to bar 14, and bar 14 was a strong bull reversal bar. Some traders saw the spike as starting at bar 6 and ending at bar 9, while others thought that bar 9 and the bear bar before it formed the important spike, or that the two-bar spike that formed two bars after bar 10 was important. All of the bear spikes were important signs of selling pressure, and it does not matter which might have been the spike that mostly contributed to the climactic sell-off to bar 14 (a spike and climax type of spike and channel bear trend). There were then three pushes down in a parabolic move to bar 14 (bars 9 and 11 were the first two legs). This often leads to a protracted rally, but the rally usually begins as a bull channel, as it did here. A bull channel is a bear flag.


第15根K线是一个低1，聪明的交易者本会预期这笔做空要失败。事实上，他们本会预期低2要失败、楔形熊旗也要失败，而且像对待所有通道一样，他们本会在前一根K线低点处或下方买入。机构不会在通道里于K线低点下方卖出，因为那不是他们的做法。我怎么能确定？因为如果他们在卖，市场就会跌，但既然市场在涨，那他们一定在买。到某个时点，所有人都意识到这面熊旗根本不可能向下突破，空头最终买回了自己的空单——有些是在低2失败之后，有些是在楔形熊旗失败之后。结果是向上突破，这里发生在第19根K线那根多头趋势K线处，之后又在第20根K线上方再次发生。


> Bar 15 was a low 1, and smart traders would have expected that short to fail. In fact, they would have expected the low 2 to fail and a wedge bear flag to fail, and, as with all channels, they would have been buying at or below the low of the prior bar. Institutions would not be selling below the lows of bars in a channel, because that is not what they do. How can I be sure? Because if they did, the market would go down, but since it is going up, they must be buying. At some point, everyone realized that this bear flag was never going to break to the downside and the bears eventually bought back their shorts, some after the failed low 2 and others after the failed wedge bear flag. The result was an upside break, which happened here at the bar 19 bull trend bar and again above bar 20.


多头把第3、第9和第11根K线看作构成一面楔形牛旗；当市场跌破第11根K线时，这个楔形失败，市场随之崩跌。这次空头突破只有一段，因为这个形态演变成了一个急速行情与高潮底部。


> The bulls saw bars 3, 9, and 11 as forming a wedge bull flag, and when the market fell below bar 11, the wedge failed and the market collapsed. The bear breakout had only one leg because the pattern evolved into a spike and climax bottom.


从第14根K线开始的四根连续多头趋势K线，显示了买压。第四根是对一次失败低1的突破。第17根K线是一个低2或低3建仓形态，但它没有触发做空，市场反而在两根K线之后向上突破。第18根K线是一个楔形熊旗建仓形态，只触发了一个最小报价单位，随后市场转涨并在第19根K线向上突破。第20根K线是一次自均线缺口K线做空的向上反转，它开启了一波由三根多头趋势K线组成的急速行情。与之前在这面不断生长的熊旗里出现的几次多头突破不同，这一次有后续行情——以连续多头趋势K线的形式出现。这让多数交易者确信，市场现在始终入场方向是做多，他们不再指望熊旗突破。


> The four consecutive bull trend bars that started at bar 14 showed buying pressure. The fourth was a breakout above a failed low 1. Bar 17 was a low 2 or low 3 setup, and instead of triggering a short, the market broke to the upside two bars later. Bar 18 was a wedge bear flag setup that triggered by one tick, and then the market reversed up and broke out to the upside on bar 19. Bar 20 was a reversal up from a moving average gap bar short, and it began a spike consisting of three bull trend bars. Unlike the earlier bull breakouts in the growing bear flag, this one had follow-through in the form of consecutive bull trend bars. This convinced most traders that the market was now always-in long, and they were no longer looking for a breakout of a bear flag.


第12根K线是一面牛旗的起点，它跟在自第11根K线低点起的强劲上涨之后。第12根K线之前那根空头K线是第一次向下推进，第12根K线之后的两根空头K线构成第二次向下推进，形成一个可能的高2牛旗，并可能带来第二段上涨。下一根K线是一根多头K线，因此是一个两根K线反转买入信号；但市场没有向上突破走出第二段上涨，反而用一根强劲的空头趋势K线向下突破。那根K线让多头放弃了他们的前提，他们至少再等好几根K线也不会考虑买入。第13根K线是牛旗向下突破之后的一次回调，也是一路急跌到第14根K线抛物线楔形反转的起点（第9、第11和第14根K线是三次向下推进）。


> Bar 12 was the start of a bull flag, following the strong move up from the bar 11 low. The bear bar before bar 12 was the first push down, and the two bear bars after bar 12 formed a second push down, setting up a possible high 2 bull flag that could have led to a second leg up. The next bar was a bull bar and therefore a two-bar reversal buy signal, but instead of breaking to the upside for a second leg up, the market broke to the downside with a strong bear trend bar. That bar made the bulls give up on their premise, and they then would not look to buy again for at least several more bars. Bar 13 was a pullback from the bear breakout of the bull flag and it was the start of a plunge down to the bar 14 parabolic wedge reversal (bars 9, 11, and 14 were the three pushes down).


当一面熊旗向上突破时，比如在第19根K线处，多头需要一根多头趋势K线，收盘价至少高出旗形顶部好几个最小报价单位，才能让空头放弃「这波上涨只是空头趋势里一次回调」的前提。同样，当一面牛旗向下突破时，交易者想看到的是一根强劲的空头趋势K线，收盘价低于旗形底部好几个最小报价单位，就像第13根K线之前两根形成的那根空头趋势K线。交易者看到高2牛旗正在形成，但一旦那根空头趋势K线远远收在旗形下方，他们就认定多头的前提不再成立，市场很可能至少还会走几小段下跌。


> When a bear flag breaks to the upside, like on bar 19, the bulls need a bull trend bar that closes at least several ticks above the top of the flag to make the bears give up on their premise that the rally is only a pullback in a bear. Similarly, when a bull flag breaks out to the downside, traders want to see a strong bear trend bar with a close that is several ticks below the bottom of the flag, like the bear trend bar that formed two bars before bar 13. Traders saw the high 2 bull flag setting up, but one that bear trend bar closed well below the flag, traders assumed that the bull premise was no longer valid and that the market would likely trade down for at least a couple of small legs.


![图 7.6](figures/fig-07-06.jpg)


**图 7.6　最终牛旗的向下突破**


有时交易者想买一面牛旗，但买入建仓形态始终没有触发，市场反而向下突破。如图 7.6 所示，市场曾强劲上推到第20根K线；当市场开始回调时，交易者在寻找买入建仓形态，因为在这么强的多头急速行情之后，至少会去测试那个高点的胜算更大。然而市场始终没有突破那条跌到第22根K线的微型通道，反而在第23根K线向下突破。这让自第20根K线到第22根K线的这波走势成了多头趋势的最终旗形，尽管它从未向上突破。第23根K线那根大号空头趋势K线一形成，多头就放弃了「至少应该还有一次向上推进」的信念，转而按旗形高度预期至少一段向下的等距运动。空头也看到了这个向下突破，并且预期同样的事。由于往下好几个点之内都没有人接盘，市场一路快速跌到收盘。随着市场下跌，由于缺少回调，触发了动量卖出程序，进一步加重了这波抛售的力度。


> Sometimes traders want to buy a bull flag, but a buy setup never triggers and the market instead breaks to the downside. As shown in Figure 7.6, there was a strong push up to bar 20 and, as the market began to pull back, traders were looking for a buy setup, since the odds favored at least a test of the high after such a strong bull spike. However, the market never broke above the micro channel down to bar 22, and instead broke to the downside on bar 23. That made the move from bar 20 to bar 22 the final flag of the bull trend, even though it never had a bull breakout. Once the large bar 23 bear trend bar formed, the bulls gave up on their belief that there should be at least one more push up, and instead looked for at least a measured move down, based on the height of the flag. Bears also saw the bear breakout and expected the same thing. Since there was no one to buy for the next several points on the downside, the market fell quickly into the close. As the market fell, the absence of pullbacks triggered momentum sell programs, contributing to the strength of the sell-off.


一旦一波强劲的多头急速行情中出现一根顶部带长影线、或带空头实体的K线，交易者通常可以在收盘处买入，做这波行情里最后一次剥头皮，赶在市场修正之前。第20根K线之前那根K线顶部有一根长影线，机敏的交易者会琢磨：这是不是市场即将回调的信号。由于第20根K线也是自第14根K线低点起的第三次向上推进，交易者怀疑它可能是一个高潮顶部。不过，如果市场在回调期间形成了一个合理的买入建仓形态，他们本会在信号K线上方挂买入止损单，以确保做多。市场始终没有成交在任何前一根K线的高点上方，而任何想在信号K线高点上方用买入止损单入场的多头，都没能被止损单带进场。


> Once a strong bull spike has a bar with a big tail on the top or a bear body, traders usually can buy the close for one final scalp before the market corrects. The bar before bar 20 had a large tail on the top, and astute traders wondered if it was a sign that the market might soon pull back. Since bar 20 was also the third push up from the bar 14 low, traders suspected that it could have been a climactic top. However, if the market had created a reasonable buy setup during the pullback, they would have placed buy stops above the signal bar to make sure to get long. The market never traded above the high of any prior bar, and a bull who wanted to enter on a buy stop above the high of the prior bar never got stopped into a long.


第15、第17和第20根K线构成一个抛物线楔形顶部，它是买入高潮的一种。


> Bars 15, 17, and 20 formed a parabolic wedge top, which is a type of buy climax.


![图 7.7](figures/fig-07-07.jpg)


**图 7.7　小幅最终旗形与大反转**


小的最终旗形可以造就开盘反转。在图 7.7 中，第3根K线是一根巨大的空头趋势K线，在它之前，市场向上跳空到空头趋势线上方之后，已经出现了另外三根强劲的空头趋势K线。第2根K线向上突破空头通道的尝试失败了。


> Small final flags can set up opening reversals. In Figure 7.7, bar 3 was a huge bear trend bar that followed three other strong bear trend bars after the market gapped above the bear trend line. The bar 2 breakout above the bear channel failed.


第4根K线是一面小熊旗给出的做空建仓形态。考虑到市场到目前为止的高潮式表现以及昨天的趋势线突破，交易者指望这是一面最终旗形，在测试第1根K线那个空头低点之后带来一波向上反转。


> Bar 4 was the setup for a short off a small bear flag. Given the climactic behavior of the market to this point and yesterday’s trend line break, traders were looking for this to be a final flag that would lead to a reversal up after a test of the bar 1 bear low.


第5根K线又是一根巨大的空头趋势K线，第6根K线是一个 ii形态（内包内包）做多入场，预期会出现一波至少持续10根K线、至少两段上涨的行情。第5根K线的成交量约为105,000手合约，大约是近期清淡K线平均成交量的10倍，因此支持一个可能的连续卖出高潮底部。第二段在次日的第9根K线结束。那些大号空头趋势K线显示出的向下动能之强，通常会让交易者在一两天之内把市场压下去测试这个低点。虽然没有画出来，但第9根K线的高点在当天稍晚引来一波抛售，远远跌破了第5根K线的低点。交易者把连续卖出高潮看作买入的机会。许多空头在第5根K线收盘前后买回了空单，激进的多头则做多。另一些人则在第6根K线向上突破多头 ii形态时买入，指望昨天的低点这第二次向上反转尝试可能是当天的低点。他们可能冒着相当于第5根K线高度那么多最小报价单位的风险，或者也许两三个点。他们的止盈目标包括第5根K线的高点、对移动平均线的一次测试、按第5根K线高度测算的一段向上等距运动，以及当天的新高。


> Bar 5 was another huge bear trend bar and bar 6 was an ii long entry, with the expectation of a rally that would last at least 10 bars and have at least two legs up. Bar 5 had about 105,000 contracts, which is about 10 times greater than the average volume or recent quiet bars, and therefore was supportive of a possible consecutive sell climax bottom. The second leg ended at bar 9 on the following day. The strength of the downward momentum demonstrated by the large bear trend bars would usually result in traders pushing the market down for a test of the low within a day or two. Although it is not shown, the bar 9 high led to a sell-off later that day that went far below the bar 5 low. Traders look for consecutive sell climaxes as opportunities to buy. Many bears bought back their shorts around the close of bar 5, and aggressive bulls went long. Others bought as bar 6 broke out above the bull ii pattern, expecting the second attempt to reverse up from yesterday’s low to be a possible low of the day. They might have risked as many ticks as bar 5 was tall, or maybe two or three points. Their profit targets included the bar 5 high, a test of the moving average, a measured move up based on the height of bar 5, and a new high of the day.


![图 7.8](figures/fig-07-08.jpg)


**图 7.8　两根K线的最终旗形**


一根或两根K线的最终旗形可以带来一次大反转，即使它出现在一波强劲的多头急速行情之后。这种情况在开盘时更可能发生，因为那时急剧反转很常见。在图 7.8 中，在一根巨大、可能带有高潮性质的多头趋势K线之后，第3根K线是一波两根K线的回调，因此它是一个可能的最终旗形。


> A one-or two-bar final flag can lead to a big reversal, even after a strong bull spike. This is more likely on the open, when sharp reversals are common. In Figure 7.8, bar 3 was a two-bar pullback after a huge and possibly climactic bull trend bar, and therefore it was a possible final flag.


第4根K线是一个 ii形态做空最终旗形的建仓形态，很可能带来一次两段式、长时间的修正，事实也确实如此。第3根K线那面牛旗最终就是那面最终旗形，它的突破失败了，并在第4根K线之后转跌。注意，这个 ii形态的第二根K线是空头收盘，交易者想做空时，这一点总是理想的。


> Bar 4 was an ii setup for a final flag short that was likely to lead to a two-legged, protracted correction, which it did. The bar 3 bull flag turned out to be the final flag, and its breakout failed and reversed down after bar 4. Note that the second bar of the ii pattern had a bear close, which is always desirable when a trader is looking to short.


市场涨到第4根K线高点的那股强劲动能，使交易者在当天稍晚把市场推上去测试趋势极值。


> The strong momentum up to the bar 4 high made traders drive the market up to test the trend extreme later in the day.


第3根到第5根K线演变成一面更大的楔形牛旗，其中第3根K线是第一次向下推进，第5根K线是第三次。第二次向下推进出现在第5根K线之前三根。当市场在第6根K线那个更低的高点转跌时，它成了一面最终旗形。


> Bars 3 to 5 evolved into a larger wedge-shaped bull flag where bar 3 was the first push down and bar 5 was the third. The second push down was three bars before bar 5. This became a final flag when the market reversed down at the bar 6 lower high.


涨到第6根K线的这波上涨是一个楔形熊旗，也是一次更低的高点主要趋势反转，其中第5根K线之前那根K线是第一次向上推进。


> The rally to bar 6 was a wedge bear flag and lower high major trend reversal, where the bar before bar 5 was the first push up.


第7根K线从一根内包K线转涨，而那根内包K线就是这波抛售的最终旗形。


> Bar 7 reversed up from an inside bar, and that bar was the final flag of the sell-off.


![图 7.9](figures/fig-07-09.jpg)


**图 7.9　小幅最终旗形常常演变成更大的最终旗形**


如图 7.9 所示，第2根K线是一笔成功的空头剥头皮，做的是它前面那面一根K线最终旗形的突破。形态随后长成一面更大的楔形熊旗（另一面最终旗形），止于第3根K线。第一段上涨的顶点是第一面小幅最终旗形的顶部，也就是第2根K线之前那根多头内包K线。第二段上涨是第2根K线之后那根大号内包K线。那根多头K线顶部有一根小影线，而下一根K线的实体更小。那根影线和那根更小的K线，构成了自第2根K线低点起的初始上涨结束、直到第2根K线之后那根多头K线顶部之间的停顿。最后一次向上推进到第3根K线。在更小时间级别的走势图上，这大概更清楚地是一个楔形，但从这里能看到的内容也可以推断出来。其他交易者则只把它看作一次低2做空，其中第2根K线是低1入场K线。


> As shown in Figure 7.9, bar 2 was a successful short scalp from the breakout of the one-bar final flag that preceded it. The pattern then grew into a larger wedge bear flag (another final flag) that ended at bar 3. The first leg up was the top of the first small final flag, which was the bull inside bar before bar 2. The second leg up was the large inside bar after bar 2. There was a small tail on the top of the bull bar, and the next bar had a smaller body. That tail and the smaller bar created the pause from the initial move up from the bar 2 low to the top of the bull bar after bar 2. The final push up was to bar 3. This was probably more clearly a wedge on a smaller time frame chart, but can be inferred from what was present here. Other traders saw this as simply a low 2 short where bar 2 was the low 1 entry bar.


市场在第4根K线转涨，这个形态又长成一面更大的楔形熊旗，止于第6根K线。第一次向上推进到第3根K线，接下来的两段上涨分别止于第5根K线（或它之后的摆动高点）和第6根K线。其他交易者则把第5根K线看作第一次向上推进，把第6根K线看作第三次。那条止于第5根K线的小型向上急速与通道结构有两小段，而第5根K线之后涨到第6根K线的这波上涨有更清楚的两段。


> The market reversed up at bar 4 and the pattern grew into a larger wedge bear flag that ended at bar 6. The first push up was to bar 3, and the next two legs up ended at bar 5 (or the swing high after it) and bar 6. Other traders saw bar 5 as the first push up and bar 6 as the third. The small spike and channel up that ended at bar 5 had two small legs, and the rally up to bar 6 after bar 5 had two clearer legs.


这面熊旗楔形的突破带来了一笔成功的剥头皮，但并没有创出新的波段低点。第7根K线这次更高的低点主要趋势反转被第8根K线测试，它形成了一面双底牛旗，也是这次更高的低点主要趋势反转的二次入场。随后的上涨造就了一面更大的熊旗楔形，止于第9根K线。前两段上涨的顶点是第3根和第6根K线的高点。第3根K线第一次向上推进之后，第4根K线又走出了一个更低的低点，这并不重要，因为这是楔形常见的变体。


> The breakout of the bear wedge resulted in a successful scalp, but not a new swing low. This bar 7 higher low major trend reversal was tested by bar 8, which formed a double bottom bull flag and a second entry for the higher low major trend reversal. The rally that followed created a larger bear wedge that ended at bar 9. The first two legs up were the bars 3 and 6 highs.
