It was irrelevant that a lower low developed at bar 4 after the first push up at bar 3, because this was a common wedge variant.


为什么要坚持把一切都看成越来越大的熊旗？因为它们确实存在，市场因此是在告诉交易者：它并没有反转成一段强劲的多头趋势。多头试图向上突破第8根K线那个双底牛旗和头肩底的尝试失败了。市场在这波向上急速行情之后那条通道的顶部、也就是第9根K线处转跌，而且这次失败也发生在自第3根到第6根K线那条趋势通道线正上方。这个头肩底做了多数头肩底都会做的事。它变成了一面熊旗（这一面略微向上倾斜，所以更像是楔形而不是三角形），也变成了持续形态，而不是反转形态。次日市场跌破了第4根K线的低点。


> Why the insistence of seeing everything as larger and larger bear flags? Because they were there, and the market was therefore telling traders that it had not reversed into a strong bull trend. The bulls failed in their breakout attempt above the bar 8 double bottom bull flag and head and shoulders bottom. The market reversed down at the bar 9 top of the channel that followed this spike up, and the failure was also from just above the trend channel line from bar 3 to bar 6. This head and shoulders bottom did what most head and shoulders bottoms do. It became a bear flag (this one was slightly sloping up so it was more of a wedge than a triangle) and a continuation pattern, instead of a reversal pattern. The market broke below the bar 4 low on the next day.


![图 7.10](figures/fig-07-10.jpg)


**图 7.10　最终旗形不必朝顺趋势方向突破**


如图 7.10 所示，在跳空开盘并强劲上冲到第5根K线之后，交易者不确定接下来会出现一次开盘向下反转并形成当天的高点，还是先出现一个高1牛旗、随后走出一条多头通道。当市场自第5根K线高点回调时，他们仔细观察。从第5根到第6根K线，交易者以为市场可能在形成一面牛旗。然而，第7根K线是一根大号空头趋势K线，收在自己的低点，也收在第4根K线那根大号多头趋势K线的底部下方。第7根K线收在它前一根K线下方好几个最小报价单位处，因此是在试图形成一个突破缺口。


> As shown in Figure 7.10, after the gap up and strong bull spike up to bar 5, traders were uncertain if there was going to be an opening reversal down and a high of the day or a high 1 bull flag and then a bull channel. They watched carefully as the market pulled back from the bar 5 high. From bar 5 to bar 6, traders thought that the market might be forming a bull flag. However, bar 7 was a large bear trend bar that closed on its low and below the bottom of the bar 4 large bull trend bar. Bar 7 closed many ticks below the bar before it and therefore was an attempt to form a breakaway gap.


许多交易者在该K线一收盘就做空，并把止损放在它的高点上方，预期市场正翻转为始终入场做空，很可能有不错的后续卖盘。第5根K线可能就是当天的高点，而如果市场跌破当天第3根K线那个低点，可能就会有一段向下的等距运动。此时多数交易者相信，第5根K线是当天高点的好候选。接下来几根K线的后续行情，让交易者确信市场现在始终入场方向是做空。他们等着市场跌破开盘区间的底部、也就是第3根K线低点，随后走出大约一段向下的等距运动。第14根K线正是自开盘区间突破起算的一段精确的向下等距运动，许多空头在那里止盈。


> Many traders shorted as soon as it closed and put a stop above its high, expecting that the market was flipping to always-in short and would likely have good follow-through selling. Bar 5 might have been the high of the day, and if the market fell below the bar 3 low of the day, it might have a measured move down. Most traders at this point believed that bar 5 was a good candidate for a high of the day. The follow-through over the next several bars convinced traders that the market was now always-in short. They were looking for a breakout below the bar 3 bottom of the opening range and then about a measured move down. Bar 14 was an exact measured move down from the opening range breakout, and many bears took profits there.


由于交易者把第5根到第6根K线看作一面牛旗，它就是这波上涨行情的最终旗形，尽管它从未向上突破。


> Since traders saw bar 5 to bar 6 as a bull flag, it was the final flag of the rally, even though there was never an upside breakout.


第16根K线是一个双底、或者说是略微更低的低点主要趋势反转，但它之后跟着的是交易区间，而不是多头趋势。主要趋势反转之后跟着交易区间的情形，比跟着反方向趋势的情形更常见。


> Bar 16 was a double bottom or slightly lower low major trend reversal, but was followed by a trading range instead of a bull trend. Major trend reversals are more often followed by trading ranges instead of trends in the opposite direction.


![图 7.11](figures/fig-07-11.jpg)


**图 7.11　高潮之后的小幅最终旗形**


图 7.11 所示道琼斯工业平均指数（Dow Jones Industrial Average）的月线图，在高潮之后出现了许多一根或两根K线的最终旗形。有些带来了反转，比如第8、12、16和第19根K线处（缩略图是第12根和第19根K线的放大图）；另一些则只带来回调，比如第5、第10（左侧的缩略图是放大图）、13和第21根K线处。有些最终只是普通旗形，并不是这波行情里的最终旗形，比如第4、第15和第23根K线；还有一些触发了，却没能让市场反转，反而成了趋势中的回调（第13根和第21根K线就是最终旗形失败的例子，因为市场在旗形之后转跌，但反转失败，多头趋势分别在第14根和第23根K线处恢复）。一旦出现一次高潮，接着一面短暂旗形，随后是这面旗形的突破，这波突破往往强到构成又一次高潮。连续高潮之后容易出现一次反转，它可以持续大约10根K线、分成大约两段。当它们出现在一个重要的支撑位或阻力位时，可能带来强劲反转，比如第20根K线处。当市场正在跌破第19根K线时，我告诉过许多朋友，这可能带来一次强劲的多头反转，因为第18根K线那个空头低点正下方有一条长达20年的多头趋势线。此外还有第11根K线低点的支撑，那里形成了一个双底牛旗。交易者留意到第25根K线可能出现一个更低的高点，许多人会把它看作潜在头肩顶的右肩。过去两个月里，我一直告诉朋友们，第24根K线可能是这波上涨的最终旗形。如果是，这次反转应该持续大约10根K线（10个月）、至少分成两段。它应该在第22根K线高点、第23根K线低点、移动平均线（未显示）或第20根K线低点中的某一处找到支撑。


> The monthly chart of the Dow Jones Industrial Average shown in Figure 7.11 had many one-and two-bar final flags after climaxes. Some led to reversals, like at bars 8, 12, 16, and 19 (the thumbnails show close-ups of bars 12 and 19), whereas others led to pullbacks, like bars 5, 10 (the left-hand thumbnail shows a close-up), 13, and 21. Some ended up as just ordinary flags and not the final flags in the move, like bars 4, 15, and 23, and some triggered but failed to reverse the market and became pullbacks in the trend (bars 13 and 21 are examples of failed final flags, because the market reversed down after the flags, but the reversals failed and the bull trends resumed at bars 14 and 23). Once there is a climax, then a brief flag, and then a breakout of that flag, the breakout is often strong enough to be another climax. Consecutive climaxes are prone to be followed by a reversal that can last about 10 bars and have about two legs. When they occur at a significant support or resistance level, they can lead to strong reversals, like at bar 20. As the market was breaking below bar 19, I told many friends that it could lead to a strong bull reversal because there was a 20-year-long bull trend line just below the bar 18 bear low. There was also the support of the bar 11 low, which led to a double bottom bull flag. Traders are aware of a possible lower high at bar 25, which many would see as the right shoulder of a potential head and shoulders top. I have been telling friends for the past couple of months that bar 24 could be the final flag of the rally. If so, the reversal should last for about 10 bars (10 months) and have at least two legs. It should find support at either the bar 22 high, the bar 23 low, the moving average (not shown), or the bar 20 low.


# 第 8 章　双顶与双底回调

*8. Double Top and Bottom Pullbacks*


如果市场在一波抛售之后形成双底，而且在多头趋势展开之前、接着出现一段更高的低点回调、恰好测试到双底低点略上方，这就是一个双底回调做多建仓形态。双底不必精确，第二个底常常略低于第一个底，因此这个形态有时同时也是头肩底。如果第二个底连第一个底都没碰到，就有一种风险：这个底只是在形成一段两段式的横盘到上涨修正，所以这时更好的做法是找做多的剥头皮机会，而不是找波段交易。双底（或双顶）回调形态可以看作一个三次推进的底部（或者说三重底或三角形），只是第三次向下推进时卖方力量不够强，没能创出新低。这个形态总是出现在支撑位，正如空头趋势里的每一次上涨一样。如果三个底部中第一个底部之后的上涨足够强，交易者就会怀疑：趋势是不是正在演变成一个交易区间，甚至反转成多头趋势。在交易区间里，每一次下跌都是牛旗，每一次上涨都是熊旗。如果市场处在多头趋势的早期阶段，那么每一次下跌同样是牛旗。无论市场是要进入交易区间还是要展开新的多头趋势，从第一波上涨之后出现的那波抛售都是一个牛旗，哪怕它跌回到第一个底部附近的位置。从双底起的那波上涨，就是这个牛旗的突破。从双底低点起的那波上涨之后的回调（也就是第三次向下推进）同样是一个牛旗，无论它的终点是在双底上方、形成双底回调（或三角形），还是正好落在双底的位置、形成三重底，又或者跌破双底后反转向上、形成双底下方的一次突破失败（基本上就是一种最终旗形反转）。它同时也是对第二个牛旗的一次回调，所以第三次向下推进之后的那波上涨，是对第二个牛旗上方那次突破的突破回调。第三次向下推进在哪里结束并不重要，整体形态看起来是三重底、三角形、头肩底、最终旗形还是双底回调，同样也不重要，因为它们意义相同。第三次反转向上形成了一个三次向下推进的反转形态，交易者这时要找的就是做多的机会。当市场形成双底回调、形态又好看、三个底部的多头反转K线都很强、尤其是最后一根很强时，这个形态是最可靠的买入建仓形态之一。


> If a market forms a double bottom after a sell-off, and before the bull trend takes off, and it then has a higher low pullback that tests just above the double bottom low, this is a double bottom pullback long setup. The double bottom does not have to be exact, and the second bottom is often slightly lower than the first, making the pattern sometimes also a head and shoulders bottom. If the second bottom does not at least reach the first, there is a risk that the bottom is forming only a two-legged sideways to up correction, thereby making it better to look for a scalp long rather than a swing. A double bottom (or top) pullback pattern can be thought of as a three-push bottom (or a triple bottom or triangle) where the third push down did not have strong-enough sellers to create a new low. The pattern always forms at a support level, as does every move up in a bear trend. If the move up from the first of the three bottoms is strong enough, traders will wonder if the trend is evolving into a trading range or even a reversal into a bull trend. In a trading range, every move down is a bull flag and every move up is a bear flag. If the market is in the early stages of a bull trend, then every move down is also a bull flag. Whether the market is entering a trading range or a new bull trend, the sell-off from the first rally is a bull flag, even though it falls to around the level of the first bottom. The rally off the double bottom is a breakout of the bull flag. The pullback (which is the third move down) from the move up off the double bottom is also a bull flag, whether it ends above the double bottom and forms a double bottom pullback (or a triangle), it ends at the level of the double bottom and forms a triple bottom, or it falls below the double bottom and reverses up and forms a failed breakout below a double bottom (basically, a type of final flag reversal). It is also a pullback from that second bull flag, so the rally off the third push down is a breakout pullback from the breakout above the second bull flag. It does not matter where the third push down ends, and it also does not matter if the overall pattern looks like a triple bottom, a triangle, a head and shoulders bottom, a final flag, or a double bottom pullback, because the significance is the same. The third reversal up creates a three-push down reversal pattern, and traders need to be looking for opportunities to get long. When the market forms a double bottom pullback and the shape is good and the bull reversal bars for the three bottoms are strong, especially if the final one is strong, the pattern is one of the most reliable buy setups.


从第二个底出发的那波上涨通常是一次突破，哪怕它可能只持续几根K线。因此随后的回调就是一次突破回调，而突破回调是最可靠的建仓形态之一。它也可以看作两次没能突破先前极值的尝试（那个极值往往是一个低2），而两次失败的尝试通常会带来一次反转。有些技术分析师说，三重底和三重顶总是会失败、总是会变成持续形态，但他们要求三个极值必须精确到最小报价单位完全一致。按这种严格定义，这个形态罕见到根本不值一提。而且，告诉市场你不允许它做某件事，本身就是傲慢；傲慢总会让你赔钱，因为能说了算的是市场，不是你——什么可以发生、什么将会发生，由市场决定。交易者用宽松的定义能赚得多得多。当某个东西看起来像一个可靠的形态时，它很可能就会像可靠的形态那样走。


> The move up from the second bottom is usually a breakout, even though it may last for only a couple of bars. The pullback is therefore a breakout pullback, which is one of the most reliable setups. It can also be thought of as two failed attempts to exceed the prior extreme (often a low 2), and two failed attempts usually lead to a reversal. Some technicians say that triple bottoms and tops always fail and always become continuation patterns, but they require that the three extremes be identical to the tick. With that strict definition, the pattern is so rare that it is not worth mentioning. Also, it is simply arrogant to tell the market that you will not allow it to do something, and arrogance always costs you money because it is the market and not you that gets to say what can and will happen. Traders will make much more money by using loose definitions. When something resembles a reliable pattern, it will likely trade like the reliable pattern.


这是一个反转形态，不是双底牛旗那样的持续形态。两者都是做多的建仓形态，但一个是趋势的开端（反转形态），另一个出现在已经确立的趋势里（持续形态），或者至少是在已经走出一段强劲行情段之后。


> This is a reversal pattern and not a continuation pattern, like the double bottom bull flag. Both are long entry setups, but one is the beginning of the trend (a reversal pattern) and the other takes place in an established trend (a continuation pattern), or at least after there has been one strong leg.


同样，如果多头趋势中出现双顶，接着出现一段涨到接近高点的回调，这个双顶回调就是一个很好的做空建仓形态。这里也一样，三次推进的顶部采取什么形状并不重要，因为意义相同。如果信号K线很强，卖压也好，那就是一个卖出建仓形态，无论它看起来像三重顶、三角形、头肩顶、最终旗形还是双顶回调。


> Likewise, if there is a double top in a bull trend and there is then a pullback that reaches close to the high, this double top pullback is a good short setup. Again, it does not matter what shape the three-push top takes because the significance is the same. If the signal bar is strong and there is good selling pressure, it is a sell setup, whether it looks like a triple top, a triangle, a head and shoulders top, a final flag, or a double top pullback.


有时同一个交易区间里会既有双顶又有双底。结果通常是一个三角形，这意味着市场处在突破模式。市场往往会回到区间的中部，然后测试顶部或底部，第三次推进就确立了这个三角形。如果区间足够大，交易者可以在市场反转向下时做空、反转向上时做多，赚点剥头皮利润。如果形态好，成功率大约 60%，回报至少和风险一样大。如果交易区间太窄，交易者可以选择做多或做空的波段交易，也可以等突破。如果突破很强，就顺着它的方向交易，因为回报至少和风险一样大的概率常常在 70% 或以上。如果突破失败，就朝相反方向交易。


> Sometimes there will be both a double top and a double bottom in the same trading range. The result is usually a triangle, which means that the market is in breakout mode. The market tends to move back to the middle of the range and then test either the top or the bottom, and that third push establishes the triangle. If the range is big enough, traders can scalp shorts as the market reverses down and longs as it reverses up. If the setup is good, the probability of success is about 60 percent for a reward that is at least as large as the risk. If the trading range is too tight, traders can choose to either swing a long or short, or wait for the breakout. If the breakout is strong, trade in its direction, because the probability of a reward that is at least as large as the risk is often 70 percent or more. If it fails, trade in the opposite direction.


![图 8.1](figures/fig-08-01.jpg)


**图 8.1　月度 SPY 上的双底回调**


如图 8.1 所示，月度 SPY 在第7根K线那根外包K线上出现了一个双底回调买入机会，因为价格向上越过前一根K线的高点一个最小报价单位。如果前一根K线是一根像样的信号K线，外包上涨K线可以成为可靠的入场K线，这里的情况就是如此。其他交易者则会在以下位置买入：在外包上涨K线的高点上方；在第7根K线之后那根多头趋势K线的收盘价处；在那根多头趋势K线的高点上方；以及在下一根多头趋势K线的收盘价处——对许多交易者来说，那根K线确认了新趋势。在一段上涨行情开始时，在一根强劲多头趋势K线的高点上方买入是一笔可靠的交易，从紧跟其后的那根强劲多头趋势K线就能看出来。


> As shown in Figure 8.1, the monthly SPY had a double bottom pullback buy at the bar 7 outside bar as it went one tick above the high of the prior bar. Outside up bars can be reliable entry bars if the bar before was a decent signal bar, as was the case here. Other traders would have bought above the high of the outside up bar, at the close of the bull trend bar that followed bar 7, above the high of that bull trend bar, and at the close of the next bull trend bar, which confirmed the new trend for many traders. Buying above the high of a strong bull trend bar at the start of a move up is a reliable trade, as can be seen by the strong bull trend bar that followed.


第5根K线略低于第3根K线，但这在双底回调的买入形态里很常见，实际上还更可取。第6根K线是自双底起的那次突破，第7根K线则是一次回调，它成功地考验了突破交易者的决心。许多交易者把这些看作三角形。突破回调是最可靠的建仓形态之一。突破回调常常是头肩形态。


> Bar 5 was slightly below bar 3, but this is common and actually preferable in double bottom pullback buy patterns. Bar 6 was the breakout from the double bottom, and bar 7 was the pullback that successfully tested the resolve of the breakout traders. Many traders see these as triangles. A breakout pullback is one of the most reliable setups. Breakout pullbacks often are head and shoulders patterns.


第11根K线是对第8根和第9根K线那个双顶的回调。有些交易者把它看作一次更低的高点主要趋势反转、移动平均线处的一个低2，或者是对跌破双顶之后那次突破的回调。


> Bar 11 was a pullback from the bars 8 and 9 double top. Some traders saw it as a lower high major trend reversal, a low 2 at the moving average, or a pullback from the breakout below the double top.


第1根和第2根K线形成了一个双顶熊旗（一个持续形态，而不是双顶——双顶是多头趋势末端的一种反转形态）。空头趋势里的双顶总是一个低2卖出建仓形态，因为它是两次向上推进。多头两次尝试反转趋势都失败了，所以至少会在接下来几根K线里袖手旁观。这就造成买方缺席，增大下跌的速度与幅度，市场一路奔向某个支撑位，看那里能否重新找到买方。


> Bars 1 and 2 formed a double top bear flag (a continuation pattern and not a double top, which is a reversal pattern at the end of a bull trend). A double top in a bear trend is always a low 2 sell setup, because it is two pushes up. The bulls made two attempts to reverse the trend and failed, and will step aside for at least a couple of bars. This creates an absence of buyers and increases the speed and size of the move down, as the market races to a support level where it might find buyers again.


![图 8.2](figures/fig-08-02.jpg)


**图 8.2　作为双底回调的熊旗**


有时一个熊旗可以成为一个双底回调的买入建仓形态。在图 8.2 中，第1根K线处的两根K线反转出现在当天大幅第二段下跌的末端，因此是一个可能的反转建仓形态。不过，在一条狭窄空头通道的底部，仅凭两根K线反转还不足以构成买入的理由。虽然涨到第2根K线的那波上涨很小、因而很弱，但第3根和第4根K线都没能跌破低点，于是它们形成了一个双底牛旗。有些交易者把第3根K线看作一个楔形熊旗的终点，前两次推进分别出现在四根K线和六根K线之前。这就使第4根K线成为一个小型突破回调的买入建仓形态，突破的是第4根K线之前两根K线处形成的那个小牛旗的突破位。其他交易者把第3根K线看作对熊旗的突破，但这次突破没有后续行情，让交易者怀疑这个旗形是不是最终旗形、市场是不是要反转向上。


> Sometimes a bear flag can be a double bottom pullback buy setup. In Figure 8.2, the two-bar reversal at bar 1 was at the end of a large second leg down on the day and therefore a possible reversal setup. However, a two-bar reversal is not enough reason to buy at the bottom of a tight bear channel. Although the move up to bar 2 was small and therefore weak, neither bar 3 nor bar 4 could take out the low and therefore they formed a double bottom bull flag. Some traders saw bar 3 as the end of a wedge bear flag with the first two pushes being four and six bars earlier. This made bar 4 a small breakout pullback buy setup from the small breakout of the bull flag that formed two bars before bar 4. Other traders saw bar 3 as a breakout of the bear flag, but the breakout had no follow-through, which made traders wonder if the flag was a final flag and if the market was going to reverse up.


第6根K线精确测试了第3根K线的低点，且没能跌破它（也没跌破第1根K线的低点），所以这是一个范围更大的双底牛旗，其中第3根K线（或者第3根和第4根K线）构成第一个底。这也被称为吸筹。机构在守住第1根K线的低点，而不是试图打掉止损，这说明他们认为市场要向上走。


> Bar 6 made an exact test of the bar 3 low and was unable to drop below it (or below the bar 1 low), so this was a broader double bottom bull flag, with bar 3 (or bars 3 and 4) forming the first bottom. This is also referred to as accumulation. The institutions were defending the bar 1 low instead of attempting to run the stops, indicating that they believed that the market was going up.


第5根K线是一根均线缺口K线，它往往能提供走向趋势反转所必需的那股逆势动能。它突破了一条重要趋势线。第6根K线是对第1根K线趋势极值的更高的低点测试，也是对第5根K线那段多头急速行情的突破回调。第6根K线还是一次更高的低点主要趋势反转、自第5根K线起的第三次向下推进，以及一次单根K线的最终旗形反转（终点在两根K线之前）。


> Bar 5 was a moving average gap bar, which often provides the necessary countertrend momentum to lead to a trend reversal. It broke a major trend line. Bar 6 was a higher low test of the bar 1 trend extreme and a breakout pullback from the bar 5 bull spike. Bar 6 was also a higher low major trend reversal, three pushes down from bar 5, and a one-bar final flag reversal (from 2 bars earlier).


![图 8.3](figures/fig-08-03.jpg)


**图 8.3　弱势的双底回调**


有些双底回调看上去就是不强，这通常说明它们是熊旗的一部分，而不是反转形态。在图 8.3 中，第4根K线看起来像是一个双底回调做多的建仓形态，但在一条非常强的空头趋势里，第3根K线只比第2根K线的低点高 5 美分。这种略微更高的低点通常会抵消这个形态，使市场走出两段式空头反弹的可能性远大于展开新的多头趋势。而且，强趋势里的第一次回调（无论第2根K线之后跟着的是多小的上涨行情）几乎总会形成一个顺势入场点，所以在这里找底部并不明智。不过，如果交易者做了这笔交易，市场从那个做多入场点起上涨了 1.00 美元以上。考虑到第2、3、4根K线上都有大影线，而且市场仍处在头 90 分钟之内、因而容易出现开盘反转，这是一笔合理的交易。最聪明的交易者会去做空对移动平均线的测试，那次测试以三角形的形式出现（有三次向上推进，第一次在第2根K线之后两根K线处，第二次在第4根K线的前一根K线处形成）。如果你改去做那笔做多的剥头皮，可能就很难迅速切换到做空的心态。


> Some double bottom pullbacks just don’t look strong, and that usually means that they are part of a bear flag and not a reversal pattern. In Figure 8.3, bar 4 looked like a setup for a double bottom pullback long, but bar 3 was 5 cents above the bar 2 low in a very strong bear trend. This slightly higher low usually negates the pattern and makes a two-legged bear rally much more likely than a new bull trend. Also, the first pullback (whatever minor rally would follow bar 2) in a strong trend almost always sets up a with-trend entry, so it was not wise to be looking for bottoms here. However, the market rallied over $1.00 from the long entry, if a trader took the trade. With the big tails on bars 2, 3, and 4, and with the market still in the first 90 minutes and therefore prone to opening reversals, it was a reasonable trade. The smartest traders would have been shorting the moving average test, which came in the form of a triangle (there were three pushes up, with the first coming two bars after bar 2 and the second forming on the bar before bar 4). If you instead scalped that long, it could have been difficult to quickly switch to a shorting mentality.


第8根K线是一个双底回调建仓形态，其中第7根K线比第6根K线的低点低 13 美分，但入场从未被触发（第8根K线之后那根K线未能越过第8根K线的高点）。再说一次，在强空头趋势里、此前又没有强劲的趋势线突破，就去抄底并不是好办法。市场处在一条狭窄空头通道里，而通道持续的时间通常比看起来合理的要长得多。交易者只有在先出现强劲的多头突破、随后出现回调时，才应该考虑买入；或者其他类型的反转也行，比如以第11根K线结束的那段从窄幅交易区间开始的急速下跌之后的最终旗形反转尝试。即便如此，在之前没有上涨行情的情况下，任何反转都更可能带来一个交易区间，而不是多头趋势，因此任何做多都只是剥头皮。


> Bar 8 was a double bottom pullback setup, with bar 7 being 13 cents below the bar 6 low, but the entry never triggered (the bar after bar 8 was unable to take out the high of bar 8). Again, bottom picking in a strong bear trend without a prior strong trend line break is not a good approach. The market was in a tight bear channel, and channels usually last much longer than what seems reasonable. Traders should only look to buy if there was first a strong bull breakout and then a pullback, or some other type of reversal, like the final flag reversal attempt after the spike down from the tight trading range that ended at bar 11. Even then, in the absence of a prior rally, any reversal was more likely to lead to a trading range instead of a bull trend, and therefore any long was only a scalp.


第11根K线是对底部形态的第三次尝试。第10根K线的低点比第9根K线的低点高 2 美分。买在双底的交易者要么已经出场，要么会在第11根K线那个移动平均线处的低2上反手做空。最有经验的交易者根本不会去买那个弱势双底；他们会等着，预期它会失败，然后做空第11根K线处的低2。


> Bar 11 was a third attempt at the bottom formation. The low of bar 10 was 2 cents above the low of the bar 9. Traders who bought the double bottom would have exited or they would have reversed to short at the bar 11 low 2 at the moving average. The most experienced traders would not have bought the weak double bottom; instead they would have waited, expecting it to fail, and would have shorted the low 2 at bar 11.


当天临近收盘时，出现了一个小的双底牛旗，随后是一根内包K线。由于内包K线是一种停顿、因而是一种回调，这根内包K线补全了一个小型的双底回调买入建仓形态。


> At the end of the day there was a small double bottom bull flag followed by an inside bar. Since an inside bar is a pause and therefore a type of pullback, the inside bar completed a small double bottom pullback buy setup.


第2根和第3根K线形成了一个双底，但那个交易区间里同时还有一个双顶。只要交易区间里既有双底又有双顶，通常就会有一次回到中部的走势，从而确立一个三角形，这里的第4根K线就是如此。交易区间继续横盘，而且正如预期那样，最终朝着它之前那段趋势的方向突破。


> Bars 2 and 3 formed a double bottom, but there was also a double top within that trading range. Whenever there is both a double bottom and a double top within a trading range, there is usually a move back to the middle, which establishes a triangle, as was the case here at bar 4. The trading range continued sideways and, as expected, eventually broke out in the direction of the trend that preceded it.


![图 8.4](figures/fig-08-04.jpg)


**图 8.4　双底回调与双顶回调**


如图 8.4 所示，Emini小型合约今天既有双底回调反转，也有双顶回调反转。第1根和第2根K线形成了一个双底，不过乍一看第1根K线可能容易被忽略。入场K线的低点下方挂着保护性止损，这个低点常常会被测试，第2根K线就测试了它；两次下跌到同一水平就是一个双底，哪怕其中第一次并不是一个摆动低点。第1根K线底部有一根大影线，几乎可以肯定在 1分钟图上有一个更高的低点（事实上确实有）。第3根K线是一段深度回调，它测试了这个双底，因此是对止损的第二次攻击。它甚至没能像第一次攻击那样接近第2根K线的低点，空头就撤了、多头接管了市场。有些交易者把第2根和第3根K线看作双底牛旗，另一些人则把它们看作三重底牛旗或双底回调。你认为哪一个特征更重要并不重要，因为它们都是买入建仓形态。


> As shown in Figure 8.4, the Emini today had both double bottom and top pullback reversals. Bars 1 and 2 formed a double bottom, although at first glance bar 1 might be easy to overlook. The bottom of an entry bar has protective stops below it and it will often be tested, as it was by bar 2, and two moves down to the same level is a double bottom, even if the first one is not a swing low. With the big tail on the bottom of bar 1, there was almost certainly a 1 minute higher low (and in fact there was). Bar 3 was a deep pullback that tested the double bottom, so it was a second attempt to run the stops. It could not even get as close as the first attempt at the bar 2 low before the bears pulled out and the bulls took control. Some traders saw bars 2 and 3 as a double bottom bull flag, while others thought of them as a triple bottom bull flag or a double bottom pullback. It does not matter which feature you think is more important, because they all are buy setups.


第4根和第5根K线在这个趋势性交易区间日里形成了一个双底牛旗。第6根K线的回调测试了这个双底，形成一个大双底回调。你也可以把它叫作三重底，但那个说法在这里不会带来任何交易上的好处，所以不值得用。交易者也可以把它看作自第6根K线结束的那段小空头趋势起的一次双底主要趋势反转（所有牛旗都是小级别空头趋势）。


> Bars 4 and 5 created a double bottom bull flag on this trending trading range day. This double bottom was tested by the bar 6 pullback, forming a large double bottom pullback. You could have called it a triple bottom as well, but that term would not add any trading benefit here so it was not worth using. A trader might also see it as a double bottom major trend reversal from the small bear trend that ended at bar 6 (all bull flags are small bear trends).


第7根K线与第1根K线类似，它同样是一根入场K线。它和第8根K线形成了一个不太明显的双顶。另外，第7根K线之前那个两根K线反转是一次向上推进，而第7根K线之前那根十字星K线是第二次向上推进；两者合起来构成了一个双顶。你认为哪个形态更重要并不重要，因为它们都是顶部形态。你只需要知道，市场正试图向下转。


> Bar 7 was similar to bar 1, in that it was also an entry bar. It and bar 8 formed a subtle double top. Also, the two-bar reversal just before bar 7 was a push up, and the doji bar just before bar 7 was a second push up; together they formed a double top. It does not matter which pattern you think is more important since they are both topping patterns. All you need to know is that the market is trying to turn down.


第8根K线试图打掉第7根K线那根做空入场K线上方的保护性止损，但失败了。第9根K线是第二次尝试，在一个更低的价格上再次失败，从而形成一个双顶回调做空的建仓形态，入场点设在第9根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处的止损单上。这笔空单形成了一次五个 tick 的失败，并为一个很好的反转做多埋下伏笔：在移动平均线处那个两根K线反转上方一个最小报价单位挂止损单买入。第10根K线是入场K线。这个楔形回调牛旗测试了第4根到第6根K线那个交易区间的顶部，是一次突破回测。


> Bar 8 tried to run the protective stops above the bar 7 short entry bar, but failed. Bar 9 was a second attempt and failed at an even lower price, creating a double top pullback short setup with an entry on a stop at one tick below the low of bar 9. This short formed a five-tick failure and set up a good reversal to a long on a stop above the two-bar reversal at the moving average. Bar 10 was the entry bar. This wedge pullback bull flag tested the top of the bar 4 to bar 6 trading range, and was a breakout test.


第11根和第12根K线形成了一个双顶熊旗做空建仓形态，也提醒交易者去留意之后的一个双顶回调做空建仓形态。第13根K线那根多头趋势K线是一次上涨尝试，既想测试这个双顶，也想形成一个高2。


> Bars 11 and 12 formed a double top bear flag short setup, and alerted traders to look for a later double top pullback short setup. The bar 13 bull trend bar was an attempt to rally and test the double top and an attempt to form a high 2.


第14根K线是一次更低的高点回调，它在移动平均线处失败，同时也是一个双顶回调做空建仓形态。


> Bar 14 was a lower high pullback that failed at the moving average, and was a double top pullback short setup as well.


# 第 9 章　失败形态

*9. Failures*


失败形态失败形态（failure）指任何没有达到目标的交易：它带来的要么是较小的利润，更常见的是亏损。对剥头皮交易者来说，目标是剥头皮交易者的利润；但如果交易者本来期待更多，而市场没有满足他们的预期，那么即使这笔交易给出了剥头皮交易者的利润，它仍然是失败形态。每一个失败的多头建仓形态，都是多头转弱、空头转强的标志；每一个失败的空头建仓形态，都是空头转弱、多头转强的标志。最常见的好建仓形态成功率约为60%，所以失败率约为40%。一个建仓形态失败时，往往会在反方向创造出一个极好的建仓形态。刚刚被迫出场的交易者，会不愿再顺着原来的方向重新入场，市场因此变得一边倒。此外，他们带着亏损离场时，会把市场朝反方向推得更远。


> Failures A failure is any trade that does not reach its goal, resulting in either a smaller profit or, more commonly, a loss. For a scalper, the goal is a scalper’s profit, but if traders were expecting more and the market failed to meet their expectations, even if it provided a scalper’s profit, it is still a failure. Every failed bull setup is a sign of weakness by the bulls and strength by the bears and every failed sell setup is a sign of weakness by the bears and strength by the bulls. Since the most common good setups have about a 60 percent success rate, they have about a 40 percent failure rate. When a setup fails, it often creates an excellent setup for a trade in the opposite direction. The traders who were just forced out will be hesitant to reenter in the same direction, making the market one-sided. In addition, as they exit with their losses, they drive the market even further in the opposite direction.


本章讨论几种更常见的形态失败的情形：这些失败的幅度足以反转、够做一次剥头皮。当形态足够大、背景也合适时，它们有时甚至能引出一次主要趋势反转。关键在于要明白：每一种形态都有失败的时候，交易者应当把这一点当作正常现象来接受。把失败看成一个潜在的机会，因为正如前面提到的，它往往会在反方向搭出一笔有利可图的交易。另一些时候，这次失败会在原来建仓形态的方向上引出第二个信号。


> This chapter discusses some of the more common occurrences of patterns that fail and reverse enough for a scalp. When the pattern is large enough and the context is right, they sometimes can even lead to a major trend reversal. It is critical to understand that every pattern fails some of the time, and traders should accept that as a normal occurrence. Look at a failure as a potential opportunity, because, as mentioned, it will often set up a profitable trade in the opposite direction. At other times the failure will result in a second signal in the direction of the original setup.


以下是几种常见的失败：它们往往引出反方向的交易：


> Here are some of the common failures that often lead to trades in the opposite direction:


- 高1、高2、低1或低2失败。任何东西的突破失败，比如摆动高点或低点、趋势线或趋势通道线。没能突破某个磁力位，比如等距运动目标位、此前的摆动高点或低点、趋势线或趋势通道线。


> Failed high 1, high 2, low 1, or low 2. Failed breakout of anything, like a swing high or low, a trend line, or a trend channel line. Failure to break through a magnet, like a measured move target, a prior swing high or low, a trend line, or a trend channel line.


- 最终旗形失败（这次反转尝试失败，并搭出一个突破回调）。楔形失败。信号K线或入场K线失败。一个最小报价单位的突破失败。反转失败，比如双底或双顶失败、头肩形态失败。没能到达止盈目标，比如 Emini 小型合约中差五个、九个或17个最小报价单位的失败，或股票里11、51、99或101美分的失败。


> Failed final flag (the reversal attempt fails and sets up a breakout pullback). Failed wedge. Failed signal bar or entry bar. Failed one-tick breakout. Failed reversal, like a failed double bottom or top or a failed head and shoulders pattern. Failure to reach a profit target, like a five-, nine-, or 17-tick failure in the Eminis or an 11, 51, 99, or 101 cent failure in a stock.


有些失败是强趋势的标志，并会搭出一笔顺趋势的交易：


> Some failures are a sign of a strong trend and set up a with-trend trade:


- 在强劲多头趋势中没能跌破前一根K线的低点，或在强劲空头趋势中没能升到前一根K线的高点之上。这表明了紧迫感和强趋势。回调没能到达移动平均线。这表明了紧迫感和强趋势。没能到达某个磁力位，比如等距运动目标位、此前的摆动高点或低点、趋势线或趋势通道线。这往往引出一波回调，之后又是一次到达该磁力位的尝试。


> Failure to fall below the low of the prior bar in a strong bull trend or to rally above the high of the prior bar in a strong bear trend. This indicates urgency and a strong trend. Failure of a pullback to reach the moving average. This indicates urgency and a strong trend. Failure to reach a magnet, like a measured move target, a prior swing high or low, a trend line, or a trend channel line. This often leads to a pullback and then another attempt to reach the magnet.


如果一笔交易赚到了剥头皮交易者的利润（因此交易者已经平掉了一部分或全部仓位），随后市场又掉头回来，打掉了原来设在信号K线或入场K线之外的止损，那么市场里剩下的燃料就少得多，不足以把这个新的、相反的方向推远，因为被套在这笔交易里的交易者少得多（他们已经带着利润出场了）。而且许多剥头皮交易者在分批止盈之后会在保本处平掉剩余仓位，所以他们的止损会比原来设在入场K线或信号K线之外的那些更紧。


> If a trade makes a scalper’s profit (and therefore the trader exited some or all of the position) and then comes back and takes out the original signal or entry bar stops, there is much less fuel left in the market to drive the market in this new, opposite direction because there are far fewer traders who are trapped in the trade (they already exited with profits). Also, many of the scalpers would exit the balance of their positions at breakeven after taking partial profits, so their stops would be tighter than the original ones beyond the entry or signal bars.


虽然一次小级别反转也许只是交易区间里的一次反转、只够做一次剥头皮，但它有时能变成趋势的一次主要反转，或成为其中的一部分。最可靠的一种失败，是趋势中的一面旗形。旗形形成时，逆势交易者盼着趋势反转，而这是一笔低概率的押注，因为市场有惯性，趋势会抵抗反转尝试。例如，如果先有一段强劲多头趋势，接着出现一个反转建仓形态，有些交易者就会做空。然而，如果市场反而横盘到下跌、走到移动平均线，并在那里用一根多头信号K线搭出一个高2，那么那次空头反转尝试很可能会失败。这是一个极好的买入信号，因为你入场的方向与更大的趋势一致，而且至少可以合理地预期市场会测试此前那段趋势的极值。任何反转形态，包括主要反转形态，都可能失败，并导致趋势恢复。


> Although a minor reversal might just be a reversal in a trading range that is good for only a scalp, it can sometimes turn into or be a part of a major reversal of a trend. The single most reliable failure is a flag in a trend. As a flag is forming, countertrend traders are hoping for a trend reversal, which is a low-probability bet because markets have inertia and trends resist reversal attempts. For example, if there is a strong bull trend and then a reversal setup, some traders will go short. However, if the trade instead goes sideways to down to the moving average and sets up a high 2 there with a bull signal bar, that bear reversal attempt will likely fail. This is a great buy signal because you are entering in the direction of a larger trend and it is reasonable to expect at least a test of the prior extreme of the trend. Any reversal pattern, including major reversal patterns, can fail and result in the resumption of a trend.


交易者入场时，许多人会把保护性止损放在信号K线之外一个最小报价单位处。入场K线收盘之后，如果它很强，许多人会把它移到入场K线之外一个最小报价单位处。你怎么知道这一点？只看走势图就知道。看任何一张图，找出可能的信号K线和入场K线，看看当有K线反向越过它们时会发生什么。很多时候，这次反转会以一根强劲趋势K线的形式出现；大多数时候，这波行情的幅度至少够一个剥头皮交易者的利润。这是因为交易者一旦带着亏损被从新仓位里冲洗出局，就会变得更谨慎，想看到更多的价格行为才愿意顺着同一方向重新入场。市场因此落到只剩一方手里，所以这波行情往往又快又大，够做一次剥头皮。


> When traders enter a trade, many place a protective stop at one tick beyond the signal bar. After the entry bar closes, if it is strong, many move it to one tick beyond the entry bar. How do you know this? By simply looking at charts. Look at any chart and find possible signal and entry bars and see what happens when a bar reverses beyond them. So much of the time, the reversal will be in the form of a strong trend bar, and most of the time the move will be enough for at least a scalper’s profit. This is because once traders get flushed out of a new position with a loss, they become more cautious and want more price action before reentering in the same direction. This leaves the market in the hands of just one side, so the move is usually fast and big enough for a scalp.


为什么一个最小报价单位的突破失败如此常见，尤其是在 Emini 小型合约中？在股票里，失败常常出现在1到10美分的突破上，取决于股票的价格和股性。每只股票的交易都有自己鲜明的特征，想必是因为每天交易它的许多人是同一批；所以一小群交易者只要有足够的成交量，就能把市场推动到形成反复出现的形态。如果市场处在弱多头趋势中横盘到下跌，许多交易者会相信：只要当前这根K线延伸到前一根K线上方一个最小报价单位处，就会有交易者在那里挂止损单买入。大多数聪明交易者都会预料到这一点。然而，如果有足够多、成交量又足够大的其他交易者认为这次修正跌得还不够深、不够久（例如，如果他们认为很可能出现一段两段式行情），这些交易者也许就会实际在高点处做空，或者在前一根K线上方一个最小报价单位处做空。如果他们的成交量压过了新多头，而援手的新多头又不够多，市场就很可能会向下走一两个最小报价单位。


> Why is a one-tick failed breakout so common, especially in the Eminis? With stocks, failures often come on 1 to 10 cent breakouts, depending on the price of the stock and the personality of the stock. Every stock has distinct characteristics in its trading, presumably because many of the same people trade it every day, so a small group of traders trading sufficient volume can move the market enough to create recurring patterns. If the market is sideways to down in a weak bull trend, many traders will believe that if the current bar extends one tick above the prior bar, traders will buy there on a stop. Most smart traders will expect this. However, if enough other traders with enough volume feel that the correction has not extended deep enough or long enough (for example, if they believe that a two-legged move is likely), those traders might actually go short at the high or at one tick above the prior bar. If their volume overwhelms the new longs and not enough new longs come to the rescue, the market will likely trade down for a tick or two.


此时，新多头开始紧张。既然他们的入场价这么好，为什么没有更多买家进来？而且，现在市场又便宜了一两个最小报价单位，在那些想买进的交易者眼里，这应该显得更有价值。按理说这应当很快把价格推上去，可是市场保持下跌的时间越长——哪怕只是几个最小报价单位——就有越多新多头开始担心自己可能看错了。有些人会开始以市价卖出平仓，给卖盘加码；另一些人会把卖出平仓单挂在一两个最小报价单位更低的位置，也许根据的是1分钟或3分钟图，把单子挂在最近一根K线下方一个最小报价单位处。这些单子一旦被触发，这些新买家也就变成了卖家，把价格推得更低。同时，原来那些空头会察觉到新多头被套了，许多人会给自己的空单加仓。当价格跌了三个、四个或五个最小报价单位后，那些被止损出场的买家，会从寻找买点转为等待更多价格行为展开。在买家缺席的情况下，价格会继续下跌，去寻找足够满足卖方的买盘。到某个时候，卖方会开始回补、止盈，价格下跌随之放缓，买家也会重新开始买进。一旦买压压过卖压，价格就会再次上涨。


> At this point, the new longs are feeling nervous. If their entry was at such a great price, why didn’t more buyers come in? Also, now that the market is even a tick or two cheaper, this should look like even better value to traders looking to get long. This should quickly drive the price up, but the longer the market stays down even just a couple of ticks, the more new bulls will become concerned that they may be wrong. Some will start selling out at the market, adding to the offers, and others will place sell exit orders at one or two ticks lower, maybe basing these orders on a 1 or 3 minute chart, with the order one tick below the most recent bar. Once these are hit, these new buyers will also become sellers, pushing the price further down. Also, the original shorts will sense that the new longs are trapped, and many will increase their short positions. As price falls three, four, or five ticks, the stopped-out buyers will switch from looking to buy to waiting for more price action to unfold. In the absence of buyers, the price will continue to fall in search of enough bids to satisfy the sellers. At some point, sellers will begin to cover and take profits, slowing the price fall, and buyers will again begin to buy. Once the buying pressure overtakes the selling pressure, the price will then go up again.


在5分钟图上，交易区间里出现的一个最小报价单位的突破失败，往往在更高的时间级别上（比如15分钟或60分钟图）也同样是差一个最小报价单位的突破失败。如果是这样，那么60分钟图上为什么没有一大堆差一个最小报价单位的突破失败呢？因为其中许多失败会在5分钟图上回调很多根K线，然后再次突破。结果是：尽管在60分钟K线正在形成的过程中，60分钟图上确实出现过差一个最小报价单位的突破失败，但到那根60分钟K线收盘时，这次突破已经延伸到一个最小报价单位以上了。


> A one-tick failed breakout on the 5 minute chart when it occurs in a trading range is often also a one-tick failed breakout on a higher time frame, like a 15 or 60 minute chart. If that is the case, why doesn’t the 60 minute chart have a lot of one-tick failed breakouts? That is because many of the one-tick failed breakouts pull back for many bars on the 5 minute chart and then break out again. The result is that even though there was a one-tick failed breakout of the 60 minute chart as the 60 minute bar was forming, by the time the bar closed, the breakout extended to more than one tick.


一个最小报价单位的失败，是新交易者亏损的一个常见来源。他们会看到自己认为的好建仓形态——比如一个买点——然后自信地把一张买入止损单挂在前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处。也许移动平均线正上方有一个两根K线反转形态，但它与前面两根K线完全重叠，而做多的入场位处在那个小交易区间的顶部。新手交易者看到那根强劲的多头趋势K线就买入，但经验丰富的交易者知道，这类两根K线反转通常是一个多头陷阱，他们很可能正是在新手买入的地方做空。果不其然，市场向上跳一个最小报价单位，触发了新手的买入止损单，让他们做多。然而紧接着的下一个最小报价单位就低了一个，然后是两个、三个；30秒之内，他们就看着自己的保护性止损被打掉，亏掉两个点。他们想不通：怎么会有人恰好在他们买入的地方卖出？那明明是个绝好的建仓形态！


> A one-tick failure is a common source of losses for new traders. They will see what they believe is a good setup—for example, a buy—and they confidently place a buy stop order at one tick above the high of the prior bar. Maybe there is a two-bar reversal just above the moving average, but it overlaps the prior two bars completely and the long entry is at the top of the small trading range. Novice traders will see the strong bull trend bar and buy, but experienced traders know that this type of two-bar reversal is usually a bull trap, and they are likely shorting where the novice traders are buying. As expected, the market ticks up and hits the entry buy stops of the novices, making them long. However, the very next tick is one tick lower, then two, then three, and within 30 seconds they lose two points as they watch their protective stops get hit. They wonder how anyone could be selling exactly where they were buying. It was such a great setup!


这类陷阱很常见。另一个例子是：新手在一段空头趋势中、还没有任何多头强势迹象之前就买入（比如此前还没有一波升到空头趋势线上方的急速行情）；或者交易者在铁丝网顶部那根实体极小的大十字星上方买入，或者在把一面熊旗误读成反转形态之后买入——他们被自己的急切冲昏了头，想在一段自认为已经走得过头的空头趋势里提早入场。


> These traps are common. Another example is a novice buying in a bear trend before there was a sign of bullish strength, like a prior surge above a bear trend line, or traders buying above a huge doji with a tiny body at the top of barbwire or a bear flag that they misread as a reversal, overcome by their eagerness to get in early in what they perceive as an overdone bear trend.


另一种常见情形是出现一根带小尾巴、甚至没有尾巴的大趋势K线。如果它是一根多头趋势K线，很多交易者会把保护性止损放在这根K线下方一个最小报价单位处。市场通常会在接下来五到10根K线里一路向下磨，打掉这些止损、把交易者套出场，然后再顺着那根趋势K线的方向反转向上去。


> Another common situation is when there is a huge trend bar with a tiny tail or no tail. If it is a bull trend bar, lots of traders will put their protective stops at one tick below the bar. It is common for the market to work its way down over the next five to 10 bars, hit the stops and trap traders out, and then reverse back up in the direction of the trend bar.


那位新手交易者没有意识到的是：许多大资金交易者把这些看成极好的做空建仓形态，他们乐于做空，因为他们知道只有弱势筹码才会买入；而这些弱势筹码一旦被冲洗出局，就会帮着把市场推下去。一个最小报价单位的失败，是市场正在往另一个方向走的可靠信号，所以要寻找让你入场的建仓形态。前面讲的这些对下跌的市场同样成立，而且所有一个最小报价单位的失败，有时会是两个最小报价单位，在200美元的股票里甚至会有五到10个最小报价单位。


> What that novice trader doesn’t realize is that lots of big traders view these as great short setups and they are happy to short, knowing that only weak hands would be buying, and as they are flushed out, they will help drive the market down. A one-tick failure is a reliable sign that the market is going the other way, so look for setups that allow you to enter. All of the preceding is true for down markets as well, and all of the one-tick failures can sometimes be two ticks, and even five to 10 ticks in a $200 stock.


突破回测常常会精确到最小报价单位去测试入场价，把弱势筹码套出场；他们随后只能追着市场、以差得多的价格重新入场。一次突破回测可能差一个最小报价单位没碰到保本止损，另一些时候会越过它两三个最小报价单位；但无论是哪一种，只要市场重新反转向趋势的方向，这次没能把市场反转回原来入场价之外的尝试，就是一个可靠的顺趋势建仓形态。例如，如果在 Emini 里，一根多头反转K线上方出现了一个强劲的买入建仓形态，市场随后上涨了10根K线，但之后又抛售，那就去看看当这波抛售接近原来那根多头信号K线的高点时会怎样。如果有一根K线在那根信号K线高点上方两个最小报价单位处转向向上，那么它就差一个最小报价单位没碰到保本止损。市场没能把多头冲洗出局。交易者随后会在这根突破回测K线上方买入，因为他们会把这次没能打到保护性止损看成多头在原入场价附近积极买入的信号：多头在保护自己的止损，等于在宣告自己很强。


> Breakout tests often test the entry price to the exact tick, trapping out weak hands who will then have to chase the market and reenter at a much worse price. A breakout test may miss the breakeven stop by one tick and at other times it will go beyond it for a couple of ticks, but in either case, if the market reverses back into the direction of the trend, this failed attempt to reverse the market beyond the original entry price is a reliable with-trend setup. For example, if there is a strong buy setup above a bull reversal bar in the Emini and the market trends up for 10 bars but then later sells off, look to see what happens when the sell-off gets near the high of that original bull signal bar. If there is a bar that turns up at two ticks above the high of the signal bar, then it missed the breakeven stops by a tick. The market failed to flush the bulls out. Traders will then buy above this breakout test bar because they will see the failure to hit the protective stops as a sign that the bulls were aggressively buying around the original entry price, protecting their stops and making a statement that they are strong.


大多数交易日都有大量的交易区间价格行为，并提供许多在摆动高点、低点突破失败处的入场机会。当价格走到前一个摆动高点上方、而动能又不是太强时，把一张做空的单子挂在前一根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处，做成止损单。如果到那根K线收盘时订单还没成交，就把订单上移到刚收盘的那根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处。继续这样做，直到当前行情段涨得太高、动能也太强，你需要更多价格行为才能做空。等下一次回调至少突破一条小级别趋势线，然后再寻找做空新摆动高点的机会。在趋势日里，小级别趋势线被突破之后、并且出现一根强劲反转K线时，你也可以反向操作新的摆动高点和低点。


> Most days have a lot of trading range price action and offer many entries on failed swing high and low breakouts. When the price goes above a prior swing high and the momentum is not too strong, place an order to short the higher high at one tick below the low of the prior bar on a stop. If the order is not filled by the time the bar closes, move the order up to one tick below the low of the bar that just closed. Continue to do this until the current leg gets so high and has so much momentum that you need more price action before shorting. Wait for another pullback that breaks at least a minor trend line and then look to short a new swing high. You can also fade new swing highs and lows on trend days after a minor trend line break and when there is a strong reversal bar.


同样地，前一个摆动低点下方的第一次突破失败，就是更低低点上的买入建仓形态。把一张买单挂在前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处，做成止损单。如果没有成交，就不断把订单下移到前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处；但如果市场跌得太远或太快，就重新开始这个过程：等一小段上涨行情突破一条小级别趋势线，然后考虑买入新低点处的一次突破失败。


> Similarly, the first failed breakout below a prior swing low is a lower low buy setup. Place an order to buy at one tick above the high of the prior bar on a stop. If it is not filled, keep lowering the order to one tick above the high of the prior bar, but if the market drops too far or too fast, start the process over; wait for a small rally that breaks a minor trend line and then consider buying a failed breakout to a new low.


在 Emini 里，当平均日波动幅度约为10个点时，一笔流行的交易是做四个最小报价单位的剥头皮。在趋势中，可能有一连串成功的剥头皮；但一旦某一次碰到限价单却没有成交，这个差五个最小报价单位的失败就是动能丧失的信号。这在1分钟图和3分钟图上也很常见。因为要完成四个最小报价单位的剥头皮，需要六个最小报价单位的突破（一个最小报价单位用于止损入场，四个最小报价单位是利润，通常还要再一个最小报价单位来确保止盈限价单成交），所以一波只走了五个最小报价单位就反转的行情，往往说明趋势交易者已经失去控制，回调或反转即将到来。由于许多交易者还会为捕捉两个、三个或四个点的止盈目标挂限价单，如果市场在这些目标还差一个最小报价单位的地方反转，那也是弱势的信号。例如，如果市场创出一个重要的日内低点，然后上涨到信号K线高点上方17个最小报价单位处，那么大多数想用四个点利润的限价单出场的交易者都不会成交，除非市场走到信号K线上方18个最小报价单位处。


> In the Emini, a popular trade is a scalp for four ticks when the average daily range is about 10 points. In a trend, there may be a series of successful scalps, but when one hits the limit order and does not get filled, this five-tick failure is a sign of a loss of momentum. These are also common on 1 and 3 minute charts. Since a six-tick breakout is needed to make a four-tick scalp (one tick for the stop entry, four ticks of profit, and usually one more tick to be sure the profit target limit order is filled), a move that goes only five ticks and then reverses often indicates that the trend traders have lost control and a pullback or reversal is imminent. Since many traders also place limit orders to capture two-, three-, or four-point profit targets, if the market reverses at one tick shy of these targets, it is also a sign of weakness. For example, if the market makes a significant intraday low and then rallies 17 ticks above the signal bar high, most traders trying to exit on limit orders with four points of profit will not get filled unless the market goes 18 ticks above the signal bar.


如果市场只走到17个最小报价单位，随后下一根K线又跌破了那根K线，那么那些没有提早一个最小报价单位离场的多头就会开始考虑出场，这往往至少带来一次向下的剥头皮。交易者会认为多头提早一个最小报价单位止盈了，这意味着多头对市场能否给出完整的四个点没有信心。信心不足会导致多头止盈、空头积极做空。多头本可以继续依靠移动止损，指望市场很快成交他们四个点的限价单；但大多数交易者不愿为了多赢那一个最小报价单位，去冒15个最小报价单位的浮盈变成两三个最小报价单位的风险。这等于为了赚一个最小报价单位而冒10个或更多最小报价单位的风险，是个亏钱的策略。一旦市场走到17个最小报价单位后回调几个最小报价单位，如果交易者的止盈限价单没有成交，他们很可能会把止盈目标下调两三个最小报价单位，并把移动止损上移到前一根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处。如果两张单子都没有成交，而那根K线收盘较弱或收成空头K线，他们也许就直接以市价出场。顺带说说，如果市场走到信号K线高点上方16个最小报价单位，那么它到达17或18个最小报价单位的概率约为80%。这意味着，在16个最小报价单位之后出场通常是不明智的，除非市场跌破前一根K线的低点——尤其当那根K线是一根卖出信号K线时。


> If instead the market hits 17 ticks and then the next bar trades below that bar, the remaining longs who did not exit one tick early will now think about exiting, and this often results in at least a downward scalp. Traders will assume that the bulls were taking their profit at one tick early, which means that the longs were not confident that the market would give them the full four points. This lack of confidence can lead to profit taking by the longs and aggressive shorting by the bears. Bulls could continue to rely on their trailing stops and hope that the market soon fills their four-point limit orders, but most traders would not be willing to risk having a 15-tick open profit turn into a two-or three-tick profit in an attempt to win that extra tick. This is the same as scalping for a one-tick profit while risking 10 or more ticks and is a losing strategy. Once the market hits 17 ticks and pulls back a few ticks, if traders’ profit-taking limit orders are not filled, they would most likely lower their profit targets by a couple of ticks and raise their trailing stops to one tick below the low of the prior bar. If neither order is filled and the bar had a weak or bear close, they might just exit at the market. Incidentally, if the market goes 16 ticks above the signal bar high, it has about an 80 percent chance of reaching 17 or 18 ticks. This means that it is usually unwise to exit after 16 ticks unless the market trades below the low of the prior bar, especially if that bar is a short signal.


大多数交易者处理潜在的九个最小报价单位失败的方式差不多。如果交易者买入了 Emini，想用两个点的利润出场，他们的限价单会挂在信号K线高点上方九个最小报价单位处。市场通常还得再走一个最小报价单位才能成交这张单，也就是信号K线高点上方10个最小报价单位处。如果市场碰到这张单却没有成交，随后开始下跌，他们就得决定是依靠初始止损，还是依靠移动止损，比如放在最近一根带有像样多头实体的K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处。如果他们的限价单正好挂在一个阻力位（比如前一个摆动高点）上，而市场又没有很快突破它，他们也可能会迅速把限价单下调几个最小报价单位。一旦市场走到九个最小报价单位，他们就绝不该让这笔交易变成亏损，因为那样就是冒八个或更多最小报价单位的风险去赚一个最小报价单位，交易者等式非常糟糕。


> Most traders handle potential nine-tick failures in a similar way. If traders bought the Emini and were trying to exit with a two-point profit, their limit orders would be nine ticks above the high of the signal bar. The market usually has to go one more tick to fill the order, which is 10 ticks above the signal bar high. If the market hits the order but does not fill it and begins to trade down, they have to decide whether to rely on their initial stop or a trailing stop, like one tick below the low of the most recent bar with a decent-sized bull body. If their limit order is exactly at a resistance level, like a prior swing high, and it does not quickly break above, they might also quickly lower their limit order by a few ticks. Once it hits nine ticks, they should never allow the trade to turn into a loss, because they would then be risking eight or more ticks to make one tick, and this has a terrible trader’s equation.


在 SPY、QQQ 这类有许多剥头皮交易者的其他市场里，也有类似的失败。对这两个市场来说，常见的止盈目标是10个最小报价单位，而它通常需要市场越过信号K线走12个最小报价单位。如果这波行情只走到10个或11个最小报价单位（甚至八个或九个）就反转，那么它通常会引出至少一次反方向的有利可图的剥头皮，因为剥头皮交易者被套住了，他们会在信号K线或入场K线的反转处出场。这类失败在股票上也很常见。例如，如果一只股票做剥头皮时能可靠地赚到超过一美元，却在两次尝试中都没能碰到1.00美元的目标，那这往往就是一次不错的反方向剥头皮。


> There are comparable failures in other markets that have many scalpers, like the SPY and the QQQ. For both, a common profit target is 10 ticks, which usually requires a 12-tick move beyond the signal bar. If the move reaches only 10 or 11 ticks (or even eight or nine) and then reverses, it usually leads to at least a profitable scalp in the opposite direction, since the scalpers are trapped and will get out on the reversal of the signal or entry bar. This type of failure is common with stocks as well. For example, if a stock reliably reaches more than a dollar on a scalp, but then falls just short on two attempts at the $1.00 target, then this is often a good scalp in the opposite direction.


最常见也最可靠的失败之一，是价格第一次急速冲过趋势线。股票交易者总是在日线图上寻找这种情形，但它会出现在所有时间级别上。例如，如果 AAPL 正处在强劲的多头市场里，却出了一份糟糕的财报，它可能一天下跌8%，并在日线图上触及移动平均线。这时经验丰富的交易者不会去找做空机会，而是往往在那根下跌急速行情的收盘价处、或第二天的开盘价处买入。他们看待这件事，就像购物者看到商场打折一样。这只股票刚刚打了8%的折，而这场促销不会持续太久，所以他们很快买进。他们知道，大多数反转尝试都会失败，而第一次尝试几乎总会跟着一个新高，所以他们才会在一条强劲空头急速行情的底部买入。


> One of the most common and reliable failures is the first spike through the trend line. Stock traders look for these all the time on daily charts, but it happens on all time frames. For example, if AAPL is in a strong bull market and has a bad earnings report, it might sell off 8 percent in one day and hit the moving average on the daily chart. Instead of looking for shorts, experienced traders will often buy on the close of that spike down or on the open of the next day. They see this just like a shopper sees a sale at the mall. The stock just got marked down 8 percent and the sale won’t last long, so they quickly buy it. They know that most attempts to reverse fail and the first attempt almost always is followed by a new high, so they buy it even though they are buying at the bottom of a strong bear spike.


所有形态都常常失败，不管看起来多好。失败发生时，就会有被套的交易者不得不带着亏损出场，通常是在入场K线或信号K线之外一个最小报价单位处。这对聪明交易者来说，是一个做低风险剥头皮的机会。把你的入场止损单，正好挂在那些被套交易者放保护性止损的同一位置，你就会在他们出场的地方入场。他们不会急于顺着原来的方向再次入场，这会让市场倒向你的方向，因此至少应该带来一次剥头皮，而且往往会是一段两段式行情。


> All patterns often fail, no matter how good they look. When they do, there will be trapped traders who will have to exit with a loss, usually at one tick beyond the entry or signal bars. This is an opportunity for smart traders to enter for a low-risk scalp. Place your entry stop order at exactly the same place that these trapped traders are placing their protective stops, and you will get in where they will get out. They won’t be eager to enter again in their original direction, which makes the market one-sided in your direction and should lead to at least a scalp and usually a two-legged move.


![图 9.1](figures/fig-09-01.jpg)


**图 9.1　小的假突破**


在5分钟 Emini 图上，一到两个最小报价单位、并导致反转的假突破很常见。图 9.1 给出了六个例子（第1根K线的标注远在那根K线上方）。突破交易者挂止损单入场后，一旦发现市场在回调一两个最小报价单位，而不是立刻顺着他们的方向继续走，他们就会开始挂保护性止损。逆势交易者嗅到了血腥味，会正好在被套交易者止损出场的地方入场。大多数突破尝试都会失败，尤其在市场处于交易区间时；而这些失败常常表现为一个最小报价单位的假突破。经验丰富的交易者利用这些突破来止盈，或者做反方向的交易，因为他们预期交易区间里的大多数突破都会失败。例如，如果一位交易者在交易区间底部附近买入，他很可能是为了测试区间高点做剥头皮，因此常常会挂一张限价单，在区间顶部卖出平掉多头、锁定利润。在强趋势中，他们反过来做。例如，如果市场处在多头趋势中，交易者反而会在区间顶部上方挂止损单买入，因为他们预期还有一段上涨。


> One-and two-tick false breakouts leading to reversals are common in the 5 minute Emini. Figure 9.1 presents six examples (the label for bar 1 is well above the bar). Once the breakout traders enter on their stop and discover that the market is pulling back by a tick or two instead of immediately continuing in their direction, they start to place protective stops. Countertrend traders smell the blood and will enter just where the trapped traders are taking their losses. Most breakout attempts fail, especially when the market is in a trading range, and the failures are often in the form of one-tick false breakouts. Experienced traders use the breakouts to take profits or to trade in the opposite direction, expecting that most breakouts in a trading range will fail. For example, if a trader bought near the bottom of a trading range, he will likely be scalping for a test of the high of the range and will often have a limit order to sell out of his long and take profits at the top of the range. In a strong trend, they do the opposite. For example, if the market is in a bull trend, traders instead will buy on a stop above the top of the range, since they expect another leg up.


![图 9.2](figures/fig-09-02.jpg)


**图 9.2　Emini 中一个最小报价单位的陷阱**


如图 9.2 所示，在 Emini 这两天的行情里，有很多一个最小报价单位陷阱的例子。


> As shown in Figure 9.2, there were many examples of one-tick traps in these two days in the Emini.


第1根K线是一个差一个最小报价单位没成功的低2，并成为从太平洋标准时间上午8:55开始的那面楔形牛旗的突破回调入场点。


> Bar 1 was a one-tick failed low 2 and became a breakout pullback entry for the wedge bull flag that began at 8:55 a.m. PST.


第2根K线是铁丝网中一个差一个最小报价单位没成功的高2，它套住了那些自以为谨慎、等大外包K线上方再买入的交易者，结果他们买在了移动平均线下方一个交易区间的顶部。这就成了一面双顶熊旗。


> Bar 2 was a one-tick failed high 2 in barbwire that trapped traders who thought that they were being conservative by waiting to buy above the large outside bar, only to be trapped buying at the top of a trading range below a flat moving average. This became a double top bear flag.


第3根K线是失控多头趋势里一次差一个最小报价单位的失败反转，当时聪明的交易者正急切地等着任何回调去买入。他们在那根K线低点下方买入，而那正是弱势空头做空的位置——那些空头做空的是开盘高点上方突破之后的回落。


> Bar 3 was a one-tick failed reversal in a runaway bull trend where smart traders were eagerly waiting for any pullback to buy. They were buying below the low of the bar, exactly where weak bears were shorting the reversal down from the breakout above the high of the open.


第4根K线跌破了四根K线前那个小摆动低点一个最小报价单位，搭出了一个高2做多。


> Bar 4 broke one tick below the small swing low of four bars earlier and set up a high 2 long.


第5根K线是一根大的多头趋势K线，因此在它低点下方一个最小报价单位处会有止损。这些止损在第7根K线处被打掉了一个最小报价单位。多头得以把市场撑在第4根K线这个多头急速行情的底部之上。


> Bar 5 was a large bull trend bar, and there would therefore be stops at one tick below its low. These were run by one tick on bar 7. The bulls were able to hold the market above the bar 4 bottom of the bull spike.


第9根K线低了一个最小报价单位，把交易者套进了他们自以为是更低高点做空的交易里，而实际上那是一面横盘的多头旗形。


> Bar 9 went one tick lower, trapping traders into what they thought was a lower high short, but actually was a sideways bull flag.


第10根K线把第6根K线那些空头的保本保护性止损打掉了两个最小报价单位。它与第8根K线一起搭出了一面双顶熊旗。


> Bar 10 ran the breakeven protective stops for the bar 6 shorts by two ticks. It set up a double top bear flag with bar 8.


第14根K线是最可靠的一个最小报价单位的失败之一——一个差一个最小报价单位没成功的高2，而新手交易者错误地把它当成了多头回调。这是一个完美的陷阱，并引出了一波强劲下跌（图中未显示）。他们没有注意到：回调到第11根K线已经打破了趋势线，随后第12根K线又做了一次更高的高点测试。另外，从高点往下有五根空头趋势K线和一根十字星，而第13根K线那个高1之后也没有趋势线突破。这是从一个更高的高点出发、经两根K线反转之后形成的空头通道，所以高2信号K线上方更可能有空头而不是买家。记住，一个高2本身并不是买入信号。它是多头趋势顶部处的买入信号，但这里多头趋势已经结束了。市场此时要么处在交易区间中，要么处在空头趋势中。高2在交易区间里也是买入信号，但只在区间底部，不是在这么靠近顶部的地方。


> Bar 14 was one of the most reliable one-tick failures—a failed high 2 in what novice traders erroneously assumed to be a bull pullback. This was a perfect trap and led to a strong down move (not shown). They missed noticing the trend line break by the pullback to bar 11 and then the higher high test at bar 12. Also, there were five bear trend bars and one doji down from the high and no trend line break after the bar 13 high 1. This was a bear channel after a two-bar reversal from a higher high, and therefore it was more likely that there would be more shorts than buyers above the high 2 signal bar. Remember, a high 2 alone is not a buy signal. It is a buy signal at the top of a bull trend, but here the bull trend was over. The market was now either in a trading range or in a bear trend. A high 2 is also a buy signal in a trading range, but only at the bottom of the range, not this close to the top.


![图 9.3](figures/fig-09-03.jpg)


**图 9.3　越过信号K线和入场K线保护性止损的突破**


看看图 9.3 中发生了什么：市场穿过了那些水平线，它们位于信号K线和入场K线之外一个最小报价单位处，很可能是交易者放保护性止损的地方。大多数时候，那里会出现一根趋势K线，行情也大到足以让剥头皮交易者获利。这张图上的许多失败都是弱势建仓形态，聪明的价格行为交易者本来不会去做。然而，有足够多的交易者做了这些交易，所以当他们被迫带着亏损出场时，就把市场推向了反方向。例如，那些在第4根反转K线处做多的交易者，止损会放在入场K线下方或信号K线下方。两处都被第5根大空头趋势K线打掉了，而入场止损单正好挂在这些位置的聪明空头，至少赚到了剥头皮交易者的利润。


> Look at what happened in Figure 9.3 as the market broke through the horizontal lines, which were one tick beyond signal and entry bars and were likely places where traders would place their protective stops. Most of the time, there was a trend bar and the move was big enough for a scalper to make a profit. Many of the failures on this chart were for weak setups that smart price action traders would not have taken. However, enough traders took them so that they moved the market in the opposite direction as they were forced out with a loss. For example, traders who went long off the bar 4 reversal bar would have had their stops below either the entry bar or the signal bar. Both were run by the big bar 5 bear trend bar, and smart shorts who had their entry stops at those exact locations made at least a scalper’s profit.


作为一条推论，如果一根K线的极值被测试了但没有被超越，那么止损就被测试了但没有被打掉，这笔交易往往会盈利。如果做多入场的保护性止损差一个最小报价单位没被打到，这次测试实际上形成了一个双底牛旗：第一个底是信号K线或入场K线的底部，第二个底是那根回到该价位、但没能触及保护性止损的K线。


> As a corollary, if the extreme of the bar is tested but not exceeded, then the stops are tested but not hit, and the trade will often be profitable. If it is a protective stop on a long entry that is missed by one tick, the test effectively forms a double bottom bull flag, with the first bottom being the bottom of the signal or entry bar and the second one being the bar that came back to that level but failed to reach the protective stops.


![图 9.4](figures/fig-09-04.jpg)


**图 9.4　失败的止盈目标**


当市场触及一张止盈限价单的价格后回调时，大多数交易者的限价单不会成交。当市场随后停滞、或回调几个最小报价单位时，这些交易者中有很多人会以市价出场，因为他们不想冒进一步回吐浮盈的风险。这会给任何修正添燃料，而且往往是市场试图反转的信号。


> When the market hits a profit-taking limit order price and then pulls back, most traders would not have their limit orders filled. When the market then stalls or pulls back for a few ticks, many of these traders will exit at the market because they do not want to risk giving back any more of their open profit. This adds fuel to any correction and is often a sign that the market is trying to reverse.


如图 9.4 所示，市场在第2根K线上方上涨了21个最小报价单位，然后反转向下。有些在第2根信号K线上方一个最小报价单位处买入的交易者，挂着以五个点利润平掉多头的限价单，也就是信号K线高点上方21个最小报价单位处，但除非市场再高一个最小报价单位，大多数人都不会成交。市场反而反转向下，这些交易者中有许多人迅速平仓离场，想在市场回到他们的入场价之前尽量多保住一些利润。


> As shown in Figure 9.4, the market rallied for 21 ticks above bar 2 and then reversed down. Some traders who bought one tick above the bar 2 signal bar had limit orders to exit their longs with five points of profit, 21 ticks above the signal bar high, but most would not have been filled unless the market went one tick higher. Instead, the market reversed, and many of those traders quickly got out of the market as they tried to salvage as much profit as they could before waiting to see if the market would go all the way back to their entry price.


第7根K线对多头来说是一次差17个最小报价单位的失败，他们在第6根买入信号K线上方一个最小报价单位处买入。许多想赚四个点的交易者，看到市场在信号K线高点上方17个最小报价单位处触及他们的限价单，等市场跌破那根K线的低点时就出场了。而正确判断趋势强劲、选择波段持有而不是试图在四个点处出场的交易者，会依靠保本止损。一旦市场走到第7根K线高点之上，他们就把止损移到第8根K线下方一个最小报价单位处——那是最近的一个更高的低点。


> Bar 7 was a 17-tick failure for bulls who had bought one tick above the bar 6 buy signal bar. Many traders who were trying to make a four-point profit saw the market reach their limit order at 17 ticks above the signal bar high and exited once the market fell below the low of that bar. Traders who correctly believed that the trend was strong, and were, instead, swinging their longs and not trying to exit at four points, would rely on a breakeven stop. Once the market moved above the bar 7 high, they would then trail their stops to one tick below bar 8, the most recent higher low.


第4、8、20和30根K线是做空交易中五个最小报价单位失败的例子。大多数空头需要市场跌破信号K线底部六个最小报价单位，他们那张做四个最小报价单位剥头皮的止盈限价单才会成交。有些交易者的单子会成交，但大多数不会成交。


> Bars 4, 8, 20, and 30 were examples of five-tick failures on short trades. Most shorts needed the market to fall six ticks below the bottom of the signal bar for their profit-taking limit order for a four-tick scalp to get filled. Some traders would have had their orders filled, but most would not have been filled.


第9根K线对在第8根K线上方买入、想赚三个点的多头来说，是一次差13个最小报价单位的失败。


> Bar 9 was a 13-tick failure for longs who bought above bar 8, hoping to make a three-point profit.


第16和24根K线，对想赚两个点的交易者来说，是差九个最小报价单位的失败。他们不会让这些交易变成亏损，而是会移动止损。例如，他们会在第17根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处平掉第16根信号K线的多头，或者也许在第17根K线收成空头K线的收盘处平掉。他们可能会在第24根K线之后两根形成的那根空头K线下方一个最小报价单位处，平掉第23根买入信号K线上方那笔多头。


> Bars 16 and 24 were nine-tick failures for traders who tried to make two points. They would not let those trades turn into a loss and would trail their stops. For example, they would exit the bar 16 signal bar long at one tick below the bar 17 low, or possibly on the bear close of bar 17. They might exit the long from above the bar 23 buy signal at one tick below the bear bar that formed two bars after bar 24.


![图 9.5](figures/fig-09-05.jpg)


**图 9.5　交易区间里的突破通常会失败**


当双向交易很强时，摆动高点上方的突破和摆动低点下方的突破通常都会失败。


> When there is strong two-sided trading, breakouts above swing highs and below swing lows usually fail.


如图 9.5 所示，涨到第1根K线的上涨很强，但由于开盘反转往往很剧烈，而且它是一个更高的高点（高于昨天收盘价附近的那个摆动高点）、又突破了多头趋势通道线，所以做空是合理的。


> As shown in Figure 9.5, the rally to bar 1 was strong, but since opening reversals are often sharp and it was a higher high (above the swing high near yesterday’s close) that broke above a bull trend channel line, it was a reasonable short.


第1根K线摆动高点之后的第2根K线回调很深，而自开盘以来的K线都很大、影线也长。当时是双向的剧烈交易，在多头趋势明确形成之前，交易者应该假定多头和空头都很活跃。由于这一天还没有证明自己是多头趋势日，就应该把它当作交易区间日来交易。


> The bar 2 pullback after the bar 1 swing high was deep, and the bars since the open had been large with big tails. There was two-sided volatile trading and until a bull trend clearly developed, traders should have assumed that both bulls and bears were active. Since this had not proven itself yet to be a bull trend day, it should have been traded as a trading range day.


第3根K线是一个更高的高点，因为它是高于更早一个摆动高点的摆动高点。涨到第3根K线的动能太强，没有二次入场或一根强劲的反转K线，就不能考虑做空；但如果交易者做了空，这波下跌有26美分，所以至少能有一点利润。


> Bar 3 was a higher high since it was a swing high that was above an earlier swing high. The momentum up to bar 3 was too strong to consider a short without a second entry or a strong reversal bar, but if a trader shorted, the move down was 26 cents, so it could have been minimally profitable.


第5根K线是一个更高的高点，也是合理的做空点，尤其因为它有两段小的上涨（中间有一根空头趋势K线，代表从第4根K线起第一段上涨的结束）。市场只跌了18美分就又涨了上去。一位机敏的交易者也许会平掉一部分，但大多数人只会以4美分的亏损把交易打平出场。


> Bar 5 was a higher high and a reasonable short, especially since it had two small legs (there was a bear trend bar in the middle that represented the end of the first leg up from bar 4). The market dropped only 18 cents before going back up. A nimble trader might have taken some off, but most would have just scratched the trade with a 4 cent loss.


第7根K线属于同一波上涨，所以它是一次二次入场（一个低2）的做空。第7根K线与第5根K线形成了分毫不差的双顶，而且本质上是一个被截短的三次推进上涨形态（第3、5、7根K线），所以很可能走出两段下跌。


> Bar 7 was part of this same up move so it was a second-entry (a low 2) short. Bar 7 was a double top with bar 5 to the penny, and essentially a truncated three-push up pattern (bars 3, 5, and 7), so two down legs were likely.


第10根K线是一个更低的低点，也是一段可能的更大级别多头趋势中的第二段下跌。它的低点高于第2根K线的低点，所以市场可能仍在形成大型的多头趋势性摆动。在多头趋势或横盘市场中，两段下跌——尤其是平坦移动平均线下方的两次推进——始终都是不错的做多。


> Bar 10 was a lower low and the second leg down in a possible larger bull trend. Its low was above the bar 2 low, so the market might still have been forming large bull trending swings. Two legs down in a bull trend or sideways market, especially two pushes below a flat moving average, are always a good long.


第11根K线是一个更高的高点，因为它高于第9根K线那个摆动高点，尽管第9根K线是前一段下跌的一部分。仍然会有交易者在那里交易（会有空头的止损、买入突破的止损单，也会有人新开空单），因为走到任何此前摆动高点之上都是强势信号，也是交易区间日上一次潜在的反向操作（要留意突破失败、以及强势缺乏后续行情的迹象）。


> Bar 11 was a higher high because it was above the bar 9 swing high, even though bar 9 was part of the prior down leg. There would still have been traders who would have traded there (there would have been stops on shorts, stops to buy the breakout, and new shorts), because going above any prior swing high is a sign of strength and a potential fade on a trading range day (look for breakouts to fail and signs of strength to lack follow-through).


第13根K线比第11根K线低一个最小报价单位，是一面双顶熊旗，因此是一个做空建仓形态。它自第10根K线起有两段上涨，第二段位于平坦移动平均线上方（第11根K线是第一段）。


> Bar 13 was one tick below bar 11 and was a double top bear flag and therefore a short setup. It was two legs up from bar 10 and the second leg above a flat moving average (bar 11 was the first).


第14根K线相对第10根和第12根K线这两个摆动低点来说，是一个更低的低点。顺带说说，从第10根和第14根K线做多的那两笔交易，都是对从第4根和第8根K线画出的空头趋势通道线的失败过靶。这提高了做多成功的可能性。两者都有两根K线反转建仓形态。第10根K线是一面楔形牛旗的底部，第14根K线是一面扩张三角形牛旗的底部。


> Bar 14 was a lower low for both the swing lows at bars 10 and 12. Incidentally, the longs from bars 10 and 14 were both failed overshoots of a bear trend channel line drawn from bars 4 and 8. This increased the chances of successful long trades. Both had two-bar reversal setups. Bar 10 was the bottom of a wedge bull flag, and bar 14 was the bottom of an expanding triangle bull flag.


![图 9.6](figures/fig-09-06.jpg)


**图 9.6　AMZN 中的失败突破**


亚马逊（AMZN）在图 9.6 所示的5分钟图上，摆动高点和低点之外出现了许多由一根K线构成的大的失败突破。开盘那波高潮式上涨、接着大幅反转下跌之后，多头和空头都展示出了实力，这提高了当天任何一方发起的行情都会被另一方反转的可能性。交易区间因此很可能出现。所有带标注的K线都是失败的突破。窄幅交易区间从第3根K线之后开始，先变成一个小型扩张三角形顶部，到第6根K线结束，又变成一个扩张三角形底部，到第7根K线结束。从底部开始的上涨没能突破顶部，反而与第6根K线形成了双顶，市场随后一路抛售到收盘。


> Amazon (AMZN) had many large one-bar failed breakouts beyond swing highs and lows on the 5 minute chart shown in Figure 9.6. After the climactic run-up on the open and then the large reversal down, the bulls and the bears both demonstrated strength and increased the odds that any move by one side would be reversed by the other throughout the day. This made a trading range likely. All of the labeled bars were failed breakouts. The tight trading range began after bar 3, and turned into a small expanding triangle top that ended at bar 6 and then an expanding triangle bottom that ended at bar 7. The rally from the bottom failed to break out of the top and instead formed a double top with bar 6, and the market sold off into the close.


![图 9.7](figures/fig-09-07.jpg)


**图 9.7　交易区间里的突破通常会失败**


当某一天看起来正在发展成交易区间日时，交易者会预期突破失败，并寻找反向操作。如图 9.7 所示，到中午时已经很清楚：这一天波动小、横盘，这大大提高了突破很可能失败的可能性。第1、2、3根K线都是突破反向操作的二次入场。涨到第3根K线顶部之前那根趋势K线很大、成交量也大，把许多满怀希望的多头吸了进来，他们押注终于可能出现一段趋势。在小波动日里，这始终都是低概率的押注，好得多的做法是反向操作突破，或者寻找强劲的突破回调。跌到第1根K线低点和涨到第2根K线高点的两次突破都很弱（影线显眼、K线重叠），所以两次突破都很可能失败。以第3根K线收尾的那次突破始终没有出现突破回调，没能给多头一个低风险做多的机会，所以唯一可做的就是那次二次入场做空。


> When a day appears to be developing into a trading range day, traders expect breakouts to fail and they look to fade them. As shown in Figure 9.7, by midday it was clear that the day was small and sideways, which greatly increased the chances that breakouts would likely fail. Bars 1, 2, and 3 were second entries on breakout fades. The trend bar leading up to the bar 3 top was large and had big volume, sucking in lots of hopeful bulls who bet that there might finally be a trend. This is always a low-probability bet on a small day, and it is much better to fade the breakouts or look for strong breakout pullbacks. The breakouts to the bar 1 low and the bar 2 high were weak (prominent tails, overlapping bars), so it was likely both times that the breakouts would fail. The breakout that ended in bar 3 never had a breakout pullback to give the bulls a low-risk long, so the only trade was the second-entry short.


![图 9.8](figures/fig-09-08.jpg)


**图 9.8　把交易者套在好交易之外**


苹果（AAPL）一直是日内交易者最好把握的股票之一，但和许多其他股票一样，它有时会在反转开始时打掉止损，把交易者套在极好的交易之外，如图 9.8 所示。


> Apple (AAPL) has been one of the best-behaved stocks for day traders, but like many other stocks, it sometimes traps traders out of great trades by running stops at the start of a reversal, as shown in Figure 9.8.


交易者在第1根K线处的双底牛旗买入，入场方式要么是六根K线之后、要么是三根K线之后，当市场升到前一根K线的高点之上时。出现了一波升到移动平均线上方的上涨，它突破了趋势线，而那道均线缺口K线的做空又带来了第2根K线对空头低点的测试。许多多头的保护性止损都在第1根K线双底牛旗的下方。第2根K线比第1根低了一个最小报价单位，把多头套了出去，但它与第1根K线形成了双底牛旗，这带来了一次反转，并一直延续到了第二天。第1根K线下方那次一个最小报价单位的突破失败，把多头套了出去、把空头关在了里面。跌到第2根K线的这波下跌处在一条陡峭的空头通道中，它是第三次向下推进，因此是一个高3买入建仓形态。在陡峭通道中，高3比高2更可靠，因为通道常常在第三次向下推进后反转向上。这笔做多特别好的地方在于，它把新入场的多头套在了场外，并立刻在他们面前反转向上，所以在心理上他们很难再买回来。他们会追着市场往上买，入场太迟，反而给这波上涨添了燃料。


> Traders bought the double bottom bull flag at bar 1 by entering either three or six bars later as the market went above the high of the prior bar. There was a rally above the moving average that broke the trend line, and the moving average gap bar short led to the bar 2 test of the bear low. Many bulls had their protective stops below the bar 1 double bottom bull flag. Bar 2 dipped below bar 1 by a tick and trapped the longs out, but it formed a double bottom bull flag with bar 1, which led to a reversal that carried into the next day. The one-tick failed breakout below bar 1 trapped bulls out and bears in. The move down to bar 2 was in a tight bear channel, and it was the third push down and therefore a high 3 buy setup. A high 3 is a more reliable setup in a tight channel than a high 2, because channels often reverse up after a third push down. What made this long especially good was that it trapped new longs out and immediately reversed up on them, so psychologically it would have been difficult for them to buy. They would have chased the market up, entering late, thereby adding fuel to the upswing.


![图 9.9](figures/fig-09-09.jpg)


**图 9.9　头一个小时里的双顶与双底**


股票常常在头一个小时里形成双顶或双底旗形（见图 9.9）。它们大多可以交易，但一定要把一部分仓位剥头皮止盈，并把止损移到保本处，以防形态失败。


> Stocks commonly form double top or bottom flags in the first hour (see Figure 9.9). Most are tradable, but always scalp out part of your position and move your stop to breakeven in case the pattern fails.


第2根和第4根K线形成了一面双顶熊旗，它失败了。市场随后形成了由第3根和第5根K线构成的双底牛旗。


> Bars 2 and 4 formed a double top bear flag that failed. The market then formed a bars 3 and 5 double bottom bull flag.


随后你必须在那面由第4根和第6根K线构成的双顶熊旗处再次反手，但你的多头本来会净赚70美分。此时你就知道，市场正在形成一个交易区间，很可能是一个三角形。


> You then had to reverse again at the bar 4 and 6 double top bear flag, but you would have netted 70 cents from your long. At this point, you knew that the market was forming a trading range, likely a triangle.


第7根K线是另一次失败，但是一个不错的做多，因为强劲行情（涨到第1根K线的上涨）之后的交易区间通常是持续形态，而且第3、5、7根K线都在移动平均线处找到了支撑。跌到第9根K线的抛售持续了七根K线，没有任何多头强势，所以更好的做法是等二次入场，尽管第9根K线（与第7根K线相比）是一个更高的低点。它很可能走不远。


> Bar 7 was another failure, but a good long since trading ranges following a strong move (the rally to bar 1) are usually continuation patterns, and bars 3, 5, and 7 all found support at the moving average. The sell-off to bar 9 was seven bars long with no bullish strength, so it would have been better to wait for a second entry, despite bar 9 being a higher low (compared to bar 7). It was likely to fail to go far.


第10根K线处的突破回调，是一次完美的二次入场。


> The breakout pullback at bar 10 was a perfect second entry.


![图 9.10](figures/fig-09-10.jpg)


**图 9.10　失败的双底牛旗**


如图 9.10 所示，第4根K线本是一个双底牛旗入场的建仓形态，但它随着第5根K线那个低2而失败，而那个低2是从跌到第4根K线的强劲空头急速行情中回调出来的。这导致市场跌破双底，随后又走出一段两段式行情，跌到第7根K线。做空有几个选择，比如在第5根K线下方、第4根K线低点下方一到两个最小报价单位处、在跌破第4根K线的那根K线收盘处，或者在下一根K线（一根强劲的后续行情K线）的收盘处。


> As shown in Figure 9.10, bar 4 was a setup for a double bottom bull flag entry, but it failed with the bar 5 low 2, which was a pullback from the strong bear spike down to bar 4. This led to a breakout below the double bottom and then a two-legged move to bar 7. There were several choices for getting short, like below bar 5, one or two ticks below the bar 4 low, on the close of the bar that broke below bar 4, or on the close of the next bar, which was a strong follow-through bar.


![图 9.11](figures/fig-09-11.jpg)


**图 9.11　大多数头肩形态都会失败**


如图 9.11 所示，第5根和第11根K线是头肩底形态的右肩，而这类形态大多会失败，这里也是如此（第1根和第9根K线是左肩）。仅凭形态本身，不足以成为做一笔逆势交易的理由。你总是希望在反转形态出现之前，先看到一些更早的逆势强势。即便如此，也没有任何保证这笔交易会成功。第2根K线打破了趋势线，涨到第4根K线的上涨很强，尽管它没能超过第2根K线的高点，这是一个弱势信号。虽然大多数聪明交易者在第5根K线双底牛旗和做多入场之后、面对第6根K线的失败时不会反手做空，但他们会把止损移到保本处，心想：如果止损被打掉了、而这笔交易仍然成立，那么这次止损打掉的行情就会搭出一个突破回调做多的建仓形态。这里止损确实被打掉了，但市场继续下跌。跌破第5根K线之后紧接着的那一根K线突破回调，是一次极好的做空。第5根K线也是第4根急速行情之后三角形里的第三次向下推进，而这个三角形同时也是一面楔形牛旗。


> As shown in Figure 9.11, bars 5 and 11 were right shoulders of head and shoulders bottoms, most of which fail, as they did here (bars 1 and 9 were the left shoulders). The shape alone is not enough reason to place a countertrend trade. You always want to see some earlier countertrend strength prior to the reversal pattern. Even then, there are no guarantees that the trade will be successful. Bar 2 broke a trend line and the rally to bar 4 was strong, although its failure to exceed the bar 2 high was a sign of weakness. Although most smart traders would not have reversed to short at the bar 6 failure after the bar 5 double bottom bull flag and long entry, they would have moved their stops to breakeven, thinking that if the stops were hit but the trade was still good, the stop run would set up a breakout pullback long setup. Here, the stops were hit but the market kept selling off. The one-bar breakout pullback just after the breakout below bar 5 was a great short. Bar 5 was also the third push down in a triangle after the bar 4 spike, and the triangle was also a wedge bull flag.


第11根K线那个右肩是一个买点，但保本止损同样会被打掉。


> The bar 11 right shoulder was a buy, but again the breakeven stop would have been hit.


![图 9.12](figures/fig-09-12.jpg)


**图 9.12　对趋势极值的两段式测试**


如图 9.12 所示，跌到第2根和第6根K线的两波抛售都打破了主要趋势线，所以在两种情况下，对前一个高点的两段式测试都应该搭出一笔不错的做空。第3根K线的低2做空成功了，方法是在第3根K线下方做空，或者接两根K线之后的二次入场。


> As shown in Figure 9.12, the sell-offs to bar 2 and to bar 6 broke major trend lines, so, in each case, a two-legged test of the prior high should set up a good short. The bar 3 low 2 short was successful, either by shorting below bar 3 or by taking the second entry two bars later.


第8根K线的做空就没那么确定了，因为这次测试是一根大的多头趋势K线（几乎是一根外包K线，因为它的低点与前一根K线相同）。在一根外包K线之后入场的传统做法，是把止损单挂在两个极值之外一个最小报价单位处，朝突破的方向成交。然而，外包K线本质上就是一根K线的交易区间，而大多数交易区间突破入场都会失败。你只应该偶尔在一根外包K线的突破上入场，因为风险太大（要冒到K线另一端的风险，而它很大）。既然这是两根K线反转，最安全的入场位就在两根K线中较低的那根下方，也就是那根大的多头趋势K线下方，因为市场常常会跌破空头K线，却不会同时跌破两根K线——这里正是如此。


> The bar 8 short was less certain because the test was a large bull trend bar (almost an outside bar, since it had the same low as the prior bar). The traditional way to enter after an outside bar is on a stop at one tick beyond both extremes, getting filled in the direction of the breakout. However, outside bars are basically one-bar trading ranges, and most trading range breakout entries fail. You should only rarely enter on a breakout of an outside bar because the risk is too great (to the opposite side of the bar, which is large). Since this was a two-bar reversal, the safest entry was below the lower of the two bars, which was the large bull trend bar, because very often the market goes below the bear bar, but not below both bars, and that happened here.


如果你在第8根K线的内包K线突破处做空，那么到它收盘时你就会紧张（那是一根十字星K线，表明没有信念）。不过，大多数交易者不会做那笔空，因为三根或更多横盘K线、且其中至少一根是十字星，通常造成太多不确定性（铁丝网）。外包K线之前的那两根小K线小得足以像十字星，所以最好等更多价格行为。但是，如果你没在第8根K线做空，你就得相信有很多人做了空，而这些交易者入场K线收成十字星，让他们对自己的仓位感到不安。他们会很快出场，于是就被套住了。他们很可能在第8根入场K线上方一个最小报价单位处买回自己的空单，然后在看到更好的价格行为之前不愿再卖出。空头离场之后，他们又要买回自己的仓位，那么在他们出场的位置（第9根K线，即做空入场K线上方一个最小报价单位处）做多，应该够做一次剥头皮，而且很可能走两段上涨。交易者可以在第9根K线上方一个最小报价单位处买入，也可以在第9根K线之后那根K线上方买入，依靠的是第9根K线是一根多头趋势K线，因此是一根不错的做多信号K线。


> If you shorted at the bar 8 breakout of the inside bar, you would have been nervous by the bar’s close (a doji bar, indicating no conviction). However, most traders would not have taken that short, because three or more sideways bars, at least one of which is a doji, usually creates too much uncertainty (barbwire). The two small bars before the outside bar were small enough to act like dojis, so it was best to wait for more price action. However, if you did not short on bar 8, you would have to believe that many did and the doji close of their entry bar made these traders feel uncomfortable with their positions. They would have been quick to exit, thereby becoming trapped. They would likely have bought back their shorts at one tick above the bar 8 entry bar and then be reluctant to sell again until they saw better price action. With the shorts out of the market and with them buying back their positions, going long exactly where they were exiting (bar 9, one tick above the short entry bar) should have been good for a scalp and likely two legs up. A trader could have bought either at one tick above bar 9 or above the bar after bar 9, relying on bar 9 being a bull trend bar and therefore a good long signal bar.


![图 9.13](figures/fig-09-13.jpg)


**图 9.13　差五个最小报价单位的失败**


在图 9.13 中，做空剥头皮赚四个最小报价单位这个策略，成功了将近两个小时。然而，从第4根内包K线开始的那笔空头只下跌了五个最小报价单位就反转向上。这意味着许多空头没能在止盈限价单上成交，也意味着空头会很快在保本处出场，在第5根K线上方更是一定会出场。市场当时正在测试昨天的低点，而且是第二次探向趋势通道线下方（该通道线根据从第1根K线到第3根K线的趋势线画出）。多头正在寻找买入的理由，而那笔失败的做空剥头皮，正是他们期待的最后一个理由。


> Scalping short for four ticks was a successful strategy for almost two hours in Figure 9.13. However, the short from the bar 4 inside bar dropped only five ticks and reversed up. This meant that many shorts did not get filled on their profit-target limit order and that the shorts were quick to exit at breakeven and certainly above bar 5. The market was testing yesterday’s low, and it was the second probe below the trend channel line (based on the trend line from bar 1 to bar 3). The bulls were looking for reasons to buy, and the failed short scalp was the final thing that they were hoping to find.


![图 9.14](figures/fig-09-14.jpg)


**图 9.14　QQQ 中失败的信号**


如图 9.14 所示，这些5分钟 QQQ 交易每一笔都在走到8到11个最小报价单位之间后失败。保护性止损会让剥头皮交易者在所有这些交易中大致在保本处出场，但这仍然很费力，收获却很少。不过很明显，当时还有许多其他有利可图的剥头皮机会，只是若太多交易都不成功，剥头皮会让人疲惫。这常常让交易者失去专注，接着错过有利可图的交易。在一个清晰的空头趋势日里，最好的做法是只顺势交易，寻找卖出低2建仓形态的机会，尤其要在移动平均线处。你的胜率会很高，让你能保持健康的心态、继续入场，最好至少把一部分仓位做成波段。


> As shown in Figure 9.14, each of these 5 minute QQQ trades reached between 8 and 11 ticks before failing. The protective stops would get scalpers out at around breakeven in all of them, but it still was a lot of work with little to show for it. Clearly, however, there were many other profitable scalps, but it is tiring to scalp if there are too many unsuccessful trades. This often makes a trader lose focus and then miss profitable trades. On a clear bear trend day, the best approach is to trade only with the trend and look to sell low 2 setups, especially at the moving average. Your winning percentage will be high, allowing you to have a healthy attitude and continue to take entries, preferably swinging at least part of your position.


![图 9.15](figures/fig-09-15.jpg)


**图 9.15　换一个更小的目标**


AAPL 通常会给出1.00美元的剥头皮机会（行情通常超过1.00美元，让剥头皮交易者可以在1.00美元的限价单上分批止盈）。然而，如图 9.15 所示，第2根K线在第1根K线上方入场点之上只延伸了93美分，随后就搭出了一个低2做空。这个低2意味着市场两次都没能到达目标。市场大体横盘、又刚好错过1.00美元的剥头皮，交易者很可能会把止盈目标降到约50美分。他们本可以在这波61美分的下跌中分批止盈。


> AAPL usually yields $1.00 scalps (the moves are usually more than $1.00, allowing a scalper to take partial profits on a $1.00 limit order). As shown in Figure 9.15, however, bar 2 extended only 93 cents above the entry above bar 1, and then set up a low 2 short. This low 2 meant that the market failed twice to reach the target. With the market largely sideways and just missing a $1.00 scalp, traders would likely have reduced their profit target to about 50 cents. They would have been able to take partial profits on this 61 cent drop.


![图 9.16](figures/fig-09-16.jpg)


**图 9.16　空头急速行情可以是一个买入机会**
