如图 9.16 所示，NetApp 公司（NTAP）在这段日线图上的多头趋势中两次“打折”，交易者积极买入这些降价货。仅仅因为趋势线下方出现了一条强劲的急速行情，并不意味着趋势已经结束。大多数反转尝试看起来都很棒，而大多数都会失败。正因如此，经验丰富的交易者会积极买入急剧的降价，哪怕是在一条空头急速行情的底部。第11根K线处在一波16%抛售的底部，但它仍然是一个更高的低点，并与第7根K线形成双底牛旗。由于向下的通道持续了那么多根K线，更安全的做法是等一等，再去买入第13根K线那个更高的低点，或者买入第14根K线低2建仓形态上方的突破——那个形态是一面失败的双顶熊旗。


> As shown in Figure 9.16, NetApp Inc. (NTAP) went on sale twice during this bull trend on the daily chart, and traders bought the markdown aggressively. Just because there is a strong spike down below the trend line does not mean that the trend is over. Most reversal attempts look great and most fail. Because of this, experienced traders will buy sharp markdowns aggressively, even at the bottom of a bear spike. Bar 11 was at the bottom of a 16 percent sell-off, but it was still a higher low and a double bottom bull flag with bar 7. Since the channel down lasted so many bars, it was safer to wait to buy the bar 13 higher low or the breakout above the bar 14 low 2 setup, which was a failed double top bear flag.


第22根K线是一根非常强劲的空头趋势K线，一路跌到移动平均线，但从第15根到第19根K线的上涨非常强劲。这根空头趋势K线很可能源于某篇吓人的新闻报道，但一根强劲的空头趋势K线并不会造出一次反转。大多数时候，它会失败，并带来一个新的趋势高点。多头认为，出现交易区间和一个新高，比出现一次成功的反转更有可能，于是他们买入了这根K线的底部。它的低点还与第20根K线形成了双底，而且它很可能将成为一个交易区间的底部，或者一面双底牛旗。这根空头K线的后续行情很弱，市场横盘了四根重叠的K线，影线都很显眼。这不是空头反转通常的样子，空头于是买回了自己的空单。他们的买入，加上多头在这里的买入，带来了新的趋势高点。


> Bar 22 was a very strong bear trend bar down to the moving average, but the rally up from bar 15 to bar 19 was very strong. The bear trend bar was probably based on some scary news report, but one strong bear trend bar does not create a reversal. Most of the time, it will fail and lead to a new trend high. Bulls thought that a trading range and a new high were more likely than a successful reversal, and they bought the bottom of the bar. Its low also formed a double bottom with bar 20 and was probably going to be the bottom of a trading range or a double bottom bull flag. The bear bar had weak follow-through and went sideways for four overlapping bars, which had prominent tails. This is not how a bear reversal usually looks, and the bears bought back their shorts. Their buying, combined with the bulls buying here, led to the new trend high.


![图 9.17](figures/fig-09-17.jpg)


**图 9.17　大多数趋势反转尝试都会失败**


当多头趋势像图 9.17 中 SPY 的60分钟图那样强劲时，它就有惯性，会抵抗各种结束它的尝试。过于急切的前空头看到移动平均线下方和趋势线下方的强劲空头急速行情后，就把它们当成市场正在反转为空头趋势的迹象。多头则把每一波空头急速行情都看作买入建仓形态。他们知道，一次成功的反转需要的不只是一条强劲的空头急速行情。他们相信每一次反转都会失败，因为大多数反转确实会失败，而且市场还会走高，所以他们急切地买入回调。当 SPY 只打折1%或2%时，多头迅速买入，因为他们知道这个折扣不会持续太久。许多急速行情是由价格真空造成的。多头想买入回调，所以一旦他们觉得市场会再低一点，就停止买入。这让空头得以快速把市场打压下去。一旦价格足够低、多头认为它不会再跌了，他们就不知从哪儿冒出来，积极买入。他们压过了空头，空头随后不得不买回自己的空单，给这波上涨添了一把力，而那条巨大的空头急速行情也就没有了后续行情。


> When a bull trend is strong like it was on the 60 minute chart of the SPY shown in Figure 9.17, it has inertia and will resist attempts to end. Overly eager bears looked at strong bear spikes below the moving average and below trend lines as signs that the market was reversing into a bear trend. Bulls saw each bear spike as a buy setup. They knew that a successful reversal requires more than simply a strong bear spike. They believed that each reversal would fail, because most do, and that the market was going higher, so they were eager to buy pullbacks. When the SPY went on sale by just 1 or 2 percent, bulls quickly bought it since they knew that the sale wouldn’t last long. Many of the spikes were created by vacuums. The bulls wanted to buy a pullback, so they stopped buying if they thought that the market would go a little lower. This allowed the bears to drive the market down quickly. Once it was low enough and the bulls thought that it wouldn’t go lower, they appeared out of nowhere and bought aggressively. They overwhelmed the bears, who then had to buy back their shorts, adding to the rally, and the huge bear spike had no follow-through.


虽然这些急速行情在形成时看起来很可怕，但如果交易者明白正在发生什么，就会急于在底部买入。如果他们不想承担巨大的隔夜风险，可以在每一条空头急速行情的底部买入看涨期权，几天后在每一个新高处止盈。


> While the spikes were scary as they were forming, if traders understood what was going on, they would be eager to buy at the bottom. If they did not want to have a huge overnight risk, they could buy calls at the bottom of each bear spike and take profits on each new high a few days later.


![图 9.18](figures/fig-09-18.jpg)


**图 9.18　失败形态有时可以是强势的标志**


如图 9.18 所示，从第15根K线起的更低低点主要趋势反转向上很强，很可能至少有两段上涨。然而，涨到第19根K线的上涨没能到达空头趋势线。它冲到了移动平均线上方，并且离那条线足够近，已经落在它的磁场范围内。这给了交易者信心去买第22根K线的高2建仓形态，因为他们认为市场应该会测试到趋势线上方。


> As shown in Figure 9.18, the lower low major trend reversal up from bar 15 was strong and was likely to have at least two legs up. However, the rally to bar 19 failed to reach the bear trend line. It pushed above the moving average and came close enough to the line to be within its magnetic field. This gave traders confidence to buy the bar 22 high 2 setup because they thought that the market should test above the trend line.


第4根K线是强劲空头急速行情之后的一根多头反转K线。这波急速行情强到让交易者相信市场处在始终入场做空状态，所以交易者都在寻找卖出上涨行情的机会。由于他们认为第4根K线不会引出一次重要的反转，许多空头把限价单挂在它的高点处及其上方来做空。有足够多的交易者急于做空，以至于他们在那根K线高点下方一个最小报价单位处就做了空。市场从未走到那根多头信号K线的高点之上，这是空头强势的一个标志。市场随后下跌到第5根K线低2做空信号K线下方。第10根K线之后那根K线的高点处，以及第11、13和26根K线处，都出现了类似的情形。第18根K线是多头版本。交易者急于做多，以至于他们在第18根K线之前那根K线的低点处及其下方挂了买入限价单，而只有那些最激进、把限价单挂在第18根K线低点上方一个最小报价单位处的多头才做上了多。其他人只能追着市场往上买。


> Bar 4 was a bull reversal bar after a strong bear spike. The spike was strong enough to convince traders that the market was always-in short, so traders were looking to sell rallies. Since they did not think that bar 4 was going to lead to a significant reversal, many bears placed limit orders to short at and above its high. Enough traders were so eager to short that they shorted at one tick below its high. The market never made it to above the high of the bull signal bar, which was a sign that the bears were strong. The market sold off below the bar 5 low 2 short signal bar. A similar situation formed at the high of the bar after bar 10, and at bars 11, 13, and 26. Bar 18 was the bullish equivalent. Traders were so eager to get long that they had buy limit orders at and below the low of the bar before bar 18, and the most aggressive bulls with limit orders at one tick above the bar 18 low were likely the only ones who got long. The others had to chase the market higher.


第27根K线在第21根K线低点上方一个最小报价单位处转向向上，使一个完美的双底牛旗没能形成。这是多头急切的标志：市场从第24根K线高点下跌时，他们把买入限价单挂在第21根K线低点处及其上方一个最小报价单位处。他们太急于做多，不想冒限价单挂在第21根K线低点处和上方一个最小报价单位处却无法成交的风险。相反的情形出现在第7根K线，它在第5根K线高点下方一个最小报价单位处转向下跌。它没能到达第5根K线的高点，是因为空头有一种做空的紧迫感，所以这次失败是空头趋势强势的标志。第7根K线是对移动平均线的一次测试，但空头太急于做空，把卖出限价单挂在移动平均线下方两个最小报价单位处，而不是下方一个最小报价单位处。这使那根K线的高点没能到达移动平均线，是空头趋势强劲的标志。


> Bar 27 turned up at one tick above the low of bar 21, preventing a perfect double bottom bull flag. This was a sign of eager bulls who placed buy limit orders at one and two ticks above the bar 21 low as the market was trading down from the bar 24 high. They were so eager to get long that they did not want to risk having unfilled buy limit orders at and one tick above the bar 21 low. The opposite situation happened when bar 7 turned down at one tick below the bar 5 high. It failed to reach the bar 5 high because the bears felt an urgency to get short, so the failure was a sign that the bear trend was strong. Bar 7 was a test of the moving average, but the bears were so eager to get short that they placed their sell limit orders at two ticks below the moving average instead of at one tick below. This prevented the high of the bar from reaching the moving average and was a sign of a strong bear trend.


第15根K线底部之后的那个低1，没能引出新的空头低点，这是反转向上很强的标志。


> The low 1 after the bar 15 bottom failed to lead to a new bear low and was a sign that the reversal up was strong.


![图 9.19](figures/fig-09-19.jpg)


**图 9.19　先错过目标，随后到达目标**


当一个等距运动目标位相当明显、市场又靠得足够近、已经落进它的磁力牵引范围，却还没有近到让交易者相信它已被充分测试时，市场往往会回调，然后做一次更有说服力的测试。如图 9.19 所示，当天是 Emini 的一个趋势性交易区间日，而那个明显的等距运动目标位，是按开盘区间算出的一个等距运动目标。第7根和第9根K线走到了三个最小报价单位以内，但除非市场走到一个最小报价单位以内，大多数交易者不会觉得这次测试已经完成。这次测试没能到达目标，但它已经近到足以让交易者相信这个磁力位正在影响价格行为。交易者想看看市场在测试它之后是会回落，还是会向上突破、上涨到某个更高的目标位。市场回调到第14根K线处一面小的扩张三角形牛旗，然后在当天的最后一根K线上把目标测试到一个最小报价单位以内。顺带说说，如果这次测试超出等距运动目标位四个或更多最小报价单位，那通常意味着市场正在无视这个目标位，奔向一个更高的目标位。


> When there is a fairly obvious measured move target and the market comes close enough to be within its magnetic pull, but not close enough for traders to believe that it was adequately tested, the market often pulls back and then makes a more convincing test. As shown in Figure 9.19, today was a trending trading range day in the Emini and the obvious measured move target was a measured move up based on the opening range. Bars 7 and 9 came within three ticks, but most traders would not feel that the test is complete unless the market comes within one tick. The test failed to reach the target, but it was close enough to make traders believe that the magnet was influencing the price action. Traders wanted to see whether the market would fall back after testing it or it would break above and rally to some higher target. The market pulled back to a small expanding triangle bull flag at bar 14 and tested the target to within a tick on the final bar of the day. Incidentally, if the test goes four or more ticks above the measured move target, that usually means that the market is ignoring the target and is heading toward a higher target.


第14根K线也是一面更大楔形牛旗的信号K线，其中第8根K线是第一次向下推进，第10根或第12根K线构成第二次。有些交易者以为这面旗形在第12根K线就结束了，但第10根到第12根K线之间的距离，与第8根到第10根K线之间的距离相比很小，所以许多交易者并不相信修正已经结束。这就导致了最后一次向下推进：一路走到第14根K线，创出一个更低的低点。


> Bar 14 was also the signal bar for a larger wedge bull flag where bar 8 was the first push down and bars 10 or 12 formed the second. Some traders thought the flag ended at bar 12, but the distance between bar 10 and bar 12 was small compared to the distance between bar 8 and bar 10, so many traders were not convinced that the correction was over. This resulted in the lower low final push down to bar 14.


从第14根K线起的三根K线多头急速行情，向上越过了前一根60分钟K线的高点（图中未显示）一个最小报价单位。两根K线之后，当市场在一面5分钟楔形熊旗中反转向下时，60分钟交易者开始怀疑自己是不是正处在一个60分钟的一个最小报价单位的多头陷阱里。有些60分钟交易者在前一根60分钟K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂止损单买入，而现在市场掉头向下了。不过，大多数时候，当60分钟图上正在形成一个差一个最小报价单位的突破失败时，市场会在那根60分钟K线收盘之前反转回那次突破失败之上。结果是，尽管这个差一个最小报价单位的突破失败在5分钟图上存在了很多根K线，但到60分钟K线收盘时，它已经从60分钟图上消失了——这里正是如此。那根60分钟K线在第15根K线之后的那根K线处收盘，而这根60分钟K线的最终高点，比前一根60分钟K线的高点高出三个最小报价单位。


> The three-bar bull spike up from bar 14 broke above the high of the prior 60 minute bar (not shown) by one tick. When the market reversed down two bars later in a 5 minute wedge bear flag, the 60 minute traders were wondering if they were in a 60 minute one-tick bull trap. Some 60 minute traders bought on a stop at one tick above the high of the prior 60 minute bar and now the market was turning down. However, most of the time when there is a developing one-tick failed breakout on the 60 minute chart, the market reverses back above the one-tick failed breakout before the 60 minute bar closes. The result is that although the one-tick failed breakout was present for many bars on the 5 minute chart, it disappeared from the 60 minute chart by the time the 60 minute bar closed, as was the case here. The 60 minute bar closed on the bar after bar 15, and the final high of the 60 minute bar was three ticks above the high of the prior 60 minute bar.


# 第 10 章　日线图上的巨量反转

*10. Huge Volume Reversals on Daily Charts*


当一只股票在日线图上处在陡峭的空头趋势中，随后又出现一个成交量达到近期平均量五到10倍的交易日时，多头可能已经投降，一个可交易的底部可能已经出现。这个巨量日往往就是跳空低开的一天；如果它收出一根强劲的多头收盘，做多能盈利的概率就会上升。交易者未必是在寻找一次多头反转，但在高潮式抛售之后，出现至少一段两段式走势、至少涨到移动平均线的概率很大，这足以让他们做成一笔持续几天到几周的盈利交易。


> When a stock is in a steep bear trend on the daily chart and then has a day with volume that is five to 10 times its recent average, the bulls may have capitulated and a tradable bottom may be present. The huge volume day is very often a gap down day, and if it has a strong bull close, the odds of a profitable long increase. Traders are not necessarily looking for a bull reversal, but after a climactic sell-off, the odds are good that there will be at least a two-legged move to at least the moving average that will allow them to place a profitable trade that will last from days to weeks.


顺便说一句，在一张处在强空头趋势中的1分钟 Emini 小型合约图上，如果出现一根巨量K线（约25,000手合约），它不大可能是这波空头趋势的终点，但往往是回调即将到来的信号，而且通常是在成交量更小的情况下先走出一两个更低的低点之后才出现（成交量背离）。你几乎从来都不该去看日内图上的成交量，因为它在5分钟图上的预测价值并不可靠；而5分钟图才是你交易时主要该用的图。


> Incidentally, on a 1 minute Emini chart that is in a strong bear trend, if there is a huge volume bar (about 25,000 contracts), it is unlikely to be the end of the bear trend, but often is a sign that a pullback will come soon, usually after one or two lower lows on less volume (volume divergence). You should rarely if ever look at volume on intraday charts because of its unreliable predictive value on the 5 minute chart, which is the chart that you should mainly use for trading.


![图 10.1](figures/fig-10-01.jpg)


**图 10.1　巨量反转**


有时候，市场会在巨量日向上反转。如图 10.1 所示，雷曼兄弟（Lehman Brothers，LEH）在第3根K线大幅跳空低开，随后跌破一条空头趋势通道线（这条线由第1根和第2根K线确定），但之后强劲上涨，一路涨到收盘。成交量是前一个交易日的三倍，约为过去一个月平均量的10倍。有了这样一根强劲的多头趋势K线（在蜡烛图小图上看得更清楚），在收盘时买入是安全的；但更谨慎的交易者会等到市场突破这根可能的信号K线的高点。第二天市场跳空高开。交易者本可以买入开盘，也可以等一次向下测试，然后买入新的日内高点，或者在5分钟图上找一波抛售，等回补缺口的尝试失败之后，买入向上反转。这样的强势几乎总是会带来至少两段上涨（第二段上涨走到了第6根K线，出现在第5根K线成功回测缺口、形成更高的低点之后），并且会向上穿过移动平均线。


> Sometimes markets reverse up on huge volume days. As shown in Figure 10.1, Lehman Brothers (LEH) opened with a huge gap down on bar 3 and then ran below a bear trend channel line (from bars 1 and 2), but rallied strongly into the close. Volume was three times that of the prior day and about 10 times that of the average of the past month. With such a strong bull trend bar (seen more clearly on the candle chart thumbnail), it was safe to buy at the close, but a more cautious trader would have waited until the market took out the high of this possible signal bar. The market gapped up on the next day. A trader could have bought the open, waited for a test down, and then bought a new intraday high, or looked for a sell-off on the 5 minute chart and bought the reversal up after the attempt to close the gap failed. This kind of strength is almost always followed by at least two legs up (the second leg up to bar 6 occurred after the successful bar 5 gap test higher low) and a penetration of the moving average.


第4根和第6根K线形成双顶熊旗。第7根K线试图与第5根K线形成双底牛旗，结果反而变成了三根K线之后的一次突破回调做空入场。


> Bars 4 and 6 formed a double top bear flag. Bar 7 attempted to form a double bottom bull flag with bar 5, but instead resulted in a breakout pullback short entry three bars later.


到图上最后一根K线为止，市场正在测试第3根K线的低点，想守住它下方的止损，并形成一个双底。几个月后，LEH 破产倒闭。


> As of the final bar on the chart, the market was testing the bar 3 low in an attempt to defend the stops below it and form a double bottom. Months later, LEH went out of business.


![图 10.2](figures/fig-10-02.jpg)


**图 10.2　巨量却没有反转**


在大幅下跌日出现巨量，并不保证会有上涨行情。如图 10.2 所示，贝尔斯登（Bear Stearns，BSC）在一个周五走出一根巨量空头趋势日K线，成交量约为平常交易日的15倍。在此前的两周里，这只股票已经跌掉约70%的价值。不过，成交量只有前一个交易日的约1.5倍，而且只有极小的一段多头影线。价格行为对多头不利：跌破空头趋势通道之后并没有出现反转。事实上，这根巨量空头趋势K线远远收在通道线下方，确认了趋势通道线无力容纳这波空头趋势，也确认了这波趋势的强势。周一开盘时（第3根K线），这只股票又跌掉80%，但成交量略少一些。有些交易者买在了周五的收盘价上，认定高潮底部已经出现，认定这个国家第五大投资银行兼券商绝无可能再跌；结果一到周一，他们就损失惨重。只有高潮式成交量、却没有看多的价格行为，并不构成对强空头趋势反向操作的理由。


> Huge volume on a big down day does not guarantee a rally. As shown in Figure 10.2, Bear Stearns (BSC) had a huge bear trend day on a Friday with volume that was about 15 times that of a typical day. The stock had lost about 70 percent of its value over the prior two weeks. However, the volume was only about one and a half times that of the day before and there was only a minimal bull tail. The price action was against the longs since there was no reversal from the break of the bear trend channel. In fact, the huge bear trend bar closed well below the line, confirming the strength of the trend channel line failure to contain the bear trend. The stock lost another 80 percent when it opened on Monday (bar 3), but traded slightly less volume. Traders who bought the Friday close, thinking that a climactic bottom was in and that there was no way that the country’s fifth largest investment bank and brokerage could fall any further, were devastated come Monday. Climactic volume in the absence of bullish price action is no reason to fade a strong bear trend.


这张图与前面那张 LEH 走势图覆盖同一段时间。不过，LEH 那张图直到周一才跌破空头趋势通道线（第3根K线），并在当天放巨量向上反转。而在 BSC 这张图里，巨量日早了一天，那天同样跌破了空头趋势通道线，但当天收在低点附近，没有任何看多的价格行为。它在第3根K线跳空低开，和 LEH 一样（两只股票的第3根K线都是周一），但 LEH 强劲上涨，BSC 却几乎涨不动。BSC 的第3根K线同样是跌破空头趋势通道线之后的一根多头反转K线，但那天要在买 LEH 还是买 BSC 之间做选择的交易者，显然更愿意买 LEH，因为它的多头反转K线非常强劲。即使交易者在第3根K线上方一个最小报价单位处买入 BSC，随后三天也能赚到超过100%，但 LEH 显然是一笔确定性高得多的做多押注。


> This chart covers the same time period as the preceding LEH chart. However, the LEH chart did not break the bear trend channel line (bar 3) until Monday and it reversed up on that day on huge volume. Here, on the BSC chart, the huge volume day was a day earlier and it also broke below the bear trend channel line, but the day closed near its low with no bullish price action. It gapped down on bar 3, just like LEH (bar 3 is the Monday for both stocks), but LEH rallied strongly whereas BSC could barely rally at all. Bar 3 for BSC was still a bull reversal bar following the break of a bear trend channel line, but any traders choosing between buying LEH and BSC on that day would obviously much rather buy LEH because of its very strong bull reversal bar. Even if traders bought BSC at one tick above bar 3, they would have made more than 100 percent over the next three days, but LEH was clearly a much more certain bull bet.


这张图印出来之后，BSC 被摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase，JPM）收购，价格只是它几个月前市值的极小一部分。


> Since this chart was printed, BSC was bought out by JPMorgan Chase (JPM) for a tiny fraction of its market capitalization of just a few months earlier.


# 第二部分　日内交易

*Part II　Day Trading*


如果你还没有做到持续稳定盈利，就不该把 Emini 里一到两个点的剥头皮、或者股票里 10 到 20 美分的剥头皮，当成交易的立足点。事实上，在成为有经验的交易者之前，你应该避开剥头皮，因为要盈利你需要极高的胜率，而这一点连有经验的交易者都很难做到。


> If you are not yet consistently profitable, you should not be looking at one-or two-point scalps in the Emini or 10 to 20 cent scalps in stocks as the cornerstone of your trading. In fact, you should avoid scalps until you are an experienced trader, because you need a very high winning percentage to be profitable, and that is difficult for even experienced traders to achieve.


日内交易首先要考虑的是选哪个市场，以及用哪种走势图。最好交易机构青睐的股票，因为你想降低被专业做市商或做市商操纵的可能性，也想让滑点尽可能小。在任何一组 5 到 10 只股票里，每天的好交易都多得是，你根本不必退而求其次去做那些成交量小、可能附带额外风险的股票。


> The first consideration in day trading is the selection of the market and type of chart that you want to use. It is best to trade stocks that are popular with institutions, because you want to reduce the chance of manipulation by a specialist or market maker, and you want minimal slippage. There are so many great trades every day on any basket of five to 10 stocks that you won’t have to resort to stocks with small volume that might carry additional risks.


你一天里的K线越多，做的交易就越多，每笔交易的风险也越小。不过，你可能看图快不到能看清建仓形态，也可能没时间下单而不犯下让人没法接受的错误。另外，有些最好的交易来得太快，你很可能错过很多笔，最后手上只剩那些没那么赚钱的交易。这里有一个数学上的最优平衡点，你得根据自己的性格和交易能力把它定下来。多数成功的交易者能交易 5 分钟K线图。3 分钟图上的价格行为很相似，交易更多、止损更小，但总体胜率更低。如果你发现自己错过的交易太多，尤其是当天最赚钱的那些交易，就该考虑换到更慢的时间级别，比如 15 分钟图。


> The more bars in your day, the more trades you will make, and the risk will be less per trade. However, you might not be able to read the charts fast enough to see the setups, and you might not have time to place your orders without an unacceptable level of mistakes. Also, some of the best trades happen so quickly that you will likely miss many and then be left with all the trades that are less profitable. There is a mathematical sweet spot that you will have to determine based on your personality and trading abilities. Most successful traders can trade a 5 minute candle chart. The price action on a 3 minute chart is very similar and offers more trades and smaller stops, but in general it has a lower winning percentage. If you find that you are missing too many trades, especially the most profitable trades of the day, you should consider moving to a slower time frame, like a 15 minute chart.


你也可以用基于成交量的图（比如每根K线代表 25,000 份合约）、基于 tick 的图（tick 这里指成交笔数，比如每根K线代表 5,000 次价格变化），或者用简单的K线图。线图也可以交易，但价格行为交易者看不到K线或蜡烛线，就等于放弃了太多信息。


> You can also use charts based on volume (like each bar representing 25,000 contracts) or ticks (for example, each bar representing 5,000 price changes or ticks) or simple bar charts. Line charts are also tradable, but price action traders are giving up too much information when they cannot see bars or candles.


总的来说，日内交易时你每笔交易的风险最小，所以你应该按自己能做的最大合约数去交易。沃伦·巴菲特说过：“如果它值一便士，那它就值一毛钱。”能持续稳定盈利的交易者一旦认定某个入场是有效的，就要准备好交易一个合理数量的合约。


> In general, since your risk per trade is smallest when you day trade, you should be trading your maximum number of contracts. Warren Buffett was quoted as saying, “If it’s worth a penny, then it’s worth a dime.” Once consistently profitable traders have decided that they have a valid entry, they need to be prepared to trade a reasonable number of contracts.


交易者总是在想怎样才能把盈利能力最大化，而其中最重要的两点是交易选择和仓位规模。新手应该主要专注于每天只做最好的两到五笔入场的波段交易，这些通常是非趋势日（大约占 80% 的交易日）里在新区间高点和低点上的反转二次入场，以及趋势日里的急速行情与回调。交易者一旦做到持续稳定盈利，下一个目标就该是加大仓位规模，而不是增加胜率更低的入场。如果一位交易者在 Emini 里每天只净赚一个点，但交易 25 份合约，算下来一天就超过 1,000 美元。如果他能加到 100 份合约，一年就能赚 1,000,000 美元。如果他一天净赚四个点，那就是一年 4,000,000 美元。Emini、国债和中期国债市场都能轻松承接这种规模的交易。价格超过 100 美元、流动性又好的股票，一位有经验的交易者在大多数交易日能净赚 50 美分到一美元，这些股票也能承接 1,000 到 3,000 股的订单，而且滑点极小。像 QQQ 这样的交易所交易基金（ETF）能承接 10,000 股的订单，但日内的波幅更小，一位好交易者更现实的日净利大约是 10 到 20 美分，也就是一年几十万美元。


> Traders are always thinking about the best way to maximize their profitability, and the two most important considerations are trade selection and position size. A new trader should focus primarily on swinging only the best two to five entries each day, which are usually second entries in the form of reversals at new swing highs and lows on nontrending days (maybe 80 percent of days), and spikes and pullbacks on trend days. Once a trader is consistently profitable, the next goal should be to increase the position size rather than adding lower-probability entries. If a trader consistently nets only one point a day in the Eminis but trades 25 contracts, this comes out to over $1,000 per day. If the trader can get up to 100 contracts, he will make $1,000,000 per year. If he nets four points a day, that is $4,000,000 per year. The Emini and Treasury bond and note markets can easily handle this size of trading. For very liquid stocks with prices over $100, an experienced trader can net 50 cents to a dollar on most days, and these stocks can handle 1,000- to 3,000-share orders with minimal slippage. Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) like the QQQ can handle 10,000-share orders, but the daily range is smaller, and a more realistic daily net profit would be about 10 to 20 cents for a good trader, or a couple of hundred thousand dollars a year.


如果一位交易者管理的是一笔 50,000,000 美元的基金，每笔交易做 1,000 份 Emini 合约（他可能得把订单拆成每笔 200 到 400 份的小单），而每天只净赚一个点，那么扣掉费用之前，这就能为客户赚到 10,000,000 美元。要把精力集中在做最好的那些交易上，然后再去加大你的交易量。


> If a trader was managing a fund of $50,000,000 and trading 1,000 Emini contracts per trade (he might have to split his orders into 200- to 400-lot pieces), and he netted only a point per day, this would generate $10,000,000 for clients before fees. Concentrate on taking the best trades and then increasing your volume.


# 第 11 章　一天中的关键时段

*11. Key Times of the Day*


一个交易日可以分成三个时段。虽然同样的价格行为原理全天都适用，但每个时段都有一些规律性的概括，对交易者很有用。任何类型的价格行为都可能出现在一天中的任何时候，但一天中最有可能找到一笔能赚到两到三倍风险回报的交易，往往就是头一两个小时。这是一天中最重要的时段，对大多数交易者来说，这也是最容易赚钱的时段（如果不小心，也是最容易亏钱的时段）。总的来说，大多数交易者都应该下大力气在头一两个小时里做交易，因为这段时间的交易拥有回报、风险、成功率三者结合得最好的交易者等式（trader's equation）。正因为重要，第三部分的各章会详细讨论它。太平洋标准时间（PST）上午7:00经常有报告发布，它们往往会带出当天的趋势。计算机在分析速度和下单速度上有明显的优势，它们就是你的竞争者。当你的竞争对手拥有巨大的优势时，不要去跟它们拼。等它们的优势消失，等速度不再重要时再交易。始终入场方向一旦确立，就去找顺势的趋势交易。哪怕你可能错过头一两根K线，只要趋势强劲，这笔交易里剩下的点数依然很多。


> The trading day can be divided into three periods, and although the same price action principles apply throughout the day, there are some generalizations about each period that are useful for traders. Any type of price action can happen at any time of the day, but there is a tendency for the first hour or two to be the most likely time of the day to find a trade where you can make two to three times your risk. This is the most important time of the day, and for most traders it is the easiest time to make money (and the easiest to lose money, if a trader is not careful). In general, most traders should work very hard to take trades in the first hour or two because those trades have the best trader’s equation combination of reward, risk, and probability. Because of its importance, the chapters in Part III discuss it in detail. There are often reports at 7:00 a.m. PST, and they commonly lead to the trend of the day. Computers have a clear edge in speed of analysis and order placement, and they are your competitors. When your competition has a big advantage, don’t compete. Wait for their edge to disappear, and trade when speed is no longer important. Once the always-in direction has been established, then look to take the trend trade. Even though you might miss the first bar or two, if the trend is strong, there will be plenty of points left in the trade.


在日线图上，强劲的多头趋势K线下方、强劲的空头趋势K线上方，经常有一小段影线。它们往往由开盘反转造成。比如，如果多头认为当天可能是强势的多头趋势日，而开盘后头几根K线却在下跌，他们当中的大多数人会相信：这很可能就是当天的低点，是一个极好的机会，能以极便宜的价格买入，而这个价格很快就会消失。如果他们判断正确，市场会上涨，他们就买在了当天低点附近。于是在日线图上，由开盘那波三根K线的抛售所形成的那根多头趋势K线，底部会留下一小段影线。因为这些聪明的多头对这种情况早有准备，所以他们在一笔大概至少有50% 成功率的交易上，冒了很小的风险，赚到了巨大的回报（记住，由于市场的整体特征，他们相信当天很可能会上涨）。


> On the daily chart, there is often a small tail below strong bull trend bars and above strong bear trend bars. These are often caused by opening reversals. For example, if bulls think that the day is likely to be a strong bull trend day and it trades down for the first few bars of the day, the majority of them will believe that this will likely be the low of the day and a great opportunity to buy at a tremendous value that will soon disappear. If they are right, the market will rally, and they will have bought around the low of the day. On the daily chart, there will be a small tail on the bottom of the bull trend bar that resulted from the three-bar sell-off on the open. Because they were ready for that possibility, these smart bulls made a huge reward, risking little, on a trade that probably had at least a 50 percent chance of success (remember, because of the overall character of the market, they believed that the day was likely to rally).


日内中间那一段时间，从太平洋时间上午8:30到9:30前后开始，到11:00至11:30前后结束，有时会拖到12:30，更容易出现双向交易，比如交易区间或通道。这是一天当中窄幅交易区间最常见的时候。这种环境对用止损单入场来说极其糟糕。在双向交易非常明显的市场里，市场稍微下跌一点，买方就进场并接管局面，所以在市场下跌时用止损单入场，跟机构在这些窄幅交易区间里的做法完全相反。那些买方，是从盈利空单里剥头皮出来的空头，以及为了向上剥头皮而买入的多头。到了顶部，情况反过来，卖出占主导：多头卖出，了结盈利的多头剥头皮仓位；空头卖出，开始建空头剥头皮仓位。市场里也有波段交易者，但总的来说，只要市场处在交易区间中，不管它是不是窄幅，大部分成交量都是剥头皮，而机构在低买高卖。作为交易者，赚钱最好的办法就是做机构在做的事；所以如果你要在交易区间里做交易，就以剥头皮为目标，低买高卖。有经验的交易者会在顶部的疲弱高1、高2买入信号K线上方挂限价单卖出，在底部的疲弱低1、低2信号K线下方挂限价单买入。由于限价单交易更难准确评估，初学者应该避开它们。用止损单入场要非常小心：只有在区间顶部、市场正在向下转时才用卖出止损单；只有在接近底部、市场正在向上转时才用买入止损单。市场总是猛冲顶部和底部，把满怀希望的初学者骗到顶部用止损单买入、在底部用止损单卖出。他们只看见向上和向下急速行情的力度，忽略了过去20根K线的交易区间，结果做的恰好跟机构相反。由于这么多建仓形态都是为了剥头皮，而大多数交易者没法靠剥头皮谋生，他们在这段时间应该非常挑剔。在大概90% 的日子里，当天的高点或低点都在日内头三分之一时间形成，因此日内中间三分之一时间，通常就是交易者判断最初这段趋势该继续还是反转的时候。多头和空头都很活跃，各自争夺控制权，各自都想催生出一段通往收盘的趋势。市场经常在太平洋时间上午8:30前后反转，然后在日内中间三分之一剩下的时间里走出趋势。交易者要意识到：开盘时开始的那段趋势未必能持续一整天，头两个小时之后完全可能发展出相反的走势。


> The middle of the day, beginning around 8:30 to 9:30 a.m. PST and ending around 11:00 to 11:30 and sometimes as late as 12:30, is more prone to two-sided trading, like trading ranges or channels. This is the time of the day when tight trading ranges are the most common. This is a terrible environment for entering on stops. In very two-sided markets, when the market goes down a little, buyers come in and take control, so entering on stops as the market is falling is the exact opposite of what the institutions are doing in these tight trading ranges. The buyers are the bears scalping out of their profitable shorts and the bulls buying for scalps up. At the top, the opposite happens and the selling predominates. The bulls sell out of their profitable long scalps, and the bears sell to initiate short scalps. There are swing traders as well, but in general, when the market is in a trading range, whether or not it is tight, most of the volume is scalping and the institutions are buying low and selling high. The best way to make money as a trader is to do what the institutions do, so if you are going to trade in a trading range, look to scalp, and buy low, sell high. Experienced traders will sell on limit orders above weak high 1 and high 2 buy signal bars at the top, and buy on limit orders below weak low 1 and low 2 signal bars at the bottom. Because limit orders trades are more difficult to evaluate accurately, beginners should avoid them. Be very careful about stop entries and only sell on a stop if you are at the top of the range as the market is turning down, and only buy on a stop near the bottom as the market is turning up. The market always races to the top and bottom, suckering hopeful beginners into buying on stops at the top and selling on stops at the bottom. They just look at the strength of the spikes up and down and ignore the trading range of the past 20 bars and end up doing the opposite of the institutions. Because so many of the trade setups are for scalps and most traders cannot make a living by scalping, they should be very selective during this time. Since the high or low of the day forms during the first third of the day in maybe 90 percent of days, the middle third of the day is usually when traders are deciding if the initial trend should resume or reverse. The bulls and the bears are active, each fighting over control and each trying to generate a trend into the close. The market often reverses around 8:30 a.m. PST and then trends for the rest of the middle third of the day. Traders need to be aware that the trend that began at the open might not last all day, and the exact opposite can develop after the first couple of hours.


初学者往往在日内中间三分之一时间里亏钱。他们亏掉的经常比在日内头三分之一时间里赚到的还多；如果是这样，他们就应该考虑在日内中间三分之一时间不做交易，除非信号特别强。许多交易者的钱大部分都是在头几个小时赚的，之后在一天中间这段时间，他们要么交易得少得多，要么干脆不做。假如一个人开了两家店，一家很赚钱，另一家不管老板怎么做都一直亏，而且亏的常常比那家赚钱的店赚的还多，他还应该继续开这两家店吗？答案很明显。你可以把日内头三分之一和中间三分之一时间看成那两家店。把亏钱的店关掉，一点问题都没有。你的目标是赚钱，不是整天都做交易。如果价格行为一整天都很好，你也不累，那么全天交易在财务上是明智的。不过，通常不是这种情况。中间三分之一时间往往有更多的双向交易、更多的通道、更多的窄幅交易区间、很多反转、没有后续行情的趋势K线，以及一大堆十字星。除非交易者对自己的止损入场非常挑剔，或者能用限价单反向操作赚钱，否则他们就应该等价格行为变得更容易预测。一笔交易都不做，永远比去做那些亏损大于盈利的交易要好。初学者赢的次数往往刚好够多，让他们继续按老样子做下去，指望自己缺的只是经验。可是不管积累多少经验，窄幅交易区间始终很难做。几乎总是更好的做法是：等到始终入场方向变得清楚，这样后续行情的概率才高到足以支撑一笔盈利的交易。


> Beginning traders tend to lose money in the middle third of the day. They often lose more than they have made in the first third of the day, and if that is the case, they should consider not trading in the middle third unless signals are especially strong. Many traders make most of their money in the first couple of hours of the day and then trade much less or not at all during the middle of the day. If a person owns two stores and one makes a lot of money, but the other consistently loses money no matter what the owner does, and often more than what he makes from his good store, should he continue to operate both stores? The answer is obvious. You can look at the first and middle thirds of the day as two stores. There is nothing wrong with closing that losing store. Your goal is to make money, not to trade all day long. If the price action is good all day long and you are not tired, then it is financially wise to trade all day. However, that is usually not the case. The middle third tends to have much more two-sided trading, channels, tight trading ranges, many reversals, trend bars without follow-through, and lots of dojis. Unless traders are very selective with their stop entries or capable of making money by fading moves with limit orders, they should just wait for the price action to become more predictable. It is always better to not take any trades than to take trades where your losses are greater than your wins. Beginners frequently win just often enough to make them continue what they are doing, hoping that all they need is experience. However, no matter how much experience they accumulate, a tight trading range will always be difficult to trade. It is almost always better to wait until the always-in direction is clear, so that the odds of follow-through are high enough to allow for a profitable trade.


一天的三个时段经常构成一种趋势恢复形态。比如，如果先有两个小时的抛售，然后在太平洋时间上午11:30前后走出一波上涨行情，之后市场可能再次抛售，恢复日内头三分之一时间的空头趋势。有时这个形态很清楚地是上—下—上或下—上—下，但更多时候它没那么明显，尽管这种倾向依然存在。正因为如此，许多交易者会把日内中间三分之一时间里任何一段反转了头三分之一走势的行情，只看成最初那段趋势的一次潜在回调。然后他们会等原来的趋势在上午11:30前后恢复；如果出现迹象表明事情正在这样发展，他们就会做这笔交易。即使在形态并不清楚的日子里，交易者也知道，市场经常在上午11:30前后走出一段行情，而这段行情往往会延续到当天的收盘，因为机构要开始他们当天最后的交易。这段行情可能是反转，但也可能是突破。比如，如果头两个小时是强劲的抛售，然后到上午11:30是一波疲弱的上涨行情，看起来像是做头并正在反转，市场却可能反而向上突破，走成一根趋势反转日K线，并一路涨到收盘。进入上午11:30这个时间点时，交易者并不执着于任何一个方向，但当市场进入日内最后三分之一时间、机构开始做他们最后的交易时，他们对两个方向都始终准备着。


> The three periods of the day often create a trend resumption pattern. For example, if there is a sell-off for a couple of hours, and then a rally into around 11:30 a.m. PST, the market might sell off again after that, resuming the bear trend of the first third of the day. Sometimes the pattern is clearly up-down-up or down-up-down, but more often it is less obvious, even though the tendency is still there. Because of this, many traders will view any move in the middle third of the day that reverses a move of the first third as simply a potential pullback from the initial trend. They will then look for the original trend to resume around 11:30 a.m., and if there is a sign that this is what’s happening, they will take the trade. Even on days when the pattern is not clear, traders know that the market often makes some move around 11:30 a.m. that will often carry into the close of the day as the institutions begin their final trading of the day. The move can be a reversal, but it can also be a breakout. For example, if there was a strong sell-off for the first two hours and then a weak rally into 11:30 a.m., and it appears to be topping out and reversing, the market might instead break out to the upside and lead to a trend reversal day and a rally into the close. Traders aren’t married to any particular direction going into 11:30 a.m., but are always ready for a move in either direction as the market enters the final third of the day and the institutions begin their final trades.


一天的最后一段一直持续到收盘。它经常恢复当天早些时候的那段趋势——这就是趋势恢复日的情形——但有时它也会反转趋势，形成一根反转日K线。如果日线图上是强劲的多头趋势，大多数日子都会收在开盘价之上，市场通常会在最后30到60分钟里尝试上涨。空头趋势则更多日子收在开盘价之下，而且经常一路抛售到收盘。


> The final period of the day runs until the close; it often resumes the trend from earlier in the day, as in a trend resumption day, but it sometimes reverses the trend and forms a reversal day. If there is a strong bull trend on the daily chart, most days will have closes above the opens and the market will usually try to rally in the final 30 to 60 minutes. Bear trends have more days with closes below the opens and often sell off into the close.


在最后30到60分钟里，交易者应该留意两种截然不同的价格行为：如果有所准备，每一种都是机会；如果没有准备，每一种都会带来麻烦。第一种是，市场有时会在最后半小时走出毫不松劲的趋势，因为风险经理告诉手下的交易者，他们必须在收盘前平掉亏损仓位。动能程序（momentum programs）察觉到这段强趋势后，也会毫不松劲地顺势交易，只要动能还在延续。有些日子里，许多共同基金在收盘前会有类似的订单要成交。那些想等回调入场的交易者会被关在场外，因为回调从来不会出现。如果你看到这种情况，就在当前K线的收盘价顺着趋势入场，把保护性止损放到这根K线的另一端之外。如果趋势一直延续到收盘，你就能很快赚到一笔意外之财。值得注意的是，交易者经常感到疲惫；由于他们的优势很小，一旦状态不在最好，就应该停止交易。交易者在一天里的任何时候都可能疲惫、无聊或分心，在恢复正常之前都不该做交易。计算机不会疲惫，收盘时做交易的状态跟一整天一样好。这是它们相对个人交易者的又一项优势。


> There are two very different types of price action that traders should look for in the final 30 to 60 minutes because each offers opportunities if traders are prepared, and each poses problems if they are not. First, the market sometimes will have a relentless trend in the final half hour as risk managers tell their traders that they have to cover their losing positions before the close. Momentum programs detect the strong trend and also trade wth trend relentlessly, as long as the momentum continues. On some days many mutual funds will have similar orders to fill going into the close. Traders who want to enter on pullbacks get trapped out because a pullback never comes. If you see this, enter with the trend on the close of the current bar and put your protective stop beyond the other end of the bar. If the trend continues into the close, you can make a quick windfall profit. It is worth noting that traders often get tired, and since their edge is small, they should refrain from trading if they cannot trade at their best. Traders can get tired, bored, or distracted at any time during the day and should not trade until they are back to normal. The computers don’t get tired and trade into the close as well as they did all day long. This is another one of the advantages that they have over individual traders.


当日线图上是多头趋势时，多头趋势K线的数量几乎总会多于空头趋势K线。空头趋势时则相反。比如，如果市场处在强空头趋势中，而进入最后一小时时出现一波力度中等的上涨行情，许多交易者会预期当天收在低点附近，日线图上收出一根收在低点附近的强空头趋势K线。正因为这样，有经验的交易者会迅速做空任何在临近收盘时开始向下反转的上涨行情，预期市场收在当天低点附近。另一些交易者会等抛售变得明确之后再去做空。结果往往是：当日线图上是空头趋势时，空头趋势日会在收盘前走出一段强空头趋势。日线图上的多头趋势则相反：绝大多数K线都收在高点附近，市场经常在最后一小时之前先有一波抛售，然后一路涨到收盘。


> When there is a bull trend on the daily chart, there will almost always be more bull trend bars than bear trend bars. The opposite is true when there is a bear trend. For example, if the market is in a strong bear trend and there is a moderate rally going into the last hour, many traders will expect the day to close near its low and for the bar on the daily chart to be a strong bear trend bar with a close near its low. Because of this, experienced traders will be quick to short any rally that begins to reverse down toward the end of the day, expecting a close near the low of the day. Other traders will wait for the sell-off to become clear and then short. The result is often a strong bear trend into the close of a bear trend day when there is a bear trend on the daily chart. The opposite is true of bull trends on the daily chart, where the preponderance of the bars close near their highs and the market often rallies into the close after a sell-off before the final hour.


另一种收盘行情对交易者更难对付，因为它不是把他们关在一笔盈利交易之外，而往往让他们带着亏损被止损出场。市场会一路走出趋势直到收盘，但K线很大、影线很长，还会有两三次反转，这些反转会打掉一些止损，却没有碰到信号K线之外那个最初的止损。如果你关于收盘前有趋势的判断是对的，而市场正在形成一两根带长影线的K线，那么只要把这笔交易当波段来做，并坚持最初的止损直到回调结束，之后再把止损收紧到回调之外一点点，你就能赚钱。


> The other type of close is more difficult for traders because instead of trapping them out of a winning trade, it tends to stop them out with losses. The market will trend into the close but have large bars, big tails, and two or three reversals that run stops but do not hit the original stop beyond the signal bar. If your premise that there is a trend into the close is correct and the market is forming a bar or two with large tails, you can make money if swing the trade and stick to your initial stop until after the pullback, and then tighten your stop to just beyond the pullback.


每当有报告发布时——不管是太平洋时间上午7点的住房报告，还是上午11:15的FOMC公告——你进场或出场时都很常见滑点，所以风险往往更大，回报往往更小。而且成功率只有50%。结果就是一个糟糕的交易者等式，大多数交易者应该先等上几秒到几分钟，等市场恢复秩序之后再下单。


> Whenever a report is released, whether it is a 7 a.m., PST, housing report or an 11:15 a.m. FOMC announcement, slippage is common as you get in or out of your trade, so the risk is often larger and the reward is often smaller. Also, the probability is only 50 percent. The result is a bad trader’s equation, and most traders should wait for seconds to minutes until the market becomes orderly before placing a trade.


![图 11.1](figures/fig-11-01.jpg)


**图 11.1　风险经理助推收盘前的趋势**


如图 11.1 所示，收盘前的这波上涨行情，部分原因就是风险经理的拍肩提醒（shoulder tap）。当市场开始向上转、走到第22根K线时，所有在第10根K线之后做空的人，到收盘时都有可能变成亏损持仓；而在第16根K线之后做空的人，手里已经拿着亏损单了。交易公司的风险经理会盯着交易者到收盘时还持有哪些仓位。如果很多交易者持有的空单突然开始亏钱，他们可能对自己的交易产生了情绪依赖，盼着尾盘来一波抛售。他们的奖金取决于业绩，他们可能不愿承认自己对今天的空头趋势突然看错了。风险经理的工作就是冷静客观，他会让这些交易者把空单买回来。如果足够多的公司都这么做，就会助推收盘前一段毫不松劲的上涨趋势。那些在家做交易的人本来在等回调，可回调从来没有出现。等他们明白发生了什么之后，本来可以在第21根和第23根K线处那两次短暂回调的上方买入，或者在任何一根K线的收盘价买入，然后把自己的保护性止损放在入场K线的低点下方。动能程序察觉到这种毫不松劲的买入，也开始买入，只要向上的动能一直很强，它们就会继续买。共同基金和对冲基金在收盘前的买入也会起同样的作用。当市场一路抛售到收盘时，所有这些交易者做的都是相反的事。


> As shown in Figure 11.1, the rally into the close was due in part to the risk manager shoulder tap. As the market began to turn up and reached bar 22, all of the traders who shorted after bar 10 were in jeopardy of having losing positions by the close, and all those who shorted after bar 16 were already holding losers. Risk managers at trading firms monitor what positions traders are holding into the close. If a lot of traders are holding shorts that are suddenly becoming losers, they might be emotionally attached to their trades and hope for a late sell-off. Their bonuses depend on their performance, and they might hate to admit that they are suddenly wrong about today’s bear trend. The risk manager’s job is to be coldly objective, and he will tell the traders to buy back their shorts. If this takes place at enough firms, it can contribute to a relentless uptrend into the close. Traders at home were hoping for a pullback, but it never came. Once they realized what was happening, they could have bought above the brief pullbacks at bars 21 and 23 or bought the close of any bar, and then placed protective stops below the low of their entry bar. Momentum programs detect the relentless buying and begin buying as well, and will continue to buy as long as the momentum up is strong. Mutual and hedge fund purchases going into the close can also contribute. All of these traders are doing the opposite when the market sells off into the close.


日线图上（图略），市场处在窄幅多头通道中。过去32天里，只有两天收在当天低点附近；同样在这32天里，有21天收在开盘价上方。在日线图的多头波段里，大多数日子的K线都是多头实体，交易者都急着买进通往收盘的上涨行情。


> The market was in a tight bull channel on the daily chart (not shown). Only two of the past 32 days closed near the low of the day, and 21 of the past 32 days closed above the open. In bull swings on the daily chart, most days had bull bodies, and traders were eager to buy a rally into the close.


头几个小时里，市场处在交易区间中；这个区间大约是日均区间的一半，提醒交易者可能会出现突破，走成一天趋势性交易区间。当市场从第7根K线与第2根K线构成的双顶向下走时，交易者越来越相信突破会向下，卖出也随之增加。市场随后形成了一个更低的交易区间，接着从第15根那根均线缺口K线开始抛售，向下突破，但又反转向上，涨到了开盘价上方。记住，大多数反转日都是从趋势性交易区间日开始的。


> The market was in a trading range for the first couple of hours; the range was about half the size of an average daily range, alerting traders to a possible breakout into a trending trading range day. As the market moved down from the bar 7 double top with bar 2, traders became more convinced that the breakout would be to the downside, and the selling increased. The market then formed a lower trading range, but then sold off from the bar 15 moving average gap bar, broke out to the downside, but reversed up to above the open. Remember, most reversal days begin as trending trading range days.


和经常出现的情况一样，市场在日内中间三分之一时间里横盘，随后，从第7根K线到第10根K线的那段空头趋势试图在日内最后三分之一时间里恢复。然而，向下的突破失败了，第10根到第16根K线的交易区间成了那段空头趋势里的最终旗形。


> As is often the case, the market went sideways in the middle third of the day, and then the bear trend from bar 7 to bar 10 tried to resume in the final third of the day. However, the downside breakout failed, and the bar 10 to bar 16 trading range became the final flag in the bear trend.


![图 11.2](figures/fig-11-02.jpg)


**图 11.2　收盘前的趋势可能很吓人**


关于收盘前的趋势，你可能判断对了，却仍然亏钱，因为市场在收盘前走出了几根十字星。如图 11.2 所示，涨到第19根K线的那段急速行情由两根强劲的多头趋势K线构成，本来很可能会走出后续行情，但任何多单的保护性止损都必须放在这段急速行情下方，至少也要放在第二根大号多头趋势K线的低点下方。市场一旦从第20根K线附近开始收出十字星，就有出现急速回调的风险。如果你是在第16根K线上方买入的，本可以用一个很紧的止损放在第20根K线下方，或者用保本止损。但是，如果你是买在第19根K线那段急速行情的收盘价，或者买在第21根十字星上方，你就必须把风险一直留到这段急速行情两根K线的低点下方，至少也要到第19根K线下方。这些影线是在警告：市场已经变成双向的了。如果你在这种市场里做交易——只有经验非常丰富的交易者，才应该在一天临近结束时市场走进窄幅交易区间的情况下考虑继续持有——你就必须把它当波段来做，容许双向波动，并使用宽的止损。


> You can be right about the trend into the close and still lose money when the market has a couple of dojis before the close. As shown in Figure 11.2, the two strong bull trend bars that formed a spike up to bar 19 were likely to have follow-through, but the protective stop on any long needed to be below the spike or at least below the low of the second large bull trend bar. Once the market began forming dojis around bar 20, there was a risk of a sharp pullback. If you bought above bar 16, you could have used a tight stop below bar 20 or a breakeven stop. However, if you bought the close of the bar 19 spike or above the bar 21 doji, you needed to risk to below the low of both bars of the spike or at least to below bar 19. The tails were a warning that the market was two-sided. If you take a trade in this type of market, and only very experienced traders should ever consider staying in when the market enters a tight trading range at the end of the day, you have to trade it for the swing and allow for two-sided movement and use a wide stop.


这是一个趋势恢复日：大约在日内头三分之一时间里有一波上涨行情，到第5根K线结束；随后是日内中间的一段交易区间；然后多头趋势恢复，一直走到收盘。最后一波上涨行情从太平洋时间上午11:15开始，不过向上的突破直到中午12:30才出现。


> This was a trend resumption day, where there was a rally for approximately the first third of the day, ending at bar 5, and then a trading range for the middle of the day, and a resumption of the bull trend into the close of the day. The final rally began at 11:15 a.m. PST, although the upside breakout did not come until 12:30 p.m.


![图 11.3](figures/fig-11-03.jpg)


**图 11.3　盘中反转**


当天的趋势在头一个小时左右确立之后，市场经常在日内中间三分之一时间开始的时候反转，时间大约在太平洋时间上午8:00到9:30之间（通常是8:30前后）。有时市场会转而进入一段持续几个小时的交易区间，然后在最后一两个小时里的某个时点向上或向下突破。这次突破可能带出一个趋势恢复日，也可能带出一个反转日。如图 11.3 所示，从第8根K线到第12根K线的那波上涨行情强到让先前的空头趋势无法在进入最后三分之一时重新占据主导。相反，在第17根K线处那次想让市场向下反转的疲弱尝试之后，第8根到第12根K线的那波上涨行情继续向上。多头的恢复是从第18根K线开始的：它是第12根到第15根K线那个楔形牛旗向均线回调的一波行情。不过多头没能把上涨延续下去，市场一路抛售回到开盘价，在日线图上收成一根十字星。


> After the trend of the day becomes established within the first hour or so, the market often reverses at the start of the middle third of the day, between about 8:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. PST (usually around 8:30 a.m.). Sometimes the market instead enters a trading range for several hours, and then breaks out in either direction at some point in the final hour or two. The breakout can lead to either a trend resumption day or a reversal day. As shown in Figure 11.3, the rally from bar 8 to bar 12 was so strong that the earlier bear trend was unable to reassert itself going into the final third of the day. Instead, the rally from bar 8 to bar 12 resumed upward after the weak attempt at bar 17 to reverse the market down. The bull resumption began with the bar 18 pullback from the bar 12 to bar 15 wedge bull flag to the moving average. The bulls were unable to continue the rally, though, and the market sold off back to the open, creating a doji day on the daily chart.


第3根K线是对均线的一次测试，并与第1根K线构成双顶，因此可能是当天的高点。交易者当时在等开盘区间底部被突破，然后是一段大约向下的等距运动。结果市场先走出一段空头急速行情跌到第4根K线，之后又推进了两次，形成一段空头急速与通道趋势，其中的通道是一个楔形。交易者把这看成日内中间三分之一时间开始时一次可能的向上反转，也可能是当天的低点。买入信号出现在自第8根K线开始的那个两根K线反转上方。许多交易者认为，市场在第9根那根外包上涨K线处已经翻转为始终做多；到第10根K线那段多头急速行情结束时，大多数交易者都认为市场已经处在多头方向。


> Bar 3 was a test of the moving average and a double top with bar 1, and therefore a possible high of the day. Traders were looking for a breakout of the bottom of the opening range and then about a measured move down. Instead, the market had a bear spike down to bar 4 and then two more pushes, creating a bear spike and channel trend where the channel was a wedge. Traders saw this as a possible reversal up at the start of the middle third of the day and a potential low of the day. The buy signal was above the two-bar reversal that began with bar 8. Many traders saw the market as having flipped to always-in long on the bar 9 outside up bar, and most traders believed it was long by the end of the bar 10 bull spike.


# 第 12 章　市场

*12. Markets*


市场价格行为的技巧在所有市场里都管用，但多数日内交易者偏爱这样的市场：在5分钟图上一天里有很多次入场机会，而且能承接大仓位而不出现滑点。5分钟标普（S&P）Emini 小型合约，你下的单子不管多大它都接得住；你的仓位永远长不到它容不下的地步。不过，罗素期货合约（Russell futures contract）在一些个人交易者中很受欢迎，因为他们觉得它日内趋势走得好，而且相对平均波段的规模来说，保证金比较小。多数成功的个人交易者最终想交易的合约数量，会超过罗素在不担心滑点的情况下能承接的量。


> Markets Price action techniques work in all markets, but most day traders prefer markets that have many entries a day on the 5 minute chart and can handle large position sizes without slippage. The 5 minute Standard & Poor’s (S&P) Emini futures contract can handle any order size that an individual trader can place; you will never outgrow it. The Russell futures contract, however, is popular with some individual traders because they feel that it trends well intraday and the margin is relatively small for the size of the average swing. Most successful individual traders eventually want to trade more contracts than the Russell can handle without the worry of slippage.


刚起步时，你应该考虑用 SPY 代替 Emini。如果 Emini 在1,100附近成交，SPY 就会在110.00附近，而 Emini 里80个最小报价单位、也就是两个点的剥头皮，在 SPY 里是20美分的剥头皮（Emini 的每个最小报价单位都比 SPY 的最小报价单位大2.5倍）。一张 Emini 相当于500股 SPY。如果你交易300到500股 SPY，就可以对自己那笔波段仓位分批止盈，而不会承担太大的风险。SPY 的一个好处是，20美分这个剥头皮规模感觉太小、来得也太快，以至于给波段交易下单会比给剥头皮下单更容易——刚起步时这是更好的做法。你会发现，Emini 没有触及的入场或出场止损位，SPY 常常会触及。正因为如此，有些交易者在 SPY 里用2个或3个最小报价单位的止损。


> When starting out, you should consider trading the SPY instead of the Emini. If the Emini is trading around 1,100, the SPY will be around 110.00 and an eight-tick scalp for two points in the Emini is a 20 cent scalp in the SPY (each Emini tick is two and a half times larger than an SPY tick). One Emini is equivalent to 500 SPY. If you trade 300 to 500 SPY, you can scale out of your swing position and not incur too much risk. One advantage of the SPY is that the 20 cent scalp size feels so small and comes so quickly that it will be easier to place orders for swing trades than for scalps, which is a better approach when just starting out. You will notice that the SPY often hits a one-tick entry or exit stop when the Emini does not. Because of this, some traders use a two-or three-tick stop in the SPY.


等你把仓位规模加到1,000到1,500股 SPY 之后，如果你打算继续加规模，就改用 Emini，它能承接巨大的成交量，而滑点不会成为显著的问题。刚起步时，你可以用100股 SPY 做剥头皮，止盈目标20美分、保护性止损20美分，这相当于 Emini 两个点的止损，所以你的风险只有20美元加手续费。不过，在 SPY 里剥头皮要赚到钱，你的手续费必须极低，比如100股1.00美元。另外，你还需要一套能让你快速下单的委托输入系统。要不然，就先做波段交易，等你持续稳定盈利之后再考虑加入一些剥头皮。


> Once you have increased your position size to 1,000 to 1,500 SPY, if you plan to continue to increase your size, switch to the Emini, which can handle huge volume without slippage being a significant problem. When just starting out, you can scalp 100 SPY using a 20 cent profit target and a 20 cent protective stop, which is equivalent to a two-point Emini stop, so your risk is just $20 plus commissions. However, you cannot scalp and make money in the SPY unless your commissions are minimal, like $1.00 for 100 shares. Also, you need an order entry system that allows you to place orders quickly. Otherwise, just swing trade until you are consistently successful, and then look to add some scalping.


货币期货、外汇（forex）、美国国债与中期国债期货都能承接巨大的成交量，但多数日子里给出的入场机会比 Emini 少。债券和中期国债日内可能出现很长的趋势，所以当一笔交易成形时，你常常可以入场，然后让它做上几个小时的波段。外汇市场在 Emini 日盘时段通常没有多少好交易；既然你不想要任何干扰，那么如果你在积极交易 Emini，白天最好避开它。DIA 和道指期货的流动性有点稀薄，所以对剥头皮者来说滑点会是个问题。正如 SPY 与 Emini 相同，QQQ 与纳斯达克期货相同。QQQ 也很受日内交易者欢迎，能承接大额订单。


> Currency futures, foreign exchange (forex), and Treasury bond and note futures can handle huge volume, but give fewer entries than the Eminis on most days. Bonds and notes can have protracted trends intraday, so when a trade sets up, you can often enter and let it swing for hours. The forex market usually doesn’t offer many great trades during the Emini day session, and since you don’t want any distractions, it is best to avoid it during the day if you are actively trading the Eminis. The DIA and Dow futures are a little thin, so slippage can be a problem for scalpers. Just as the SPY is identical to the Eminis, the QQQ is identical to the NASDAQ futures. The QQQ is also very popular with day traders and can accommodate large orders.


许多股票日内的可交易性都很好。最容易的做法是只交易那些日均波幅有几美元、日均成交量在500万股以上的股票。你希望自己能以最小的滑点剥头皮赚到50美分到1美元，也希望波段那部分有可能跑出好几美元。目前，苹果（AAPL）、国际商业机器（IBM）、谷歌（GOOG）、亚马逊（AMZN）、高盛（GS）、石油服务 HOLDRS（OIH）、超短石油天然气 ProShares ETF（DUG）、超金融 ProShares ETF（UYG）和 SPDR 黄金信托（GLD）都不错，但还有其他很多股票，你可以按需要往自己的名单里加或减。


> Many stocks trade very well intraday. It is easiest to trade only those with an average daily range of several dollars and an average volume of five million shares or more. You want to be able to scalp 50 cents to a dollar with minimal slippage, and you want the possibility that the swing portion can run several dollars. Currently, Apple (AAPL), International Business Machines (IBM), Google (GOOG), Amazon (AMZN), Goldman Sachs (GS), Oil Service HOLDRS (OIH), UltraShort Oil and Gas ProShares ETF (DUG), Ultra Financials ProShares ETF (UYG), and SPDR Gold Trust (GLD) are all good, but there are many others, and you can add or subtract from your list as needed.


# 第 13 章　时间级别与走势图类型

*13. Time Frames and Chart Types*


对剥头皮交易者来说，做 Emini 小型合约最省事的是用 5 分钟蜡烛线图。不过，要做 Emini 或股票的日内波段交易，一张简单的 5 分钟K线图就很好用。这是因为在笔记本或单显示器上，你可以把六张K线图并排放到屏幕里，每张图是一只不同的股票，而每张图都装得下一整天的K线。要是你用蜡烛线，它比K线宽，图上就只能显示大约半天的价格行为。提这一点的一个重要原因，是提醒交易者这套方法用简单的K线图就很好使，尤其是在你只想挑最好的入场点来做波段交易时。对剥头皮者来说，Emini 上用蜡烛线图的好处是能一眼看清一根K线归谁，尤其是建仓形态那根K线。另外，很多高2和低2的变体在K线图上看不清楚。


> For a scalper, it is easiest to use a 5 minute candle chart for the Emini. However, for intraday swing trading of the Emini or stocks, a simple 5 minute bar chart works well. This is because on a laptop or a single monitor, you can fit six bar charts on your screen, each with a different stock, and each chart will contain a full day's worth of bars. If you use candles, which are wider than bars, your charts will show only about a half day of price action. An important reason for mentioning this is to remind traders that this approach works well with simple bar charts, especially when you are trying to swing trade only the best entries. The advantage of candle charts on the Emini for scalpers is that it is easy to quickly see who owns the bars, especially the setup bar. Also, a lot of high and low 2 variants are not easy to see on bar charts.


价格行为的交易技巧在所有市场、所有时间级别都管用，所以交易者得做一个显而易见的基本决定：该做哪些市场、哪些时间级别。多数交易者的目标是长期把盈利做到最大，而这背后隐含的一点是，每个交易者都要找到一套合自己性子的做法。


> Price action trading techniques work in all markets and all time frames, so traders have to make the obvious basic decision of which markets and time frames they should trade. The objective of most traders is to maximize profitability over the long run, and implicit in that is that each trader needs to find an approach that suits his or her personality.


如果 5 分钟 Emini 图平均每天有十几个好的入场点，3 分钟图有 20 个，1 分钟图有 30 个，而风险（保护性止损的大小）在 5 分钟图上是 8 个最小报价单位，3 分钟图上是 6 个，1 分钟图上是 4 个，那为什么不做更短的时间级别？交易更多、风险更小、赚钱更多——对吧？对，前提是你能在实时行情里足够快地正确读图，把入场单、止损单和止盈目标单分毫不差地挂在对的价位上，而且一天七小时、年复一年地一直这么干。对许多交易者来说，时间级别越小，错过的好交易越多，胜率也越低。他们用这套方法在 1 分钟图和 3 分钟图上剥头皮就是快不起来，做不到像在 5 分钟图上那样赚钱，所以 5 分钟图才该是他们的重点，他们该做的是不断把仓位规模做大。最好的交易往往来得让人意外，那些建仓形态可能很难让人信得过。大多数交易者根本来不及处理这些信息。他们总会挑着做，而且往往挑不到最好的那几个建仓形态，可那几个偏偏是对他们的最终盈亏最重要的。最好的交易往往建仓和触发得太快，很容易错过，结果剩下的全是没那么好的交易，亏损的单子一个不落。


> If a 5 minute Emini chart offers a dozen good entries on average every day, and the 3 minute chart offers 20, and the 1 minute offers 30, and the risk (size of the protective stop) is eight ticks on the 5 minute, six ticks on the 3 minute, and four ticks on the 1 minute, why not trade the shorter time frames? More trades, smaller risk, more money—right? Right, if you can read the charts correctly fast enough in real time to be able to place your entry, stop, and profit target orders at the exact prices correctly, and do this constantly for seven hours a day, year in and year out. For many traders, the smaller the time frame, the more good trades they miss, and the lower their winning percentage becomes. They simply cannot scalp with this method fast enough on the 1 and 3 minute charts to be as profitable as they are on the 5 minute chart, so that should be their focus and they should continually work on increasing their position size. The best trades often come as a surprise, and the setups can be hard to trust. Most traders simply cannot process the information fast enough. Invariably, they will cherry-pick and tend not to pick the very best setups, which are the most important ones to their bottom lines. The best trades often set up and trigger so fast that they are easy to miss, and then you are left with all the trades that are less good, including all of the losers.


更高时间级别图上一段行情的平均幅度，比更小时间级别图上的要大。不过，几乎所有更高时间级别的波段，都是从 1 分钟图和 3 分钟图上的一次反转开始的。只是很难知道哪一次会走成，而且一天想做 30 笔以上、指望撞上一次大行情，实在很耗人。1 分钟图和 3 分钟图上最好的那些交易，会带出 5 分钟图和 15 分钟图上的强势入场点；对多数交易者来说，把精力放在最好的 5 分钟交易上、同时不断把仓位规模做大，要赚钱得多。一旦他们能稳定盈利，就能赚到多得惊人的钱，还能有很高的胜率，结果是压力小得多，长期保持状态的能力也更强。


> The average size of a move on a higher time frame chart is greater than that on a smaller time frame chart. However, almost every higher time frame swing starts with a reversal on the 1 and 3 minute charts. It is just hard to know which ones will work, and it can be draining trying to take 30 or more trades a day, hoping for a big move. The very best trades on 1 and 3 minute charts lead to strong entries on 5 and 15 minute charts, and for most traders it is much more profitable to focus on the best 5 minute trades and work on increasing their position size. Once they can trade successfully, they can make an incredible amount of money and have a very high winning percentage, which results in much less stress and a better ability to maintain their performance over time.


另外，随着仓位规模变大，到了某个点，成交量会在 1 分钟图的太多笔交易上影响市场。举个极端的例子：如果你挂一个卖出 5,000 手 Emini 合约、价位在市场上方两个最小报价单位的止盈限价单，任何有价格阶梯的人都会看出这个异常挂单，一天里你想在 10 到 15 笔交易上成交都会很难。而且用止损单进这么大的仓位，会滑到一两个最小报价单位，这会把剥头皮的收益风险比彻底毁掉。交易者完全可以用价格行为一笔做 5,000 手合约，但不能用大多数交易所需的那套入场和出场剥头皮技巧。但愿你有朝一日也能遇上这种烦恼：因为自己的成交量已经对成交不利，不得不重新考虑自己的做法！


> Also, as your position size increases, at some point the volume will affect the market on too many trades on a 1 minute chart. As an extreme example, if you had a profit-target limit order to sell 5,000 Emini contracts at two ticks above the market, anyone with a price ladder would see the aberration and you would have a difficult time getting filled on 10 to 15 trades a day. Also, entering that size on a stop would result in a tick or two of slippage, which would ruin the risk/reward ratio of scalping. A trader can trade even 5,000 contracts per trade using price action, but not with the entry and exit scalping techniques needed for most trades. May you someday have the problem of having to rethink your approach because your volume is adversely affecting your fills!


1 分钟图在两种场合下有用。如果 5 分钟图正在急速趋势里，而你空仓又想进场，可以看 1 分钟图，等高2或低2回调顺势入场。对经验丰富的交易者来说，1 分钟图有用的第二种场合，是在 5 分钟图上对处于趋势中的股票做波段交易。股票处于趋势中时，会非常尊重移动均线，可以在均线处用高1或低1的建仓形态做顺趋势交易，风险就是信号K线的高度。交易者可以把风险再降一些：等 5 分钟图上价格触及或刺穿移动均线之后的第一次反转，在 1 分钟图上入场。如果你把 5 分钟图的 20 根K线移动均线画到 1 分钟图上，就能很快看到这些触及，然后下单。你实际上要在 1 分钟图上画一条 90 根K线的移动均线，来替代 5 分钟图的 20 根K线移动均线。为什么是 90 根而不是 100 根？因为 1 分钟图上的移动均线是每根 1 分钟K线收盘时都重算一次，而不是每第五根K线收盘时才重算，所以近期K线的权重会让 100 根K线的移动均线显得稍稍太平。另外，1 分钟图上前四根K线的收盘价并不属于那条 5 分钟移动均线。要修正这一点，就用 90 根K线的移动均线（我用的是指数移动均线，不过任何移动均线都行），它和 5 分钟图的 20 根K线移动均线非常接近。实际操作中，因为你主要盯着 Emini，很少有时间去看 1 分钟股票图。不过，当某只股票走强趋势时，你偶尔可以脱离 1 分钟图快速入场。这段讨论隐含的一点是：不同时间级别上可能出现方向相反的趋势。比如，市场已经强劲上涨了两周，但最近两天走在下行通道里，而最近 15 分钟又在向上回调到正在下行的 5 分钟移动均线，那么 5 分钟图是空头趋势，1 分钟图是多头趋势，而这两天的下跌很可能正在 60 分钟图上形成牛旗。日线图看空、月线图看多，两者同时成立也有可能。想把这一堆全部理顺太容易把人绕晕，而等所有时间级别都同向则是浪费时间，因为这种情况很少发生，就算发生了，也不保证就能赚到钱。只挑一个时间级别，做好眼前的价格行为就够了。只要读得准、做得好，你根本不用知道其它那些图上正在发生什么，照样能做得很好。


> The 1 minute chart can be helpful in two situations. If the 5 minute chart is in a runaway trend and you are flat but want to get in, you can look at a 1 minute chart for high/low 2 pullbacks to enter with the trend. The second situation where 1 minute charts are helpful for experienced traders is in swing trading trending stocks off the 5 minute chart. When stocks are trending, they are very respectful of the moving average and with-trend trades can be made off high/low 1 or 2 setups at the moving average, risking the height of the signal bar. Traders can reduce that risk somewhat by entering on the 1 minute chart on the first reversal after a moving average touch or penetration on the 5 minute chart. If you plot a 5 minute 20 bar moving average on the 1 minute chart, you can quickly see the touches and then place the order. You actually need to plot a 90 bar moving average on the 1 minute chart as a surrogate for the 5 minute 20 bar moving average. Why 90 and not 100 bars? Because the moving average on the 1 minute chart is recalculated at the close of every 1 minute bar, and not just at the close of every fifth bar, so the weighting of the more recent bars tends to make a 100 bar moving average a tiny bit too flat. Also, the first four closes on the 1 minute chart are not part of the 5 minute moving average. To correct for this, use a 90 bar moving average (I use an exponential moving average, but any moving average is fine), which is very close to the 5 minute 20 bar moving average. In actual practice, you will rarely have time to look at a 1 minute stock chart because of your focus on the Emini. However, when a stock is strongly trending, you might occasionally take quick entries off the 1 minute chart. Implicit in this discussion is that there can be opposite trends on different time frames. For example, if the market has been going up strongly for a couple of weeks, but for the past two days it has been in a trending bear channel and for the past 15 minutes it is in a pullback up to the falling 5 minute moving average, then the 5 minute chart is in a bear trend, the 1 minute chart is in a bull trend, and the two days of downward movement are likely forming a bull flag on the 60 minute chart. It is also possible that the daily chart is bearish and the monthly chart is bullish, both at the same time. It is too confusing to try to reconcile all of this, and it is a waste of time to wait for all time frames to be going in the same direction, because that rarely happens, and even if it does, there is no guarantee of a profitable trade. Just pick one time frame, and trade the price action that is in front of you. If you read correctly and trade well, you will do fine without ever knowing what is going on in all of those other charts.


许多交易者用的图，K线是按成交量而不是按时间画的。比如，Emini 图可以做成这样：只要出现了 5,000 个或更多最小报价单位，或者一成交满 25,000 手合约，一根K线就收盘。你用哪种图都无所谓，只要你对读图和下单所需的速度感到顺手就行。所有图上的形态都源于人类行为，所以它们是一样的。时间图上画的趋势线往往比成交量图上的更精确，但很多交易者并不操心趋势线精不精确，直接用个大概。


> Many traders use charts where the bars are based on volume and not time. For example, an Emini chart can be constructed where each bar closes as soon as 5,000 or more ticks have occurred, or as soon as 25,000 contracts were traded. It does not matter what type of chart you use as long as you are comfortable with the speed needed to read the chart and place the order. The patterns on all charts are based on human behavior and are therefore the same. Trend lines tend to be more precise on charts based on time than those based on volume, but many traders don't worry about precise trend lines and instead just use approximations.


我有一群朋友用基于斐波那契数的最小报价单位图（tick 图），另一些朋友用基于奇怪时间（比如 8 分钟或 13 分钟）的时间图。这些做法有时都管用，但只挑一种图来交易会容易得多。它是最小报价单位图、成交量图还是时间图，都无所谓；每根K线里有多少个最小报价单位、多少股、多少分钟，也无所谓。所有类型的图上，全天都会出现很棒的价格行为信号。重要得多的是交易者实时读图、正确管理交易的能力。你完全可以用完全随机的每根K线最小报价单位数、股数或分钟数去试，你会发现图看上去很棒，也有大量合理的信号。我个人喜欢 5 分钟图，因为趋势线和趋势通道线往往很精确，每天都有充足的建仓形态，而且我能看到K线什么时候要收盘，这让我可以提前预判交易。用最小报价单位图或成交量图时，几秒钟里的一串密集成交可能让K线比预想的早得多就收盘，我发现结果是我会错过太多这种绝佳信号——而这些信号在当天收盘后的图表打印件上一眼就能看到。还有，这类图上的趋势线也不够准。用最小报价单位图或成交量图的交易者，还往往喜欢用更小时间级别的图。他们这么做是为了把止损缩小，指望风险降下来就能盈利。结果无一例外，他们忽视了胜率下降这个交换代价，最后赔钱。


> I have a group of friends who use tick charts based on Fibonacci numbers, and other friends who use time charts based on odd times, like eight or 13 minutes. Everything works some of the time, but it is easier to trade if you pick just one chart. It does not matter if it is a tick chart, a volume chart, or a time chart, and it does not matter how many ticks, shares, or minutes are in each bar. There will be great price action signals on all types of charts all day long. What is far more important is a trader's ability to read real time and manage trades correctly. You can experiment with totally random numbers of ticks, shares, or minutes per bar and you will see that the charts look great and have lots of reasonable signals. I personally like the 5 minute chart because trend lines and trend channel lines are often precise, there are plenty of setups every day, and I can see when the bar is about to close, which allows me to anticipate trades. With tick or volume charts, a flurry of trades over the course of a few seconds can cause the bar to close much sooner than expected, and I find that I end up missing too many of those great signals that are so easy to see on a printout of the chart at the end of the day. Also, the trend lines are less accurate. There is also a tendency for traders who use charts based on ticks or volume to use smaller time frame charts. They do so to minimize their stop sizes, hoping that the reduced risk will result in being profitable. Invariably, they ignore the trade-off of a lower winning percentage and end up losing money.


![图 13.1](figures/fig-13-01.jpg)


**图 13.1　用K线图做波段交易**


像图 13.1 中那样的简单K线图，就足够用价格行为做波段交易了。有趋势时，就在回调处顺势入场，比如多头趋势里的高2或空头趋势里的低2。另外，在强劲的趋势线突破之后，可以等测试时逆势入场，比如在一个可能的新多头趋势里出现更高的低点或更低的低点，前提是有一根强势的反转K线。


> A simple bar chart such as those in Figure 13.1 is all that is necessary to swing trade using price action. When there is a trend, look to enter with trend on a pullback, like a high 2 in a bull trend or a low 2 in a bear trend. Also, after a strong trend line break, look to enter countertrend on a test, like a higher low or lower low in a possible new bull trend, if there is a strong reversal bar.


![图 13.2](figures/fig-13-02.jpg)


**图 13.2　1分钟图上的回调**


如果 5 分钟图上没有回调，你正为怎么进场做多发愁，不妨看看 1 分钟图（见图 13.2）。5 分钟 Emini 图的缩略图显示，它从开盘起上涨了 11.75 个点，中途没有回调。如果交易者错过了从开盘起就做多的那波趋势，他们就会错过整个波段，因为中间没有回调。不过，如果他们转去看 1 分钟图，那里有三个高1建仓形态（K线 A、B 和 C），他们本可以在那里入场。激进的多头会在 1 分钟图上前一根K线的低点挂限价单买入，认定每一次反转尝试都会很快失败。一旦做多，他们就会转在 5 分钟图上管理交易，再也不看 1 分钟图，然后突然意识到，那些其实是反转，是可以做空的。你看 1 分钟图只有一个理由——5 分钟图上没有回调，去那里找高1和高2的做多入场点。在 1 分钟图上做逆势交易会让你亏钱。事实上，那三个做多建仓形态所在的价位，正是 1 分钟图上做空者会回补的价位；而随着他们回补，他们会变成额外的买方，帮着把市场推上去。


> If the 5 minute chart does not have pullbacks and you are struggling with how to get long, consider looking at the 1 minute chart (see Figure 13.2). The thumbnail of the 5 minute Emini shows that it went 11.75 points up off the open without a pullback. If traders missed the trend from the open long, they would have missed the entire swing because there were no pullbacks. However, if they instead looked at the 1 minute chart, there were three high 1 setups (bars A, B, and C) where they could have entered. Aggressive bulls will buy place limit orders at the low of the prior bar on the 1 minute chart, expecting every reversal attempt to quickly fail. Once long, they will then manage their trades on the 5 minute chart, never look at the 1 minute, and suddenly realize that those are reversals that can be shorted. You looked at the 1 minute for only one reason—to find high 1 and 2 long entries because there were no pullbacks on the 5 minute chart. Trading countertrend on the 1 minute chart will cost you money. In fact, those three long setups are at exactly the price that the 1 minute shorts would have covered, and as they covered, they would become additional buyers and help drive the market up.


![图 13.3](figures/fig-13-03.jpg)


**图 13.3　1分钟图上的移动均线回调**


如图 13.3 所示，这张 AAPL 的 1 分钟图在强势空头趋势日里，在 90 根K线指数移动均线（相当于 5 分钟图上的 20 根K线指数移动均线）处给了三次好的做空机会，风险很小（就是那根K线的高度）。缩略图显示的是 5 分钟图上强劲的急速行情与通道空头趋势。多数交易者应该只用一张图，不必费心去看 1 分钟图。人很容易被 1 分钟图上的各种小波动迷住，错过 5 分钟图上的大局，最后赚到的 tick 数少得多。新手很容易过度交易、出场太早、不让利润跑起来，最后即使一路正确地做空到底，还是亏钱。


> As shown in Figure 13.3, this 1 minute chart of AAPL during a strong bear trend day offered three good shorts at the 90 bar exponential moving average (equivalent to the 5 minute 20 bar ema) with low risk (the height of the bar). The thumbnail shows the strong 5 minute spike and channel bear trend. Most traders should just use one chart and not bother with looking at a 1 minute chart. It is easy to get entranced by all of the little moves on the 1 minute chart and miss the big picture on the 5 minute chart, and then end up making far fewer ticks profit. It is very easy for beginners to over-trade, exit too soon, and not let profits run, and end up losing money, even though they correctly shorted all of the way down.


![图 13.4](figures/fig-13-04.jpg)


**图 13.4　成交量图与最小报价单位图在头一个小时左右K线更多**


图 13.4 里的三张图来自同一个 Emini 日盘。顶部是 5 分钟图，中间每根K线 1,500 个最小报价单位（即每根K线 1,500 笔成交），底部每根K线 20,000 手合约（每根K线在自该K线开始以来成交量首次达到 20,000 手或以上时收盘）。它们的价格行为相似，都可以交易，但由于成交量最高的时段通常出现在头一个小时左右，最小报价单位图和成交量图都出现了偏斜：当天早些时候和最后一小时里每小时的K线多得多。


> The three charts shown in Figure 13.4 were from the same Emini day session. The top was a 5 minute chart, the middle had 1,500 ticks per bar (1,500 trades per bar), and the bottom had 20,000 contracts per bar (each bar closed on the first trade that made the volume 20,000 or more contracts since the start of the bar). They had similar price action and all were tradable, but since the highest volume usually takes place in the first hour or so, the tick and volume charts were skewed, with many more bars per hour earlier in the day and in the final hour.


![图 13.5](figures/fig-13-05.jpg)


**图 13.5　价格行为在任何时间级别、任何类型的图上都管用**


图 13.5 左边那张图每根K线是斐波那契数 4,181 个最小报价单位，右边那张是 8 分钟K线图。两张图都有很多可靠的建仓形态。每种图有时都会给出好信号，但只挑一张图来交易会更容易。它是最小报价单位图、成交量图还是时间图，都无所谓；每根K线里有多少个最小报价单位、多少股、多少分钟，也无所谓。你完全可以挑完全随机的数字。重要得多的是交易者实时读图、正确管理交易的能力。所有图上发生的事，不过是我们基因的一种表达，用哪种方式呈现这种表达都无所谓。所有图展示的行为都一样。


> The chart on the left in Figure 13.5 has a Fibonacci 4,181 ticks per bar, and the chart on the right is an 8 minute bar chart. Both had many reliable setups. Every type of chart gives good signals some of the time, but it is easier to trade if you pick just one chart. It does not matter if it is a tick chart, a volume chart, or a time chart, and it does not matter how many ticks, shares, or minutes are in each bar. You can pick totally random numbers. What is far more important is a trader's ability to read real time and manage trades correctly. What takes place on all of the charts is just an expression of our genes, and it does not matter which portrayal of that expression you use. All charts show the same behavior.


![图 13.6](figures/fig-13-06.jpg)


**图 13.6　报告发布期间的大K线与反转**


报告可能带来非常情绪化的行情，配着大K线、外包K线和好几次反转。报告出来后的几秒到几分钟里，机构用计算机程序化交易，在分析速度和下单速度上有明显优势。当你的竞争对手手握大优势时，别去跟他们拼。等他们的优势消失，在速度不再重要的时候再交易，这通常是在头一到三根K线之后。不管快速行情和大K线在所有交易者心里激起什么情绪，价格行为的建仓形态依然非常可靠。总的来说，总要留一部分仓位做波段，止损设在保本，因为有时一个波段会走得比你想象得远得多。


> Reports can lead to very emotional moves with big bars, outside bars, and several reversals. In the seconds to minutes after a report comes out, computerized trading by institutions gives them a clear edge in speed of analysis and order placement. When your competition has a big advantage, don't compete. Wait for their edge to disappear and trade when speed is no longer important, which is usually after the first one to three bars. Despite the emotion that the rapid moves and big bars generate in all traders, price action setups are still very reliable. In general, always swing part of the position with a breakeven stop because sometimes a swing will go much farther than you could ever imagine.


如图 13.6 所示，联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的报告在太平洋标准时间上午 11 点 15 分发布（有时会晚几分钟才出来），引发了情绪化的交易，证据是大K线、外包K线，以及接下来 30 分钟里的好几次反转。不过，记住基本规则的价格行为交易者做得很好。 第2根K线是一根大阳线反转K线，但只要它和前一根K线大量重叠，就可能正在形成交易区间，你绝不该想着在区间顶部买入。相反，要去找被套的交易者、小K线和二次入场。


> As shown in Figure 13.6, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) report was released at 11:15 a.m. PST (it sometimes comes out several minutes late) and caused emotional trading as evidenced by large bars, outside bars, and several reversals within the next 30 minutes. However, price action traders who remembered the basic rules did well. Bar 2 was a large bull reversal bar, but whenever there is a lot of overlap with the prior bar, a trading range might be forming and you should never be looking to buy at the top of a range. Instead, look for trapped traders, small bars, and second entries.


第3根K线是个很好的做空剥头皮机会，因为有一批被套的、过于急切的多头，把那个大反转K线误当成了合理的做多建仓形态。


> Bar 3 was a great short scalp because there were trapped overly eager bulls who mistook the large reversal bar for a sensible long setup.


第4根K线是第二次尝试反转开盘时形成的当日低点下方的突破。二次入场总是值得做，而一根多头趋势内包K线，在情绪化的一天里已经是你所能指望的最好机会了。既然这本来会带来至少两段上涨，你就需要留一部分仓位做波段。初始止损放在信号K线中部附近，等第4根K线那根入场K线收盘后，再移到其下方一个最小报价单位。之后可以把止损移到前一根K线低点下方，最终移到保本。


> Bar 4 was the second attempt to reverse the breakout below the low of the day that formed at the open. Second entries are always worth taking, and a bull trend inside bar is as good as you are likely to get on an emotional day. Since this would have resulted in at least two legs up, you needed to swing part of your position. The initial stop was around the middle of the signal bar, and then one tick below the bar 4 entry bar once that bar closed. The stop could then have been trailed below the low of the prior bar and eventually moved to breakeven.


情绪化的一天往往会带出走得比你想象得远得多的趋势，抓住一次这样的行情，比很多很多次剥头皮的利润加起来还要多。这里多头趋势一直走了将近 30 个点，大约每手合约 1,500 美元。


> Emotional days often lead to trends that carry much further than you would ever anticipate, and catching one like this is much more profitable than the combined profits from many, many scalps. Here, the bull trend continued for almost 30 points, or about $1,500 per contract.


![图 13.7](figures/fig-13-07.jpg)


**图 13.7　1分钟图上头一个小时的剥头皮**


如图 13.7 所示，Emini 头两个小时在 1 分钟图上提供了很多有利可图的剥头皮机会，前提是你能读懂价格行为并且下单非常快。实际操作中这很难做到，多数交易者会觉得压力太大，做不对，结果反倒亏钱。


> As shown in Figure 13.7, the first couple of hours of the Emini provided many profitable scalps on the 1 minute chart for someone who could read price action and place orders very quickly. It is very difficult to do in actual practice, and most traders would find it too stressful to do correctly, resulting in them losing money.


第1根K线是跳空高开日里 iii 形态的假向上突破，也是一个更低的高点。


> Bar 1 was a false upside breakout of an iii pattern and a lower high on a gap up day.


第2根K线在移动均线处构成了高2、楔形牛旗和趋势通道线反转。


> Bar 2 set up a high 2 at the moving average, a wedge bull flag, and a trend channel line reversal.


第3根K线是跳空高开日里创新高突破失败后的做空，这次突破失败可能会带来对缺口的测试（市场通常都会试着测试缺口，所以交易者该去找顺着这个方向的交易机会）。


> Bar 3 was a short on a failed breakout to a new high on a gap up day that could have led to a test of the gap (the market usually tries to test gaps, so traders should look for opportunities to trade in that direction).


第5根K线是移动均线处的低3。低3是楔形或三角形的一种，而在这里它同时也是三重顶熊旗。


> Bar 5 was a low 3 at the moving average. A low 3 is a type of wedge or triangle, and here it was also a triple top bear flag.


第6根K线是微型趋势线突破失败，也是第5根K线熊旗突破之后的突破回调。


> Bar 6 was a failed micro trend line breakout and a breakout pullback from the breakout of the bar 5 bear flag.


第7根K线反转了两条空头趋势通道线，但做多并不赚钱，这会让交易者认为空头很强。因为通道很陡，这是楔形反转而不是楔形牛旗，所以更好的做法是等趋势线突破或价格上穿移动均线之后，再找更高的低点买入。


> Bar 7 reversed two bear trend channel lines, but was not a profitable long, leading traders to believe that the bears were strong. Because the channel was steep, this was a wedge reversal and not a wedge bull flag, so it was better to look to buy a higher low after a trend line break or a move above the moving average.


第8根K线是趋势线突破失败、双顶回调、低2做空建仓形态，以及从第7根K线起的一次五个最小报价单位的失败做多。这么多因素都偏向空头，市场快速下跌一点也不奇怪。


> Bar 8 was a failed trend line breakout, a double top pullback, a low 2 short setup, and a five-tick failure long from bar 7. With so many factors favoring the shorts, it was no surprise that the market fell quickly.


第9根K线是第二次尝试从空头趋势通道线过靶后反转向上，也是空头通道末端卖出高潮之后的反转上行。当空头通道向下破位又反转上行时，通常至少会带来一段两段式上涨行情，穿到通道顶部之上。


> Bar 9 was a second attempt to reverse up from the bear trend channel line overshoot and a reversal up after a sell climax at the end of a bear channel. When a bear channel breaks to the downside and reverses up, it usually leads to at least a two-legged rally that goes through the top of the channel.


第10根K线是个糟糕的做空，因为交易者正预期出现更高的低点和第二段上涨。它在第11根K线处变成了一个五个最小报价单位的失败，而这是一个反转形态。要说该怎么做，交易者本该在第10根K线下方买入，预期第二段上涨。


> Bar 10 was a bad short because traders were expecting a higher low and a second leg up. It turned into a five-tick failure at bar 11, which is a reversal pattern. If anything, traders should have bought below bar 10, expecting a second leg up.


第11根K线是双底牛旗，也是更高的低点，本应带来第二段上涨。


> Bar 11 was a double bottom bull flag and a higher low that should have led to a second leg up.


第12根K线是牛旗突破失败，但从第11根K线起的急速上冲足够强，所以交易者只应该在更低的高点处做空。


> Bar 12 was a failed bull flag breakout, but the spike up from bar 11 was strong enough so that traders should have looked to short only a lower high.


第13根K线是移动均线处的高2，也是对第10根K线上方突破的测试。


> Bar 13 was a high 2 at the moving average and a test of the breakout above bar 10.


第14根K线是扩张三角形顶部中的二次入场做空，也是这波空头反弹里的第三次上推，因此是楔形做空。它同时也是一次趋势通道线反转，以及与第5根K线构成的双顶熊旗。


> Bar 14 was a second-entry short in an expanding triangle top, as well as the third push up in this bear rally and therefore a wedge short. It was also a trend channel line reversal and a double top bear flag with bar 5.


第15根K线是移动均线处的低2、趋势线突破失败（突破的是第14根K线的高点），也是第11根K线到第13根K线那段趋势线突破之后的更低的高点。


> Bar 15 was a low 2 at the moving average, a failed trend line breakout (from the bar 14 high), and a lower high after the bar 11 to bar 13 trend line breakout.


第16根K线是移动均线处的又一次低2做空，以及双顶熊旗。


> Bar 16 was another low 2 short at the moving average and a double top bear flag.


# 第 14 章　Globex 电子盘、盘前、盘后与隔夜市场

*14. Globex, Premarket, Postmarket, and Overnight Market*


市场同样的价格行为技巧适用于所有市场，无论白天还是夜里的什么时间。老练的国际交易者太多了，许多市场一天 24 小时都在交易。盘前的高低点往往是日盘期间会被测试的目标，但做日盘交易时并不需要去看 Globex 电子盘的价格，因为这样做收获很小，而日盘的价格行为会给出足够的信号。许多交易者在做日内交易时整天都用 Globex 电子盘的图，这完全合理。我更偏爱日盘的图，因为延伸到两天或更久的趋势线和趋势通道线，在日盘图上非常可靠，对我的交易也很重要。


> Market The same price action techniques apply in all markets at any time of the day or night. There are so many sophisticated international traders that many markets are traded 24 hours a day. The premarket extremes are often targets that get tested during the day session, but it is not necessary to look at Globex prices when trading the day session since very little is gained and the day session price action will give adequate signals. Many traders use the Globex chart throughout the day when they are day trading, and that is perfectly reasonable. I prefer the day session chart, since trend lines and trend channel lines that extend over two or more days are very reliable on the day session charts, and important to my trading.


当一只股票在收盘后发布财报时，有些交易者会试着去交易这种行情，因为大幅波动看起来提供了极好的盈利潜力；但这种波动极难剥头皮，大多数交易者不该去尝试。这类波动常常快得来不及看清，也来不及把单子好好挂进去，用止损单入场时滑点很大，回调幅度也大，还会出现反转，而且往往就在你刚刚看明白市场在做什么的时候，它却突然不走了。


> When a stock has an earnings report after the close, some traders try to trade them because the big moves appear to offer great profit potential, but these moves are very difficult to scalp and most traders should not attempt it. The moves are frequently too fast to read and allow proper order placement, have big slippage on stop entries, have pullbacks that are large, and have reversals, and the market often suddenly stops moving as soon as you understand what it has been doing.


![图 14.1](figures/fig-14-01.jpg)


**图 14.1　收盘后交易**


如图 14.1 所示，戴尔（Dell）在收盘后发布了财报，看起来提供了一些盘后交易机会，但对大多数交易者来说，这种波动通常太难赚钱。第1根K线是向上突破之后的一根高1多头内包K线，它构成了一个做多建仓形态，入场点在其高点上方一美分处。


> As shown in Figure 14.1, Dell had an earnings report after the close and appeared to offer some postmarket trading opportunities, but the moves are usually too difficult to trade profitably for most traders. Bar 1 was a high 1 bull inside bar after the upside breakout and set up a long at one penny above its high.


第2根K线是一笔做多，入场点在那根外包K线高点上方 1 美分处；那根外包K线还跌破了多头微型趋势线，随后反转向上。


> Bar 2 was a long at 1 cent above the high of the outside bar, which also broke below a bull micro trend line and reversed up.
