If the market turned down after they scaled in, they could exit the entire position at the original target or at the original entry. If they exited at the original entry, they would make a profit on their late entries and would get out at breakeven on their first entry. Both the bull and the bear scalpers could therefore make a scalper's profit by entering at exactly the same time, but in opposite directions. The key is money management.


![图 16.1](figures/fig-16-01.jpg)


**图 16.1　极端剥头皮**


图 16.1 所示的 5 分钟 Emini 图演示了极端剥头皮。一天有 81 根K线，图上每三根标注一根。如果交易者想用两个点的止损剥头皮赚一个点，那么今天至少有 40 次机会这么做。记住，用止损单入场的交易者，通常需要市场越过信号K线六个最小报价单位，才能用一个止盈限价单剥头皮赚到四个最小报价单位。


> The 5 minute Emini chart shown in Figure 16.1 illustrates extreme scalping. There are 81 bars in a day, and every third one is numbered in the chart. If a trader wanted to scalp 1 point using a two-point stop, there were at least 40 opportunities to do so today. Remember, a trader entering on a stop usually needs a six-tick move beyond the signal bar to be able to scalp four ticks with a profit-taking limit order.


第1根K线是一根多头反转K线，也是一次可能发生的、跌破昨收处熊旗的突破失败。不过它顶部有两个最小报价单位的影线，而且它的高点只比昨收和移动平均线低四个最小报价单位，所以做多剥头皮的利润空间可能不够。在第1根K线上方买入的交易者看到了入场K线上的弱势收盘，许多人会在保本附近出场。


> Bar 1 was a bull reversal bar and a possible failed breakout below a bear flag from yesterday's close. However, it had a two-tick tail at the top and its high was only four ticks below yesterday's close and the moving average, so there might not have been enough room for a buy scalp. Traders who bought above bar 1 saw the weak close on the entry bar, and many would have exited around breakeven.


第2根K线是一根十字星，它没能收在第1根K线上方。这对多头是弱势信号，对空头是强势信号。这一段单根K线的上涨，本来可能发展成一次突破回调，之后可能再跟一段下跌。交易者本可以挂单，在第2根K线下方一个最小报价单位处做空。


> Bar 2 was a doji, and it could not close above bar 1. This was a sign of weakness for the bulls and a sign of strength for the bears. This one-bar rally could have developed into a breakout pullback, and it could have been followed by another leg down. A trader could have placed an order to go short at one tick below bar 2.


第3根K线没有触发那张做空单，但它是阴线收盘，而且没能涨到第2根K线上方。于是它与第2根K线在移动平均线正下方形成了一个双顶，可能带来一段下跌。交易者可以在该K线收盘时做空，并在它高点上方出场或反手做多，也可以在该低点下方一个最小报价单位处挂卖出止损单做空。这样做，同时也相当于在第2根K线那根做多入场K线下方一个最小报价单位处做空。那些多头里有许多人很可能正是在这个位置（入场K线下方）出场，给下跌添了一把力。如果触发，这会形成一次突破回调，可能带出一段下跌。交易者可以考虑剥头皮赚一两个点，也可以整笔持仓做波段（那样净赚六个最小报价单位），或者一部分剥头皮（或许是平一半）、一部分做波段，寄望波段那部分赚三到四个点。


> Bar 3 did not fill the short order, but it had a bear close and the bar failed to go above bar 2. It therefore formed a double top with bar 2, just below the moving average, and could have led to a leg down. A trader could have shorted the close of the bar and exited above its high or reversed to long there, or shorted on a sell stop at one tick below its low. This would also have been shorting at one tick below the bar 2 long entry bar. Many of those longs would likely have been exiting at this exact location (below the entry bar), adding to the down move. If triggered, this would have created a breakout pullback and likely led to a swing down. Traders could have considered scalping one or two points, swinging the entire position (they would have netted six ticks), or scalping part (maybe half) and swinging part, hoping for three or four points on their swing portion.


第4根K线这根入场K线是一根强空头趋势K线，至少很可能创出当天的新低。市场曾试图向上突破第1根K线，但失败了，现在正试图向下突破它的低点。由于市场处在移动平均线下方，而且是从昨天的熊旗向下跳空出来的，空头很强，可能走出一段漂亮的下跌、完成一次等距运动。第2根K线最终可能成为当天的高点，这一天可能变成一根强空头趋势日。有了这样的空头强势，交易者可以在第2根K线那根做多入场K线下方、空头收盘时加空，也可以在第4根K线低点下方用止损单做空，或者在第1根K线向下突破、创当天新低时做空。


> The bar 4 entry bar was a strong bear trend bar and likely to form a new low of the day at a minimum. The market tried to break out above bar 1 but failed and was now trying to break out below its low. Since the market was below the moving average and it gapped down out of a bear flag from yesterday, the bears were strong and could create a good swing down for a measured move. Bar 2 could have ended up as the high of the day, and the day could have become a strong bear trend day. With this bear strength, traders could have shorted more on the bear close below the bar 2 long entry bar, or on a stop below the low of bar 4, or on the breakout below bar 1 to a new low of the day.


第5根K线在跌破第1根K线时扩张成一根大空头趋势K线。这既可能是空头进一步增强的信号，也可能是高潮式抛售的信号。由于该K线刺穿了空头趋势通道线，如果市场从这里反转向上，至少可能有两段上涨。另外，因为那会是自昨天低点下方第二次尝试反转向上，而且也是一次楔形反转，它可能形成当天的低点。交易者可以在该K线收盘时做空，但如果这么做，他们必须准备好：一旦市场在这里停顿向下，就在保本附近出场，而且必须准备好反手做多。开盘有一个向下跳空，随后回调到移动平均线，现在又是一次卖出高潮。这可能是一个急速行情与高潮底部；而且，因为大约 90% 的日子里当天的高点或低点都在开盘头 90 分钟左右形成，交易者必须把每一个可能的早期反转都当作当天可能的极值来看。


> Bar 5 expanded into a large bear trend bar on the breakout below bar 1. This could have been either a sign of increased strength by the bears or of climactic selling. Since the bar poked below a bear trend channel line, if the market had reversed up from there it could have had at least two legs up. Also, since that would have been the second attempt to reverse up from below yesterday's low and it also would have been a wedge reversal, it could have formed the low of the day. Traders could have shorted the close of the bar, but if they did, they had to be prepared to exit around breakeven if the market paused down here, and they had to be prepared to reverse to long. There was a gap down on the open and then a pullback to the moving average and now a sell climax. This could have been a spike and climax bottom, and since the high or low of the day forms in the first 90 minutes or so in about 90 percent of days, traders had to look at every possible early reversal as a possible extreme of the day.


第6根K线的低点只比第5根K线的收盘价低五个最小报价单位，所以那些在第5根K线下方做空的空头，离能剥头皮赚到一个点只差一个最小报价单位。这个时候，他们很紧张。他们可能在这根K线上方出场，有些人甚至可能反手做多。由于这根K线是空头趋势K线，空头仍然占据主动，多数交易者会继续持空。第6根K线的低点也正好是从第1根K线的高点和低点向下算出的等距运动目标位，还是对两天前一段强上涨行情（图未显示）的一次完美突破回测。


> The low of bar 6 was only five ticks below the close of bar 5, so those bears who shorted below bar 5 came up one tick short of being able to scalp out one point. At this juncture, they were nervous. They might have exited above this bar, and some might even have reversed to long. Since the bar was a bear trend bar, the bears were still in control, and most traders would have held short. The bar 6 low was also an exact measured move down from the high and low of bar 1, and a perfect breakout test of a strong move up from two days ago (not shown).


第7根K线是一次多头两根K线反转。这对空头是个麻烦。多数人本来会试图在保本处出场，但也愿意接受一两个最小报价单位的亏损。有些交易者本会在多头收盘时买入，赌一个可能的当日低点和一段很可能的两段式上涨行情。另一些交易者会在更低时间级别的图上、以及在成交量图或最小报价单位图等其他类型图的反转处入场做多。由于第6根K线的区间大约有一半同时被它前一根和后一根K线重叠，一个小型交易区间正在形成。逆势交易通常伴随回调，所以如果交易者在第7根K线上方买入，他们需要在预期的回调期间拿住多单，并寄望它形成一个更高的低点。


> Bar 7 was a bull two-bar reversal. This was a problem for the bears. Most would have tried to exit at breakeven, but would have been willing to take a one-or two-tick loss. Some traders would have bought the bull close for a possible low of the day and a likely two-legs-up rally. Other traders would have entered long on lower time frame charts and on reversals on other types of charts, like volume or tick charts. Since about half of the range of bar 6 was overlapped by both the bar before and the bar after, a small trading range was forming. Countertrend trades usually have pullbacks, so if traders bought above bar 7, they needed to hold their longs during the expected pullback and hope that it formed a higher low.


第8根K线收在它的最高点上，于是多头在K线收盘时买入，说明他们急于做多。不过，跌到第6根K线的那波抛售很强，所以第一次反转上攻很可能失败，之后多半还会有一次打压市场的尝试。另一个选择是买这根强势收盘。如果交易者相信第二段上涨很可能出现，并且预期一路上会有回调，他们可以在接下来几根K线中任何一根的低点处、或低一两个最小报价单位处找机会买入，预期一个失败的低1，以及一个更高的低点。


> Bar 8 closed on its high, so the bulls bought into the close of the bar, indicating that they were eager to get long. However, the selling down to bar 6 was strong, so the first attempt to reverse up was likely to fail and probably to be followed by an attempt to drive the market down. An alternative was to buy this strong close. If traders believed that a second leg up was likely and they were expecting pullbacks along the way, they could have looked to buy at or one or two ticks below the low of any of the next few bars, expecting a failed low 1 and a higher low.


第9根K线是一根空头反转K线，它没能收在第8根K线那根强多头K线的高点上方。没有后续买盘。也许多头很弱，第8根K线的反转上攻会失败，变成对跌破第1根K线那次突破的突破回调，因而也就是一个低1做空形态。由于市场正在从楔形底部展开修正，第二段上涨很可能出现，所以与其在第9根K线下方一个最小报价单位处做空，已经做多的人会继续持有，止损放在第5根K线那根信号K线下方。因为那根K线只比当天低点高一个最小报价单位，他们很可能会把止损放低一个最小报价单位，就放在当天低点正下方。还没买入的多头会等一个更高的低点出现再买，如果它出现的话。激进的多头会在第9根K线的低点处挂限价单买入，他们想的是：市场很可能得跌到它低点下方一个最小报价单位，那些做多限价单才能成交；如果市场从那里反转向上，空头就会因为一次一个 tick 的失败而被套在场内，他们会非常急于出场，帮着把市场推上去。其他多头会把做多限价单挂在第9根K线低点下方一个、两个或三个最小报价单位处。所有这些单子都会给市场提供支撑。如果市场跌到第9根K线下方一个最小报价单位，然后在接下来几秒钟里反弹两三个最小报价单位，那些在低一两个最小报价单位处挂着买入限价单的多头，有些人就会把自己的做多限价单上移一两个最小报价单位，因为他们看到市场没能跌下去，就变得更急于进场。第9根K线是一个糟糕的低1做空建仓形态，因此更可能出现一个更高的低点。市场有一段强劲的空头急速行情，这是低1所需要的；但它并不明确处在空头趋势里，而在做空低1之前，空头趋势同样是必需的。另外，交易者不应在一次卖出高潮之后做空低1，而这里可能就是这样一次卖出高潮。


> Bar 9 was a bear reversal bar, and it was unable to close above the high of bar 8, which was a strong bull bar. There was no follow-through buying. Maybe the bulls were weak and the bar 8 reversal up would fail and become a breakout pullback on the breakout below bar 1 and therefore a low 1 short. Since the market was correcting from a wedge bottom, a second leg up was likely, so rather than shorting at one tick below bar 9, those already long would have held with stops below the bar 5 signal bar. Because it was only one tick above the low of the day, they would probably have put their stops one tick lower at just below the low of the day. Some bulls who hadn't yet bought would have waited to buy a higher low, if one formed. Aggressive bulls would have bought on limit orders at the low of bar 9, thinking that the market would probably have to dip one tick below its low for those long limit orders to get filled, and if the market reversed up from there, the bears would be trapped short on a one-tick failure and they would be very eager to get out and help drive the market up. Other bulls would have placed limit orders to go long at one, two, or three ticks below the low of bar 9. All of these orders would have given support to the market. If the market dipped one tick below bar 9 and then bounced up two or three ticks within the next few seconds, some bulls who had limit orders to buy at one or two ticks lower would have moved their long limit orders up by a tick or two because they would have become more eager to get in when they saw the market failing to sell off. Bar 9 was a bad low 1 short setup, and therefore a higher low was likely. The market had a strong bear spike, which is needed for a low 1, but it was not clearly in a bear trend, which is also needed before shorting a low 1. Also, a trader should not short a low 1 after a sell climax, and this was possibly one.


空头把第10根K线看作空头趋势里的一个双顶，希望它能带来类似第2、第3根K线双顶之后那样的走势。不过，他们担心那个楔形底部，所以如果市场不像当天早些时候那样快速下跌，他们就会很快平掉任何新开的空单。


> The bears saw bar 10 as a double top in a bear trend and hoped that it would have resulted in a move similar to the move that followed the bars 2 and 3 double top. However, they were concerned about that wedge bottom and would have exited any new shorts quickly if the market did not fall sharply, as it did earlier in the day.


第11根K线跌到第9根K线下方两个最小报价单位，然后急剧反弹上去。那些试图在第9根K线低点及其下方一个最小报价单位处买入的多头，很高兴自己做多了；而那些想在低两个或三个最小报价单位处买入的人，则担心自己错过了机会。他们把限价单改成市价单，这让第11根K线快速上冲。同时，那些在第9根K线下方做空的空头，担心这个低1会失败、楔形还会走出第二段上涨，于是他们现在要么市价平仓，要么在 1 分钟、2 分钟或 3 分钟K线的高点上方、或者在成交量图或最小报价单位图上的K线上方买回。第11根K线收在过去六根K线收盘价的上方（一个强势信号），它实质上是一根外包上涨K线，处在一段可能的新多头趋势的起点。有些多头会买这根强势收盘，毕竟它前面有第7、8根K线的强势，趋势可能已经反转向上。它没能形成比前一根K线更高的高点，但因为它低点低于前一根K线、高点就在前一根K线的高点上，已经足够接近，市场会把它当作外包K线来反应。到这个时候，它与前两根K线构成了三重顶；如果市场没能反转向下、反而高出一个最小报价单位，这个形态就会变成一个失败顶部，很可能带来更多买盘。第11根K线还跌破了第6、7根K线连成的趋势线，以及第9、10根K线连成的趋势通道线，这就形成了一个小的决斗线做多建仓形态。第9、10、11根K线构成一个小扩张三角形，它本该起牛旗的作用，而不是反转形态，因为第二段上涨很可能出现。


> Bar 11 fell two ticks below bar 9 and then rallied up sharply. The bulls who tried to buy at the low of bar 9 and at one tick below it were happy to be long, and those who wanted to buy at two or three ticks below bar 9 were afraid that they had missed their chance. They were changing their limit orders to market orders, which caused bar 11 to move up quickly. Also, those bears who shorted below bar 9 were afraid that the low 1 would fail and that the wedge would have a second leg up, so they were now covering at the market or above the highs of 1, 2, or 3 minute bars, or above bars on volume or tick charts. Bar 11 closed above the closes of the past six bars (a sign of strength), and it was essentially an outside up bar at the start of a possible new bull trend. Some bulls would have bought this strong close, given that it followed strength in bars 7 and 8 and the trend might have reversed up. It failed to have a high above the high of the prior bar, but with a low below the prior bar and a high at the high of that bar, it was close enough for the market to react to it as if it was an outside bar. At this point, it was a triple top with the two prior bars, and if the market failed to reverse down and instead went one tick higher, the pattern would have become a failed top and would likely be followed by more buying. Bar 11 also broke below the trend line from bars 6 and 7 and below the trend channel line from bars 9 and 10, and this created a small dueling lines long setup. Bars 9, 10, and 11 formed a small expanding triangle that should have acted as a bull flag instead of a reversal pattern because a second leg up was likely.


第12根K线向上突破了那个三重顶，也突破了第11根K线那根外包上涨K线的高点。虽然它是一根小K线，但它涨到了三重顶上方两个最小报价单位。如果它只突破一个最小报价单位就反转向下，交易者会把它看作一个可能的牛市陷阱，并会考虑平掉多单。空头也会把它当作一段两段式的空头反弹来做空。有些空头会挂单在这根K线下方一个最小报价单位处做空，以防它变成一个低2做空形态。不过，由于它的高点离移动平均线这么近，他们要等市场先摸到移动平均线，才会对自己的空单更有信心。许多人要等移动平均线被触及之后才会考虑做空，因为在那之前，他们会担心市场可能一路横盘，直到它被测试。当市场进入某个磁力位的一个最小报价单位左右范围时，除非市场再多走那一个最小报价单位、真正摸到磁力位，交易者不会对这次测试有信心。在它发生之前，他们通常不会积极地把这当成一次完成的回调来交易。有些多头会在这根K线上方加多，认为这是空头夺取主动的机会落了空，这让市场更可能上涨。第12根K线的高点比第3根K线的低点低两个最小报价单位，与那些空单的保本止损只差一个最小报价单位。如果市场在这里下跌，这就形成了一次完美的突破回测（完美，是因为它尽可能贴近地测试了那些止损，却没真正打到）。如果市场反而高出一个最小报价单位，这次突破回测就会失败；那些还没走的空头会平仓，他们的买盘会把市场推上去。多头知道这一点，会正好在那个价位挂买入止损单加多，从空头回补里获利。


> Bar 12 broke out above the triple top and above the high of the bar 11 outside up bar. Even though it was a small bar, it reached two ticks above the triple top. If it reversed down after just a one-tick breakout, traders would have viewed that as a possible bull trap and they would have looked to exit longs. Bears would also have shorted it as a two-legged bear rally. Some bears would have placed orders to go short at one tick below this bar, in case it became a low 2 short. However, with its high so close to the moving average, they would have felt more confident about their shorts if the market first touched the moving average. Many would not have looked to short until after the moving average was touched, because until it was touched, they would have worried that the market might just go sideways until it was tested. When the market gets within a tick or so of a magnet, traders do not feel confident about the test unless the market gets that extra tick and actually touches the magnet. Until that happens, they usually will not aggressively trade it as a completed pullback. Some bulls would have added to longs above this bar, thinking that it was a failed chance for the bears to take control, which made the market more likely to go up. The high of bar 12 was two ticks below the low of bar 3 and missed the breakeven stops on those shorts by one tick. If the market sold off here, this would have created a perfect breakout test (perfect because it tested those stops as closely as it could without actually hitting them). If instead the market went one tick higher, this breakout test would have failed; those remaining shorts would have covered, and their buying would have propelled the market upward. Longs knew this and would have placed buy stops to add to their longs at exactly that price to profit from that short covering.


第13根K线是一根强多头突破K线，市场向上突破并大幅收在移动平均线、空头趋势线以及第5根K线那根强空头趋势K线的高点之上。熊旗失败了，向上突破，交易者会去找大约一段等距运动的上行空间。如果那是一个成功的熊旗，他们本会预期市场去测试当天的低点。一旦它失败，他们就会预期市场上行大约同样的点数。多头会买这根收盘，赌一次对当天高点的测试。当天的波幅此前只有五个点，大约是近期日均波幅的一半，所以市场可能向上或向下走出一段等距运动。到这个时候，由于空头刚刚回补，他们在市场至少再上攻两次之前不太可能做空，而这会让多头在接下来几根K线里占据主动。如果要走等距运动，此时向上的可能性大于向下。


> Bar 13 was a strong bull breakout bar, with the market breaking and closing well above the moving average, the bear trend line, and the high of the strong bar 5 bear trend bar. The bear flag failed and broke to the upside, and traders would have looked for about a measured move up. If it was a successful bear flag, they would have expected a test of the low of the day. Once it failed, they would have looked for it to go up for about the same number of points. Bulls would have bought this close for a test of the high of the day. The day's range had been only five points, which was about half of the recent average daily range, so the market could have formed a measured move up or down. At this point, since the bears had just covered, they would have been unlikely to go short until at least two more attempts up and that would have left the bulls in control for the next few bars. If there was to be a measured move, up was more likely than down at this point.


第14根K线是一根空头反转K线，它可能形成一个更低的高点、一次突破失败，以及一个低2做空形态。不过，出于刚刚说过的理由，市场在第13根K线突破之后更可能至少上攻两次，所以这个做空形态如果触发，更可能失败，而这次失败会制造一个突破回调做多形态。因此多头会试图在它低点以下的任何下跌中买入。如果只会跌到它低点下方一个最小报价单位，形成一个一个 tick 的空头陷阱，激进的多头会想买入那一跌。为了做到这一点，他们会把做多限价单挂在第14根K线的低点处。这是因为在第14根K线下方做空的空头很可能不够多，填不满激进多头挂出的那些做多限价单。既然多头占据主动，想买的人大概会比想卖的人多。或者，多头也可以在这根K线下方挂一张触及即成交的市价买入单，或者市场一跌到第14根K线下方就立刻市价买入。其他多头会把做多限价单挂在下方两个和三个最小报价单位处。


> Bar 14 was a bear reversal bar that could have formed a lower high, a failed breakout, and a low 2 short. However, for the reasons just stated, it was more likely that the market would have at least two attempts up after the bar 13 breakout, so if this short triggered, it would be more likely to fail, and the failure would create a breakout pullback long. The bulls would therefore have been trying to buy any move below its low. If there was going to be just a one-tick move below its low, forming a one-tick bear trap, aggressive bulls would have wanted to buy that move. To do so, they would have put their limit orders to go long at the low of bar 14. This is because there probably would not be enough bears shorting below bar 14 to fill all of those long limit orders placed by aggressive bulls. Since the bulls were in control, there would probably have been more traders looking to buy than looking to sell. Alternatively, the bulls could have placed a market if touched buy order below the bar or simply bought at the market as soon as the market dipped below bar 14. Other bulls would have placed limit orders to go long at two and three ticks below.


还有人想买两个点和三个点的回调，会把做多限价单挂第14根K线高点下方七个最小报价单位和 11 个最小报价单位处。如果市场正好回调两个点，那些想在这段回调末端买入的交易者，多数只能在下探七个最小报价单位处做多，而拿不到最低的那个价位，因为那个最低的最小报价单位上想买的手数很可能远多于想卖的手数，那些多头只好改在更高一个最小报价单位处买入。


> Others would have wanted to buy two-and three-point pullbacks and would have placed limit orders to go long at seven ticks and 11 ticks below the bar 14 high. If the market pulled back exactly two points, most traders trying to buy the end of that pullback would have only been able to get long at seven ticks down and not at the exact low, because there would likely have been far more contracts being bid than being offered at the low tick, and those bulls would instead have had to buy one tick higher.


最后，有些多头会把每一个空头建仓形态都看成多头建仓形态，会假定有一批被套的、急切想进场的空头在空头收盘时做了空。那些空头总得在某个时点买回自己的空单，其中许多人会把买入止损单放在这根空头反转K线上方一个最小报价单位处。聪明的多头知道这一点，总是设法正好在被套空头买回空单的价位做多。因此这些多头会把买入止损单放在第14根K线上方一个最小报价单位处。


> Finally, some bulls would have seen every bear setup as a bull setup and would have assumed that there would have been trapped eager bears who shorted into the bear close. Those bears would have had to buy back their shorts at some point, and many would have had their buy stops at one tick above this bear reversal bar. Smart bulls knew this and were always trying to go long exactly at the price where trapped bears would have been buying back their shorts. These longs would therefore have placed buy stops at one tick above bar 14.


第15根K线吃掉了第14根K线那根空头反转K线的高点，但收盘时回落。有可能第14、15根K线这个双底当不成牛旗，反而带来一波抛售，就像第2、3根K线双底当时发生的那样。另外，这根K线的高点与开盘的高点形成了一个双顶，所以这一天可能变成双顶熊旗，并可能走出跌破当天低点的等距运动。第13、14、15根K线的高点构成一个微型楔形。如果它被触发——也就是市场跌破第15根K线的低点——可能走出一段两段式的横盘到下跌修正。如果市场反而向上突破，这段上涨会是一次创当天新高的突破、也是一次越过微型楔形的突破，平掉空单的空头会更多，新入场的多头会剥头皮做这笔突破。


> Bar 15 took out the high of the bar 14 bear reversal bar, but pulled back on the close. It was possible that the bars 14 and 15 double bottom could fail to be a bull flag and lead to a sell-off, just like what happened with the bars 2 and 3 double bottom. Also, the high of the bar formed a double top with the high of the open, so the day could have turned into a double top bear flag and could have a measured move below the low of the day. The highs of bars 13, 14, and 15 created a micro wedge. If it triggered, by the market moving below the bar 15 low, there could have been a two-legged sideways to down correction. If the market instead broke to the upside, the move up would have been a breakout to a new high of the day and above a micro wedge, and there would have been more bears covering their shorts and new bulls scalping the breakout.


第16根K线是一根大区间突破K线，它突破了一条趋势通道线。它可能是一次买入高潮，之后可能至少跟着一段两段式的横盘到下跌修正，持续一个小时或更久。每当多头趋势走了一段时间之后出现一根大多头趋势K线，概率都偏向它代表衰竭：最后一批弱多头在买，最后一批弱空头在平，而强多头和强空头则在等这样一根大多头趋势K线收盘来卖出（多头卖出自己的多单止盈，空头开新空单）。剩下的空头只会在回调时出场，而强多头只会在回调之后再次买入。这会与第5根K线所代表的那次卖出高潮类似。第16根K线的高点只比昨天的高点低五个最小报价单位，而昨天的高点一直是一个阻力区，所以那些想在这根K线高点上方买入剥头皮的人会担心：他们要想赚到那一个点，市场必须先越过那个阻力。有些多头会买这根K线的收盘，因为只要市场正好测试昨天的高点，他们就能带着一个点的利润出场。正好测试的可能性大于向上突破昨天高点，但形成一个更低的高点的可能性更大，尤其是在一次趋势通道线过靶之后。有些新多头在任何犹疑或回调时会很快平掉多单，因为他们在阻力区买入一个可能的买入高潮时，连一个最小报价单位都不想亏。另一些人会用更宽的止损，并在市场逆行时加仓。这些交易者最终会成功。激进的空头会在第16根K线收盘时做空、或在其高点处及上方做空，并在更高处分批建仓，冒的风险大约是第16根K线里所含最小报价单位的数量。


> Bar 16 was a big range breakout bar that broke a trend channel line. It could have been a buy climax and it could have been followed by at least a two-legged sideways to down correction that could have lasted an hour or more. Whenever there is a large bull trend bar after a bull trend has gone on for a while, the odds favor it representing exhaustion, with the last weak bulls buying, the last weak shorts covering, and the strong bulls and bears waiting for the close of a large bull trend bar like this to sell (the bulls selling their longs to take profits, and the bears initiating new shorts). The remaining shorts would have exited only on a pullback, and the strong bulls would have bought again only after a pullback. This would be similar to the sell climax that bar 5 represented. The high of bar 16 was just five ticks below yesterday's high, which is always a resistance area, and therefore traders looking to buy above the high of this bar for a scalp would have been concerned that the market would have to go above that resistance for them to make their one-point profit. Some bulls would have bought the close of this bar because they could have exited with a one-point profit on an exact test of yesterday's high. An exact test was more likely than a breakout above the high, but a lower high was even more likely, especially after a trend channel line overshoot. Some new bulls would have been quick to exit their longs on any hesitation or pullback because they wouldn't want to lose even one tick when they bought a possible buy climax in an area of resistance. Others would have used a wider stop and added on as the market went against them. These traders would have ultimately been successful. Aggressive bears would have shorted the close of bar 16, or at or above its high, and would have scaled in higher, risking about as many ticks as there were in bar 16.


由于它有两个点那么高，他们可能冒两个点的风险去赚一个点，并会试图在第16根K线收盘价或高点上方一个点处卖更多。他们没能在更高处分批建仓，但在第26根K线那根强空头趋势K线上剥头皮赚到了一个点。他们的止盈行为助长了第26根K线之后的反转向上。记住，所有交易者都把每个最小报价单位同时看成买入建仓形态和卖出建仓形态，并不断为两种可能的交易评估交易者等式。每天都有很多时候，多头和空头都能入场做一笔剥头皮、而且只要交易管理得当都能赚钱。第16根K线的收盘就是一个例子。


> Since it was two points tall, they might have risked two points to make one point, and they would have tried to sell more at one point above the close or high of bar 16. They were unable to scale in higher, but were able to scalp out with a one-point profit on the bar 26 strong bear trend bar. Their profit taking contributed to the reversal up after bar 26. Remember, all traders look at every tick as both a buy and a sell setup, and constantly assess the trader's equation for both possible trades. There are many times every day where both bulls and bears can enter for a scalp and both make money, if they manage their trades correctly. The close of bar 16 is an example.


第17根K线在涨到第16根K线上方三个最小报价单位之后反转向下。那些迟到的多头很快出场，激进的空头开始做空。第17根K线成了一根强空头反转K线，空头会考虑在它收盘时以及它低点下方一个最小报价单位处做空。其他空头已经在更小时间级别的图上做空了。这是一个多头不会买入的空头建仓形态。一旦市场跌破第17根K线的低点，多头就把它看作对多头趋势通道线上方那次突破的突破失败，他们和空头都预期会有一段持续一个小时或更久的两段式修正。在修正完成之前，多头不会急于买入。既然交易者在等一段两段式修正，空头就会开始挂限价单、准备在更低的高点做空。涨到第17根K线的这段上涨是一段强多头急速行情，所以多头期待随后走出一个多头通道，以及一段等距运动的上行目标，点数大约等于从第6根K线或第11根K线的低点到第17根K线高点那段急速行情的点数。


> Bar 17 reversed down after moving three ticks above bar 16. Those late bulls were quick to exit, and aggressive bears were beginning to short. Bar 17 became a strong bear reversal bar, and bears would have looked to short at its close and at one tick below its low. Other bears would have already shorted on smaller time frame charts. This was one bear setup that the bulls wouldn't buy. Once the market fell below the bar 17 low, the bulls saw that as a failed breakout above the bull trend channel line, and they and the bears expected a two-legged correction that would last an hour or more. Bulls would not have looked to buy aggressively until the correction was complete. Since traders were looking for a two-legged correction, bears would have started placing limit orders to short a lower high. The move up to bar 17 was a strong bull spike, so bulls were hoping for a bull channel and a measured move up that would have about as many points as the spike from the low of bar 6 or bar 11 to the bar 17 high.


第18根K线没有触发做空，反而成了一根多头内包K线。既然交易者预期一段两段式修正，聪明的多头不会想在它高点上方买入，而激进的空头会把做空限价单挂在它的高点以及高一个、两个最小报价单位处，止损放在第17根K线那根空头反转K线的高点上方。


> Bar 18 did not trigger a short and became a bull inside bar. Since traders were expecting a two-legged correction, smart bulls wouldn't have been looking to buy above its high, and aggressive bears would have had limit orders to go short at its high and one and two ticks higher with a stop above the bar 17 bear reversal bar high.


第19根K线没有在第18根K线高点处填掉那些做空限价单，也没有触发第17、18根K线低点下方的卖出止损单。取而代之的是，现在出现了一个 ii 形态。不过，多头仍然不会买，空头则越来越急于做空。


> Bar 19 did not fill those short limit orders at the bar 18 high, and it also did not trigger the sell stops below the bars 17 and 18 low. Instead, there was now an ii pattern. Bulls, however, still wouldn't buy, and bears were getting eager to short.


第20根K线现在成了一个 iii 形态，而且是阴线收盘，这对空头有利。聪明资金仍在等着在第17根K线下方（它位于这个 iii 形态下方）做空，以及在更低的高点做空。


> Bar 20 was now an iii setup and it had a bear close, which favored the bears. Smart money was still looking to short below bar 17 (which was below the iii), and on a lower high.


第21根K线可能就是大家都在等的那个牛市陷阱。它是第二段上涨（第18根K线是第一段），并向上延伸到了第18根K线上方一个最小报价单位。第18根K线上方一个最小报价单位的位置，那里很可能也有其他看错的多头入场做了多。市场里没有被套的空头，因为最保守的空头会在第17根K线下方用止损单入场，而那还没有发生。现在市场里唯一的空头，是那些又聪明又激进、正在等一个更低的高点牛市陷阱的空头。他们希望市场里有被套的多头，因为市场一旦下跌，这些多头就得卖出手里的多单，而这会给下跌添力。另外，在出现被套多头之后，多头就会想等更多价格行为出现再考虑买入。聪明的多头已经在等一段两段式修正，所以这里没有认真的买盘。弱多头误买了那个 iii 形态。聪明的空头在 iii 形态上方 1 个、2 个和 3 个最小报价单位处做空，保护性止损放在第17根K线的高点上方。空头会考虑在这根K线下方做空，尤其是在第17根K线下方，因为那是一根强空头反转K线。多数空头会等第17根K线被跌破后再做空，因为他们会把那看作对顶部的确认。不过，聪明空头只想剥头皮，因为这段上涨一直很强，而当天的波幅仍小于平均。到这个时候，如果波幅要扩张，向上的可能性远大于向下。另外，人人都相信这次买入高潮多半只是一次停顿，之后至少还会有一段上涨。这段横盘到下跌的修正有可能制造出一个最终旗形，随后走出一段下跌，但那只会在向上突破之后发生。


> Bar 21 might have been the bull trap that everyone was expecting. It was the second leg up (bar 18 was the first) and it extended one tick above bar 18, where other mistaken bulls also likely went long. There were not any trapped bears, because the most conservative bears would have entered on a stop below bar 17 and that had not yet happened. The only bears in the market now were the smart, aggressive ones who were hoping for a lower high bull trap. They wanted trapped bulls in the market because if the market went down, these bulls would have to sell out of their longs, and this would add to the selling. Also, after there were trapped bulls, bulls would have wanted to wait for more price action before looking to buy again. Smart bulls were already waiting for a two-legged correction, so there was no serious buying here. Weak bulls mistakenly bought the iii pattern. Smart bears were shorting at 1, 2, and 3 ticks above the iii pattern with a protective stop above the high of bar 17. Bears would have looked to short below this bar and especially below bar 17, which was a strong bear reversal bar. Most bears would have waited to short below bar 17 because they would see that as a confirmation of the top. However, smart bears were only looking for a scalp since the move up had been strong, and the day's range was still smaller than average. At this point, if the range was to expand, up was much more likely than down. Also, everyone believed that the buy climax was most likely a pause that would be followed by at least one more leg up. This sideways to down correction had the potential to create a final flag and then a swing down, but that would happen only after an upside breakout.


第22根K线把第21根K线变成了一个更低的高点最终旗形做空形态（那个 iii 下降三角形就是最终旗形），但这根K线没能延伸到 iii 形态下方，也就没能引来更多想在该旗形下方、以及第17根K线下方用止损单入场的空头。另外，这根K线收在中部，意味着交易者在尾盘买入，这与空头掌控市场时应该出现的情形正好相反。


> Bar 22 turned bar 21 into a lower high final flag short (the iii descending triangle was the final flag), but the bar was not able to extend below the iii pattern and bring in additional shorts who were looking to enter on a stop below the flag and below bar 17. Also, the bar closed in its middle, which means that traders bought into the close of the bar, which was the opposite of what should have happened if the bears were in control.


到第25根K线，这段横盘修正还在继续，市场正在形成一个窄幅交易区间，而这是一个突破建仓形态。空头本希望市场在第17根K线形成之后一两根K线内就跌破它，那会说明有抛售的紧迫感。但市场是在横盘修正，而不是向下，这是多头强势的信号。同时，市场现在只比移动平均线高两个最小报价单位，既然市场可能在那里找到支撑、而且这次修正已经持续 10 根K线，多头会开始考虑重建多单。这对空头是个麻烦。他们原本期待的是一笔高成功率的空头剥头皮，现在成功率已经变小。一旦空头突破停滞，他们会很快回补。第25根K线触及了第17、21根K线连成的空头趋势线，形成一个下降三角形——在多头趋势里出现，它就是牛旗。不过，如果你用K线的实体来看，第21到25根K线也处在一个小通道里。通道常常有三次推进，然后试图反转，就像楔形一样。第22、24根K线是两次向下推进，所以也许只剩一次向下推进，因而这个三角形向下的突破可能会失败。


> The sideways correction was continuing at bar 25 and the market was forming a tight trading range, which is a breakout setup. The bears would have preferred that the market fell below bar 17 within a bar or two of its formation, which would have indicated that there was an urgency to sell. The market was correcting sideways instead of down, and this is a sign of bull strength. Also, the market was now only two ticks above the moving average, and since the market might have found support there and because the correction was 10 bars long, bulls would have begun to look to reestablish their longs. This was a problem for the bears. They were originally expecting a high percentage bear scalp and now the chance of success had become less. They would have been quick to cover if a bear breakout stalled. Bar 25 touched the bar 17 and 21 bear trend line and created a descending triangle, which is a bull flag when it occurs in a bull trend. However, bars 21 through 25 were also in a small channel if you use the bodies of the bars. A channel often has three pushes and then tries to reverse, just like a wedge. Bars 22 and 24 were two pushes down, so there might have been only one more push down and therefore a downside breakout of the triangle might fail.


第26根K线是一次空头突破，收在当天最低点，并在移动平均线下方。新入场的空头希望市场在低两三个最小报价单位处就填掉他们的止盈限价单。可是，这根空头趋势K线只收在移动平均线下方一个最小报价单位处，而一次强突破本应收在下方好几个最小报价单位处，就像第13根K线那根多头突破K线收在移动平均线之上好几个最小报价单位处那样。它还正好测试了对开盘高点上方那次突破的回抽。就连那些在第21根K线那根多头趋势K线收盘时做空的激进空头，也还没能剥头皮赚到一个点；如果市场在这里反转向上，他们就会遭遇五个 tick 的失败，只好买回自己的空单。那些在第16根K线收盘时或高点上方做空的空头，在这里买回了空单。多头把第26根K线看作空头试图把市场翻成始终做空的一次尝试，但他们知道多数反转尝试都会失败。他们相信，空头需要下一根K线是一根强空头趋势K线，才能让交易者相信市场已经翻转了始终入场方向。由于多头趋势那么强，他们怀疑空头会失败，甚至没信心空头能把市场压到第26根K线那根空头趋势K线的低点下方。正因为如此，他们在该空头趋势K线收盘时买入，并会在它低点下方买更多。其他多头会把做多限价单挂在第17根K线高点下方七个最小报价单位处，因为他们想在多头趋势里买两个点和三个点的回调。


> Bar 26 was a bear breakout that closed on its low and below the moving average. The new bears were hoping that the market would fill their profit-taking limit orders just a couple of ticks lower. However, the bear trend bar closed only one tick below the moving average, and a strong breakout would have closed several ticks below, just as the bar 13 bull breakout closed several ticks above the moving average. It was also an exact test of the breakout above the high of the open. Even the aggressive bears who shorted the close of the bar 21 bull trend bar had not yet been able to scalp out one point; and if the market reversed up here, they would have had a five-tick failure and would have bought back their shorts. The bears who shorted the close of bar 16 or above its high bought back their shorts here. The bulls saw bar 26 as an attempt by the bears to flip the market to always-in short, but they knew that most reversal attempts fail. They believed that the bears needed the next bar to be a strong bear trend bar to convince traders that the market had reversed its always-in position. Since the bull trend was so strong, they doubted that the bears would succeed, and were not even confident that the bears would be able to push the market below the low of the bar 26 bear trend bar. Because of this, they bought on the close of the bear trend bar, and they would have bought more below its low. Other bulls would have had limit orders to buy seven ticks below the bar 17 high because they were trying to buy two-and three-point pullbacks in a bull trend.


第27根K线是一根多头内包K线，可能在移动平均线处构筑一个高2做多形态。那会是一段持续约 10 根K线的两段式修正，对多头来说大约够长了。多头想要在急涨到第17根K线高点之后走出一个上行的通道，而这次回调到移动平均线可能就是这个通道的开端。它也本会是对第2根K线高点的一次突破回测。它还可能被看作一次突破回调，空头会在它低点下方做空，而那个低点同时也是第26根K线那根空头突破K线的低点。空头想要一根阴线实体，以提高始终入场方向翻转为做空的机会。交易者一看到多头收盘，就认定空头失败了、始终入场方向仍然向上，于是在收盘时以及该K线上方买入。


> Bar 27 was a bull inside bar and could have been setting up a high 2 long at the moving average. It would have been a two-legged correction that lasted about 10 bars, which was about long enough for the bulls. The bulls wanted a channel up after the spike up to the bar 17 high, and this pullback to the moving average could have been the beginning. It would also have been a breakout test of the bar 2 high. It could also have been seen as a breakout pullback and bears would have shorted below its low, which would also have been the low of the bar 26 bear breakout bar. The bears wanted a bear body to increase the chances of the always-in direction flipping to short. Once traders saw the bull close, they assumed that the bears failed and that the always-in direction remained up, and they bought the close and above the bar.


第28根K线是第二根多头内包K线，构成了一个 ii 形态。到这个时候，交易者在琢磨：是交易区间还在延续，还是突破在更多卖盘到来之前停顿，又或者突破已经失败、多头将要重新掌控市场。


> Bar 28 was a second bull inside bar and formed an ii pattern. At this point, traders were wondering if the trading range was continuing, if the breakout was pausing before more selling came in, or if the breakout had failed and the bulls would take control again.


第29根K线是对 ii 形态的多头突破，也是一次对移动平均线、以及对开盘区间那次突破的成功回测。不过，它只是一个最小报价单位的突破、还是一根小空头趋势K线，很容易构成一笔做空——作为对第26根K线那次空头突破的回调。空头会挂单在它低点下方做空。然而，过去一个小时里一直在做空的那些空头，现在都担心：市场本来有机会给他们一笔剥头皮的利润，却没能给。他们不会再长时间拿着空单。他们会把买入止损单放在第26根K线那根空头趋势K线的高点上方、第23、24、25根K线三重顶上方、第21根K线更低的高点上方、第17根K线多头高潮高点上方、以及昨天的高点上方。由于这些止损全都彼此相差一两个最小报价单位，它们可能在一次扫止损的连锁中被迅速打掉，结果是空头认输、多头接管市场。


> Bar 29 was a bull breakout of the ii pattern and a successful test of the moving average and of the breakout of the opening range. However, it was only a one-tick breakout and a small bear trend bar, and it could easily have set up a short as a pullback from the bar 26 bear breakout. Bears would have placed orders to short below its low. However, all of the bears who had been shorting for the past hour were now concerned that the market had an opportunity to give them a scalper's profit and it failed. They would not have held on to their shorts much longer. They would have had buy stops above the bar 26 bear trend bar high; the bars 23, 24, 25 triple top; the bar 21 lower high; the bar 17 bull climax high; and yesterday's high. Since all of these stops were within a tick or two of each other, the stops could have been quickly hit in a cascade of stop running, resulting in the bears giving up and the bulls taking control of the market.


第30根K线吃掉了第29根K线的高点，还向上突破空头趋势线一个最小报价单位，但没能突破第26根K线那根做空入场K线。这是两段上涨，空头本会容许它作为空头突破之后一次可接受的回调，但他们会担心自己的空单表现不佳。他们会很快买回空单。多头知道这次修正已有两段、并且已经持续约 10 根K线，所以他们的最低标准已经满足，正准备积极买入，期待一段向上的等距运动、涨到 1,127.50 一带。这个距离够远，他们可以把新仓位的一部分或全部拿来做波段。他们会把每一个空头止损都看作买入建仓形态，会正好在空头回补的相同价位买入。随着市场上涨、多头和空头在相同价位买入，市场本应加速上行。有些多头还把这段交易区间看作一个楔形牛旗：第17根K线是第一次向下推进，第20根K线是第二次，第26根K线是第三次。他们还看到，第三次向下推进本身又由一个小楔形组成，第22、24、26根K线构成了那三次向下推进。


> Bar 30 took out the high of bar 29 and broke above the bear trend line by a tick, but failed to break above the bar 26 short entry bar. This was two legs up, and the bears would have allowed that as an acceptable pullback from the bear breakout, but they would have been concerned that their shorts were not behaving well. They would have been quick to buy back their shorts. The bulls knew that the correction had two legs and had now lasted about 10 bars, so their minimum criteria had been met and they were getting ready to buy aggressively, hoping for a measured move up to the 1,127.50 area. This was far enough up for them to be swinging some or all of their new positions. They would have seen each of those bear stops as buy setups and would have been buying at the exact same prices at which the bears were covering their shorts. With both bulls and bears buying at the same prices as the market went up, the market should have accelerated upward. Some bulls also viewed this trading range as a wedge bull flag with bar 17 as the first push down, bar 20 as the second, and bar 26 as the third. They also saw the third push down as being composed of a smaller wedge, with bars 22, 24, and 26 forming the three pushes down.


第32、33根K线是小十字星，说明交易者正在下决心去打掉那些买入止损。到这个时候，空头开始市价回补，因为他们知道自己的空单只是逆势剥头皮。他们多半乐意在保本处出场，甚至接受一两个最小报价单位的亏损。市场维持在移动平均线上方，而在一段大急速行情之后，那是看多的。


> Bars 32 and 33 were small dojis and were a sign that traders were deciding to run those buy stops. At this point, bears were beginning to cover at the market because they knew that their shorts were only countertrend scalps. They were likely happy to get out at breakeven or even with a one-or two-tick loss. The market was holding above the moving average, and after a big spike up, that was bullish.


第34根K线是一根多头趋势K线，但收盘时比高点低了两三个最小报价单位。市场在第17根K线的高点处、以及昨天高点一带遇到了卖盘。


> Bar 34 was a bull trend bar, but it closed a couple of ticks off its high. The market found sellers at the bar 17 high and in the area of the high of yesterday.


第35根K线给了多头一笔剥头皮的利润，但形成的是一根空头反转K线，且创下当天新高一个最小报价单位。有些交易者会在该K线收盘时做空，另一些人会在它低点下方一个最小报价单位处做空。激进的多头不会被这次回调困扰，他们希望它会变成一次突破回调、带来对昨天高点上方的上攻。只要市场维持在移动平均线上方、第26根K线那个更高的低点上方、或者第34根K线那根多头趋势K线的低点上方，他们就会继续持多。


> Bar 35 gave the bulls a scalper's profit, but formed a bear reversal bar with a one-tick new high of the day. Some traders would have shorted the close of the bar, and others would have shorted at one tick below its low. Aggressive bulls would not have been bothered by the pullback, hoping that it would become a breakout pullback and lead to a move above yesterday's high. They would have stayed long as long as the market held above the moving average, above the bar 26 higher low, or above the bar 34 bull trend bar low.


在第36根K线上做空的空头担心：这根K线收在了他们的入场价上，而且他们无法把市场压到第34根K线那根多头入场K线下方。他们会在该K线收盘时以及它高点上方回补空单。有些多头会在它高点上方做多，但多数人不会，因为那是在接近当天高点处买入，而当天已经横向震荡了几个小时。买当天的高点只在强多头趋势里才是好策略，而这并不是当下的价格行为。


> The bears who shorted on bar 36 were worried that the bar closed at their entry price and that they could not push the market below the bar 34 bull entry bar. They would have covered their shorts at the close of the bar and above its high. Some bulls would have gone long above its high, but most would not have because it would have been buying near the high of the day when the day had been in a trading range for a couple of hours. Buying the high of the day is a good strategy only in strong bull trends, and that was not the current price action.


第37根K线是一根多头趋势K线，但在三根大部分相互重叠的大K线上方买入是不好的。这三根K线构成一个交易区间，而在交易区间的顶部买入有风险，因为多数突破都会失败。真要说的话，在那个位置做空反而更好。


> Bar 37 was a bull trend bar, but it is bad to buy above three large bars that mostly overlap. The three bars create a trading range, and it is risky to buy at the top of a trading range since most breakouts fail. If anything, it was better to short up there.


第38根K线在第36根K线那根做多信号K线上方五个最小报价单位处、以及昨天高点上方一个最小报价单位处反转向下。许多当天早些时候就持多的多头，很可能挂着限价单要在昨天高点止盈，激进的空头也会在那里做空。第37根K线买入的多头，很可能在那五个最小报价单位的上冲之后把止损移到保本附近，而市场跌穿了那些止损。第38根K线成了一根大空头反转K线，但由于它与前四根K线重叠得太多，它形成的更像一个交易区间，而不是反转。这是第二次尝试反转开盘时的高点，所以有些交易者会在这根空头反转K线下方一个最小报价单位处挂止损单做空。另一些人会等着在更低的高点做空。涨到第38根K线高点的这段上涨，可以看作多头趋势线突破之后的一次两段式更高的高点，因此是一次可能的趋势反转。正因为如此，多头可能会等一段两段式修正之后再买入。


> Bar 38 reversed down at five ticks above the bar 36 long signal bar and one tick above the high of yesterday. Many bulls who were long from earlier in the day likely had limit orders to take profits at yesterday's high, and aggressive bears would have shorted there as well. The bar 37 longs would likely have moved their stops to around breakeven after the five-tick move up, and the market fell through those stops. Bar 38 became a large bear reversal bar, but since it overlapped the prior four bars by so much, it was forming more of a trading range than a reversal. This was the second attempt to reverse the high of the open, so some traders would have placed stops to go short at one tick below this bear reversal bar. Others would have looked to short a lower high. The move up to the bar 38 high can be seen as a two-legged higher high after a bull trend line break, and therefore it was a possible trend reversal. Because of this, bulls might have waited for a two-legged correction before buying again.


第39根K线是一根十字星内包K线。空头仍然会试图在第38根K线低点下方做空，而现在其他空头会把限价单挂出来、准备在更低的高点做空。他们会把做空限价单挂在第39根K线的高点以及高一个、两个最小报价单位处。过于急切的多头会把这看作一个高2做多建仓形态（第37根K线是高1），并且会在激进空头做空的完全相同价位做多。此时市场处在当天中间三分之一时段，更容易出现交易区间，所以多头必须耐心，而且除非市场再次变得非常强，否则必须避免在高点买入。


> Bar 39 was a doji inside bar. Bears would still have tried to short below the bar 38 low, and now other bears would have placed limit orders to short a lower high. They would have had limit orders to go short at the bar 39 high and at one or two ticks higher. Overly eager bulls would have seen this as a high 2 buy setup (bar 37 being the high 1) and would have gone long exactly where aggressive bears were shorting. The market was now in the middle third of the day and was more likely to have trading ranges, so bulls had to be patient, and they had to avoid buying at the high unless the market became very strong again.


第41根K线又一次缺乏强势，那些在第40根K线买入的早期多头，如果市场跌破这根K线的低点，会很快认下两个最小报价单位的亏损。空头会在那里做空，赌一个可能的更低的高点，但他们不会很热心，因为市场开始形成带影线的重叠小K线（这是铁丝网的行为），止损单入场更可能失败。通常更好的做法是：在铁丝网底部附近买突破，在顶部附近做空突破。


> Bar 41 again lacked strength, and those early bulls who bought bar 40 would have been quick to take a two-tick loss if the market fell below the low of this bar. Bears would have shorted there for a possible lower high, but they would not have been enthusiastic, because the market was starting to form overlapping small bars with tails (which is barbwire behavior), and breakout entries would have been more likely to fail. It is usually better to buy breakouts near the bottom of barbwire and short breakouts near the top.


第42根K线会让那些高2多单中的一部分人回补，其余的会在第38根K线、以及那根信号K线低点下方回补。


> Bar 42 would have made some of those high 2 longs cover, and the rest would have covered below bar 38 and the signal bar low.


第43根K线会让交易者琢磨市场是不是在构筑一个楔形牛旗。一个小的横盘头肩顶部，常常会变成一个三角形或楔形牛旗，而第35、40根K线是两肩。既然交易者在找楔形牛旗，他们就在找三次向下推进和一个高3做多建仓形态。第36、38根K线是前两次。第42根K线可能是第三次向下推进的开始，如果市场从那里反转向上，楔形牛旗（以及那个失败的头肩顶部）就会被触发。


> Bar 43 would have made traders wonder if the market was setting up a wedge bull flag. A small, sideways head and shoulders top often becomes a triangle or a wedge bull flag, and bars 35 and 40 were shoulders. Since traders were looking for a wedge bull flag, they were trying to find three pushes down and a high 3 long setup. Bars 36 and 38 were the first two. Bar 42 could have been the start of the third push down, and if there was a reversal up from there, the wedge bull flag (and the failed head and shoulders top) would have triggered.


第44根K线向下突破第36根K线的低点一个最小报价单位，并回测了对第27根K线上方那次突破、以及对移动平均线。它可以是一根信号K线，尽管它带阴线实体（信号K线在交易区间里常常看起来很差）。只有在强趋势里想做逆势交易时，交易者才真的需要一根好信号K线，其余多数时候信号K线看起来往往很弱。激进的多头已经挂了限价单，在第36根K线的低点处买入，预期任何向下的突破都会在几个最小报价单位内失败。其他多头会在这根K线上方做多那个高3，因为那会是一个楔形牛旗。如果市场涨到第44根K线的高点上方，这还会变成一个五个 tick 的空头陷阱，逼着被套的空头买回自己的空单。


> Bar 44 broke out below the bar 36 low by one tick and tested the breakout above bar 27 and the moving average. It could be a signal bar although it had a bear body (signal bars often look bad in trading ranges). Traders really need a good signal bar only when looking to trade countertrend in a strong trend, and signal bars often look weak most of the rest of the time. Aggressive bulls had limit orders in to buy at the low of bar 36, expecting that any break below it would fail within a few ticks. Other bulls would have bought the high 3 above this bar because it would have been a wedge bull flag. This would also have been a five-tick bear trap if the market went above the high of bar 44, forcing trapped bears to buy back their shorts.


第45根K线触发了买入，尽管它只比第44根K线的高点高一个最小报价单位。在一日中间的时段，市场常常缺乏动能，尽管价格行为的实际形状通常可靠。其他交易者会在第45根K线上方买入，因为他们把它看作一次两根K线反转。另外，许多交易者更喜欢在多头K线上方买入，因为多头收盘意味着市场已经至少朝他们的方向走了一点。


> Bar 45 triggered the buying, even though it went only one tick above the bar 44 high. The market often lacks momentum in the middle third of the day even though the actual shape of the price action is usually reliable. Other traders would have bought above bar 45 because they saw it as a two-bar reversal. Also, many traders prefer to buy above bull bars because the bull close means that the market has already moved at least a little in their direction.


第49根K线给了多头一个点的剥头皮，但许多多头还在每个信号上继续买入，一部分剥头皮，其余部分做波段。急涨到第17根K线高点的那段强抛物线式上冲本可能是一段急速行情，而此后这段时间的双向交易一直在移动平均线处找到支撑，可能正在形成一个通道。那些做波段的持多者一直在买入，并把保护性止损跟在最近的摆动低点下方，也就是第44根K线下方。


> Bar 49 gave the bulls a one-point scalp, but many bulls kept buying every signal, scalping part and swinging the rest. The strong parabolic surge up to the bar 17 high could have been a spike, and the two-sided trading since then was finding support at the moving average and could have been forming a channel. The swing longs kept buying and were trailing their protective stops below the most recent swing low, which was bar 44.


当天剩下的时间里还有许多类似的交易，但这说明了要点：如果交易者有本领高度专注、清晰地读图，他们就能一整天做几十笔剥头皮。不过，极端剥头皮对多数交易者来说会是一个亏钱的策略，他们不该去试，也永远不该使用大于回报的风险。他们倒应该把自己限制在其他许多更可能成功、也更容易执行的做法的任何一种上。本章放在这里，只是为了说明每张图上发生的事都比表面看起来多得多，以及交易者需要怎样全天不停地思考。今天有许多建仓形态，交易者都可以去博一个至少和风险一样大的回报，但他应该把自己看到的每一个建仓形态都想一遍。这张图展示了交易者一天之内能做出多少决定。多数有经验的交易者只会做其中一小部分交易。


> There were many more similar trades over the remainder of the day, but this illustrates the point that if traders have the ability to focus intensely and read clearly, they can take dozens of scalps all day long. However, extreme scalping would be a losing strategy for most traders, and they should not attempt it, and they should never be using a risk that is greater than their reward. Instead, they should restrict themselves to any of the many other approaches that are far more likely to be successful and easier to execute. This chapter is here simply to illustrate that there is much more happening on every chart than what might appear to be the case, and how traders need to be thinking constantly throughout the day. There were many setups today where a trader could go for a reward that was at least as large as his risk, but he should be thinking about every setup that he sees. This chart illustrates just how many decisions that a trader can make during the day. Most experienced traders would take only a fraction of these trades.


# 第 17 章　与盘前相关的形态

*17. Patterns Related to the Premarket*


看 Globex 电子盘 Emini 小型合约的最小报价单位图或成交量图时，开盘并不好找，因为它只是 24 小时交易日中的一小段，在图上和其余部分看不出区别。事实上，包含日盘开盘的那根K线几乎总是含有开盘之前的成交。Globex 电子盘的高点和低点有在日盘被测试的倾向，Globex 电子盘上也有些形态会在日盘开头很多根K线的过程中走完。头一个小时左右通常走得很快，单看日盘就能提供极好的价格行为。既然大多数交易者没有能力同时把两张图交易好，尤其是在开盘后那种快市里，那就只选 Globex 电子盘或日盘5分钟图中的一张。这纯粹是个人偏好问题。有些成功的交易者整天都看 Globex 电子盘，而我更愿意看日盘。另一些交易者看 Globex 电子盘看一个小时左右，然后换到日盘图。大多数在 Globex 电子盘图上成立的交易，对只看日盘的交易者来说，也有价格行为上的理由去做同样的入场。你应当愿意偶尔错过一笔交易，而不是在一面快速分析两张图、一面下入场单、止损单和止盈单的时候，因为犯糊涂而冒着亏钱的风险。


> When looking at tick or volume charts of the Globex Emini, the open is not easy to spot because it is just part of the 24-hour trading day and appears indistinguishable from the rest of the chart. In fact, the bar that contains the open of the day session will almost always contain ticks from before that open. There is a tendency for the Globex highs and lows to get tested in the day session, and there are patterns in the Globex that get completed during the first many bars of the day session. The first hour or so usually moves quickly, and the day session alone provides great price action. Since most traders are not capable of trading two charts well, especially in a fast market like after the open, just choose either the Globex or day session 5 minute chart. It is a matter of personal preference. Some successful traders watch the Globex all day, but I prefer to watch the day session. Other traders watch the Globex chart for an hour or so and then switch to the day session chart. Most trades that set up on the Globex chart will have price action reasons for traders who watch only the day session to take the same entry. You should be willing to miss an occasional trade rather than risk losing money while being confused as you quickly try to analyze two charts while you place entry, stop, and profit-target orders.


当日盘大幅跳空，并在开盘后 30 分钟左右去补这个缺口时，这段时间里 Globex 电子盘上的均线常常与日盘上的均线方向相反。举例来说，如果是大幅跳空低开，日盘的均线会向下，但如果 Globex 电子盘上刚出现了一个更低的低点、并且开盘前 30 分钟市场一直在上涨，那么 Globex 电子盘的均线可能是向上的，Globex 电子盘的价格也可能在均线之上。如果你只看日盘、看到大幅跳空、并且开盘后市场正在强势趋势运行去补缺口，那就看动能，不要看均线，因为动能反映的是当下实际发生的价格行为。只看日盘的交易者必须清楚，在头一个小时左右，均线常常是不可靠的。


> When the market has a large gap on the day session and moves to close it in the first 30 minutes or so, the moving average on the Globex is often in the opposite direction to that in the day session during this time. For example, if there is a large gap down, the moving average for the day session will be down, but if there was a lower low on the Globex and the market had been rallying for the 30 minutes before the open, the Globex moving average can be rising and the Globex prices can be above the moving average. If you look at only the day session and see a large gap and the market is trending strongly to close it off the open, look at the momentum and not the moving average, since the momentum is a reflection of the actual price action that is taking place. Traders who watch only the day session have to be aware that the moving average is often unreliable for the first hour or so.


![图 17.1](figures/fig-17-01.jpg)


**图 17.1　Globex 电子盘与日盘通常给出相关的信号**


如图 17.1 所示，Globex 电子盘图和日盘图通常在同一时间给出信号，但往往来自不同的形态。左边的 Globex 电子盘图和右边的日盘图上，第1根K线都是太平洋标准时间上午 6:35 的那根K线。Globex 电子盘上出现了最终旗形反转的买入信号，而日盘上出现的是一根空头趋势K线反转，它是进入昨日收盘的两段式上涨之后的突破回调。记住，如果当天的第一根K线是趋势K线，它通常是剥头皮的一个建仓形态。如果它失败，尤其是以一根反向的趋势K线失败，它就是反方向的建仓形态。


> As shown in Figure 17.1, the Globex and day session charts usually give signals at the same time, but often from different patterns. Bar 1 on both the Globex chart on the left and on the day session chart on the right is the 6:35 a.m. PST bar. The Globex had a final flag reversal buy signal, and the day session had a bear trend bar reversal that was a breakout pullback above the two-legged up move into yesterday's close. Remember that if the first bar of the day is a trend bar, it is usually a setup for a scalp. If it fails, especially with an opposite trend bar, it is a setup in the opposite direction.


在 Globex 电子盘盘中，第1根K线位于一根下行的均线之下，但在日盘上第1根K线却在均线之上。要等到两个盘段的均线一致，可能需要一两个小时，而在这期间每张图都可能给出不同、却同样有效的建仓形态。不过，对大多数同时看两张图的交易者来说，这么做不但毫无收获，通常还会增加一种风险：交易者不够快，抓不到所有可做的交易，而且在挂单时出错。


> In the Globex session, bar 1 was below a falling moving average, but bar 1 was above the moving average in the day session. It can take an hour or two before the moving average is the same in both sessions, and it can provide different and equally valid setups in each. However, nothing is gained by most traders who watch both charts, and doing so usually increases the chances that a trader will not be quick enough to take all of the available trades and will make mistakes in order placement.


![图 17.2](figures/fig-17-02.jpg)


**图 17.2　Globex 电子盘上的均线不一样**


有时在出现大幅跳空时，日盘均线在开盘头 30 分钟内帮不上忙。在图 17.2 中，右边的日盘跳空低开，市场在 90 多分钟里都没能推到下行的均线之上。然而左边 Globex 电子盘上的上涨行情（它几乎一天 24 小时都在交易）从开盘前 30 分钟就开始了，从太平洋标准时间上午 6:30 起市场就在上行的均线之上，看起来更偏多。第1根K线处那个上午 7:20 的铁丝网建仓形态位于均线之上，因此在 Globex 电子盘上是偏多的，但在日盘上却位于均线之下。不过两个盘段的上涨动能都很强，交易者本应去找买入的建仓形态。


> Sometimes the moving average on the day session is not helpful in the first 30 minutes when there is a large gap. In Figure 17.2, the day session on the right gapped down and the market could not push above the falling moving average for more than 90 minutes. However, the rally in the Globex (it trades almost 24 hours a day) on the left began 30 minutes before the open, and the market was above the rising moving average from 6:30 a.m. PST onward and appeared more bullish. The 7:20 a.m. barbwire setup at bar 1 was above the moving average and therefore bullish in the Globex, but below the moving average on the day session. However, the upward momentum was strong in both, and traders should have been looking for buy setups.


# 第 18 章　与昨日相关的形态：突破、突破回调与突破失败

*18. Patterns Related to Yesterday: Breakouts, Breakout Pullbacks, and Failed Breakouts*


突破回调与突破失败头一个小时的许多交易都与前一天的形态有关，所以要在市场开盘之前就试着预判建仓形态。回看昨天的最后一两个小时，看看那里是一段强趋势（一个可能延续到今天的始终入场方向）、一个交易区间、一条通道，还是任何可能带来今日开盘突破的形态。虽然有些日子开盘时落在前一天最后一两个小时那个安静的交易区间里，而且移动平均线是平的，但多数日子在开盘时总会有某种突破。当你拿不准突破是什么的时候，直接看移动平均线，把它当作一个替代指标。如果第一根K线完全位于移动平均线上方，就把开盘看作向上跳空；如果第一根K线完全位于移动平均线下方，就假定市场在向下跳空。昨天的最后一根K线收盘与今天的第一根K线开盘之间通常有一个缺口，而这一点本身就是一个突破。要去找任何东西的突破，包括进入昨收时的一根通道或一面旗形；它可以是一根K线的最终旗形，也可以是一条三小时的通道。要去找任何摆动高点或摆动低点下方的突破，尤其是昨天的高点或低点。


> Pullbacks, and Failed Breakouts Many trades in the first hour are related to patterns from the prior day, so try to anticipate setups before the market opens. Look at the final hour or two of yesterday to see if there was a strong trend (an always-in direction that might carry over to today), a trading range, a channel, or any kind of pattern that could lead to a breakout on today's open. Although some days open within a quiet trading range from the final hour or two of the prior day and the moving average is flat, on most days there is some kind of breakout on the open. When you are uncertain what the breakout is, simply look at the moving average and use that as a proxy. If the first bar is entirely above the moving average, think of the open as a gap up. If the first bar is entirely below the moving average, assume that the market is gapping down. There is usually a gap between the close of the final bar of yesterday and the open of the first bar of today, and that alone is a breakout. Look for breakouts of anything, including a channel or flag into yesterday's close. It can be a one-bar final flag or a three-hour channel. Look for a breakout below any swing high or low, especially the high or low of yesterday.


今天一开盘、你一看到突破，就必须评估它有多可能有后续行情。如果是大幅跳空低开，并且第一根K线是一根强劲的空头趋势K线、开盘靠近它的高点、收盘靠近它的低点，今天可能就是一段从开盘开始的空头趋势。反过来，如果第一根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线，这次突破就可能失败，而这一天就可能变成一段从开盘开始的多头趋势。如果那次空头突破有几根K线的后续行情，随后又出现一次强劲的多头反转，这就可能形成一个突破失败和一个可能的当日低点。如果这波上涨只持续一两根K线，随后又出现另一根强劲的空头趋势K线，那么这个失败突破可能正在失败。若果真如此，在那根空头K线下方做空就是一次突破回调入场。市场先突破，随后失败了，但这次失败变成了空头趋势里的一次回调，而不是一次反转。


> Once today opens and you see a breakout, you have to evaluate how likely it is to have follow-through. If there is a large gap down and the first bar is a strong bear trend bar with an open near its high and a close near its low, today might be a trend from the open bear. If instead it is a strong bull reversal bar, the breakout might fail and the day might become a trend from the open bull. If that bear breakout has follow-through for a few bars and then there is a strong bull reversal, this could set up a failed breakout and a possible low of the day. If the rally lasts only a bar or two and then there is another strong bear trend bar, the failed breakout might be failing. If so, shorting below that bear bar is a breakout pullback entry. The market broke out and then it failed, but the failure turned into a pullback in the bear trend instead of a reversal.


开盘出现多头突破时，反过来也成立。要去找后续行情，或者去找反转成失败突破做空的入场机会。这波反转向下是继续走出两根、三根或更多大号空头趋势K线，从而很可能成为一个空头趋势日？还是在一两根K线之内就出现一根多头反转K线，导致这次失败突破也失败？若果真如此，这个形态就正在演变成一个突破回调做多的建仓形态。每一次开盘你都要这样评估。先找突破，再找可能反转成失败突破建仓形态的机会。最后，如果出现了失败突破，要看看它有后续行情，还是在失败。如果它正在失败，它就在形成一个突破回调交易，以及突破的重新启动。


> The opposite is true when there is a bull breakout on the open. Look for follow-through or a reversal into a failed breakout short entry. Does the reversal down continue with two or three or more large bear trend bars, making a bear trend day likely? Or is there a bull reversal bar within a bar or two, resulting in a failure of that failed breakout? If so, the pattern is evolving into a breakout pullback buy setup. You need to evaluate every open this way. Look for the breakout, and then look for a possible reversal into a failed breakout setup. Finally, if there is a failed breakout, look to see if it has follow-through or if it is failing. If it is failing, it is setting up a breakout pullback trade and a resumption of the breakout.


![图 18.1](figures/fig-18-01.jpg)


**图 18.1　多头通道就是一面熊旗**


昨天的一段多头通道就是一面熊旗，市场常常在开盘时跌破它（见图 18.1）。昨天，Oil Service HOLDRS（OIH）的5分钟图上有一段将近四小时的两段式上涨行情，它在跌到第1根K线的那波强劲下跌之后突破了主要空头趋势线（图上没有显示），而这波上涨行情两次过靶一条空头趋势通道线，并且两次都反转向下（第4根和第5根K线）。这是多头正在失去控制的一个证据。不过，这段上涨行情持续的长度，又是多头强势的证据。


> A bull channel from yesterday is a bear flag, and the market often breaks below it on the open (see Figure 18.1). Yesterday, the Oil Service HOLDRS (OIH) 5 minute chart had a nearly four-hour, two-legged rally that broke the major bear trend line (not shown) after the strong move down to bar 1, and the rally overshot a bear trend channel line twice and reversed down both times (bars 4 and 5). This was evidence that the bulls were losing control. The length of the rally was evidence of bullish strength.


从第5根K线到收盘的那波抛售把市场的始终入场方向翻成了做空，交易者于是假定这个趋势会延续到今天的开盘。


> The sell-off from bar 5 into the close flipped the market to always-in short, and traders assumed that this trend would carry into today's open.


今天，市场跳空低开，出现了一根强劲的空头趋势K线，很快就跌破了昨天的低点，并在那里形成一次强劲的两根K线多头反转。这个大型熊旗突破失败跨越了两天，在第7根K线的高点上方一个最小报价单位处提供了一次极好的做多入场。这是从第1根K线开始的那面熊旗的最终旗形反转，也是一个更低的低点主要趋势反转。反转了前一天高点或低点的开盘反转，往往会形成当天的最高点或最低点，所以交易者应该把部分或大部分合约拿去做波段。这里，保本止损本可以让交易者在一段上涨到第5根K线上方新摆动高点的波段行情中赚到多达 5.00 美元。


> Today, the market gapped down, had a strong bear trend bar, and quickly traded below yesterday's low, where it formed a strong two-bar bull reversal. This large bear flag failed breakout occurred over two days and provided an excellent long entry at one tick above the high of bar 7. This was a final flag reversal from the bear flag that began at bar 1, and a lower low major trend reversal. Opening reversals that reverse the high or low of the prior day often form the high or low of the day, so traders should swing some or most of their contracts. Here, a breakeven stop would have allowed a trader to make as much as $5.00 on a swing to a new swing high above bar 5.


当开盘突破的是前一天收盘时留下的某个形态，交易者应该在像第7根K线这样的失败突破建仓形态处入场，然后在这个失败突破失败、变成突破回调时，再反方向入场。这里，随后那段三根K线的上涨行情强到第二段上涨很可能出现，因此交易者这时还不该去找突破回调做空。既然第二段上涨很可能出现，更好的做法是在第8根K线上方买入，或者在前两根K线中任何一根的低点下方买入。第8根K线是突破回调做多的信号K线，它出现在市场突破开盘区间第6根K线顶部之后。它同时也是基于那次失败的双顶熊旗做多的一个建仓形态，其中第6根K线是第一个顶。


> When the open forms a breakout of a pattern from the prior day's close, traders should enter on a failed breakout setup, like bar 7, and then enter in the opposite direction if the failed breakout fails and becomes a breakout pullback. Here, the three-bar rally that followed was strong enough so that a second leg up was likely and therefore traders should not yet have been looking to short a breakout pullback. Since a second leg up was likely, it was better to buy above bar 8 or below the low of either of the prior two bars. Bar 8 was a signal bar for a breakout pullback long, following the breakout above the bar 6 top of the opening range. It was also a setup for a long based on the failed double top bear flag where bar 6 was the first top.


有一点很重要，需要认清：即使昨天从第5根K线到收盘一路急剧抛售，市场也完全可能在今天开盘时于第6根K线处跳空高开。若果真如此，那么从第5根K线开始的这波抛售就成了一次失败的突破尝试。


> It is important to realize that, even though the market sold off sharply yesterday from bar 5 into the close, the market could easily have gapped up on the open at bar 6. If it had, then the sell-off from bar 5 would have become a failed breakout attempt.


![图 18.2](figures/fig-18-02.jpg)


**图 18.2　早盘的突破失败**


无论第一根K线有多强，甚至即使昨天收盘时留下了被套的交易者，也随时要对突破失败做好准备（见图 18.2）。UltraShort 石油天然气 ProShares（DUG）昨天以一段四小时的多头通道收盘，而这面通道就是一面熊旗，市场在临近收盘时向下跌破了它。这段多头通道由一段急速行情加通道的多头趋势构成，而跌到第4根K线的那波抛售形成了一个可能的双底牛旗。跌到第4根K线的那波抛售跌破了多头通道，而今天的开盘突破了通道的顶部。虽然当天的第一根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线、本可以是一段从开盘开始的多头趋势的起点，但它后面跟着一根强劲的空头趋势K线，于是形成了一次两根K线反转、一个失败突破做空的建仓形态，以及一个更高的高点主要趋势反转。结果是：突破第3根K线的楔形顶和扩张三角形顶（第2根和第3根K线是前两推）失败，并且形成了一段从开盘开始的空头趋势。


> Always be ready for a failed breakout, no matter how strong the first bar is and even if there are trapped traders from yesterday's close (see Figure 18.2). The UltraShort Oil and Gas ProShares (DUG) closed yesterday with a four-hour bull channel, which is a bear flag, and it broke to the downside going into the close. The bull channel was made of a spike and channel bull trend, and the sell-off to bar 4 set up a possible double bottom bull flag. The sell-off down to bar 4 broke below the bull channel, and today's open broke out of the top of the channel. Although the first bar of the day was a strong bull reversal bar and could have been the beginning of a trend from the open bull, it was followed by a strong bear trend bar and created a two-bar reversal and a setup for a failed breakout short and a higher high major trend reversal. The result was a failed breakout above the bar 3 wedge top and expanding triangle top (bars 2 and 3 were the first two pushes), and a trend from the open bear.


昨天的急速行情加通道的多头趋势在一个楔形通道里结束，因此很可能至少有一起两段式修正，但从突破到第4根K线的那次回调其实是上涨到第5根K线的一个更高的高点。当出现像楔形或扩张三角形的二次入场那样强劲的反转建仓形态时，市场通常会修正至少10根K线和两段行情，这里正是如此。市场下跌了一个大概的等距运动，并刚好测试在昨天低点上方一点的位置。低点处的那两根多头实体是买压的一个信号，一些多头在第8根K线越过那两根多头K线时用止损单入场。另一些交易者在第8根K线这根外包上涨K线上方入场。市场正试图与昨天的低点形成双底，如果它能突破第5根K线的高点，它可能在接下来的几天里向上走高，达到一个向上的等距运动。


> Yesterday's spike and channel bull trend ended in a wedge channel and was therefore likely to have at least a two-legged correction, but the pullback from the breakout to bar 4 was a higher high up to bar 5. When there is a strong reversal setup like a second entry for a wedge or an expanding triangle, the market usually corrects for at least 10 bars and two legs, which happened here. The market fell for an approximate measured move and tested just above yesterday's low. The two bull bodies at the low were a sign of buying pressure, and some bulls entered on a stop as bar 8 went above those bull bars. Other traders entered above the bar 8 outside up bar. The market was trying to form a double bottom with yesterday's low, and if it broke above the bar 5 high, it could work higher over the next couple of days to a measured move up.


第9根K线是一根外包上涨突破K线，它把市场的始终入场方向翻成了做多。它让交易者认为市场不是在形成一面熊旗，更可能是在试着形成当天的低点。


> Bar 9 was an outside up breakout bar, and it flipped the market to always-in long. It made traders think that the market was not in the process of forming a bear flag and was more likely trying to form the low of the day.


上涨到第10根K线的那波行情是一段三根K线的多头急速行情，影线小、多头实体大，因此第二段上涨很可能出现。这次回调很可能守在第9根K线的低点上方，也就是大多数交易者确信市场已经翻进多头模式的位置。


> The rally to bar 10 was a three-bar bull spike with small tails and large bull bodies and therefore a second leg up was likely. The pullback was likely to stay above the bar 9 low, which is where most traders became convinced that the market had flipped into bull mode.


涨到第3根K线的那波上涨非常强劲，有很多多头趋势K线，而且即使它以楔形收尾，这份强势也让市场很可能在修正之后再向上尝试一次。在一些更高级别的时间级别图上，它大概是一段多头急速行情。


> The move up to bar 3 was very strong, with many bull trend bars, and even though it ended with a wedge, this strength made it likely that there would be a second attempt up after a correction. It was probably a bull spike on some higher time frame chart.


楔形通常不会在没有至少一次两段式修正的情况下失败，所以当市场跳空高开并形成一根多头趋势K线时，多头很兴奋。然而就在紧接着的下一根K线，他们就被止损出局，聪明的交易者把这看作一次连续的反向失败，于是做空。


> Wedges usually don't fail before having at least a two-legged correction, so when the market gapped up and formed a bull trend bar, the bulls were excited. However, on the very next bar, they were stopped out and smart traders saw this as a consecutive, opposite failure and shorted.


第6根K线在陡峭空头趋势里是一次失败的顺势线突破，所以它是一个微型趋势线低1做空。这是强空头急速行情里的低1做空，可能是一个新的空头波段，因此是一笔合理的交易。


> Bar 6 was a failed trend line break in a steep bear trend, so it was a micro trend line low 1 short. This was a low 1 short in a strong bear spike in a possible new bear swing and therefore a reasonable trade.


第7根K线形成了空头低2做空的建仓形态，并与第6根K线构成一个小双顶。第8根K线是价格行为交易者在强劲上涨到第3根K线之后所等待的那次深度修正。它也是当天的两段下跌和一次对昨天低点的测试。有些交易者把跌到第8根K线的这波行情看作一次两段式修正，其中第一段向下走到第4根K线，而那次回调上涨到了一个更高的高点。


> Bar 7 set up a bear low 2 short setup, and was a small double top with bar 6. Bar 8 was the deep correction that price action traders were looking for after the strong move up to bar 3. It was also two legs down on the day and a test of yesterday's low. Some traders saw the move down to bar 8 as a two-legged correction where the first leg down was to bar 4 and the pullback was to a higher high.


第9根K线是再一次买入机会，因为它是失败的低2，而失败的低2通常至少还会带来两段上涨。这是一笔极好的交易，因为它把多头挡在了一波强劲上涨之外，逼得他们只能一路追着市场往上买。像这种外包上涨的失败低1或低2陷阱，在强趋势启动时很常见，是趋势可能走得很远的一个信号。


> Bar 9 was another chance to buy since it was a failed low 2, which usually results in at least two more legs up. This was a great trade because it trapped bulls out of a strong up move and they would then have to chase the market up. An outside up failed low 1 or low 2 trap like this is common at the start of a strong trend and is a sign that the trend will likely go far.


第10根K线是一段强劲的上涨行情，它突破了趋势线，也突破了移动平均线，而且带有很多多头趋势K线，因此很可能随后出现一个更高的低点。第10根K线同时也是一根均线缺口K线，但此时你应该找机会买入回调，只有在极好的建仓形态出现时才做空，而且只做一笔剥头皮。从第9根K线起，趋势向上，直到出现相反的证明为止。


> Bar 10 was a strong up leg that broke the trend line and broke above the moving average and had many bull trend bars, so a higher low was likely to follow. Bar 10 was also a moving average gap bar, but at this point you would be looking to buy a pullback and you would short only a great setup and then only for a scalp. The trend was up since bar 9 until proven otherwise.


第11根K线是从一条空头微型通道的突破失败，而第12根K线成了一个更低的低点突破回调做多建仓形态。


> Bar 11 was a failed breakout from a bear micro channel, and bar 12 became a lower low breakout pullback buy setup.


市场在奔向第13根K线的路上形成了两根小的空头趋势K线，这实际上是从第12根K线的反转上涨算起的一次两段式修正。你本可以在第13根K线处买入、在第二根空头趋势K线上方买入，或者在第14根K线处、在那根充当突破回调的内包K线之后买入。这是一个更高的低点主要趋势反转。


> The market formed two small bear trend bars en route to bar 13, and this is effectively a two-legged correction from the bar 12 reversal up. You could have bought on bar 13, above the second bear trend bar, or on bar 14, after the inside bar that acted as a breakout pullback. This was a higher low major trend reversal.


市场突破第10根K线时没有出现回调，说明多头很强。你可以在1分钟图上等一个高2做多，或者等5分钟图上的停顿或回调。


> There was no pullback when the market broke above bar 10, indicating that the bulls were strong. You could have looked for a high 2 on the 1 minute chart to go long or waited for a 5 minute pause or pullback.


第15根K线不是好的高1做多，因为此时上涨已不再是一段强劲的多头急速行情。它跟随的是一段小幅的急速行情与高潮式多头行情，而这波行情是从一次小的趋势通道线过靶（虚线）反转向下的，所以它很可能至少要以横盘到下跌的方式修正两段。而且，那根信号K线是一根强劲的空头趋势K线，这是双向交易更多的一个信号。双向交易的第一个信号是四根K线之前的那根空头趋势K线，而第15根K线之前的五根K线有一些重叠，还有明显的影线。


> Bar 15 was not a good high 1 long because the move up was no longer a strong bull spike. It followed a small spike and climax bull move that reversed down from a small trend channel line overshoot (dashed line), and it was likely to correct sideways to down for at least a couple of legs. Also, the signal bar was a strong bear trend bar, which was a sign of more two-sided trading. The first sign of the two-sided trading was the bear trend bar from four bars earlier, and the five bars before bar 15 had some overlap and prominent tails.


第16根K线是在突破小内包K线上方时的高2做多，这样可以设置很紧的止损。


> Bar 16 was a high 2 long on the breakout above the small inside bar, which allowed for a tight stop.


![图 18.3](figures/fig-18-03.jpg)


**图 18.3　头一个小时的双顶**


如图 18.3 所示，在头一个小时里，市场常常形成一个双顶或双底，而它会成为当天的极值，或者至少是接下来几个小时的极值。AAPL 昨天以窄幅交易区间收盘，那可能是一个最终旗形的建仓形态。在第3根K线、也就是当天的第一根K线处，AAPL 迅速跌破了昨收时那面多头旗形，随后又突破它的顶部，形成一个小楔形牛旗突破。然而这个突破也失败了，并在下一根K线反转向下。虽然第4根K线处这次两根K线反转是一个不错的最终旗形做空入场，但上涨动能很强，而且最初的向下突破失败意味着，也许最好再等更多的价格行为出现才做空。此时，在一次向下突破失败和昨日高点被反转之后又出现一次旗形突破失败，让空头的胜算更大。


> As shown in Figure 18.3, in the first hour, the market often forms a double top or bottom that becomes an extreme of the day or of at least the next few hours. AAPL closed yesterday with a tight trading range, which could have been a setup for a final flag. On bar 3, the first bar of the day, AAPL quickly broke below the bull flag from yesterday's close and then broke out of the top, forming a small wedge bull flag breakout. However, this breakout also failed, and it reversed back down on the next bar. Although this two-bar reversal at bar 4 was a decent final flag short entry, the momentum up was strong and the original failed breakout through the downside meant that it might have been better to wait for more price action before shorting. At this point, a failed flag breakout after a failed downside breakout and a reversal of yesterday's high made the bear case more likely.


第5根K线出现在一个铁丝网形态的末端，这个形态把多头套进了高2买入，而在高2信号K线（前一根K线）低点下方一个最小报价单位处，是一次极好的做空入场。这根K线把多头套住，随后又逼他们离场。市场本可以在移动平均线处以及第2根与第3根K线之间那面多头旗形里找到支撑，所以交易者对自己的空单很谨慎。任何K线重叠的区域，尤其当这些K线很大、而窄幅交易区间里又有多次反转时，都是双向交易很强的区域。多头会在下方做空、不在上方买入，空头会在上方做空、不在下方做空。结果就是突破往往会被拉回区间里，就像第3、9、11根K线的空头突破以及第4、7根K线的多头突破之后那样。


> Bar 5 came at the end of a barbwire pattern that trapped bulls into buying a high 2, and was a great short entry at one tick below the low of the high 2 signal bar (the prior bar). This bar trapped the bulls long and it then forced them out. The market could have found support at the moving average and within the bull flag between bars 2 and 3, so traders were cautious about their shorts. Any area of overlapping bars, especially when they are large and when the tight trading range has multiple reversals, is an area of strong two-sided trading. Bulls will short below and not buy above, and bears will short above and not below. The result is that breakouts tend to get pulled back into the range, as they were after the bear breakouts at bars 3, 9, and 11 and the bull breakouts at bars 4 and 7.


第6根K线是反手做多的信号，因为它是一次失败突破、多头趋势中向移动平均线的第二段下跌（大多数K线都位于一条上行的移动平均线上方）、一次两根K线反转，也是回调到移动平均线上的一根多头K线。


> Bar 6 was a signal to reverse to long, because it was a failed breakout, a second leg down to the moving average in a bull trend (most bars were above a rising moving average), a two-bar reversal, and a bull bar on a pullback to the moving average.


注意，跌到第6根K线的那波抛售突破了一条趋势线，说明空头愿意变得更激进，所以交易者对第4根K线这个多头趋势顶部的失败测试有所准备。


> Note that the sell-off to bar 6 broke a trend line, indicating that the bears were willing to become aggressive, so traders were prepared for a failed test of the bar 4 top of the bull trend.


第7根K线是一根反转K线，但它突破新高的尝试失败了。这是第二次尝试突破昨天高点失败（第4根K线是第一次），它形成了一个楔形顶和一个更高的高点主要趋势反转。既然当天的区间到目前为止只有近期一段典型交易日的大约一半，那么无论向哪个方向突破，都很有可能把区间扩大一倍，而且很可能至少有两段行情（在出现任何回调之后，趋势交易者大概都会足够有信心，至少再向下一推）。第7根K线是第二次尝试突破昨天高点失败，而当市场两次尝试做某件事都失败时，它通常会改朝反方向走。第7根K线的双顶（也是多头趋势里的第三次向上推进）就是当天的顶部。


> Bar 7 was a reversal bar that failed in its breakout to a new high. It was the second failed attempt to break out above yesterday's high (bar 4 was the first), and it created a wedge top and a higher high major trend reversal. Since the range of the day so far had been only about half of that of a typical recent day, there was a good chance that a breakout in either direction would double the range and likely have at least two legs (the trend traders would probably be confident enough to make at least a second push down after any pullback). Bar 7 was the second failed attempt to break out above yesterday's high, and when the market tries to do something twice and fails, it usually tries to go in the opposite direction. The bar 7 double top (and third push up in the bull trend) was the top of the day.


许多交易者会认为，市场在第7根K线之后那面四根K线牛旗被两根强劲空头趋势K线跌破时，就已经变成始终做空了。有些交易者则希望看到更多证据。


> Many traders would have thought that the market became always-in short on the two strong bear trend bars that broke below the four-bar bull flag that followed bar 7. Some traders would have wanted more evidence.


第9根K线跌破了第6根K线的摆动低点，但没有跌破当天的低点。由于区间仍然很小，而且市场两次突破昨天高点都没有得到后续行情，那么大得非常高的概率是：至少还会有一次向下的推进去测试当天的低点，而这个低点是一个磁力位，并且距离非常近。市场此时已经处在它的磁力范围之内。


> Bar 9 broke below the bar 6 swing low, but not the low of the day. Since the range was still small and the market twice failed to get follow-through on the breakout above yesterday's high, the odds were very high that there would be at least one more push down to test the low of the day, which was a magnet and in very close proximity. The market was now within its magnetic field.


第10根K线完成了一个铁丝网形态，但既然人人都确信会有第二段下跌并测试当天的新低，它就在小内包K线下方提供了一个极好的低2做空。它同时也是第6根K线下方那次突破的突破回调入场。最后，由于它是一根这么大的突破K线、又收在它的低点，那些想要更多证据、想确认市场现在确实已经始终做空的交易者得到了满足。人们很有信心市场会继续走低，也许走到大约一个向下等距运动的位置。


> Bar 10 completed a barbwire pattern, but since everyone was confident of a second leg down and a test to a new low of the day, it offered a great low 2 short below the small inside bar. It was also a breakout pullback entry from the breakout below bar 6. Finally, since it was such a large breakout bar and it closed on its low, the traders who wanted more evidence that the market was in fact now always-in short were satisfied. There was a lot of confidence that the market would work lower, maybe to around a measured move down.


回调到第10根K线的那片铁丝网突破了一条小空头趋势线（图上没有显示），所以它也许就是结束第一段下跌的那次修正，但下跌动能一直很强，多头还没有足够信心积极买入。他们需要看到更多的价格行为。


> The barbwire pullback to bar 10 broke a minor bear trend line (not shown), so it might have been the correction that ended the first leg down, but the momentum down had been so strong that the bulls were not confident enough to buy aggressively yet. They needed more price action.


跌到第11根K线当天新低的那一波下行基本上是直落而下，因此很可能不是这波行情的终点（交易者会寻找第二段下跌，至少去测试第11根K线的低点）。由于这是对一条空头趋势通道线的突破失败（这条线从第8根K线的前一根K线开始），所以先出现两段上涨的可能性更大。


> The break to the bar 11 new low of the day was essentially straight down, and therefore likely not the end of the move (traders will look for a second leg down to at least test the bar 11 low). Since it was a failed breakout of a bear trend channel line (the line began on the bar before bar 8), two legs up were likely first.


第12根K线是第11根K线那个小双底之后的一个小双底回调做多建仓形态，但如果没有此前一次不错的趋势线突破，或者一根强劲的反转K线，这只能做一笔剥头皮。而且，既然第二段下跌很可能出现，又没有证据说明始终入场的交易方向已经反转向上，那么比起被七根带大影线的横盘K线之后的一笔小多头剥头皮分散注意力，专注于再次做空或加仓做空要明智得多。


> Bar 12 was a small double bottom pullback long setup after the small bar 11 double bottom, but in the absence of a prior good trend line break or a strong reversal bar, it would only be a scalp. Also, since a second leg down was likely and there was no evidence that the always-in trade had reversed back up, it would have been much wiser to focus on getting short again or adding to shorts than allowing yourself to be distracted by a small bull scalp after seven sideways bars with big tails.


第13根K线是空头的又一次低2机会，但上涨到移动平均线的那波行情突破了一条不错的空头趋势线。这向多头和空头都发出信号：从新摆动低点来的下一次向上反转，只要反转足够强，就很有可能走出两段上涨。这次低2做空是二次入场，而且它在移动平均线处有一根空头信号K线，这提高了成功的概率。


> Bar 13 was another low 2 opportunity for the bears, but the rally to the moving average broke a good bear trend line. This was a signal to both the bulls and the bears that the next reversal up from a new swing low had a good chance of having two legs up, if the reversal was strong enough. The low 2 short was a second entry, and it had a bear signal bar at the moving average, which increased the chance of success.


第14根K线是又一次低2做空，它跟随的是从第13根K线向下的一波相当强劲的两根K线空头急速行情。


> Bar 14 was another low 2 short and followed a reasonably strong two-bar bear spike down from bar 13.


第15根K线是从跌破新低之后的一个两根K线向上反转。在过靶两条空头趋势通道线之后，它在跌破新低处形成了一根强劲的多头反转K线。从第一次趋势线突破回调到第13根K线算起，这是第二段下跌（小幅急速行情之后的通道就是第一段下跌），同时也是对昨天第1根K线那个最低高点的突破回测。有些交易者把它看作双底买入建仓形态，另一些则把它看作强劲上涨到第7根K线之后的一个更高的低点。从当天最高点算起，这是第二段下跌，也是一个大楔形牛旗的底部，其中第3根和第11根K线是前两推向下。所有这些都是强势的信号，提高了这波上涨会走出两段的概率。第二段在第16根K线结束，它突破了第一段的高点后反转。它没能突破第14根K线的高点，与第14根K线形成双顶熊旗。它同时也是第13根K线向下那波空头急速行情之后一条抛物线通道的底部。另一些交易者则把第8根K线低点之前那两根空头趋势K线看作更重要的急速行情，他们的下跌通道从第10根K线开始。


> Bar 15 was a two-bar reversal up from a break to a new low. It had a strong bull reversal bar off the new low after overshooting two bear trend channel lines. It was the second leg down (the channel after a small spike, which was the first leg down) from the first trend line breakout pullback to bar 13 and a breakout test of the bar 1 lowest high of yesterday. Some traders saw it as a double bottom buy setup, and others saw it as a higher low after a strong rally to bar 7. It was the second leg down from the high of the day and the bottom of a large wedge bull flag where bars 3 and 11 were the first two pushes down. All of these were signs of strength and increased the odds that the rally would have two legs. The second leg ended at bar 16, which broke above the high of the first leg and reversed. It failed to break above the bar 14 high, forming a double top bear flag with bar 14. It was also the bottom of a parabolic channel that followed the bear spike down from bar 13. Other traders saw the two bear trend bars before the bar 8 low as the more important spike, and their channel down began at bar 10.


有些交易者把第10根K线看作急速行情，把从第13根K线开始的下跌看作通道。有些交易者认为第4根K线之后那根空头趋势K线，或者第5根K线那根空头趋势K线，是重要的急速行情。他们把第7根K线看作一个更高的高点突破回调。实际情况是，那每一根空头趋势K线都代表卖压，而卖压是会累积的。一旦它累积到足够的临界规模、压过多头，市场就跌下去了。


> Some traders saw bar 10 as a spike and the move down from bar 13 as the channel. Some traders thought that the bear trend bar after bar 4 or the bar 5 bear trend bar were important spikes. They saw bar 7 as a higher high breakout pullback. The reality was that each of those bear trend bars represented selling pressure, which is cumulative. Once it reached enough critical mass to overwhelm the bulls, the market went down.


顺便说一句，当一波强劲上涨以三次推进结束，随后以更小的动能抛售（斜率更平缓、趋势K线更小、影线更多）时，那三次推进的高点很可能不久就会被越过，因为这个底部很可能是更高级别时间级别上的一个更高的低点。市场在第二天的开盘就完成了这个目标。如果市场继续上涨，下一个目标就是从这个双底走出的一个向上等距运动。


> Incidentally, when there is a strong move up that ends in three pushes and then sells off with less momentum (shallower slope, smaller trend bars, more tails), the odds are good that the high of the three pushes will be exceeded before long because this bottom is likely a higher time frame higher low. The market fulfilled its objective on the open of the next day. If the market continues up, the next target would be a measured move up from the double bottom.


![图 18.4](figures/fig-18-04.jpg)


**图 18.4　从昨日的形态突破**
