如图 18.4 所示，当天的第一根K线常常是从昨天某个形态的突破。昨天是一个多头趋势性交易区间日，也是一段急速行情加通道的多头趋势，其中有三次向上推进。市场在收盘时跌破通道，又在跳空开盘时进一步跌破。第1根K线是突破回调做空，它本可以是一段从开盘开始的空头趋势的起点。


> As shown in Figure 18.4, the first bar of the day is often a breakout of a channel from yesterday. Yesterday was a bull trending trading range day and a spike and channel bull trend that had three pushes up. The market broke below the channel on the close, and it broke further below on the gap opening. Bar 1 was a breakout pullback short, and it could have been the start of a bear trend from the open.


第3根K线试图形成一个失败突破的开盘反转，但下跌既陡峭，又处在一条通道里。这让第3根K线成了一笔有风险的买入，尽管当天有那个小幅的三推向下。当下跌处在一条很紧的通道里时，更安全的做法是等到出现突破、然后再买入回调。


> Bar 3 tried to form a failed breakout opening reversal, but the move down was steep and in a channel. This made bar 3 a risky buy, despite the small three pushes down on the day. When the move down is in a tight channel, it is safer to wait to buy until there is a breakout and then a pullback.


第5根K线是一个更低的低点突破回调，它试图与昨天的低点形成双底（分毫不差）。它引出一段小楔形上涨行情，并在第6根K线处形成一个双顶熊旗。


> Bar 5 was a lower low breakout pullback, and it tried to form a double bottom with yesterday's low (to the penny). It led to a small wedge rally that formed a double top bear flag at bar 6.


双顶熊旗是开盘后第一波下跌之后常见的建仓形态，尤其是在个股里，而它后面常常跟着一段拖得很长的空头趋势，这段空头趋势又常常是一个趋势性交易区间空头。第6根K线那根信号K线是一根均线缺口K线。


> A double top bear flag is a common setup after an initial down move off the open, especially in stocks, and is often followed by a protracted bear trend that is frequently a trending trading range bear. The bar 6 signal bar was a moving average gap bar.


第7根K线是突破回调做空，尽管对当天低点的突破此时还没有走出来。这已经很接近了。它同时也是一次失败的双底回调、一个成功的双顶回调建仓形态，以及从第6根K线向下那条微型通道的突破失败。


> Bar 7 was a breakout pullback short even though the breakout of the low of the day had not yet developed. Close enough. It was also a failed double bottom pullback and a successful double top pullback setup, and a failed breakout of the micro channel down from bar 6.


第9根K线是从跌破昨天和今天低点形成的两段式突破回调。


> Bar 9 was a two-legged breakout pullback from breaking below yesterday's and today's lows.


昨天的全天多头趋势其实只是一面大型熊旗，而今天就是从它突破出来的那段空头趋势。今天是一个趋势性交易区间空头趋势日，一个从开盘开始的空头趋势日，也是一段跳空后的急速行情加通道空头趋势。


> Yesterday's daylong bull trend was actually just a large bear flag, and today was the bear trend that came from its breakout. Today was a trending trading range bear trend day, a trend from the open bear trend day, and a gap spike and channel bear trend.


![图 18.5](figures/fig-18-05.jpg)


**图 18.5　空头通道就是一面牛旗**


空头通道就是一面牛旗，在开盘时向上突破它之后，往往跟着一个突破回调的买入信号。如图 18.5 所示，昨天是一个强空头趋势日，但第4根K线突破了一条主要趋势线，说明市场可能在对第3根K线的低点做一次测试之后试着反转（通常是一次两段下跌）。可事态相反，市场以两段行情一路抛售到收盘。


> A bear channel is a bull flag, and a breakout above it on the open is often followed by a breakout pullback buy signal. As shown in Figure 18.5, yesterday was a strong bear trend day, but bar 4 broke above a major trend line, indicating that the market might try to reverse after a test of the bar 3 low (usually a two-legged drop). Instead, the market sold off in two legs into the close.


第8根K线突破了由第4根K线那波上涨行情画出的新的、更平缓的主要趋势线，随后在第9根K线处、也就是移动平均线处出现了一次小幅的两段式突破回调（两根空头趋势K线之间夹着一根多头趋势K线）。这次突破回调是一个更高的低点主要趋势反转，它带来了一段从开盘开始的多头趋势日。当头 5 到 10 根K线形成横盘区间时，许多机构会在区间突破处入场，而这次突破常常带来一个趋势日。更早入场风险更小，比如本例中在测试移动平均线的那根K线上方入场。


> Bar 8 broke above the new, flatter major trend line generated by the bar 4 rally and then had a small two-legged breakout pullback at the moving average at bar 9 (two bear trend bars separated by a bull trend bar). This breakout pullback, which was a higher low major trend reversal, led to a trend from the open bull trend day. When the first 5 to 10 bars form a sideways range, many institutions enter on the breakout of the range, and this breakout often leads to a trend day. There is less risk entering earlier, like above the moving average test bar in this case.


第10根K线是第三次向上推进（三个趋势性交易区间），所以预期会出现一次两段式回调。不过，上涨到第10根K线的通道很紧，因此在通道下方出现突破和两段式抛售之后，很可能会跟着一次对高点的测试。


> Bar 10 was the third push up (three trending trading ranges), so a two-legged pullback was expected. However, the channel up to bar 10 was tight, so the breakout and two-legged sell-off below the channel were likely to be followed by a test of the high.


第11根K线测试了先前那个交易区间的低点，它是太平洋标准时间上午 11:45 的一次急跌，目的是把多头挡在场外。它形成了一根均线缺口K线做多，同时也是高2，而这最后一段多头行情突破了第三个交易区间的顶部，并在收盘前延伸到接近一个向上的等距运动（跌到第11根K线那波抛售的高度的两倍）。


> Bar 11 tested the low of the prior trading range and was an 11:45 a.m. PST sharp move down to trap bulls out of the market. It formed a moving average gap bar long that was also a high 2, and this final bull leg broke out of the top of the third trading range and extended to almost a measured move up into the close (twice the height of the bar 10 to bar 11 sell-off).


这是一段急速行情加通道的多头趋势，它后面跟着一个双底牛旗（第11根K线，以及两小时前那个交易区间的底部），而它本身是一个从开盘开始的多头趋势日。


> This was a spike and channel bull trend that was followed by a double bottom bull flag (bar 11 and the bottom of the trading range from two hours earlier), and it was a trend from the open bull trend day.


![图 18.6](figures/fig-18-06.jpg)


**图 18.6　昨日的形态很重要**


前一天的形态几乎总会影响头一个小时。看图 18.6 时，别管这张图里那些极小的K线，把注意力放在概念上。


> Patterns from the prior day almost always influence the first hour. Looking at Figure 18.6, don't worry about the tiny bars in this chart and instead focus on the concepts.


第1根K线是一次急剧回调，用来测试昨天强劲的收盘，它很快就反转向上，在第1根K线这根回调K线的高点上方一个最小报价单位处形成了一次买入入场，随后又在当天第一根K线的高点上方给了第二次买入入场。


> Bar 1 was a sharp pullback to test yesterday's strong close, and it quickly reversed up, creating a buy entry at one tick above the high of the bar 1 pullback and again above the high of the first bar of the day.


第4根K线是一个突破回调做空的建仓形态。开盘在第3根K线的更低的高点之后走出一个更低的低点，主要趋势反转，而第4根K线形成了一个低2做空。


> Bar 4 was a breakout pullback short setup. The open generated a lower low after the bar 3 lower high, major trend reversal and bar 4 set up a low 2 short.


第5根K线是一次开盘反转，它跟在一次更低的低点主要趋势反转之后，测试的是昨天在空头趋势线突破之后形成的那个空头低点。今天开盘向上，随后下跌去测试那个更低的低点。第5根K线上方的突破回调入场实际上是一个高2，因为第5根K线是第二段下跌（昨天收盘是第一段），同时它与昨天的最后一根K线、以及当天早些时候形成的那个低点构成一个小双底。


> Bar 5 was an opening reversal that followed the lower low major trend reversal test of the bear low that formed yesterday after the bear trend line break. Today opened up and traded down to test that lower low. The breakout pullback entry above bar 5 was effectively a high 2 since bar 5 was the second leg down (yesterday's close was the first leg) and a small double bottom with both the final bar of yesterday and with the low that formed earlier that day.


第6根K线那个小小的更低的高点以及随后的趋势线突破，带来了一次突破回调做空。当天第一根K线在趋势线下方测试后反转向上，但这波上涨在第6根K线处失败了。


> The small bar 6 lower high and then trend line break resulted in a breakout pullback short. The first bar of the day tested below the trend line and reversed up, but the move up failed at bar 6.


第7根K线是一个楔形做多建仓形态（跌破空头趋势通道线和昨天低点的一次失败突破），而这个楔形出现在一条主要空头趋势线被突破之后。它是从跌破那条小趋势通道线之后向上反转。


> Bar 7 was a wedge long setup (a failed breakout below the bear trend channel line and below yesterday's low), and the wedge followed a break of a major bear trend line. It was a reversal up from the breakout below the small trend channel line.


第8根K线是从进入昨收时那波突破趋势线的行情之后的突破回调。那条空头通道是一面熊旗，所以第8根K线是一个突破回调做多的建仓形态。它也是昨天开盘那波强劲上涨之后一次大两段式回调的终点。在第8根K线这次突破回调的更高的低点之后，最容易的入场是第9根K线处的高2。


> Bar 8 was a breakout pullback from the break above the trend line going into yesterday's close. That bear channel was a bear flag, so bar 8 was a setup for a breakout pullback long. It was also the end of a large two-legged pullback after the strong rally on yesterday's open. The easiest entry after the bar 8 breakout pullback higher low was the high 2 at bar 9.


# 第 19 章　开盘形态与反转

*19. Opening Patterns and Reversals*


机构交易者在开盘前就有单子要成交，他们想以尽可能好的价格成交。举个例子，如果他们手上的单子大多是买单，而市场大幅低开、留下一个大缺口，只要他们觉得这个更低的开盘价是一份不会持续太久的好价钱，他们就会立刻买入。如果他们认为市场还会再跌一点，他们就会等更低的价位再买。如果市场反而跳空高开，他们可能会认定市场应该回调。一旦这么想，他们就没有动力现在买入，因为他们预期很快就能买得更低。这就制造出一段下跌真空，市场可以快速向下走，因为机构多头只是在等一个更有利的价位。他们无一例外都会等到市场来到某个支撑位，比如均线、趋势线、等距运动目标位，或者某个摆动高点或低点。如果有足够多的机构在买方出现订单失衡，而且他们都在差不多的位置开始买入，这场急速抛售就可能强力反转向上。这波抛售的原因，与其说是空头强，不如说是多头强——这些多头只是在等市场跌到某个支撑位，然后就一路不停地买，把空头彻底压垮。这就是真空效应：市场被快速抽低到一个有大量强势买盘在等着的价位。


> Institutional traders have orders to fill before the day opens, and they want to fill them at the best possible price. For example, if they have mostly buy orders and the market opens with a large gap down, they will buy immediately if they feel that the lower open represents a great value that won't last long. If they believe that the market will trade down a little, then they will wait to buy lower. If the market instead opens with a gap up, they might decide that the market should pull back. If that is their belief, there is no incentive for them to buy now because they expect that they will soon be able to buy lower. This creates a sell vacuum, and the market can move down quickly since the institutional bulls are simply waiting to buy at a more favorable price. Invariably, they will wait until the market reaches a support level like the moving average, a trend line, a measured move, or a swing high or low. If enough institutions have order imbalances to the buy side and if they all begin their buying at around the same level, the sharp sell-off can reverse up strongly. The sell-off wasn't as much due to strong bears as it was due to strong bulls who were simply waiting for the market to fall to a support level, whereupon they bought relentlessly and overwhelmed the bears. This is the vacuum effect; the market got sucked down quickly to a level where there were lots of strong buyers waiting.


在机构带着大量卖单进入开盘的日子，情况正好相反。往往会出现一段上涨真空，把市场快速抽上去，然后空头突然现身，把市场狠狠砸下去。他们从开盘起就看空，但如果他们相信市场会先涨到某个阻力位，那在市场到达他们认为不会再高的那个位置之前，他们会忍住不做空。如果他们觉得市场还会再涨一点，现在做空就说不通。到了那个位置，他们开始做空，把多头压垮。结果就是一次开盘反转下跌。


> The opposite happens on days when the institutions have a lot of sell orders going into the open. There will often be a buy vacuum that sucks the market up quickly and then suddenly the bears appear and drive the market down hard. They were bearish from the open, but if they believed that the market was going to trade up to some resistance level, they would refrain from shorting until the market reached the point where they thought that it would not go higher. It does not make sense for them to short if they think the market will go a little higher. At that point, they begin shorting and they overwhelm the bulls. The result is an opening reversal down.


这些急速的反转向上和反转向下都是开盘反转，常常会成为当天的高点或低点。如果交易者明白正在发生什么，不被「所有急速行情都只是急速行情、后面会跟着通道」这种想法骗住，他们就会准备好顺着反转做波段交易，有时还能把一部分仓位拿过当天的大部分时间。


> These sharp reversals up and down are opening reversals and often become either the high or the low of the day. If traders understand what is going on and do not get tricked into believing that all sharp moves are just spikes that will be followed by channels, they will be ready to swing trade on the reversal and sometimes can hold part of their position for most of the day.


虽然多数日子里都会有一次开盘反转、或者一段开盘即趋势的行情（这类行情做成至少两倍于风险回报的概率有 50% 到 60%），但初学者很难判断，在常常出现的那几个建仓形态里，哪一个才是最好的那个。任何建仓形态的准确概率都没法高度确定地知道，因为变量太多，开盘区间里的建仓形态尤其如此，不过我用的这些数字是合理的参考。多数日子里，开盘区间里都有好几个说得过去的反转，但它们只有大约 30% 的概率发展成回报至少两倍于风险的波段交易（尽管其中许多有大约 60% 的概率做出与风险一样大的回报）。另外，最早的那一次有时是最好的，但随后那几次反转常常会回调到入场价之外，把初学者吓得离场。初学者可以挑一个自己觉得强的去做，然后就只靠保护性止损、容忍回调，等最终的突破；也可以剥头皮赚一个与风险相等的回报，如果下一个反转建仓形态看起来不错，再反方向做一笔。多数交易者如果接下自己认为好的建仓形态，靠好保护性止损、容忍回调，只在反方向出现强信号时才出场，那他们变得盈利的机会更大。


> Although most days have an opening reversal or trend from the open where there is a 50 to 60 percent chance of making at least twice the size of the risk, beginners struggle to determine which of the often several setups is that best one. The exact probabilities of any setup cannot be known with a high degree of certainty because there are so many variables, and this is especially true of setups in the opening range, but the ones that I am using are reasonable guidelines. On most days, there are several reasonable reversals in the opening range, but they have only about a 30 percent chance of leading to a swing trade where the reward is at least twice as large as the risk (although many have about a 60 percent chance of making a reward that is as large as the risk). Also, the earliest is sometimes the best one, but the several reversals that follow often pull back beyond the entry price and scare beginners out of their positions. Beginners can either take one that they feel is strong and then simply rely on their protective stops and allow for pullbacks, waiting for the ultimate breakout, or they can scalp for a reward that is equal to their risk and then trade in the opposite direction if the next reversal setup looks good. Most traders have a better chance of becoming profitable if they take what they believe is a good setup, rely on their protective stops, and allow the pullbacks, exiting only if a strong signal in the opposite direction forms.


当天第一根K线有大约 20% 的概率成为任何市场的当日高点或低点。如果它是一根没有大影线的强趋势K线，这个概率是 30%。在 50% 的日子里，当日的高点或低点出现在头五根K线左右；在 90% 的日子里，它出现在前一两个小时内。尽管多数反转带来的利润都达不到风险的两倍，但如果交易者把它们当作波段来持有，多数最终只会变成剥头皮。盈利那几笔赚到的钱通常至少和亏损那几笔亏掉的钱一样多，偶尔出现的一笔大赚，就让这种做法值得一做。另一种做法是，交易者可以干脆只找回报至少和风险一样大的剥头皮机会。当日高点通常来自某种双顶，尽管那两个高点常常并不在同一个价位；当日低点通常来自双底。总的来说，如果这一天在不停反转，交易者应该等到出现双顶或双底，再去找波段交易。一旦这类形态形成，根据背景和建仓形态的不同，它有大约 40% 到 50% 的概率带来一笔波段交易，以及当天的一个极值。


> The first bar of the day has about a 20 percent chance of being either the high or the low of the day for all markets. If it is a strong trend bar without big tails, it has a 30 percent chance. Either the high or the low forms within the first five bars or so in 50 percent of days, and it forms within the first hour or two in 90 percent of days. Even though most reversals do not lead to a profit that is at least twice as large as the risk, if a trader held them for a swing, most would end up as scalps. The profits from the winning trades are usually at least as large as the losses from the losing trades, and the occasional big winner makes this approach worthwhile. Alternatively, a trader can simply look to scalp for a reward that is at least as large as the risk. The high of the day usually comes from some kind of double top, even though the two highs are often not at the same price, and the low of the day usually comes from a double bottom. In general, if the day is having reversals, a trader should wait until there is a double top or bottom before looking for a swing trade. Once one forms, it has about a 40 to 50 percent chance of leading to a swing, depending on the context and the setup, and an extreme of the day.


多数交易者应该下苦功，成为识别并交易最好开盘反转的专家，把这些波段交易当作自己交易的基石。比如，当 Emini 小型合约的平均波幅大约是 10 到 15 个点时，在一个看起来相当不错的开盘反转上（背景好、信号K线也说得过去的那种），做出一个 4 个点的波段波动的概率常常只有大约 40%（建仓形态非常强时可以达到 50% 到 60%）。不过，那个两个点的止损在止盈目标到达之前、或者在出现反转信号（交易者可以借它更小的亏损或一点小赚离场）之前就被打掉的概率，常常只有大约 30%。这就让这类交易的交易者等式非常有利。如果交易者在十笔交易里有四笔赚到 4 个点，这些波段交易就带来 16 个点的利润。如果他们再有三笔两个点或更少的亏损，加上三笔大约一到三个点的盈利，那么这些交易合计大约打平。交易者挑对建仓形态时，这是相当典型的结果。这样他在 10 笔交易上就有大约 16 个点的利润，平均每笔赚 1.6 个点，对日内交易者来说已经很好了。


> Most traders should work hard to become experts at spotting and trading the best opening reversals, and make these swing trades the cornerstone of their trading. For example, when the average range in the Emini is about 10 to 15 points, the probability of a four-point swing on a reasonably good-looking opening reversal (one where the context is good and there is a decent signal bar) is often only about 40 percent (it can be 50 to 60 percent when the setup is very strong). However, the chance of a two-point stop being hit before either the profit target is reached or a reversal signal develops, where the trader can exit with a smaller loss or a small profit, is often only about 30 percent. This makes the trader's equation very favorable for this type of trade. If traders win four points in four out of 10 trades, they have 16 points of profit off of their swing trades. If they then have maybe three losses of two points or less and three wins of about one to three points, they will end up about breakeven on those trades. This is fairly typical when a trader picks appropriate setups. The trader then has about 16 points of profit on 10 trades, and averages 1.6 points of profit per trade, which is good for a day trader.


如果没有出现反转，那段急速行情其实后面可能跟着一段通道，这一天就可能变成急速与通道趋势日。如果确实出现了反转，但它只持续了几根K线，随后又反转回急速行情的方向，那么这次反转尝试就失败了，变成了一个突破回调的建仓形态，后面通常会出现某种通道。举个例子，如果市场在当天头三根K线上强力上涨，随后却出现一根空头反转K线，许多交易者会反手在那根K线下方做空。不过，如果急速行情很强、反转K线很弱，更多交易者会假定这次反转尝试会失败。在任何回调中，他们都会把买入止损单挂在前一根K线的高点上方；如果没有回调，就挂在空头反转K线的高点上方。如果市场向上成交，这波小幅抛售就变成一次突破回调，反转尝试也就失败了。有些多头如果对上涨行情的强度特别有信心，会在反转K线处及其下方挂买入限价单。


> When there is not a reversal, the spike in fact can be followed by a channel and the day can become a spike and channel trend day. If there is a reversal, but it lasts for only a few bars and then reverses back in the direction of the spike, the reversal attempt has failed and has become a breakout pullback setup that will usually be followed by some type of channel. For example, if the market rallies up strongly on the first three bars of the day but then has a bear reversal bar, many traders will reverse to short below that bar. However, if the spike is strong and the reversal bar is weak, more traders will assume that the reversal attempt will fail. They will place buy stop orders above the high of the prior bar in any pullback, including the high of the bear reversal bar if there is no pullback. If the market trades up, the small sell-off becomes a breakout pullback and the reversal attempt will have failed. Some bulls will place buy limit orders at and below the reversal bar if they are especially confident of the strength of the up move.


开盘总会走向突破或反转，有时两者都有。除了跳空开盘之外，开盘时的常见形态与一天中其他任何时间出现的形态相同，包括：


> The open always leads to a breakout or a reversal, and sometimes to both. Other than gap openings, common patterns on the open are the same as patterns occurring at any other time of the day and include:


从开盘就开始的趋势——这在第一本书的第一部分讨论过。突破与反转——这里的反转就是突破失败。反转要找在支撑或阻力区域：均线、趋势线、趋势通道线、摆动高点与摆动低点（尤其是昨日的高点和低点）、突破区域、交易区间的顶部和底部，以及等距运动目标位。突破回调——一种没能让市场反转的突破失败。


> Trends from the open, which were discussed in Part I in the first book. Breakouts and reversals, which are failed breakouts. Look for reversals at support or resistance areas like the moving average, trend lines, trend channel lines, swing highs and lows (especially the high and low of yesterday), breakout areas, trading range tops and bottoms, and measured move targets. Breakout pullbacks (a failed breakout that failed to reverse the market).


多数日子里，当日的高点或低点在前一个小时左右形成。当天的一个极值一旦形成，市场就反转向着后来成为另一个极值的位置走。开盘即趋势的日子里显然没有反转，但市场仍朝着另一个极值推进，后者通常靠近当天收盘。开盘反转往往可以辨认出来，对波段交易来说可能是极好的机会。开盘后的第一波往往很快、点数很多，很难相信它会突然转向，可这种情况很常见。转折通常出现在某个关键位置：测试昨日的高点或低点，昨日或今日的摆动高点或低点，突破昨日或今日的某个交易区间，趋势线或趋势通道线，均线，或者上述任何一项出现在另一个时间级别图上、或 Globex 电子盘图上的版本。就算最好的建仓形态出现在 60 分钟图或日线图上，也几乎总会有价格行为上的理由，让人完全依据 5 分钟日盘图去做这笔交易——所以擅长读图的交易者只需要盯住自己交易用的那一张图。


> On most days, either the high or low of the day is formed within the first hour or so. Once one of the day's extremes is formed, the market reverses toward what will become the other extreme of the day. Obviously, there is no reversal on a trend from the open day, but the market still works toward the other extreme, which will usually be near the close of the day. The opening reversal is often recognizable and can be a great trading opportunity for a swing trade. The first move on the open is often fast and covers many points, and it is hard to believe that it could suddenly reverse direction, but this is a common occurrence. The turn is usually at some key point like a test of the high or low of yesterday, a swing high or low of yesterday or today, a breakout of a trading range of yesterday or today, a trend line or trend channel line, a moving average, or any of the above on a different time frame chart or on the Globex chart. Even if the best setup is on a 60 minute or daily chart, there will almost always be a price action reason to take the trade based entirely on the 5 minute day session chart, so traders adept at chart reading only need to watch the one chart that they are using for trading.


开盘最初的价格行为往往会暴露当天的性格。如果第一根K线是昨日收盘区间中部的一根十字星K线，那么这根K线本身就是一个单K线交易区间，当天走成交易区间的概率就增加了。如果头一个小时里有许多相互重叠的K线、带着大影线和多次反转，当天走成交易区间的概率同样会增加。相反，如果是跳空高开或跳空低开，随后头一个小时里出现一段三四根K线的空头急速行情，趋势K线又大、重叠很少、影线也小，那当天走成空头趋势日的概率就增加。交易者常常会在头一个小时左右寻找一对连续的多头趋势K线。如果出现了，交易者会把它看作市场处于始终做多状态的信号，至少值得做一笔剥头皮。也就是说，他们认为市场可能正处在一轮多头趋势的早期阶段。在后续行情足够多、让交易者相信可能出现某种等距运动之前，许多交易者会把大部分或全部仓位剥头皮了结。这造成了头一个小时左右常见的那些反转。反过来，如果出现的是连续几根强势空头趋势K线，他们就会假定市场处于始终做空状态，而且这一天正试图变成空头趋势日。比如，如果先有连续几根强势空头趋势K线，随后有一根K线跑到前一根K线高点之上，许多交易者会在这根回调K线的低点下方做空，做一笔剥头皮。如果背景合适，他们可能认为这次回调是一段大趋势的开始，于是把大部分或全部交易做成波段。


> The initial price action often reveals the character of the day. If the first bar is a doji bar in the middle of yesterday's closing range, then the bar is a one-bar trading range, and the odds of a trading range day are increased. If the first hour has many overlapping bars with big tails and multiple reversals, the odds of a trading range day are also increased. In contrast, if there is a gap up or down and then a three-or four-bar bear spike within the first hour and the trend bars are large with little overlap and only small tails, the odds of a bear trend day increase. Traders often look for a pair of consecutive bull trend bars in the first hour or so. If they are present, traders would see them as a sign that the market is always-in long, at least for a scalp. This means that they think that the market might be in the early stages of a bull trend. Until there is enough follow-through for traders to believe that a measured move of some kind is likely, many traders will scalp most or all of their position. This leads to the many reversals that are common in the first hour or so. If instead there were consecutive strong bear trend bars, they would assume that the market was always-in short and that the day was trying to become a bear trend day. For example, if there have been consecutive strong bear trend bars and then a bar trades above the high of the prior bar, many traders will short below the low of that pullback bar for a scalp. If the context is right, they might think that the pullback is the start of a large trend and they will swing most or all of their trade.


开盘区间常常给出当天会如何展开的线索，为当天余下的时间提供支撑和阻力，并带来等距运动目标位。开盘区间的顶部和底部几乎总是有好几种选法，所以它到底由哪几根K线构成、或者它要花多长时间形成，几乎永远不会有一致的看法。一般来说，它要么是交易区间的高度（如果有交易区间的话），要么是头 30 到 90 分钟里最大那段行情的高度。有时这段行情内部还包含两三段更小的行情，有时则会先有一次回调，随后短暂地出现一个更高的高点或更高的低点、或者更低的高点或更低的低点。如果出现了那个新极值，有些交易者会用它把开盘区间放大，另一些人则继续沿用原来的区间，把那个新极值看成一次没有意义的过靶。


> The opening range often gives clues to how the day will unfold, provides support and resistance for the rest of the day, and leads to measured move projections. There are almost always several choices for the top and bottom of the opening range, so there will rarely ever be perfect agreement as to the exact bars that contain it or the length of time that it takes to form. In general, it is the height of either the trading range, if there is one, or the largest leg of the first 30 to 90 minutes. Sometimes the leg will have two or three smaller legs within it, and sometimes there will be a pullback and then a brief higher high or low or lower high or low. If there is that new extreme, some traders will use that to enlarge the opening range, and others will continue to use the original range and will view the new extreme as a meaningless overshoot.


把开盘区间的大小分成三类会很有帮助。如果它的高度只有近几天日波幅的大约 25%，交易者就会在区间朝任一方向突破时入场。一个月里会有那么两三次，这一天变成开盘即趋势日，回调很小，推进不停。


> It is helpful to classify the size of the opening range into three categories. If the range is only about 25 percent of the size of the range of recent days, traders will enter on a breakout of the range in either direction. A couple of times a month, this will become a trend from the open day with small pullbacks and relentless progression.


如果开盘区间大约是近几天日波幅的三分之一到一半，交易者就会假定这个区间会扩大到接近平均一天的幅度。这一天通常先有一段交易区间活动，然后向上或向下突破。大约三分之二的时候，它会变成趋势日，而且通常是趋势性交易区间日，不过任何类型的趋势日都有可能。突破通常会走到一个大约基于开盘区间高度的等距运动目标位。当天晚些时候，市场通常会回来测试突破点，随后又常常重新突破回先前的区间里。如果回到开盘区间的那次反转很强，市场收在那个更早区间的另一侧，这一天就成了反转日。事实上，这就是反转日最常见的形成方式。另外三分之一的情况里，市场只是稍微越过开盘区间，然后反转、从区间的另一侧突破出去，接着又回到区间之内。这种情况出现时，这一天通常变成一个小型交易区间日，但有时那第二次突破也能带来反方向的趋势性交易区间日。


> If the opening range is about a third to a half the size of the range of recent days, traders will assume that the range will grow to about the size of an average day. The day will usually have some trading range activity and then break out up or down. About two-thirds of the time it will become a trend day, which will usually be a trending trading range day, although any type of trend day is possible. The breakout will typically reach about a measured move based on the height of the opening range. It will usually come back and test the breakout point later in the day, and it often then breaks back into the earlier range. If the reversal back into the opening range is strong and the market closes at the opposite side of that earlier range, the day becomes a reversal day. This is in fact the most common way that reversal days form. In the other third of cases, the day just trades a little beyond the opening range, then reverses and breaks out of the opposite side of the range, and then trades back into the range. When this happens, the day usually becomes a small trading range day, but sometimes that second breakout can lead to a trending trading range day in the opposite direction.


第三种可能是开盘后那一波走势很大。这通常是因为一段强势的急速行情，这一天往往变成急速与通道趋势日，但有时它也会带来一次高潮反转，通常是在一面小小的最终旗形之后。


> The third possibility is when the opening move is large. This is usually due to a strong spike and the day often becomes a spike and channel trend day, but sometimes it leads to a climactic reversal, usually after a small final flag.


有一点很重要，必须认出来：如果市场在开盘时走出一段强势行情，随后反转，那段最初的强势行情说明的是强势，它当天晚些时候可能会再回来。比如，如果市场在当天头四根K线上强烈下跌，随后反转向上进入一段强势多头趋势，你应该记住开头那段空头趋势，不要假定多头会一直控制市场到收盘。那段最初的下跌强势说明，空头早些时候愿意激进地做空市场，而且尽管后来有多头趋势，他们当天晚些时候可能还会再找一次机会。所以，如果多头趋势中出现一次强势修正，别忽略另一种可能：这可能是又一次趋势转换正在发生，这一次是转回空头趋势。


> An important point to recognize is that if the market makes a strong move on the open and then reverses, that initial strong move indicates strength, and it may return later in the day. For example, if the market sells off strongly for the first four bars of the day and then reverses up into a strong bull trend, you should remember the initial bear trend and not assume that the bulls will control the market until the close. That initial downside strength indicates that bears were willing to aggressively short the market earlier in the day and may look for another opportunity later in the day, despite the bull trend. So if there is a strong correction in the bull trend, do not ignore the possibility that it could be another trend change taking place, this time back to a bear trend.


头一个小时的形态与当天后面的形态相同，但反转往往更猛烈，趋势也倾向于持续得更久。要让交易利润最大化，一个重要的关键是：把任何可能成为当日高点或低点的仓位拿一部分做波段。如果这笔交易看起来特别强，就把整个仓位都做成波段，并在交易走出初始风险一到两倍之后，先对三分之一到一半的仓位止盈。如果你买入的位置可能是当日低点，初始止损设在信号K线下方、也就是入场价下方大约三个点处，那么在 2 到 4 个点左右先平掉大约四分之一到一半，也许在 4 到 6 个点再平掉另外四分之一到一半。另一种做法是不用固定的限价单，而是在赚到 2 个点之后的第一次停顿处平掉一些，在 4 个点之后的第一次停顿处再平掉一些。剩下的合约继续持有，直到出现明确而强烈的反向信号，或者保本止损被打掉。每一个顺趋势的建仓形态都考虑加仓，比如强趋势中回调到均线的两段式回调。对这些追加的合约，把大部分或全部仓位剥头皮了结，但继续留一些合约做波段。


> The patterns in the first hour are the same as those later in the day, but the reversals are often more violent and the trends tend to last longer. An important key to maximizing trading profits is to swing part of any position that could be a high or a low of the day. If the trade looks particularly strong, swing all of the position and take partial profits on a third to a half after the trade has run one to two times your initial risk. If you bought what you think could be the low of the day and your initial stop was below the signal bar, which was about three points below your entry price, take about a quarter to half off at around two to four points and maybe another quarter to half off at four to six points. Alternatively, instead of using fixed limit orders, take some off at the first pause after two points of profit and some more off at the first pause after four points. Hold the remaining contracts until there is a clear and strong opposite signal or until your breakeven stop is hit. Look to add to your position at every with-trend setup, like a two-legged pullback to the moving average in a strong trend. For these additional contracts, scalp most or all of the position, but continue to swing some contracts.


有些反转起步很安静，只沿着很轻微的倾斜趋势走很多根K线，看起来不过是旧趋势里的又一面旗形，可随后市场强力突破，进入反方向的趋势。比如，一面熊旗可以向上突破，市场也就可能反转成多头趋势。另一些反转从入场K线起就有很强的动能。对所有可能性都保持开放，尽量接下每一个信号，尤其是在信号很强的时候。困难之一是，反转往往很急，交易者可能没有足够时间说服自己相信一个反转建仓形态真的能带来反转。不过，如果信号K线是一根强趋势K线，成功的把握就不错，你必须做这笔交易。如果你觉得自己需要更多时间评估这个建仓形态，至少先做半仓或四分之一仓，因为这笔交易可能突然又远又快地跑出去，你需要参与在里面，哪怕仓位很小。然后再找第一次回调加仓。


> Some reversals start quietly, trend only slightly for many bars, and appear to be just another flag in the old trend, but then the market forcefully breaks into an opposite trend. For example, a bear flag can break out to the upside and the market could reverse into a bull trend. Other reversals have strong momentum from the entry bar. Be open to all possibilities and try to take every signal, especially if it is strong. One of the difficulties is that reversals often are sharp and traders might not have enough time to convince themselves that a reversal setup could actually lead to a reversal. However, if there is a strong trend bar for the signal bar, the chances of success are good and you must take the trade. If you feel like you need more time to assess the setup, at least take a half or a quarter position because the trade might suddenly move very far very fast and you need to be involved, even if in only a small way. Then look to add on at the first pullback.


与属于反转形态的双底回调不同，双底牛旗是一个持续形态，它在多头趋势已经开始之后才形成。从功能上说，它和双底回调是一回事，因为两者都是买入的建仓形态。


> Unlike a double bottom pullback that is a reversal pattern, a double bottom bull flag is a continuation pattern that develops after the bull trend has already begun. Functionally, it is the same as a double bottom pullback, since both are buy setups.


双顶熊旗也是如此：它是既有空头趋势中的持续形态，而不是像双顶回调那样的反转形态。不过两者都是做空的建仓形态。在一段强势下跌和一次回调之后，空头趋势恢复，随后市场再次回调到与第一次回调大致相同的位置。这个交易区间就是双顶熊旗，是一个做空的入场建仓形态。多数时候，第二次回调会略低于第一次，这在空头趋势里是意料之中的（每一个摆动高点都倾向于低于前一个）。入场用止损单，挂在建仓形态那根K线下方一个最小报价单位处。


> The same is true for a double top bear flag, which is a continuation pattern in an ongoing bear trend and not a reversal pattern, like the double top pullback. Both, however, are short setups. After a strong down move and a pullback, the bear trend resumes, and then the market pulls back again to about the same level as the first pullback. This trading range is a double top bear flag, and it is a short entry setup. More often than not, the second pullback will be slightly below the first, as would be expected in a bear trend (each swing high tends to be below the prior one). The entry is on a stop at one tick below the setup bar.


有时市场在头三到 10 根K线左右形成一个交易区间，其间有两次或更多次反转。如果这个区间与日均波幅相比很小，突破就很可能出现。第一根K线之后，如果既有向上反转又有向下反转，有些交易者会在这个小区间突破时入场，去找一段等距运动。交易者可以在区间突破时入场，但如果他们能在区间顶部或底部对小K线做反向操作，风险会更小；或者等突破之后，在突破失败或突破回调时入场，就跟对待任何交易区间一样。


> Sometimes the market forms a trading range in the first three to 10 bars or so, with two or more reversals. If the range is small compared to the average daily range, a breakout is likely. After the first bar, if there is both a reversal up and a reversal down, some traders will enter a breakout of this small range, looking for a measured move. Traders could enter on a breakout from the range, but the risk is smaller if they are able to fade small bars at the top or bottom of the range, or wait until after the breakout and enter on a failed breakout or a breakout pullback, just as they would with any trading range.


![图 19.1](figures/fig-19-01.jpg)


**图 19.1　小幅开盘区间突破之后的等距运动**


当开盘区间大约是近几天日波幅的一半时，市场通常会突破开盘区间，并试图把这段幅度大致翻倍。有时开盘区间有很多种选法。哪一种才对？通常都对，因为不同的交易者会依据不同的选法做决定；但在图 19.1 展示的这一天，没有一种选法给出精确的止盈指南或反转指南。多数支撑位，比如等距运动目标位，并不会带来反转，因为市场有惯性，因而强烈倾向于继续做它一直在做的事。这意味着多数反转尝试都会失败。不过，市场最终反转时，总是在某个支撑位上。如果支撑位上出现强势反转建仓形态，它更有可能带来一笔盈利的交易。到第5根K线时，当天的波幅仍只有近几天平均波幅的一半左右，所以概率偏向于波幅明显扩大。随着每一次新的反转，开盘区间不断扩大，但跌向第6根K线的那波抛售很强，所以这次突破很可能带来一段大致等距的下跌。


> When the opening range is about half the size of the range of recent days, the market usually has a breakout of the opening range and an attempt to approximately double it. Sometimes there are many choices for the opening range. Which one is right? They all usually are because different traders will make decisions based on different ones, but on the day shown in Figure 19.1 none led to a precise guide for profit taking or reversals. Most support levels, like measured move projections, do not lead to reversals, because the market has inertia and therefore a strong tendency to continue to do what it has been doing. This means that most reversal attempts fail. However, when the market finally reverses, it is always at a support level. If there is a strong reversal setup at a support level, it is more likely to lead to a profitable trade. By bar 5, the range of the day was still only about half the average range of recent days, so the odds favored a significant increase in the range. With each new reversal, the opening range expanded, but the sell-off down to bar 6 was strong, so the breakout was likely to lead to an approximate measured move down.


这一天变成了趋势性交易区间日，并在收盘前重新突破回上面的区间，这种情况很常见。在这里，当天收在上方区间顶部附近，成了一个反转日。多数反转日一开始都是趋势性交易区间日。如果交易者明白这一点，就可以把从下方区间底部反转向上那一波中的一部分仓位做成波段。


> The day became a trending trading range day and broke back into the upper range at the end of the day, which is common. Here, the day closed near the top of the upper range and became a reversal day. Most reversal days begin as trending trading range days. If traders understand this, they can look to swing part of their trade off the reversal up from the bottom of the lower range.


头一个小时左右的反转里，只有大约 25% 能做成波段，所以更好的做法是剥头皮，直到出现双底或双顶、或者一个明确的始终入场建仓形态——那时做波段的概率才够好。今天就是一个普通的日子，开头好多个建仓形态都只够剥头皮。第3根K线与第1根K线构成双顶，因此有大约 50% 的概率成为当日高点。它同时还是到均线的一次突破回调。第4根K线与第2根K线构成双底，有 50% 的概率成为当日低点。两者都不是今天的高点或低点。90% 的日子里，当日高点或低点在前几个小时之内就出现，而且它通常来自某种双顶或双底。第5根K线与第3根K线构成双顶，又是一个小型楔形顶和一根均线缺口K线，它成了当日高点。


> Only about 25 percent of reversals in the first hour or so result in swings, so it is better to scalp until there is either a double bottom or top or a clear always-in setup, where the odds are good for a swing. Today was an ordinary day where the first many setups were only scalps. Bar 3 was a double top with bar 1 and therefore had about a 50 percent chance of being the high of the day. It was also a breakout pullback to the moving average. Bar 4 was a double bottom with bar 2 and had a 50 percent chance of being the low of the day. Neither was the high or low of today. The high or low occurs within the first couple of hours in 90 percent of the days, and it usually comes from some type of double top or bottom. Bar 5 formed a double top with bar 3, a small wedge top, and a moving average gap bar, and it became the high of the day.


在散户投资者还占日常成交量更大比例的时候，他们对开盘缺口和开盘反转的贡献更多——他们在开盘前根据日线图下单。比如，如果出现一根多头反转K线，交易者会在收盘后看到它，然后在开盘前下单，在那根K线的高点上方买入。他们太怕错过这笔买入，以至于愿意在开盘时就买进，哪怕买在那根K线高点之上。这常常导致市场跳空高开，好找到足够多的卖家愿意接下这笔交易的另一边。这些过分急切的买家以抬高的价格成交之后，市场会跌到机构认为有价值的位置。机构于是大量买入，把市场反转推上新高，造出开盘多头反转。开盘时那波短暂的小幅抛售，在日线图上的多头趋势K线底部留下一根下影线，这在多头趋势日很常见。空头日之后则相反：绝望的多头太急于在开盘时出场，以至于愿意在当天第一笔成交里就卖出。市场往往不得不跳空低开，好找到足够多的买家。他们的卖单成交之后，市场会涨到机构觉得做空有价值的位置，这又把市场反转压回当日新低，常常造出一个空头趋势日。


> When retail investors controlled a bigger part of the daily volume, they contributed more to opening gaps and reversals by placing orders before the open, based on the daily chart. For example, if there was a bull reversal bar, traders would see that after the close and place orders before the open to buy above the high of that bar. They were so afraid of missing the buy that they were willing to buy on the open, even if they bought above the high of the bar. This often resulted in the market gapping up to find enough sellers willing to take the other side of the trade. Once these overly eager buyers were filled at the inflated price, the market would trade down to where the institutions thought there was value. They then bought heavily, reversing the market up to a new high, creating the opening bull reversal. The small, brief sell-off on the open creates a tail on the bottom of the bull trend bar on the daily chart, which is common on bull trend days. The opposite happened after bear days where desperate longs were so eager to exit on the open that they were willing to sell the first trade of the day. The market often had to gap down to find enough buyers. Once their sell orders were filled, the market traded up to where institutions felt there was value in selling, and this reversed the market back down to a new low of the day, often creating a bear trend day.


![图 19.2](figures/fig-19-02.jpg)


**图 19.2　开盘区间的大小很重要**


如图 19.2 所示，开盘区间的大小常常给出当天晚些时候会发生什么的线索。这张 Freeport-McMoRan（FCX）5 分钟图上的开盘区间，只有近几天日均波幅的大约四分之一。几根K线之后，当交易者看到这个区间可能很小，多数人会忽略第一根K线，然后去找一段向上急速行情和一段向下急速行情。市场一跌破第3根K线，第3根K线就成了向上急速行情（一次反转下跌）。市场一涨过第4根K线，第4根K线就成了向下急速行情（一次反转上涨）。到那时，许多交易者把这两段急速行情当作突破模式建仓形态，在顶部那段急速行情上方一个最小报价单位处挂买入止损单，在底部那段急速行情下方一个最小报价单位处挂卖出止损单。其中一张单子成交后，另一张就成了初始保护性止损。如果入场之后市场反向走，交易者常常会把保护性止损的幅度翻倍，并打算在止损被打掉时反手。


> As shown in Figure 19.2, the size of the opening range often gives a clue to what will happen later in the day. The opening range on this 5 minute chart of Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) was about a quarter of the average daily range of recent days. After several bars, when traders saw that the range might be small, most would have ignored the first bar and then looked for a spike up and a spike down. As soon as the market traded below bar 3, it became a spike up (a reversal down). Once the market traded above bar 4, it became a spike down (a reversal up). At that point, many traders treated those two spikes as a breakout mode setup and placed buy stops at one tick above the top spike and sell stops at one tick below the bottom spike. Once one order is filled, the other becomes the initial protective stop. If after entering, the market reverses direction, a trader will often double the size of the protective stop and plan to reverse the position if the stop is hit.


交易者常常可以在突破之前就入场。比如这里，开盘大幅高开、留下一个大缺口（陡峭的均线说明了这一点），第一根K线又是一根多头趋势K线，所以当天成为多头趋势日的可能性不小。第4根K线从一次跌破第2根K线 ii形态、幅度只有一个最小报价单位的突破中反转向上之后，许多交易者在第4根K线这根双底牛旗信号K线上方做多（记住，当日低点常常来自某种双底）。另一些人在第5根K线涨过那根小空头内包K线的第一时间买入，还有人是在突破第3根K线时买入。


> Traders can often enter before the breakout. Here, for example, there was a large gap up open (the steep moving average shows this) and a bull trend bar for the first bar, so there was a good chance of a bull trend day. Once bar 4 reversed up from a one-tick breakout below the bar 2 ii pattern, many traders went long above the bar 4 double bottom bull flag signal bar (remember, the low of the day often comes from a double bottom of some type). Others bought as soon as bar 5 went above the small bear inside bar, and others bought on the breakout above bar 3.


开盘区间像这样小的时候，区间内的回调也小；而当天突破并趋势运行时，回调往往仍然很小，就像这里一样。最后两个小时里通常会有一次回调，其大小约为先前那些回调的两倍——从第14根K线开始的那波抛售就是这样。


> When the opening range is small like this, the pullbacks within that range are small; and when the day breaks out and trends, the pullbacks often remain small, as they did here. There is usually a pullback in the final couple of hours that is about twice the size of the earlier pullbacks, and that happened on the sell-off from bar 14.


交易者常常在头一个小时里寻找两根连续的趋势K线，一旦出现，许多交易者就断定市场有了一个始终入场方向。比如，第2根K线处有两根连续的多头趋势K线。由于它们实体小、影线大，多数交易者需要更多验证，才敢断定始终入场方向是向上。这个验证来自第4根K线之后那两根多头趋势K线。到那时，许多交易者假定始终入场方向向上，于是把多单做成波段，止损放在那两根K线构成的急速行情底部下方。第5根K线是一根强势的多头突破K线，进一步证明当天是多头趋势日；随后出现的几根多头实体又给出了更多证据。注意，第4根K线之前有三根空头趋势K线，而每一根后面都跟着一根带多头实体的K线。空头没能造出后续下跌行情，这说明他们很弱。多头把每一根这样的空头趋势K线都看成买入机会，而不是做空的建仓形态，这是市场很可能向上的强证据，尤其是在大幅跳空高开的日子里。


> Traders often look for two consecutive trend bars in the first hour, and when they are present, many traders conclude that the market has an always-in position. For example, there were consecutive bull trend bars at bar 2. Since their bodies were small and the tails were large, most traders needed more verification before concluding that the always-in direction was up. This came with the two bull trend bars that followed bar 4. At that point, many traders assumed that the always-in direction was up and they therefore were swinging longs with a stop below the bottom of the two-bar spike. Bar 5 was a strong bull breakout bar and further evidence that the day was a bull trend day, and the several bull bodies that followed gave additional evidence. Notice that there were three bear trend bars before bar 4 and each was followed by a bar with a bull body. The bears were unable to create follow-through selling, which meant that they were weak. The bulls saw each of those bear trend bars as buying opportunities instead of sell setups, and this was strong evidence that the market was likely to go up, especially on a day with a large gap up.


![图 19.3](figures/fig-19-03.jpg)


**图 19.3　开盘时的突破回调**


如图 19.3 所示，谷歌（GOOG）在这四天的开盘时段出现了好几次突破回调。第1根K线是在陡峭均线处的一个低2做空，它把昨日低点下方的缺口补掉、还多跌了 6 美分，随后建立了一次向下的反转，形成了当日高点。


> As shown in Figure 19.3, Google (GOOG) had several breakout pullbacks on the opens of these four days. Bar 1 was a low 2 short at the steep moving average and closed the gap below yesterday's low by 6 cents, setting up a reversal down that formed the high of the day.


第2根K线是突破昨日某个摆动高点之后对均线的一次回调。做多的建仓形态是那个多头 ii形态。第2根K线那根多头K线之后的那根K线，与当天第一根K线构成双顶，成了当日高点。


> Bar 2 was a moving average pullback after breaking above a swing high from yesterday. The bull ii pattern was the setup for the long. The bar after the bar 2 bull bar formed a double top with the first bar of the day, and this was the high of the day.


第3根K线是一次向上反转（一次突破失败），来自跌破那段进入昨日收盘的上涨行情的多头趋势线。第4根K线是一个更高的低点，并与第3根K线构成一个大致的双底。


> Bar 3 was a reversal up (a failed breakout) from breaking the bull trend line from the rally into the prior day's close. Bar 4 was a higher low and an approximate double bottom with bar 3.


第5根K线是一个高2双底牛旗（第一个底部在两根K线之前），同时也是突破昨日高点之后的第一次回调。这一天本可能变成开盘即趋势日。


> Bar 5 was a high 2 double bottom bull flag (the first bottom was two bars earlier) that also was the first pullback after the breakout above yesterday's high. This could have turned into a trend from the open day.


![图 19.4](figures/fig-19-04.jpg)


**图 19.4　开盘初期的突破失败**


如图 19.4 所示，苹果（AAPL）在这三天的开盘时段出现了好几次突破失败，它们带来了开盘反转。第1根K线是针对趋势通道线过靶之后开盘反转的一笔二次入场（低2）。


> As shown in Figure 19.4, Apple (AAPL) had several failed breakouts on the open during these three days, and they led to opening reversals. Bar 1 was a second entry (low 2) for an opening reversal off a trend channel line overshoot.


第2根K线是一次向下反转，来自对昨日最后一小时那个交易区间上方的突破（一次突破失败），以及对进入昨日收盘的那条空头趋势线（图中未显示）的突破。随后市场从均线处反转向上，形成了第3根K线这个更高的低点，它同时是一次突破回调。


> Bar 2 was a reversal down from a breakout (a failed breakout) above the trading range in the final hour of the prior day and of the bear trend line (not shown) going into the close of the prior day. The market then reversed up from the moving average, forming the bar 3 higher low, which was also a breakout pullback.


第4根K线是在一个当时还算不上多头趋势日的日子里，从一个更高的高点向下反转，因此是一笔好的做空。它同时呈楔形，并且是开盘那段缺口急速行情上涨之后通道的顶部。


> Bar 4 was a reversal down from a higher high on a day that was not yet a bull trend day, and therefore a good short. It also had a wedge shape and was the top of a channel after the gap spike up on the open.


第6根K线是一次更低的高点最终旗形向下反转，发生在第5根K线跌破多头通道之后。交易者预期会去测试通道的第3根K线底部。


> Bar 6 was a lower high final flag reversal down after the bar 5 break below the bull channel. Traders expected a test of the bar 3 bottom of the channel.


第7根K线是大跳空高开日子里的一次高2突破回调，但市场在第8根K线这个更高的高点、也是最终旗形突破处反转下跌。由于此时这一天还不算多头趋势日，所以这是一笔好的做空。


> Bar 7 was a high 2 breakout pullback in a day with a large gap up, but the market reversed back down at the bar 8 higher high and final flag breakout. Since this was not a bull trend day at this point, this was a good short.


第9根K线是个新低，但它带着很强的动能，使第二段下跌行情很可能出现。那个向上的缺口是一段多头急速行情，从第8根K线到第9根K线的走势则是一段空头急速行情。这是一个高潮反转建仓形态，之后跟着一个交易区间，这种情况很常见。交易区间期间，多头和空头都在加仓，想换来一段通道形式的后续行情。空头赢了，多头不得不卖掉自己的多单，这又加大了卖压。


> Bar 9 was a new low, but it came with strong momentum, making a second leg down likely. The gap up was a bull spike, and the move from bar 8 to bar 9 was a bear spike. This was a climactic reversal setup and was followed by a trading range, as is often the case. During the trading range, both the bulls and the bears were adding to their positions in an attempt to get follow-through in the form of a channel. The bears won and the bulls had to sell out of their longs, adding to the selling pressure.


第10根K线是一个低2，也是一个两段式的更低的高点。第11根K线是基于第10根K线那个更低的高点之后高2失败而成的做空二次入场。多头两次试图扭转这个更低的高点所隐含的空头含义，两次都失败了。市场尝试做某件事两次、两次都失败时，它通常就会往反方向走。


> Bar 10 was a low 2 and a two-legged lower high. Bar 11 was a second entry into the short based on a failed high 2 after the bar 10 lower high. The bulls made two attempts to reverse the bearish implications of the lower high and they failed twice. When the market tries to do something twice and it fails both times, it usually will go in the opposite direction.


![图 19.5](figures/fig-19-05.jpg)


**图 19.5　跳空低开与跳空高开都可能带来开盘上涨行情**


如图 19.5 所示，第4根K线是一根强空头反转K线，也是强空头趋势中对均线的一次测试，为跌破第1根K线那次突破建立了一个突破回调的做空机会。那段涨到均线的向上缺口，就是这次回调。


> As shown in Figure 19.5, bar 4 was a strong bear reversal bar and a moving average test in a strong bear trend, setting up a breakout pullback short for the breakout below bar 1. The gap up to the moving average was the pullback.


从第2根K线到第3根K线的走势是一段急速与通道的空头趋势，第4根K线是在通道顶部附近的一次测试。这种测试之后往往跟着交易区间式的价格行为。另外，那个向上的缺口突破了昨日最后一小时那条陡峭的空头趋势线，多头当时在找一个突破回调的做多建仓形态。当多头和空头都有说得通的理由时，就存在不确定性，而不确定性通常意味着市场正处在一个交易区间的开端，就像这里的情况。


> The move from bar 2 to bar 3 was a spike and channel bear trend, and bar 4 was a test near the top of the channel. The test is often followed by trading range price action. Also, the gap up broke above the steep bear trend line of the final hour of yesterday, and bulls were looking for a breakout pullback long setup. When there are reasonable arguments for both the bulls and the bears, there is uncertainty, and uncertainty usually means that the market is at the start of a trading range, as it was here.


第5根K线不是一根反转K线，而是突破昨日空头通道之后的一次突破回调，也是一个高2的变体（第4根K线是空头K线，之后有一根多头K线，然后又形成一小段下跌到第5根K线）。在收盘高潮之后，这可能是一个更高的低点；而在一次高潮之后（进入收盘的那段强势空头几乎没有任何回调，既然它很可能无法持续，因此就是高潮行情），往往会出现一段两段式的逆势行情。第5根K线之后那根多头趋势K线，与第5根K线、它前面那根空头K线、还有从第4根K线下来的那波下跌，共同构成一次两K线反转。记住，像那根多头趋势K线那样，先急速下跌、再急速上涨，就是一次卖出高潮——在更高的时间级别图上它是一次两K线反转，在更高一级的时间级别图上则是一根多头反转K线。


> Bar 5 was not a reversal bar, but was a breakout pullback from the break above yesterday's bear channel, and a high 2 variant (bar 4 was a bear bar, there was then a bull bar, and then a second small leg formed down to bar 5). This was a possible higher low after a climactic close, and after a climax (the strong bear into the close had virtually no pullbacks, and since it was likely not sustainable, it was therefore climactic) there is often a two-legged countertrend move. The bull trend bar that followed bar 5 was a two-bar reversal with both bar 5 and the bear bar before it, and with the move down from bar 4. Remember, a sharp move down followed by a sharp move up, like that bull trend bar, is a sell climax, which is a two-bar reversal on a higher time frame chart and a bull reversal bar on an even higher time frame chart.


第8根K线是一个楔形顶，也是从第5根K线这个更高的低点起来的两段式上涨。


> Bar 8 was a wedge top and a two-legged move up from the bar 5 higher low.


这一天是趋势性交易区间日，从第20根K线起来的那波上涨，测试了上面那个更早的交易区间的底部。


> The day was a trending trading range day, and the rally up from bar 20 tested the bottom of the earlier upper trading range.


第24根K线是一个双底牛旗。第一个底部是第20根K线，或者是第18根K线那个低点之后的内包信号K线。它同时也是在测试昨日低点、以及对从第18根K线到第23根K线这段大型两段式熊旗突破失败之后的向上反转。


> Bar 24 was a double bottom bull flag. The first bottom was bar 20 or the inside signal bar following the bar 18 low. It was also a reversal up from a test of yesterday's low and a failed breakout of the large two-legged bear flag from bar 18 to bar 23.


第25根K线是当天头 30 分钟里的一根强外包上涨K线，于是交易者认为始终入场方向可能已经转为做多。他们希望任何回调都停在第25根K线的低点之上；当第26根K线转头向上时，他们认为当日低点可能已经出现。


> Bar 25 was a strong outside up bar in the first 30 minutes of the day, so traders thought that the always-in position might have become long. They wanted any pullback to stay above the bar 25 low, and when bar 26 turned up, they thought that the low of the day could be in.


第26根K线是一个更高的低点，并让市场从 ii形态建仓形态向上突破。ii形态的第二根K线收出强势的多头收盘，这增加了向上走的可能性。它同时是熊旗里一个失败的低2，把那些看到大幅跳空低开、又在二次入场处做空（低2缺口回调）的空头套住了。这是一面小型最终熊旗。它是对跌破昨日低点那次尝试的第二次反向尝试，也是在跳空跌破昨日那面两段式熊旗之后向上反转的第二次尝试。


> Bar 26 was a higher low and led to a breakout from an ii setup. The second bar of the ii pattern had a strong bull close, which increased the chances of a move up. It was also a failed low 2 in a bear flag, which trapped bears who saw the big gap down and shorted the second entry (low 2 gap pullback). This was a small final bear flag. It was a second attempt to reverse the attempt to move below yesterday's low and a second attempt to reverse back up after gapping below yesterday's two-legged bear flag.


![图 19.6](figures/fig-19-06.jpg)


**图 19.6　跳空开盘后的两段式回调**


大幅低开留下缺口之后，常常会有一段两段式回调到均线，然后突破进入空头趋势，如图 19.6 所示。


> A large gap down often has a two-legged pullback to the moving average and then a breakout into a bear trend, as seen in Figure 19.6.


第2根和第3根K线在低开缺口很大的一天里构成了一面双顶熊旗（那个缺口就是旗杆），并与第1根K线一起构成一个三角形（三个顶部、且形态在收敛，就是三角形）。


> Bars 2 and 3 formed a double top bear flag on a big gap down day (the gap was the flagpole), and a triangle with bar 1 (three tops and a contracting pattern is a triangle).


第3根K线是一次两K线反转的第一根，也是一个低2做空建仓形态。在第3根K线之后那根空头K线下方做空，比在第3根K线这根多头趋势K线下方做空更安全，因为市场很可能横盘之后再次尝试突破第1根和第2根K线构成的双顶。在交易区间顶部、在一根空头K线下方做空，比在一根多头趋势K线下方做空更可靠。


> Bar 3 was the first bar of a two-bar reversal, and a low 2 short setup. It was safer to short below the bear bar that followed bar 3 rather than shorting below the bar 3 bull trend bar, because there was too much risk that the market might go sideways and then make another attempt to break out above the bars 1 and 2 double top. Shorting below a bear bar at the top of a trading range is more reliable than shorting below a bull trend bar.


虽然多数交易者认为开盘区间只持续一两个小时，但市场常常在太平洋标准时间上午 8:30 前后启动一段趋势，这里就是如此。第3根K线那个双顶到底应该算作开盘反转、还是只算一个双顶，并不重要。重要的是，趋势常常在上午 8:30 前后启动或反转。


> Although most traders think of the opening range as lasting only an hour or two, the market often begins a trend around 8:30 a.m. PST, as it did here. Whether the bar 3 double top should be considered to be an opening reversal or just a double top is irrelevant. What is important is that a trend often begins or reverses around 8:30 a.m.


![图 19.7](figures/fig-19-07.jpg)


**图 19.7　双底牛旗与双顶熊旗**


如图 19.7 所示，双底牛旗和双顶熊旗很常见。在上涨到第2根K线之后，第3根和第4根K线构成一面大型双底牛旗。在强势下跌到第5根K线之后，第6根和第7根K线构成一面双顶熊旗。


> As shown in Figure 19.7, double bottom bull flags and double top bear flags are common. Bars 3 and 4 formed a large double bottom bull flag after the rally to bar 2. Bars 6 and 7 formed a double top bear flag after the strong move down to bar 5.


![图 19.8](figures/fig-19-08.jpg)


**图 19.8　两次失败的尝试之后出现反转**


当市场两次尝试向上突破都失败时，它通常接下来会尝试从底部突破。如图 19.8 所示，GOOG 在一个小区间里横盘，直到太平洋标准时间上午 7:00 的一份报告发布，因此处于突破模式。由于在一个收敛的交易区间里有三个顶部，它是一个三角形。交易者本可以在交易区间低点下方挂止损单入场，但在第5根K线下方做空这个低2，风险更小。之所以是低2，是因为第3根和第5根K线是向上的两段行情。由于此时这一天正处在交易区间里，高2和低2可以同时存在，这里就是如此。那个高2做多失败后变成了低2做空。因为这个交易区间在均线下方，它是一面熊旗，因此很可能向下突破。


> When the market tries to break out to the upside twice and fails, it usually will then try to break out of the bottom. As shown in Figure 19.8, GOOG went sideways in a small trading range into a 7:00 a.m. PST report and was therefore in breakout mode. Since there were three tops in a convergent trading range, it was a triangle. A trader could have entered on a stop below the trading range low, but it was less risky to short the low 2 below bar 5. This was a low 2 because bars 3 and 5 were two legs up. Since the day was in a trading range at this point, both a high 2 and a low 2 could coexist, as they did here. The high 2 long failed and became a low 2 short. Since the trading range was below the moving average, it was a bear flag and therefore likely to have a downside breakout.


第2根K线是第二根连续的空头趋势K线，两根K线都是实体大、影线小。这让交易者认为始终入场方向是向下，而且任何回调都会建立一笔做空——至少够做一次剥头皮。第5根K线下方的低2做空入场是第一次机会；从那根大空头入场K线和后续行情K线可以清楚看出，多数交易者相信这波抛售会走得足够远、够做一笔波段，而不只是变成一次剥头皮加反转向上。第5根K线与第3根K线构成双顶，带来了一笔波段做空。


> Bar 2 was the second consecutive bear trend bar, and both bars had large bodies and small tails. This led traders to think that the always-in direction was down and that any pullback would set up a short that was likely good for at least a scalp. The low 2 short entry below bar 5 was the first opportunity, and it is clear from the large bear entry bar and follow-through bar that most traders believed that the sell-off was going to extend far enough for a swing, and not just become a scalp and a reversal up. Bar 5 was a double top with bar 3 and led to a swing short.


交易者把这个双底叫做开盘反转，还是认为它出现得太晚、已经算不上开盘区间的一部分，都不重要。不过，交易者需要意识到，市场常常在太平洋标准时间上午 8:30 前后反转，并准备好接下这笔交易。


> It does not matter whether a trader calls the double bottom an opening reversal or thinks that it occurred too late in the day to be thought of as part of the opening range. However, the trader needs to be aware that the market often reverses around 8:30 a.m. PST, and be prepared to take the trade.


![图 19.9](figures/fig-19-09.jpg)


**图 19.9　开盘时的铁丝网**


如图 19.9 所示，有些日子开盘时均线走平、K线大而相互重叠，根本没有安全的建仓形态（顶部或底部附近没有可以放反向操作单子的小K线）。这就是铁丝网，应该像对待所有铁丝网那样交易；它需要耐心。等一边被一根趋势K线的突破套住，再考虑对这次突破做反向操作。因为铁丝网发出的突破通常都会失败，所以铁丝网常常是一面最终旗形。在这里，突破跌到了昨日低点之下。市场常常会对昨日高点或低点的突破做出反转。这种倾向增加了这段铁丝网变成最终旗形的概率。这个形态向上推了三次，并且是横盘。有些交易者把它看成三角形——如果只用K线的实体来看，会更容易看出来。


> As shown in Figure 19.9, some days open with a flat moving average, big overlapping bars, and just no safe setups (no small bars near the top or bottom where a fade trade could be placed). This is barbwire and should be traded like all barbwire; it requires patience. Wait for one side to be trapped with a trend bar breakout and then look to fade the breakout. Because breakouts from barbwire usually fail, barbwire is often a final flag. Here, the breakout fell below the low of yesterday. The market often reverses a breakout of the high or low of the prior day. This tendency increased the odds that the barbwire would become a final flag. The pattern had three pushes up and was sideways. Some traders saw it as a triangle, which is easier to visualize if you use only the bodies of the bars.


第7根K线是在跌破铁丝网底部之后的一次向上反转，但它前面跟着四根空头趋势K线。那股空头力量足够强，让交易者愿意等第二个买入信号。尽管有些交易者把它看作一个高2（其中高1是第6根K线的高点），但第6根K线是一根强势的外包下跌K线，多数交易者把它看成这波下跌的起点。正是在这根K线上，交易者认为市场可能正在突破一个交易区间、进入一段趋势，并且预期在那根把多头套住的外包下跌K线之后至少还会有第二段下跌。这使得多数交易者把第7根K线看成高1，因为下跌是从第6根K线的顶部开始的，而不是从第5根K线的顶部。


> Bar 7 was a reversal up after a breakout of the bottom of the barbwire, but it followed four bear trend bars. That was enough bear strength for traders to wait for a second buy signal. Even though some traders saw it as a high 2 where the high 1 was the high of bar 6, bar 6 was a strong outside down bar, and most traders considered it to be the start of the down move. It was the bar when traders thought that the market might be breaking out of a trading range and into a trend, and they expected at least a second leg down after the outside down bull trap bar. This made most traders see bar 7 as a high 1 since the down move began at the top of bar 6 and not at the top of bar 5.


第7根K线突破了一条微型趋势线，随后第9根K线是一个更低的低点突破回调买入建仓形态。它的收盘价在自身中点之上，这是作为一根反转K线的最低要求。此时的价格行为大体是双向的，反转很多、影线也很显眼，所以在当日新低处做一笔二次入场做多，甚至不需要反转K线。


> Bar 7 broke a micro trend line and then bar 9 was a lower low breakout pullback buy setup. Its close was above its midpoint, which is the minimum requirement for a reversal bar. At this point, the price action was mostly two-sided with many reversals and prominent tails, so a second-entry long at a new low of the day did not even need a reversal bar.


第9根K线上方的做多，是对当日早些时候的低点、以及昨日低点发起的第二次反转尝试。随后市场趋势向上，穿过开盘区间的另一侧，并在第12根K线处给出一个高2突破回调做多。第12根K线是均线处的一根多头反转K线，这是牛旗末端的一个强势买入信号。对许多交易者来说，市场在第9根K线之后那根强势多头趋势K线上就进入了始终做多状态；另一些交易者则是在突破第10根K线的那根强势多头趋势K线上、以及后来突破一个高2买入建仓形态的第11根K线强势多头趋势K线上，才确信市场已经始终做多。


> The long above bar 9 was a second reversal attempt of the earlier low of the day and of yesterday's low. The market then trended up through the other side of the opening range and gave a high 2 breakout pullback long at bar 12. Bar 12 was a bull reversal bar at the moving average, which was a strong buy signal at the end of a bull flag. The market became always-in long for many traders on the strong bull trend bar that followed bar 9, and other traders became convinced that it was always-in long on the strong bull trend bar breakout above bar 10 and again on the bar 11 strong bull trend bar that broke out of a high 2 buy setup.


# 第 20 章　跳空开盘：反转与延续

*20. Gap Openings: Reversals and Continuations*


任何时间级别上的跳空开盘，都指当根K线收盘后，与前一根K线不重叠。多数交易日里，5分钟图上都会出现跳空开盘。可以把它看成一次简单的突破，因为市场突破了前一日的最后一根K线。它应当像任何其他突破一样来交易，只是交易者知道，大幅跳空会增加当天走成趋势日的概率。跳空越大，当天越可能走成趋势日，这个跳空也越可能起到急速行情的作用、随后在同一个方向上出现一段趋势通道。举例来说，大幅向上跳空之后，跟随一段多头通道的概率也许是 50%，跟随一段交易区间的概率是 20%，跟随一段空头趋势的概率是 30%。这些概率只是参考，因为用计算机测试去求出精确数字，涉及的变量太多，变化太大。跳空要多大才算大幅？向上跳空之后，多大的一段上涨行情才算通道，而不只是略微向上倾斜的交易区间？多大的一段抛售才算反转，而不只是一次深度回调？另一条参考标准是：如果这个跳空是过去五天左右里最大的跳空，或者大于日均区间的一半左右，就可以算作大幅跳空。


> A gap opening on any time frame means that once the bar in question closes, it does not overlap the bar before it. On most days, there are gap openings on the 5 minute chart. They can be thought of as simple breakouts since the market broke out of the final bar of the prior day. They should be traded like any other breakout except traders know that large gaps increase the chance that the day will become a trend day. The larger the gap, the more likely the day will be a trend day and the more likely the gap will function as a spike and be followed by a trending channel in the same direction. For example, a large gap up has perhaps a 50 percent chance of being followed by a bull channel, a 20 percent chance of being followed by a trading range, and a 30 percent chance of being followed by a bear trend. These probabilities are only guidelines because using computer testing to find exact numbers is subject to too many variables. How big does a gap have to be to be thought of as large? How much of a rally after the gap up constitutes a channel instead of just a slightly upward-sloping trading range? How much of a sell-off constitutes a reversal compared to just a deep pullback? As another guideline, if the gap is the largest gap of the past five days or so, or if it is larger than about half of the average daily range, it can be considered to be a large gap.


5分钟图上相对昨日收盘的大幅跳空开盘，代表一种极端行为，往往会带来一个走向趋势日，方向可上可下。日线图上是否也有跳空并不重要，因为交易是一样的。唯一重要的是市场如何回应这种相对极端的行为——它会接受，还是会拒绝？跳空越大，越可能是一段以远离昨日收盘为方向的趋势日的开端。当天头几根K线的大小、方向以及趋势K线的数量，常常透露出随后可能出现的趋势日的方向。有时市场从开盘的第一两根K线就开始趋势运行，但更常见的情况是：它先朝错误的方向试探，然后反转，进入一段持续全天的趋势。每当看到大幅跳空开盘，明智的做法都是假定会出现一段强趋势。不过，这段趋势有时要一个小时才开始，而且常常以一段逆势的两段式行情开场，比如向均线的两段式回调，或是一个双底、双顶。有时它还会走出第三次推进，形成楔形旗形。务必让每笔交易都保留一部分波段仓位，哪怕有几笔交易的波段仓位被止损出局。一笔好的波段交易，其盈利可以顶得上 10 次剥头皮，所以在当天不会趋势运行这一点变得明确之前，不要放弃。


> A large gap opening on the 5 minute chart from yesterday's close represents extreme behavior and often results in a trend day in either direction. It does not matter whether there is also a gap on the daily chart, since the trading will be the same. The only thing that matters is how the market responds to this relatively extreme behavior—will it accept it or reject it? The larger a gap is, the more likely it will be the start of a trend day away from yesterday's close. The size, direction, and number of trend bars in the first few bars of the day often reveal the direction of the trend day that is likely to follow. Sometimes the market will trend from the opening bar or two, but more commonly it will test in the wrong direction and then reverse into a trend that will last all day. Whenever you see a large gap opening, it is wise to assume that there will be a strong trend. However, sometimes it might take an hour to begin, and the trend often begins with a two-legged countertrend move, like a two-legged pullback to the moving average or a double bottom or top. Sometimes it has a third push and forms a wedge flag. Make sure to swing part of every trade, even if you get stopped out of your swing portion on a few trades. One good swing trade can be as profitable as 10 scalps, so don't give up until it is clear that the day will not trend.


跳空应当被看成一根巨大的、隐形的趋势K线。举例来说，如果出现大幅向上跳空，随后是一段小幅回调，接着在当天余下时间里走出一段通道式的上涨行情，这很可能就是跳空急速与通道的多头趋势，其中跳空就是那段急速行情。对于 Emini 小型合约，你可以去看标普 500 现货指数，会看到当天第一根K线是一根大的趋势K线，它对应着 Emini 上的那个跳空。


> The gap should be looked at as if it is one huge, invisible trend bar. For example, if there is a large gap up and it is followed by a minor pullback and then a channel type of rally for the rest of the day, this is likely a gap spike and channel bull trend, with the gap being the spike. For the Emini, you can look at the S&P cash index and see that the first bar of the day is a large trend bar, and it corresponds to the gap on the Emini.


按开盘交易的常规思路来做，把它当成任何一次开盘：寻找开盘即趋势、突破失败（也就是反转），或者突破回调。与其他交易日唯一的区别是，你应当更激进地做波段；而如果当天开始趋势运行，就寻找可以加仓的回调。你应当始终考虑一路分批止盈，这些止盈可以是剥头皮，但只要趋势强劲，就要继续在趋势方向上寻找更多入场机会。


> Trade the open like any other open and look for a trend from the open, a failed breakout (a reversal), or a breakout pullback. The only difference from other days is that you should look to swing more aggressively; and if the day begins to trend, look for pullbacks where you can add onto your position. You should always look to take partial profits along the way, which can be scalps, but as long as the trend is strong, keep looking to take more entries in the direction of the trend.


大幅跳空只是增加了趋势日的概率，并不代表一定会出现趋势日。大多数大幅跳空日，头五到十根K线都会有一些交易区间的表现，因为多头和空头在争夺当天的趋势方向；其中有些还会整天都保持交易区间状态。对所有可能性保持开放，不要被某种信念锁死。你的任务是跟随市场。你没有能力影响它，更绝无可能用意念让它朝你想要的方向走。如果你判断错了，就出场，别再盼着市场去走那个低概率的情形、突然转向你这一边。如果出现大幅跳空，但价格行为不清楚，那就假定市场正在形成交易区间，低买、高卖。在出现一个有望带来波段机会的建仓形态之前，可能会先做几次剥头皮。


> Just because there is an increased chance of a trend day does not mean that there will be a trend day. Most big gap days have some trading range behavior for the first five to 10 bars as the bulls and bears fight over the direction of the trend, and some continue as trading range days all day long. Be open to all possibilities, and don't get locked into a belief. Your job is to follow the market. You have no ability to influence it and certainly zero chance of telepathically making it go in the direction that you want. If you are wrong, get out and stop hoping that the market will do the low-probability thing and suddenly go your way. If there is a big gap but the price action is unclear, assume that the market is forming a trading range and look to buy low and sell high. There might be several scalps before there is a setup that has a good chance of leading to a swing.


![图 20.1](figures/fig-20-01.jpg)


**图 20.1　跳空就是一段急速行情**


如图 20.1 所示，5分钟图上的跳空开盘，只是突破和急速行情的另一种形式。道指期货合约在右图的开盘向上跳空，但左图道琼斯工业平均指数现货指数上的那个跳空，只是一根大的多头趋势K线。


> As shown in Figure 20.1, a gap opening on a 5 minute chart is just another form of a breakout and a spike. The Dow Futures contract gapped up on the open on the chart on the right, but that gap on the Dow Jones Industrial Average cash index on the left was just a large bull trend bar.


![图 20.2](figures/fig-20-02.jpg)


**图 20.2　跳空可以引出一段向上或向下的趋势**


大幅跳空开盘会增加当天走成趋势日的概率（趋势可上可下），但它仍可能走成交易区间日。如图 20.2 右下角那张图所示，从第18根K线到第22根K线的横盘走势，就是大幅跳空之后数小时横盘的一个例子。


> A big gap opening increases the odds that the day will be a trend day (the trend can be up or down), but it still can become a trading range day. As shown in the lower right-hand chart in Figure 20.2, the sideways move from bar 18 to bar 22 is an example of several hours of sideways movement after a large gap.


跳空越大，当天越可能沿跳空方向走成趋势日。举例来说，左上角那张图里，第1根K线是一次大幅向上跳空，当天成了多头趋势日。


> The larger the gap, the more likely the day will be a trend day in the direction of the gap. For example, bar 1 in the upper left-hand chart was a large gap up and the day became a bull trend day.


左边两张图都是大幅向上跳空开盘，上面那张走成了多头趋势，下面那张走成了空头趋势。右边两张图都是向下跳空开盘，上面那张走成了多头趋势，下面那张走成了空头趋势。


> The two charts on the left show large gap up openings; the upper became a bull trend and the lower became a bear trend. The two charts on the right were gap down openings; the upper chart became a bull trend and the lower chart became a bear trend.


大幅向上跳空日里，第1根K线是一根多头趋势K线。当天开盘即趋势运行，走出跳空急速与通道的多头趋势。


> Bar 1 was bull trend bar on a large gap up day. The day became a trend from the open, gap spike and channel bull trend.


第4根K线是十字星，但带有实体。市场下跌了几个小时。直到第7根K线的当日低点为止，这段下跌的价格行为有着醒目的影线、相互重叠的K线以及好几根多头趋势K线，都表明这是双向价格行为。多头在当日的下半场能够不断地制造出一些买压，并掌控了市场。


> Bar 4 was a doji, but it had a bull body. The market trended down for a couple of hours. The price action down to the bar 7 low of the day had prominent tails, overlapping bars, and several bull trend bars, all indicating two-sided price action. The bulls were able to consistently create some buying pressure and controlled the market in the second half of the day.


大幅向下跳空日里，第10根K线是一根多头趋势K线，当天走成了开盘即趋势的多头趋势日。


> Bar 10 was a bull trend bar on a large gap down day, and the day became a trend from the open bull trend day.


大幅向下跳空日里，第18根K线是一根十字星K线。市场延续横盘的价格行为，直到第23根K线的空头急速行情向下破位。开盘的十字星是双向交易的信号，这种状态持续了好几个小时。空头急速行情之后，当天走成了空头趋势日，空头在第 24、25、26 根K线测试均线时压过了多头。尽管空头在第 21、22 根K线测试均线时表现强劲，但还不足以把市场拉出交易区间、拖进空头趋势。


> Bar 18 was a doji bar on a large gap down day. The market continued the sideways price action until the market broke to the downside on the bar 23 bear spike. The opening doji was a sign of two-sided trading, which continued for several hours. After the bear spike, the day became a bear trend day, and the shorts overwhelmed the longs on moving average tests at bars 24, 25, and 26. Although the shorts were strong at the bars 21 and 22 moving average tests, they were not yet strong enough to break the market out of the trading range and into a bear trend.


当出现大幅向上或向下跳空、又没有强反转时，顺趋势交易者的交易者等式可能非常有利。举例来说，当市场在第1根K线大幅向上跳空、随后横盘时，当天走成多头趋势日的概率上升到也许 60% 或更高。交易者预期区间会达到近期日均水平，那大约是 20 点。市场在回补跳空之前先向上走 20 点的概率，也许是 60% 或更高，因此在那头几根K线里买入的交易者，冒的是大约 10 点的风险，去赚大约 15 到 20 点，而且有 60% 的成功率，这是一笔很好的交易。他们本可以把止损放到缺口中部下方，那样风险也许是六点，而不是 10 点。无论如何，正是这种出色的数学期望，让大幅跳空开盘能够提供很好的交易机会。


> When there is a large gap up or down and no strong reversal, the trader's equation can be strong for the with-trend traders. For example, when the market had the large gap up at bar 1 and it then went sideways, the odds of a bull trend day went up, maybe to 60 percent or higher. Traders expected the range to reach about average for recent days, which was about 20 points. The odds of the market going 20 points higher before closing the gap were probably 60 percent or better, and therefore traders who bought during those first several bars were risking about 10 points to make about 15 to 20 points, and they had a 60 percent chance of success, which is a great trade. They probably could have risked to a move below the middle of the gap, so their risk might have been six points instead of 10. In any case, this excellent math is why large gap openings can offer great trades.


# 第四部分　融会贯通

*Part IV　Putting It All Together*


价格行为无非是人性的一种外在表现，所以它有着遗传学的基础。交易者研究哪个市场、哪个时间级别、哪种走势图类型，都不重要，因为它们反映的都是我们这个物种的行为。第四部分用详细案例演示了多个时间级别、不同市场的价格行为交易，其中就包括期权市场。它还讨论了交易者应当努力去做的那些最佳交易，尤其是刚起步、还没有盈利的新手。最后，它还给出了一些通用准则，供交易者在决定做哪些交易、以及如何管理这些交易时考虑。


> Price action is simply a manifestation of human nature and therefore is genetically based. It does not matter what market, time frame, or type of chart a trader studies, because they all are a representation of the behavior of our species. This Part IV gives detailed examples of price action trading on multiple time frames and in different markets, including the options market. It also discusses the best trades that traders should try to trade, especially beginners who are starting out and not yet profitable. Finally, it provides general guidelines that traders should consider as they decide which trades to take and how to manage their trades.


# 第 21 章　详细的日内交易实例

*21. Detailed Day Trading Examples*


本章给出许多详细的实例，演示合理的日内交易，它们把三本书里的基本思路都用上了。


> This chapter provides many detailed examples of reasonable day trades that incorporate the fundamental ideas from all three books.


![图 21.1](figures/fig-21-01.jpg)


**图 21.1　T-Note 一万股图**


图 21.1 是一张十年期美国国债期货走势图，每根K线按一万股成交来划分。一根K线里的成交量一旦超过一万手合约，这根K线就立刻收线。由于每根K线里最后一笔成交的手数可多可少，所以大多数K线的成交量都超过一万手合约，而不是正好一万手。这些K线不按时间划分，因此有的K线可能几秒钟就形成，另一些则可能要十分钟以上才累计到一万手。


> Figure 21.1 is a 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Futures chart based on 10,000 shares per bar. Each bar closed as soon as the volume in the bar passed 10,000 contracts. Since the final trade in each bar can have any number of contracts, most of the bars have more than 10,000 contracts instead of exactly 10,000 contracts. The bars are not based on time, so some bars might take a few seconds to form, while others may take more than 10 minutes to surpass 10,000 contracts.


第 3、4、5 根K线是空头趋势里测试移动平均线时的做空。


> Bars 3, 4, and 5 were shorts on tests of the moving average in a bear trend.


第6根K线是一次二次入场的空头趋势通道线过靶与反转向上，但信号K线很弱（一根小十字星）。不过，从第6根K线那处楔形反转开始的上涨行情突破了趋势线，为一次测试低点的做多做好了铺垫。


> Bar 6 was a second-entry bear trend channel line overshoot and reversal up, but the signal bar was weak (a small doji). However, the rally from the bar 6 wedge reversal broke the trend line, setting up a long on a test of the low.


第7根K线是一个两段式的更高的低点，但它是一根十字星，而十字星是双向交易的信号，不是强烈买盘的信号，而且它前面跟着两根强劲的空头趋势K线。尽管这是一个勉强可以接受的买入建仓形态，更好的做法还是等一个更强的信号。如果你做了这笔交易，你会在第8根K线下方出场，因为那是移动平均线处的一个低2做空建仓形态，而且带空头实体。那是一个强烈的卖出信号，逆势交易者本应出场，甚至可以在空头任何一次试图恢复趋势的第二次尝试时反手。在空头趋势里尝试做多的逆势交易者，应当在出现低2信号时一律出场，除非趋势显然已经反转、这个低2建仓形态很可能失败。第11根K线就是这种情况的一个例子。


> Bar 7 was a two-legged higher low, but it was a doji, which is a sign of two-sided trading and not of strong buying, and it followed two strong bear trend bars. Although this was a minimally acceptable buy setup, it would have been better to wait for a stronger signal. If you took it, you would have exited below bar 8 because that was a low 2 short setup at the moving average and it had a bear body. That is a strong sell signal, and countertrend traders should have exited and possibly even reversed on any second attempt by the bears to resume the trend. Countertrend traders trying to buy in a bear trend should always exit on a low 2 signal, unless the trend has clearly already reversed and the low 2 setup is likely to fail. Bar 11 is an example of this.


第9根K线是一次更低的低点主要趋势反转，也是结束于第6根K线那个楔形底突破之后的突破回调，是为一次可能的强趋势反转准备的买入建仓形态。它同时也是一次空头趋势通道的过靶与反转，并且是一根多头反转K线和一个两根K线反转。从第6根K线到第9根K线的这段交易区间是一条窄通道，成了这轮空头趋势的最终旗形。此外，它还是从跌到第2根K线的那段急速行情之后一条更大的楔形通道里出现的反转。急速与通道型空头里的通道，往往以三次推进收尾，这里就是如此（第 2、6、9 根K线就是这三次推进）。


> Bar 9 was a lower low major trend reversal and breakout pullback from the breakout of the wedge bottom that ended at bar 6, and a buy setup for a possible strong trend reversal. It was also a bear trend channel overshoot and reversal, and it was a bull reversal bar and a two-bar reversal. The trading range from bar 6 to bar 9 was a tight channel and became the final flag of the bear trend. Also, it was a reversal from a larger wedge channel following the spike down to bar 2. The channel of a spike and channel bear often ends with three pushes and it did here (bars 2, 6, and 9).


第10根K线是对一根内包K线的向上突破，那根内包K线结束了第一次很小的回调（一根空头趋势K线），所以交易者可以在它上方做多，也可以在越过第9根K线之后给自己已有的多单加仓。在急速与通道型空头（第2根K线结束了急速行情）和三次向下推进（结束于第 2、6、9 根K线）之后，很可能发展出一段持续时间较长的两段式上涨，所以第10根K线这里的停顿很可能只是第一段上涨的一部分，而不是第二段上涨的开端。经过一条持续了 20 到 30 根K线的空头通道之后，按常规这次修正的K线数很可能至少是它的一半。如果修正太小，空头就不敢做空，多头则会继续买入，因为他们会怀疑这次修正还需要更多K线才能看清方向。双方都需要看看市场是不是在反转，而从第10根K线起那四根K线的多头急速行情，就是说明它确实在反转的强证据。这个空头急速与通道形态很可能回撤到通道起点附近的第3根K线一带，事实也确实如此。做多的交易者常常在那里止盈。这也是有些人开始分批建仓的区域，而一旦市场回到他们最初入场的位置，他们往往会平掉全部仓位。他们在第 2 根和第3根K线之间建立的那些最初的多单，大致在保本处出场，而在更低位置的所有入场都赚到了钱。空头常常会再次大力做空，因为他们知道，当天早些时候市场就是从这个区域开始下跌的，这一次可能重演。当天已经走完，空头没有足够时间再赚钱，所以他们选择不在临近收盘时做空。


> Bar 10 was a breakout above an inside bar that ended the first tiny pullback (bear trend bar), so traders could have gone long above it or added to their longs from above bar 9. After the spike and channel bear (bar 2 ended the spike) and the three pushes down (bars 2, 6, and 9 ended them), it was likely that a protracted two-legged up move would develop, so the bar 10 pause was likely to just be part of the first leg up and not the start of the second leg up. After a bear channel that lasted 20 or 30 bars, the correction was likely to have at least half as many bars as a general rule. If the correction is too small, bears will be hesitant to short and bulls would continue to buy because they would suspect that the correction needed more bars for clarity. Both needed to see if the market was reversing, and the four-bar bull spike up from bar 10 was strong evidence that it was. The bear spike and channel formation was likely to retrace to around the bar 3 start of the channel, which it did. Longs often take profits there. This is the area where some started to scale in, and once the market gets back to their very first entry, they often exit their entire position. They got out of their original longs that they established between bars 2 and 3 at about breakeven, and they made a profit on all of their lower entries. Bears often short aggressively again because they know that the market started down from this area earlier in the day, and it could do the same again. The day was over and there was not enough time left for the bears to make a profit, so they therefore chose to not short into the close.


第11根K线是一段强劲多头急速行情之后的一个高2买入建仓形态（高1出现在两根K线之前）。交易者预期至少有两段上涨，而这次两段式回调相比急速行情的规模太小了，所以它可能并不代表第一段上涨的结束。交易者认为三种情形中必有一种正在发生：这次回调太小，只是复杂第一段上涨的一部分；第一段已经结束、第二段上涨正在开始；或者第一段已经结束、会有一次更深的回调，然后市场再涨到这一段的高点上方。这三种可能都意味着市场会走得更高，因此这是一次绝佳的买入机会。没错，第11根K线是一个两根K线反转顶部的入场K线，那是空头趋势里用均线缺口K线做空的二次入场，本可能带来一次对空头低点的测试。然而，那段向上的急速行情在大多数交易者眼里已经把市场翻成了始终做多，所以这笔空头走得很远的概率很小。多数交易者认为这次反转远比那个做空建仓形态强。


> Bar 11 was a high 2 buy setup (the high 1 was two bars earlier) after a strong bull spike. Traders were expecting at least two legs up, and this two-legged pullback was so small compared to the size of the spike that it might not have signified the end of the first leg up. Traders believed that one of three things was happening: the pullback was so small that it was just part of a complex first leg; the first leg was over and the second leg up was beginning; or the first leg was over and there would be a deeper pullback and then a move above the top of this leg. All three possibilities meant that the market was going higher and this was therefore a great buying opportunity. Yes, bar 11 was an entry bar from a two-bar reversal top, which was the second entry for a moving average gap bar short in a bear trend. This might have led to a test of the bear low. However, the spike up flipped the market to always-in long in the minds of most traders, so the chance of the short going very far was small. Most traders saw the reversal as much stronger than the short setup.


![图 21.2](figures/fig-21-02.jpg)


**图 21.2　欧元兑美元的强劲开盘**


如图 21.2 所示，5分钟图上的欧元兑美元（外汇）在创出新高之后于第2根K线反转向下。这段多头行情动能很强，从连续八根K线里都没有空头趋势K线就可以看出来，所以任何回调都很可能先测试第2根K线的高点，然后才会跌到第1根K线那根多头急速行情的低点下方。第3根K线是一根均线缺口K线，同时也是对这波上涨起点第1根K线的一次突破回测。它和它前面两根K线构成了一个微型楔形，这本来至少应该带来一次向上反弹。它同时还是那段强劲多头急速行情之后的一个楔形牛旗。第一段下跌是第2根K线之前三根，第二次向下推进是第2根K线之后两根，第三次则是第3根K线。


> As shown in Figure 21.2, the 5 minute EUR/USD (forex) reversed down at bar 2 after a new high. This bull leg had strong momentum, as evidenced by eight bars in a row without a bear trend bar, so the odds were high that any pullback would test the bar 2 high before it fell below the bar 1 bottom of the bull spike. Bar 3 was a moving average gap bar that also was a breakout test of the bar 1 beginning of the rally. It and the two bars before it formed a micro wedge, which should have led to at least a bounce up. It was also a wedge bull flag after the strong bull spike. The first leg down was three bars before bar 2, the second push down was two bars after bar 2, and the third was bar 3.


市场形成了一个三角形，最终演变成一个窄幅交易区间。三角形在一个方向上至少有三次推进，第 2、4 根K线以及第 6 或第8根K线构成了三次向上推进，而第 1 或第3根K线加上第 5、7 根K线构成了三次向下推进。当存在多种可能的数法时，有些交易者会更看重某一种，而另一些交易者则对别的数法更有信心。每当数法上出现混乱，就说明市场处在交易区间里，因此正处在突破模式，多数交易者应当等待突破，而不是在窄幅交易区间里做交易。


> The market formed a triangle, which ended up as a tight trading range. Triangles have at least three pushes in one direction, and bars 2, 4, and either 6 or 8 formed three pushes up, while bar 1 or 3 along with bars 5 and 7 formed three pushes down. When there are multiple possibilities, some traders will place more importance on one whereas other traders will feel more strongly about others. Whenever there is confusion, the market is in a trading range and therefore in breakout mode, and most traders should wait for the breakout instead of trading within a tight trading range.


第8根K线是一次失败的上破尝试（比第4根K线的高点低一个最小报价单位），随后以一根空头外包K线反转、穿过了区间的底部。它与第 4 根或第6根K线构成了一个双顶熊旗。


> Bar 8 was a failed upside breakout attempt (one tick below the bar 4 high) that reversed through the bottom of the range in a bear outside bar. It formed a double top bear flag with bar 4 or bar 6.


第9根K线是一根外包K线中部的上方小K线，是一次突破回调，提供了低风险的做空机会。


> Bar 9 was a breakout pullback small bar above the middle of the outside bar, offering a low-risk short.


第10根K线是又一次突破回调做空。第11根K线是在移动平均线处的一次低2做空，信号K线是空头K线，同时它是第二次尝试跌破第3根K线那根急速行情的低点。


> Bar 10 was another breakout pullback short. Bar 11 was a low 2 short at the moving average with a bear signal bar and a second attempt to break out below the bar 3 spike low.


第12根K线也是移动平均线处的一次低2做空。要一直坚持挂单。多头收出的十字星更高的低点可能让空头变得松懈，但你仍然要认为市场处在空头波段里，而如果价格跌破这根K线，就会形成一个低2做空。


> Bar 12 was another low 2 short at the moving average. Always keep placing your orders. A bear might become complacent because of the bull doji higher low, but you still need to be thinking that the market is in a bear swing, and if it falls below this bar, it will form a low 2 short.


第13根K线是趋势通道线过靶加一根卖出高潮K线之后的一个 ii 形态做多建仓形态。这是一个抛物线楔形底部，意味着下跌在到达最终低点之前加速了，随后反转向上。从第10根K线起有三次向下推进，而前两次推进之间的趋势线（第 10、11 根K线之后的那些摆动低点）的斜率，比第二次和第三次推进之间的趋势线（第11根K线之后的那个摆动低点与第13根K线之前那个最终低点）的斜率更平缓。


> Bar 13 was an ii setup for a long after a trend channel line overshoot and sell climax bar. This was a parabolic wedge bottom, which means that the move accelerated down to the final low and then reversed up. There were three pushes down from bar 10, and the slope of the trend line from the first two pushes (the swing lows after bars 10 and 11) was flatter than that of the trend line created by the second and third pushes (the swing low after bar 11 and the final low just before bar 13).


市场已经下跌了大约 20 根K线，这时突然出现了这轮空头趋势里最大的一根空头趋势K线（第13根K线之前两根）和最大的两根K线空头急速行情。这根急速行情很可能代表衰竭，它可能是最后一批弱多头在出场、最后一批弱空头在做空。强多头在这里买入，并且会在更低处分批建仓，而不是慌着出场，而强空头只会在一次大幅回调之后才做空。这至少创造了一次两段式上涨的好机会，至少持续 10 根K线。那根强劲的多头内包K线说明买方正在掌控市场，是一个很好的信号K线。


> The market had been trending down for about 20 bars and suddenly had the largest bear trend bar (two bars before bar 13) and largest two-bar bear spike of the bear trend. This spike had a good chance of representing exhaustion, and it might have been the last weak bulls exiting and the last weak bears shorting. The strong bulls were buying in here and would scale in lower instead of panicking out, and the strong bears would have shorted only after a big pullback. This created a good chance of at least a two-legged rally lasting at least 10 bars. The strong bull inside bar was a sign that the buyers were taking control, and it was a good signal bar.


第15根K线是三次向上推进，也是第一根均线缺口K线。从第13根K线起的那两根K线多头急速行情就是那段向上的急速行情。急速与楔形形态通常在向下修正之前还会再有两次向上推进，这里就是这样。
