Bar 29 was a wedge bull flag buy setup (bars 27, 28, and 29 were the three pushes down); it was also a double bottom with bar 27, a breakout pullback buy setup from the breakout above the bar 28 high 2 bull flag, and a failed lower high (the bar before was a small lower high and a failed high 2 buy setup).


![图 24.4](figures/fig-24-04.jpg)


**图 24.4　IBM 的最佳交易**


如图 24.4 所示，在这张 IBM 的5分钟图上，最佳交易包括：第2根K线的开盘反转以及跳空急速与通道底部；第4根K线在移动平均线处的双顶；第6根K线在强空头急速行情之后、位于移动平均线处的低2；第7根K线的低2以及微型通道突破失败；第9根K线的小型三角形或者说横盘楔形熊旗；以及第11根K线在移动平均线处的低2。在这段强空头趋势里出现了好几次回到移动平均线的回调。在跌破第2根K线之后，交易者本会认为今天是趋势性交易区间日，甚至可能是更强的开盘即趋势日。到第6根K线时，交易者已经在做空每一波走到移动平均线的两段式行情，以及他们看到的每一个低2。


> As shown in Figure 24.4, the best trades on this 5 minute chart of IBM include the bar 2 opening reversal and gap spike and channel bottom, the bar 4 double top at the moving average, the bar 6 low 2 at the moving average after a strong bear spike, the bar 7 low 2 and micro channel failed breakout, the bar 9 small triangle or sideways wedge bear flag, and the bar 11 low 2 at the moving average. There were several moving average pullbacks in a strong bear trend. After the breakout below bar 2, traders would have assumed that today was a trending trading range day or possibly even a stronger trend from the open day. By bar 6, traders were shorting two-legged moves to the moving average and every low 2 that they saw.


第6根K线是移动平均线处的一个低2做空（第5根K线是一根小号空头K线，结束了第一段上涨）。它与两根K线之前的高点构成微型双顶，并且是来自它前面那根内包K线的一次一根K线的最终旗形反转。


> Bar 6 was a low 2 short at the moving average (bar 5 was a small bear bar, ending the first leg up). It was a micro double top with the high of two bars earlier, and a one-bar final flag reversal from the inside bar just before it.


第7根K线是测试第6根K线下方保本止损之后的反转下跌。它同时也是自第6根K线结束的那面熊旗向下突破之后的回调。


> Bar 7 was a reversal down from the test of the breakeven stops below bar 6. It was also a pullback from the breakout below the bear flag that ended at bar 6.


第9根K线是一个低2做空，第11根K线是移动平均线处的一个低2做空，同时也是与第10根K线构成的微型双顶。两者看起来都不好，但你必须相信：在强空头趋势日里，移动平均线处的低2做空成功概率非常高。


> Bar 9 was a low 2 short, and bar 11 was a low 2 short at the moving average, as well as a micro double top with bar 10. Neither looked good, but you must trust that a low 2 short at the moving average has a very high probability of success during a strong bear trend day.


第5根K线之前那段两根K线的多头急速行情非常强，大多数新手把它看成一轮急剧多头反转的开始。在涨到第6根K线的这波走势里共有七根K线，其中只有一根是空头实体。人们很容易盯着这份强势，而不去承认它之前发生了什么。这波急速上涨是20多根K线里第一次回到移动平均线的回调，有经验的交易者把它看作一个卖出信号。新手只看到强势，于是找机会买入随后的更高的低点，预期出现趋势反转，或至少还有第二段上涨。他们无视自第6根K线向下的三根强劲空头趋势K线，只把它们当作对「突破当日低点」的一次激烈测试，于是为下一段上涨而买入。有经验的交易者则把这看成一次反转强趋势的尝试，因而不太可能成功，只是又一面熊旗。他们在第7根K线那波两段式横盘修正处做空，正确地预判空头趋势会恢复。


> The two-bar bull spike before bar 5 was very strong, and most beginners saw it as the start of a sharp bull reversal. In the move up to bar 6, there were seven bars, and only one had a bear body. It is easy to focus on this strength and deny what took place before it. This sharp rally was the first pullback to the moving average in over 20 bars, and experienced traders saw it as a sell signal. Beginners only saw the strength and looked to buy the higher low that followed, expecting a trend reversal or at least a second leg up. They dismissed the three strong bear trend bars down from bar 6 as just a sharp test of the breakout above the low of the day, and bought for the next leg up. Experienced traders saw this as simply an attempt to reverse a strong trend, and therefore most likely just a bear flag. They shorted the two-legged sideways correction at bar 7, correctly anticipating that the bear trend would resume.


![图 24.5](figures/fig-24-05.jpg)


**图 24.5　USO 的最佳交易**


如图 24.5 所示，今天在 United States Oil Fund LP（USO）日线图上的最佳交易建仓形态包括：第1根K线的楔形牛旗；第3根K线的高1测试移动平均线；第5根K线在一段大的高2中的二次入场（第3根K线是第一次下推）；第6根K线的扩张三角形与更高的高点主要趋势反转；第8根K线的双底（与第5根K线）以及微型通道突破回调（自第7根K线起的上涨突破了这条微型通道）；第10根K线失败的微型通道突破；第12根K线作为二次入场的均线缺口K线、双底（与第10根K线）、高2，以及对第6根K线的突破回测；第13根K线的双底与高2；以及第15根K线在移动平均线处的高2和对第11根K线的突破回测。


> As shown in Figure 24.5, the best trade setups today on the daily United States Oil Fund LP (USO) include the bar 1 wedge bull flag; the bar 3 high 1 test of the moving average; the bar 5 second entry in a large high 2 (bar 3 was the first push down); the bar 6 expanding triangle and higher high major trend reversal; the bar 8 double bottom (with bar 5) and the micro channel breakout pullback (the rally from bar 7 broke above the micro channel); the bar 10 failed micro channel breakout; the bar 12 second-entry moving average gap bar, double bottom (with bar 10), high 2, and breakout test of bar 6; the bar 13 double bottom and high 2; and the bar 15 high 2 at the moving average and breakout test of bar 11.


市场明显处在多头趋势里，所以最佳交易很可能是任何高2，尤其是在移动平均线附近，比如第1、5和12根K线处。第1根K线是移动平均线处的一个高2，有些交易者把它看成一面小楔形牛旗。第5根K线是一个更大的高2买入建仓形态中的第二段下跌，其中第3根K线是第一段下跌。


> The market was clearly in a bull trend, so the best trade was likely to be any high 2, especially near the moving average, like at bars 1, 5, and 12. Bar 1 was a high 2 at the moving average, and some traders saw it as a small wedge bull flag. Bar 5 was the second leg down in a larger high 2 buy setup where bar 3 was the first leg down.


激进的交易者把第1根K线附近那波走到移动平均线的小幅横盘看成一面安静的牛旗，而不是反转形态。因此，他们会把限价买单挂在前面几根K线的低点处及其下方，而不是等市场恢复多头趋势。


> Aggressive traders saw the small sideways move to the moving average around bar 1 as a quiet bull flag and not a reversal pattern. They therefore would have placed limit orders to buy at or below the low of the prior bars rather than waiting for the market to resume the bull trend.


第6根K线是一个更高的高点主要趋势反转和扩张三角形顶部，也是一笔合理的做空。不过，大多数主要趋势反转并不会引出反方向的趋势。它们更常演变成交易区间，但通常还是留有足够空间做一小笔波段交易（回报至少是风险的两倍）。


> Bar 6 was a higher high major trend reversal and expanding triangle top, and a reasonable short. However, most major trend reversals do not lead to trends in the opposite direction. Instead, they more often evolve into trading ranges, but usually have enough room for a small swing trade (a reward that is at least twice as large as the risk).


第8和第13根K线是位于移动平均线下方的两段式回调（均线缺口K线）。


> Bars 8 and 13 were two-legged pullbacks below the moving average (gap bars).


第8根K线是对第5根K线那个交易区间低点的第二次测试，第13根K线是对第6根K线那个交易区间高点突破的第二次测试；两者都形成了双底牛旗。


> Bar 8 was the second test of the bar 5 trading range low, and bar 13 was the second test of the bar 6 trading range high breakout; both formed double bottom bull flags.


第10根K线是一次突破回调，给出了第二个做多入场（同时也是第2、3、4、5、6、8、9根K线那个扩张三角形顶部的失败）。


> Bar 10 set up a second long entry on a breakout pullback (and a failed expanding triangle top from bars 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9).


注意，尽管这是一个明确的多头趋势，第6根K线仍是一笔不错的做空，因为有一段跌到第5根K线的趋势线突破。第6根K线是一波两段式、呈楔形的上涨，走到新高，也走到一个扩张三角形的顶部（第2、3、4、5、6根K线）。第15根K线是对第11根K线的突破回测。许多顺趋势建仓形态看起来会很糟糕，但你必须相信自己的判断并下单，否则你就会像许多其他弱手一样，被关在绝佳交易之外。


> Note that even though this was a clear bull trend, bar 6 was a good short because there was a trend line break down to bar 5. Bar 6 was a two-legged, wedge-shaped rally to a new high and the top of an expanding triangle (bars 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6). Bar 15 was a breakout test of bar 11. Many with-trend setups will look terrible, but you have to trust your read and place your orders, or else you will be trapped out of great trades like so many other weak hands.


在强多头趋势里，买入不需要强劲的建仓形态。你可以在任何位置按市价买入并赚到钱，但有了建仓形态，你就能用更紧的止损。


> In a strong bull trend, you do not need strong setups to buy. You can buy at the market anywhere and make money, but setups allow you to use tighter stops.


有些交易者会在交易走到止盈目标大约一半路程时，把保护性止损移到保本。举例来说，如果一位交易者在第8根K线上方买入，预期交易区间向上突破、随后是一段向上的等距运动，那么当市场到达第9根K线一带时，他也许会把止损移到保本——那时市场已经走过他目标一半以上的路程，而且已经有好几根K线收在交易区间顶部上方。如果他的保护性止损被打掉，他绝不该懊恼，因为它做的正是它该做的事：限制他的亏损——而亏损至少会在40%的交易里出现。


> Some traders move their protective stop to breakeven once the trade reaches about halfway to their profit target. For example, if a trader bought above bar 8, expecting an upside breakout of the trading range and then a measured move up, he might move his stop to breakeven once the market reached the bar 9 area, where the market was more than half of the way to his target and there had been several closes above the top of the trading range. If his protective stop gets hit, he should never get upset because it is doing exactly what it is supposed to be doing, which is limiting his losses, which come in at least 40 percent of his trades.


![图 24.6](figures/fig-24-06.jpg)


**图 24.6　UltraShort S&P 500 ProShares（SDS）中的最佳交易**


如图 24.6 所示，今天在5分钟 SDS 图上的最佳交易建仓形态包括：第2根K线在开盘即趋势多头日里的第一次回调；第5根K线的高2；以及第6根K线在移动平均线处的楔形牛旗或三角形二次入场。


> As shown in Figure 24.6, the best trade setups on the 5 minute SDS chart today include the bar 2 first pullback in a trend from the open bull, the bar 5 high 2, and the bar 6 wedge bull flag or triangle second entry at the moving average.


今天是一个开盘即趋势日。向上的动能很强，第一段主要行情在第3根K线结束。出现强多头趋势时，就找机会买高2。第5和第6根K线是极好的高2做多入场，而且第6根K线同时也是一次回到移动平均线的回调。第6根K线这个高2，是针对两根和四根K线之前形成的那个微型双底，也是针对自第3根K线开始的那段两段式大幅下跌，其中第4根K线是高1买入建仓形态。


> This was a trend from the open day. There was strong up momentum with the first major leg ending at bar 3. When there is a strong bull trend, look to buy a high 2. Bars 5 and 6 were great high 2 long entries, and bar 6 was also a moving average pullback. The bar 6 high 2 was for the micro double bottom that formed two and four bars earlier, and for the large two-legged move down from bar 3, where bar 4 was the high 1 buy setup.


第7根K线是第二段上涨，也是一次失败的旗形突破（一次最终旗形反转），它随后缓缓下滑，跌破了当天的主要趋势线。


> Bar 7 was the second leg up and a failed flag breakout (a final flag reversal) that drifted down and broke the major trend line of the day.


当市场进入窄幅交易区间或窄通道时，大多数交易者应该停止交易。一些有经验的交易者会在前一根K线低点买入、在前一根K线高点做空，也会在底部买入小号多头K线、在接近顶部处做空小号空头K线，比如第12根K线之后那样。


> When the market enters a tight trading range or a tight channel, most traders should stop trading. Some experienced traders will buy at the low of the prior bar and short at the high of the prior bar, and buy small bull bars at the bottom and short small bear bars near the top like after bar 12.


由于跌到第8根K线的这波走势中没有明确的上涨行情，而且空头已经掌控了一个多小时，所以找第二段下跌是合理的。第10根K线是一段小幅上涨，第12根K线是第二段上涨，而且它从第11根K线起的上涨里有一个低2。此外，第12根K线是一根小K线，与移动平均线之间留下了一个向上缺口。它还是一个小的、几乎水平的楔形顶部，其中第10根K线是第一次上推，第11根K线之后两根K线是第二次。它同时还是一个低4建仓形态、一个更低的高点主要趋势反转，以及对第7根K线低点的一次测试。


> Since there was no clear rally in the move down to bar 8 and the bears had been in control for over an hour, it was reasonable to look for a second leg down. Bar 10 was a small leg up and bar 12 was a second leg up, and it had a low 2 on its rise from bar 11. Also, bar 12 was a small bar that gapped above the moving average. It was also a small, almost horizontal wedge top where bar 10 was the first push up and two bars after bar 11 was the second. It was also a low 4 setup, a lower high major trend reversal, and a test of the bar 7 low.


第13根K线是第9根K线突破之后的突破回调，也是一根失败的多头反转K线，把多头套住了。


> Bar 13 was a breakout pullback of the bar 9 breakout and a failed bull reversal bar, trapping longs.


就在第7根K线之前，市场进入了一个窄幅交易区间，并一直持续到第12根K线之后不久。这是止损单入场最糟糕的环境，因为这恰恰与机构所做的相反——而你的工作就是尽可能地模仿机构。作为新手，你无法用限价单入场并分批建仓，所以你只能等。机构在K线下方买入，这就是市场跌破前一根K线低点之后又涨上去的原因。你也知道他们在前一根K线高点上方的卖出，因为市场随后会在一两根K线内跌下来。既然新手只应该用止损单入场，那么一旦看到市场正在进入窄幅交易区间的任何迹象，他们就绝不该再交易，因为用止损单入场会导致一次次亏损。如果你是个新手，并且决定一天最多做三笔交易，那么在第7根K线之后的那些K线里，你在想什么？你是不是在告诉自己，这正是你等了一整天的东西……一个安静、不再吓人的市场？还是你在想，概率这么低，在这里浪费三次机会中的一次简直愚蠢？既然这显然是止损单入场的糟糕环境，那么在突破之前几乎永远不会出现最佳交易；而如果你抱着「这笔交易会带来一次成功突破」的希望去做，结果只会亏钱——尽管此前5到10个信号都没能突破成功。在你做到持续盈利之前，绝不要在窄幅交易区间里交易；即使到那时，更明智的做法也是等待。你也可以像机构那样用限价单入场，在市场朝对你不利的方向走时分批建空单、建多单，但那会把人耗干。回撤会大到让人难受，你最终会犯错，比如在市场反转、转向你方向的前一刻带着大亏离场。用止损单入场、等一个概率常常有60%的环境，而不要在窄幅交易区间里交易，这要好得多。


> Just before bar 7, the market entered a tight trading range and it continued until just after bar 12. This is the worst environment for stop entries because that is the exact opposite of what the institutions are doing, and your job is to copy them, whenever you can. As a beginner, you cannot enter with limit orders and scale in, so you have to wait. They are buying below bars and that is why the market goes up after falling below the low of the prior bar. You also know that they are selling above the high of the prior bar because the market then goes down on the next bar or two. Since beginners should only be entering on stops, they should never trade once they see any sign that the market is entering a tight trading range, because entering on stops will result in repeated losses. If you are a beginner and decide to take no more than three trades a day, what are you thinking during the bars after bar 7? Are you telling yourself that this is exactly what you have been waiting for all day … a nice, quiet market that is no longer scary? Or, are you thinking that the probability is so low that you would be foolish to waste one of your three trades here? Since clearly this is a terrible environment for entering on stops, a best trade will virtually never develop until after a breakout, and you will lose money by taking trades as you hope that your trade will result in a successful breakout, even though the prior 5 to 10 signals did not. Never trade in a tight trading range until you are consistently profitable, and even then it is better to wait. You could trade like an institution and enter with limit orders, scaling into shorts above and longs below as the market goes against you, but that is emotionally draining. The drawdowns get uncomfortably large and you will end up making mistakes, like exiting with a big loss just before the market reverses and goes your way. It is far better to enter on stops and wait for an environment where the probability is often 60 percent, and not trade in a tight trading range.


![图 24.7](figures/fig-24-07.jpg)


**图 24.7　AAPL 空头趋势中的最佳交易**


如图 24.7 所示，在这张 AAPL 的5分钟图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第1根K线处以及第2根K线那个两根K线反转下方的20均线缺口K线做空，以及第7根K线的双底。


> As shown in Figure 24.7, the best trade setups on this 5 minute chart of AAPL include the 20 gap bar short at bar 1 and below the bar 2 two-bar reversal, and the bar 7 double bottom.


AAPL 处在开盘即趋势空头日里。第2根K线是一个两根K线反转建仓形态，用于一次20均线缺口K线做空。第2根K线的入场价是 $169.88，初始止损在入场K线高点上方 $170.38。那根入场K线是一根外包下跌K线，交易者一入场就把保护性止损挂在它的高点上方，很可能是在K线收盘之前就挂好了。这是合理的，因为这界定了他们的风险；如果市场立刻在K线高点上方反转，他们本来就不想继续持空。如果它不是一根外包K线，他们就会把止损放在信号K线上方。这里初始风险是50美分。


> AAPL was in a trend from the open bear. Bar 2 was a two-bar reversal setup for a 20 gap bar short. The bar 2 entry price was $169.88, and the initial stop was above the entry bar at $170.38. The entry bar was an outside down bar, and traders put their protective stops above its high as soon as they entered, probably before the bar closed. This was reasonable because it defined their risk, and they would not have wanted to be short if the market immediately reversed above the high of the bar. If it was not an outside bar, they would have placed their stops above the signal bar. The initial risk here was 50 cents.


激进的交易者本会把限价单挂在第3和第4根K线的高点处，预期任何上涨都会失败，并变成第3根K线突破熊旗之后的突破回调做空建仓形态。他们把这看成一面安静的熊旗，而不是多头反转，并预期还有更多卖盘，所以任何一根K线高点上方做空都是合理的交易。


> Aggressive traders would have placed limit orders at the bar 3 and 4 highs, expecting any move up to fail and become a breakout pullback short setup for the bar 3 breakout of the bear flag. They saw this as a quiet bear flag and not a bull reversal, and expected more selling, so shorting above the high of any bar was a reasonable trade.


第5根K线是一个糟糕的高1，因为市场正处在强空头趋势里，交易者不会平掉空单，也不会反手做多。市场冲到那根K线上方7美分，但交易者这时还不会下移保护性止损，因为最大的浮动利润只有38美分，他们会想给这笔交易时间。一般来说，像这样的交易，在浮动利润达到大约60到80美分之前，交易者不该把止损移到保本。


> Bar 5 was a bad high 1 since the market was in a strong bear trend, and traders would not have exited their shorts and would not have reversed to long. The market ran 7 cents above the bar, but traders would not yet have moved their protective stops down because the largest open profit was only 38 cents, and they would have wanted to give the trade time to work. Typically, traders should not move their stops to breakeven on a trade like this until there has been about 60 to 80 cents of open profit.


在第6根K线，交易者本可以用限价单以 $1.00 的利润平掉一半仓位（第6根K线的最低点在他们入场价下方 $1.07）。从这根K线外包上涨的性质可以看出，很多交易者很可能在这里部分或全部回补了空单。此时他们会把保护性止损移到保本，或者也许差几个美分（$170.91 是合理的，因为 AAPL 很少把止损扫过超过一美分），并且除非出现明确而强劲的反转，否则不会离场——而在这样强的空头趋势日里，这种反转不太可能出现。他们预期会出现把软弱空头吓出场的回调。例如，涨到第9根K线的这波行情不多不少正好打掉保本止损（$170.88），然后掉头向下。如果交易者被打掉止损，他们本可以在第10根K线再次做空，依据是第9根K线对移动平均线的测试和突破回测。第10根K线说明，这次突破回测达到了把交易者吓出场的目的，因为显然有大量空单涌进来。如果交易者放任自己被打掉止损，他们现在会重新做空，但价格差了41美分！


> On bar 6, traders would have been able to exit half of their shares with $1.00 profit using a limit order (the bottom of bar 6 was $1.07 below their entry price). As you can see by the outside up nature of the bar, lots of traders likely covered part or all of their shorts here. At this point, they would have moved their protective stop to breakeven or maybe a few pennies worse ($170.91 was reasonable, since AAPL rarely runs stops by more than a penny) and would not have exited unless there was a clear and strong reversal, which was unlikely on such a strong bear trend day. They expected pullbacks that scare weak shorts out. For example, the rally to bar 9 hit breakeven stops to the penny ($170.88) and then reversed back down. If traders were stopped out, they could have shorted again on bar 10, off the bar 9 moving average test and breakout test. Bar 10 showed that the breakout test accomplished its goal of scaring traders out, because clearly lots of shorts came in. If traders let themselves be stopped out, they would now be short again, but at 41 cents worse!


![图 24.8](figures/fig-24-08.jpg)


**图 24.8　GS 强空头趋势中的最佳交易**


如图 24.8 所示，在这张 Goldman Sachs Group（GS）的5分钟图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第1根K线之后两根K线形成的微型通道突破失败；第3根K线之后那根K线下方的突破回调做空（这里是一个低2）；以及自太平洋标准时间上午11:10那波空头急速行情起的急速与通道下跌之后，在第5根K线那根多头反转K线上方的二次入场做多。


> As shown in Figure 24.8, the best trade setups on this 5 minute chart of Goldman Sachs Group (GS) include the micro channel failed breakout that formed two bars after bar 1, the breakout pullback short (here, a low 2) below the bar after bar 3, and the second-entry long above the bar 5 bull reversal bar after the spike and channel down from the 11:10 a.m. PST bear spike.


小幅回调趋势是最强的一种空头趋势。既然此前没有任何多头强势可言，交易者就应该整天只考虑做空，除非出现某种能反弹到收盘的建仓形态的迹象。在第5根K线那个潜在底部出现之前，交易者本可以做空任何一次小幅回调。到第1根K线时，此前最大的一次回调刚刚超过一美元，所以交易者本可以把限价空单挂在最近低点上方一美元处。他们得先确定保护性止损该放哪里，才能算出一个最低的合理利润目标。由于这往往很难，他们需要想想最坏的情况。举例来说，如果市场涨到当天第四根K线之上，那么看空的前提就会弱得多。因此，他们本可以把保护性止损放在它高点上方一点，大约 $179.50。既然他们做空的价格大约在 $177，那么这笔交易就要冒大约 $2.50 的风险。如果他们平常一笔交易的风险不超过 $500，那他们最多只能做200股。既然这是一段趋势，他们就必须假定至少有60%的概率创新低，也就是大约 $1.00 的利润，但他们只应该做潜在回报至少等于风险的交易。这意味着，他们应该争取在入场价下方 $2.50 处、也就是 $174.50 附近平掉一半（100股）。他们会在第2根K线之前两根K线形成的那根空头趋势K线上成交。此时，他们可以把止损移到保本并持有，直到始终入场方向翻成做多、直到止损被打掉、直到最后一个小时左右出现任何说得过去的向上反转，或者直到收盘。如果他们在第5根K线上方离场，那么第二笔100股能赚 $900。如果他们在市场因涨到 $170 的多头急速行情而变成始终做多时离场，能赚 $700；如果一直持到收盘，那第二笔100股也能赚大约 $700。


> A small pullback trend is the strongest type of bear trend and, since there was no prior bull strength, traders should only have considered shorting all day, unless there was some sign of a setup for a bounce into the close. Traders could have shorted any small pullback until the potential bottom at bar 5. By bar 1, the biggest prior pullback was a little more than a dollar, so traders could have placed limit orders to short at one dollar above the most recent low. They would have needed to determine where their protective stops needed to be in order to calculate a minimum reasonable profit goal. Since this is often difficult, they needed to think about a worst-case situation. For example, if the market traded above the fourth bar of the day, then the bear case would have been much weaker. Therefore, they could have used protective stops just above its high at around $179.50. Since they would have been shorting at around $177, they would have been risking about $2.50 on their trade. If they normally don't risk more than $500 on a trade, then they could only have traded 200 shares. Since this was a trend, they had to assume that there would be at least a 60 percent chance of a new low, or about a $1.00 profit, but they should take only trades where the potential reward is at least as large as the risk. This means that they should have been trying to take maybe half off (100 shares) at $2.50 below their entry price, or around $174.50. They would have been filled on the bear trend bar that formed two bars before bar 2. At that point, they could move their stop to breakeven and hold until the always-in position reversed to long, until their stop was hit, until any reasonable reversal up in the final hour or so, or until the close of the day. If they exited above bar 5, they would have made $900 on their second 100 shares. If they exited when the market became always-in up on the bull spike up to $170, they would have made $700, and if they held until the close, they would also have made about $700 on those second 100 shares.


这是一个应当避开的反转入场的完美例子。每天你都应该在盘中不断检查走势图，尤其是在头几个小时，以判断当天是不是趋势日（主要类型在本系列第一本书里描述过）。如果是，你就不该做逆势交易。像这样一个开盘即趋势日，是最容易看出来的趋势日。到当天第三根K线（一根大号空头趋势K线，远远跌破开盘价）时，你就应该有所怀疑；等到市场跌破第1根K线时，你应该已经非常确信了。


> This was a perfect example of reversal entries to be avoided. Every day, you should be examining the chart throughout the day, and especially in the first couple of hours, to determine whether the day is a trend day (the major types were described in the first book of this series). If it is, you should not be trading countertrend. A trend from the open day like this is the easiest trend day to see. You would have suspected it by the third bar of the day (a large bear trend bar, dropping far from the open), and you would have been very confident by the time the market broke below bar 1.


第1根K线那波上涨是一根大号多头趋势K线，它突破了一条微型趋势线，因此很可能会失败。一个急切的交易者当时可能会在第2、3、4根K线那些反转K线上方买入，以为多头在这次趋势线突破期间展示了足够的强势。然而，从当天第三根K线开始市场就一直位于移动平均线之下，交易者应该记住：在这样的小幅回调空头趋势日里，第一次回到移动平均线的上涨通常会失败，随后市场会去测试低点。不要说服自己相信市场已经跌得太多、该反弹了。按定义，你正在逆势思考，在一个强趋势日里找逆势剥头皮的机会。你不敢在低点附近卖出，反而盼着趋势反转——而这是一个低概率的赌注。算算数学。大多数逆势剥头皮都会失败，而你在每一笔上亏掉的钱，多到一两次最终的盈利远远补不回来。


> The bar 1 rally was a big bull trend bar that broke a micro trend line and was therefore likely to fail. An eager trader might then have bought above the bar 2, bar 3, and bar 4 reversal bars, thinking that the bulls showed adequate strength during that trend line break. However, the market had been below the moving average since the third bar of the day, and traders should remember that on small pullback bear trend days like this, the first rally to the moving average usually fails and then the market tests the low. Don't convince yourself that the market has gone too far and is due for a rally. By definition, you are thinking countertrend and looking for countertrend scalps on a strong trend day. You are afraid to sell near the low and instead are hoping for a trend reversal, which is a low-probability bet. Do the math. Most countertrend scalps will fail, and the amount you lose on each one will be too great to make up with the eventual winner or two.


不过，由于 GS 一整天都没有出现移动平均线处可交易的低2做空，有经验的交易者会连最小的回调都做空，倚仗那个典型的回调序列（本系列第二本书里描述过）来救自己——万一回调涨得比他们认为的更高，那个序列会把他们救出来。每一种第一波回调之后，通常都跟着一次对趋势极值的测试（在这里就是当天的最低点）。


> However, since GS did not have a tradable low 2 short at the moving average all day, experienced traders would have been shorting even the tiniest pullbacks, relying on the typical pullback sequence (described in the second book in the series) to bail them out if a pullback went further up than they thought was likely. Every type of first pullback is usually followed by a test of the trend's extreme (here, the low of the day).


![图 24.9](figures/fig-24-09.jpg)


**图 24.9　VOD 日线图上的最佳交易**


如图 24.9 所示，在这张总部位于英国的沃达丰集团（Vodafone Group，VOD）——全球最大的通信服务公司之一——的日线图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第3根K线在移动平均线处的高1；第7根K线的楔形牛旗以及一次均线缺口K线的二次入场；第8根K线的小型三角形；第11根K线回到移动平均线的楔形牛旗；第12根K线的高2；第14根K线的楔形牛旗；以及第15根K线低点处的做多突破回调。


> As shown in Figure 24.9, the best trade setups on this daily chart of England-based Vodafone Group (VOD), one the world's largest communications services companies, include the bar 3 high 1 at the moving average, the bar 7 wedge bull flag and second entry of a moving average gap bar, the bar 8 small triangle, the bar 11 wedge bull flag to the moving average, the bar 12 high 2, the bar 14 wedge bull flag, and the breakout pullback on a long at the low of bar 15.


当出现强多头趋势、并且牛旗向上突破，而突破K线带多头实体时，在它低点下方买入是可靠的策略。这是因为这次回调通常会变成突破回调做多建仓形态，而你买入的价格更低。VOD 在日线图上处在强多头趋势里。第15根K线是一根多头趋势K线，突破了移动平均线处的楔形牛旗，所以任何回调很可能都很短暂、并且会成为突破回调买入建仓形态的信号K线，这种可能性很高。交易者本可以在第15根K线低点用限价单买入。那些抱着「在回调K线上方买入」的计划等待的交易者，看到第二天大幅跳空高开时都很失望。如果他们仍然想做多，就只能用更差的价格去做。


> When there is a strong bull trend and a breakout of a bull flag and the breakout bar has a bull body, buying below its low is a reliable strategy. This is because the pullback usually becomes a breakout pullback long setup and you are buying at a lower price. VOD was in a strong bull trend on the daily chart. Bar 15 was a bull trend bar breakout of a wedge bull flag at the moving average, so the odds were high that any pullback would be brief and become the signal bar for a breakout pullback buy setup. Traders could have bought on a limit order at the low of bar 15. Traders who waited with the plan of buying above the pullback bar were disappointed to see the large gap up on the next day. If they still wanted to go long, they had to do such at a worse price.


虽然市场从第5根K线跌到了自第3根K线起的上升通道底边那条趋势线（未画出）之下，但这两根K线的抛售连移动平均线都没碰到。这使得第6根K线成为主要趋势反转「更低的高点」的糟糕候选，市场更可能只是在制造一次回调。它结束于第7根K线的高2、楔形牛旗和均线缺口K线。


> Although the market fell from bar 5 to below the trend line (not shown) along the bottom of the channel up from bar 3, the two-bar sell-off did not even touch the moving average. This made bar 6 a bad candidate for a major trend reversal lower high, and it was more likely that the market was simply creating a pullback. It ended at the bar 7 high 2, wedge bull flag, and moving average gap bar.


![图 24.10](figures/fig-24-10.jpg)


**图 24.10　大多数时候都要想着低买高卖**


一般来说，永远要想着低买高卖，除了在强趋势里——在多头趋势里你买高、在更高处离场，在空头趋势里你卖低、在更低处离场。不过，如果你做空的是自认为是小级别顶部的位置，比如图 24.10 所示 Emini 图上第15或16根K线下方，而市场随后像第17根K线那样形成一个高2，那就离场，甚至可以反手做多。如果那个高2信号K线是一根正在测试移动平均线的多头K线，就尤其该这样做。同样，如果你在空头行情段的底部买入，而市场随后形成一个说得过去的低2——信号K线是一根正在测试移动平均线底部的空头K线——那就离场，并考虑反手做空。


> In general, always look to buy low and sell high, except in a strong trend where you buy high and exit higher in a bull trend or sell low and exit lower in a bear trend. However, if you short what you think is a minor top, like below bar 15 or 16 in the Emini chart shown in Figure 24.10, and the market then forms a high 2 as it did at bar 17, exit or even reverse to long. This is especially true if the high 2 signal bar is a bull bar that is testing the moving average. Likewise, if you buy at the bottom of a bear leg and the market then forms a reasonable low 2 with a bear signal bar testing the bottom of the moving average, exit and consider reversing to short.


当 Emini 的日均波动区间约为10到15点时，交易者通常得在一笔交易上冒大约两个点的风险。他们应该找那些回报至少等于风险、成功概率至少60%的交易。大多数交易日通常有五个或更多这样的建仓形态，比如在这张图上做空第1根K线的开盘反转、在第3根K线低点上方买入、买高2回调（第7根K线、第14根K线之后那根K线，以及第17根K线），以及第22根K线的微型通道突破回调。记住，如果交易者认为某个建仓形态很可能不错，他们就应该假定这意味着成功概率至少有60%。只要回报至少等于风险，这就构成正值的交易者等式。


> When the average daily range in the Emini is about 10 to 15 points, traders usually have to risk about two points on a trade. They should look for trades where the reward is at least as large as the risk and the chance of success is at least 60 percent. There are usually five or more such setups on most days, like shorting the bar 1 opening reversal in this chart, buying above the bar 3 low, buying high 2 pullbacks (bar 7, the bar after bar 14, and bar 17), and the bar 22 micro channel breakout pullback. Remember, if traders think that a setup is probably good, they should assume that this means that the chance of success is at least 60 percent. If the reward is at least as large as the risk, this creates a positive trader's equation.


注意，大多数小级别反转都来自微型双顶、微型双底和小型最终旗形。剥头皮者喜欢在下单之前看到这些建仓形态。


> Note that most minor reversals come from micro double tops and bottoms and small final flags. Scalpers like to see these setups before placing their trades.


![图 24.11](figures/fig-24-11.jpg)


**图 24.11　回报永远至少应当与风险一样大**


一笔最佳交易，就是成功概率至少有60%、潜在回报至少等于风险的交易。如图 24.11 所示，在这张印度汽车制造商 Tata Motors Ltd（TTM）的日线图上，最佳交易建仓形态是：第3和第4根K线的高2建仓形态；自第5根K线到第6根K线那段多头急速行情里的任意一根K线；第10根K线的高2；第11根K线的楔形牛旗；第12根K线突破之后的高1；第14根K线的突破回调以及它前一根K线上的高2入场；第16根K线的高2；以及第20根K线的更高的高点反转。


> A best trade is one where there is at least a 60 percent chance of success and the potential reward is at least as large as the risk. As shown in Figure 24.11, the best trade setups on this daily chart of Tata Motors Ltd (TTM), the carmaker in India, were the bar 3 and bar 4 high 2 setups, any of the three bars in the bull spike from bar 5 to bar 6, the bar 10 high 2, the 11 wedge bull flag, the high 1 after the bar 12 breakout, the bar 14 breakout pullback and the high 2 entry on the bar before it, the bar 16 high 2, and the bar 20 higher high reversal.


在强趋势里，回到移动平均线的楔形牛旗回调是可靠的买入建仓形态。TTM 从第1根K线起处在强多头趋势里，不到两个月上涨了近40%，直到第8根K线。市场在第10根K线出现了一次回到移动平均线的高2回调，那是一笔合理的买入，随后它在移动平均线处的第11根K线（一根内包K线）上演变成楔形牛旗买入建仓形态。第11根K线是自结束于第10根K线的牛旗突破以来的回调，因此它也是突破回调买入建仓形态。如果交易者在第10根K线上方买入，他们可以在三根K线之后的抛售中以保本离场，也可以依靠信号K线下方的保护性止损——那一单不会被打掉。他们还可以把止损放在第7根K线低点下方一点。


> A wedge bull flag pullback to the moving average in a strong trend is a reliable buy setup. TTM was in a strong bull trend from bar 1 and rose almost 40 percent in less than two months to bar 8. The market had a high 2 pullback to the moving average at bar 10, which was a reasonable buy, and it evolved into a wedge bull flag buy setup at the bar 11 inside bar, also at the moving average. Bar 11 was a pullback from the breakout of the bull flag that ended at bar 10, and it was therefore also a breakout pullback buy setup. If traders bought above bar 10, they could have exited at breakeven on the sell-off three bars later, or they could have relied on their protective stop below the signal bar, which would not have been hit. They could also have placed their stop a little below the bar 7 low.


第7根K线是多头趋势里一段强劲多头急速行情中的第一次回调，而且它前面没有出现买入高潮。这是一个理想的高1做多买入建仓形态，同时也是一个微型通道突破失败买入建仓形态。它还是突破回调买入建仓形态，因为它是向上突破那个以第5根K线突破收尾的窄幅交易区间之后的第一次回调。


> Bar 7 was the first pullback in a strong bull spike in a bull trend, and it did not follow a buy climax. This was an ideal high 1 long buy setup, which was also a micro channel failed breakout buy setup. It was a breakout pullback buy setup, since it was the first pullback after the breakout above the tight trading range that ended with the bar 5 breakout.


第17根K线那根巨大的多头趋势K线是一次买入高潮。每当一段持续10根、20根或更多根K线的趋势随后出现一根巨大的多头趋势K线时，这根K线往往代表衰竭。它的形成，是因为最后一批空头离场、以及迟到的多头买入。这两拨人都是弱势交易者。此时的强势多头只会买回调，强势空头则在做空，而且他们会在更高处做空更多。第17根K线的突破远远越过过去几个月的趋势通道线，并引出画一条更高的趋势通道线。市场在第19和第20根K线两次试图突破那条线，两次都遇到强劲卖盘——从这两根K线顶部的大影线、第19根K线的空头实体，以及第20根K线远远低于中点的收盘价都能看出来。当市场两次尝试做同一件事、两次都失败时，它通常就会尝试朝反方向走。自第18根K线开始的空头K线，以及第19、20根K线顶部的大影线，代表着不断累积的卖压；而自第17根K线起K线幅度都很大，说明多头正格外努力地想把趋势变成一段更强的多头趋势。他们的努力导致了自己的衰竭，卖压把他们拖垮了。市场很可能会走出至少一次两段式修正，并且可能发生趋势反转。


> The huge bull trend bar at bar 17 was a buy climax. Whenever there is a trend of 10 or 20 or more bars and it then has a huge bull trend bar, the bar often represents exhaustion. It formed due to some of the last shorts exiting and the late bulls buying. Both of these groups were weak traders. The strong bulls at this point would only buy a pullback and the strong bears would be shorting, and they would short more higher. The bar 17 breakout went far above the trend channel line of the past couple of months, and it led to the drawing of a higher trend channel line. The market tried to break above that line on bars 19 and 20 and both times found strong selling, as seen by the large tails on the tops of both bars, the bear body on bar 19, and the close well below the midpoint of bar 20. When the market tries to do something twice and fails both times, it usually then tries to go in the opposite direction. The bear bars starting at bar 18 and the large tails on the tops of bars 19 and 20 represented accumulating selling pressure, and the large size of the bars from bar 17 onward indicated that the bulls were trying exceptionally hard to convert the trend into an even stronger bull trend. Their efforts led to their exhaustion and the selling pressure wore them down. The market was likely to have at least a two-legged correction and a possible trend reversal.


跌到第18根K线的抛售跌破了多头趋势线，而所有这些卖压都让抛售更可能发生，所以在第20根K线之后那根强劲空头K线下方做空，是一笔高概率交易。那是一根大号空头趋势K线，收在最低点，并与第20根K线构成一次大幅的两根K线反转。空头实体之大、影线之小，说明卖盘非常强。


> The sell-off to bar 18 broke below a bull trend line, and all of the selling pressure made a sell-off likely, so shorting below the strong bear bar after bar 20 was a high-probability trade. This was a large bear trend bar that closed on its low and formed a large two-bar reversal with bar 20. The size of the bear body and the tiny tails indicated that the selling was very strong.

**图 24.12　SOLF 的最佳交易**


如图 24.12 所示，在这张中国太阳能电池（用于太阳能电池板）制造商 Solarfun Power Holdings Company Ltd（SOLF）的日线图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第4根K线在移动平均线处的高2；第5根K线自第三次上推之后的巨幅反转下跌；第7根K线在两段强劲下推之后的低2；第8根K线的双底牛旗；第9根K线之后以及又一次在第10根K线之后的小型高2；第12根K线的更高的高点；以及第14根K线两段式的更低的高点。


> As shown in Figure 24.12, the best trade setups on the daily chart of Solarfun Power Holdings Company Ltd (SOLF), the Chinese manufacturer of photoelectric cells that are used in solar panels, include the bar 4 high 2 at the moving average, the bar 5 huge reversal down from the third push up, the bar 7 low 2 after two strong pushes down, the bar 8 double bottom bull flag, the small high 2 after bar 9 and again after bar 10, the bar 12 higher high, and the bar 14 two-legged lower high.


更高的高点反转之后，通常跟着一个更低的高点做空建仓形态。SOLF 从第5根K线那个高点开始强势下跌。就在第6根K线之前有一根大号空头趋势K线，第3和第4根K线附近还有几根其它空头趋势K线。这些代表卖压，而卖压是累积的，到某个时点可能会带来趋势反转。不过，在趋势线突破之后，空头没能接出连续的空头趋势K线，所以始终入场方向仍然是做多。


> A higher high reversal is usually followed by a lower high short setup. SOLF had a strong move down from the bar 5 high. There was a second large bear trend bar just before bar 6 and several other bear trend bars around bars 3 and 4. These represented selling pressure, which is cumulative and at some point can lead to a trend reversal. However, the bears were unable to string together consecutive bear trend bars after the trend line break, so the always-in position was still long.


跌到第8根K线的抛售强势跌破了多头趋势线，但涨到第9根K线的急剧上涨突破了头肩顶部中第7根K线那个右肩，因此很可能有后续行情。在涨到第9根的急速行情之后，市场走出了一条涨到第12根K线的通道，并在第12根K线上方形成了一个更高的高点。在自第5根K线起的强势下跌之后，空头在找机会做空，多头在找机会止盈。有些交易者把第12根K线看作这条通道中的第三次上推，其中第9根或第10根K线构成第一次上推，第10根或第11根K线构成第二次上推。第12根K线的信号K线是一根十字星，所以有些交易者可能选择等待，看是否有更多的空头强势出现。


> The sell-off to bar 8 strongly broke the bull trend line, but the sharp rally to bar 9 broke above the bar 7 right shoulder of the head and shoulders top and was therefore likely to have follow-through. After the spike up to bar 9, the market had a channel up to bar 12, which formed a higher high above bar 12. After strong selling down from bar 5, bears were looking to short and bulls were looking to take profits. Some traders saw bar 12 as the third push up in the channel where either bar 9 or bar 10 formed the first push and either bar 10 or bar 11 formed the second push. The bar 12 signal bar was a doji, so some traders may have waited for more bear strength to appear.


第12根K线之后那根强劲的空头趋势K线是强势卖出的迹象，给了空头在接下来两根K线上大举卖出的信心。这段三根K线的空头急速行情由带大空头实体的K线组成，而且这段急速行情跌破了多头趋势线。交易者相信更可能出现更多卖盘；由于市场此时已经始终做空，他们开始找机会做空上涨行情。


> The strong bear trend bar after bar 12 was a sign of strong selling and gave the bears the confidence to sell aggressively on the next couple of bars. This three-bar bear spike was made of bars with large bear bodies, and the spike broke the bull trend line. Traders believed that more selling was likely, and since the market was now always-in short, they were looking to short rallies.


市场在第14根K线形成了一个两段式的更低的高点，测试了第12根K线的低点，而市场从这根K线的第一个最小报价单位就开始下跌。交易者非常确信市场会下跌。有些交易者在市场跌破它前一根K线低点、变成外包下跌K线时做空，另一些交易者则在跌破第13根K线那段急速行情时做空，预期至少有一段向下的等距运动。


> The market formed a two-legged lower high at bar 14 that tested the bar 12 low, and the market sold off from the first tick of the bar. Traders were very confident that the market was going down. Some traders shorted as the market went below the low of the bar before it and became an outside down bar, while other traders shorted the breakout below the bar 13 spike, expecting at least a measured move down.


跌到第15根K线的那段空头急速行情也很强，但一些空单持有者被涨到第18根K线的急剧上涨关在了场外——那波上涨刚好在第16根K线高点上方。有些交易者在第15根K线那根多头趋势K线上方买入，因为它与第8根K线构成双底牛旗、是一次两根K线反转，也是两根K线之前那次一根K线的最终旗形反转。然而，空头在第18根K线之后那根带大空头实体的K线上又回来了。被关在一笔绝佳交易之外是很容易发生的事，但重要的是要努力避免。不要过早收紧止损，尽量用保本止损守住一部分仓位，直到市场明确变成始终做多。涨到第18根K线的这波上涨还不足以翻转始终入场方向，所以波段交易者本该继续持空。


> The bear spike down to bar 15 was also strong, but some shorts were trapped out by the sharp rally to bar 18, just above the bar 16 high. Some traders bought above the bar 15 bull trend bar because it was a double bottom bull flag with bar 8, a two-bar reversal, and a one-bar final flag reversal from two bars earlier. However, the bears returned on the bar after bar 18, which had a large bear body. It is easy to get trapped out of a great trade, but it is important to try hard to avoid getting trapped out. Do not tighten your stops too early, and try to hold some of your position with a breakeven stop until the market clearly becomes always-in long. The rally to bar 18 was not enough to flip the always-in position, so swing traders should have stayed short.


自第5根K线到第8根K线的抛售强到让交易者怀疑市场是不是正在从多头趋势演变成交易区间。涨到第12根K线的这波上涨里有很多回调、很多空头实体、很多顶部带影线的K线，这些都是卖压的迹象，表明市场正在变成一个双向市场。这看起来更像是交易区间里的一段多头行情段，而不是多头趋势。交易者开始在做空摆动高点上方卖出，比如第10根K线涨到第9根K线上方时，或者第11根K线涨到第10根K线上方时。第12根K线是一个更高的高点（高于第5根K线）主要趋势反转的信号K线，但大多数交易者认为，出现交易区间并测试区间底部第8根K线的可能性，大于出现空头趋势的可能——这永远是常态（大多数交易区间的突破尝试都会失败）。虽然在自第15根到第17根K线那片区域里有一些止盈盘，但第16和第18根K线构成了双顶熊旗，并引出了向下突破区间。许多交易者在第15根K线一带部分止盈，并把保护性止损移到保本，盼着更大的向下波段行情，同时心里也清楚概率不到50%。不过，他们有时会意外赚到一笔大钱，就像这回一样。


> The sell-off from bar 5 to bar 8 was strong enough to make traders wonder if the market was evolving from a bull trend into a trading range. The rally to bar 12 had many pullbacks, bear bodies, and bars with tails on the top, which are signs of selling pressure, indicating a change into a two-sided market. This looked more like a bull leg in a trading range than a bull trend. Traders were beginning to sell above swing highs, like when bar 10 moved above bar 9, or when bar 11 moved above bar 10. Bar 12 was a signal bar for a higher high (above bar 5) major trend reversal, but most traders assumed that a trading range and a test of the bar 8 bottom of the range was more likely than a bear trend, as is always the case (most trading range breakout attempts fail). Although there was some profit taking in that area between bars 15 and 17, bars 16 and 18 formed a double top bear flag and led to a breakout below the range. Many traders took partial profits in the bar 15 area and moved their protective stops to breakeven, hoping for a bigger swing down, but knowing that the probability was less than 50 percent. However, they sometimes make a windfall profit, as they did here.

**图 24.13　CX 的最佳交易**


如图 24.13 所示，在这张墨西哥大型水泥生产商 Cemex（CX）的日线图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第2根K线的最终旗形反转以及与第1根K线构成的微型双顶；在随后空头急速行情中那三根K线里的任意一根做空；第4根K线回到移动平均线的楔形熊旗回调；在第5根K线卖出高潮（空头突破失败）和双底之后，在那根小号多头内包K线上方买入；在第7根K线的低2和微型双顶下方做空，或者在它跌破前一根K线低点时做空（因为那根是低2做空信号K线）；在第8根K线三重底处、以及那根多头反转K线处买入；在移动平均线处做空第10根K线那个双顶熊旗（与第9根K线构成双顶，它同时也是空头趋势里移动平均线处一根空头反转K线的低2）；做空第12根K线的微型通道突破失败、以及自三重底向下突破之后的突破回调；在第14根K线的微型双底牛旗处买入，以及在强劲的第13根K线多头反转K线和大幅两段式下跌之后的失败低2处买入（大致是一段「第1段＝第2段」的运动，其中第1段是自第2根K线到第3根K线的急速行情，第2段是自第9根K线到第13根K线的空头通道，它有三推；第7根K线是一段较小的空头急速行情，与它共用同一条空头通道）；在第15根K线那个均线缺口K线下方做空；在第16根K线那个更高的低点上方买入；做空第17根K线的低2（自第16根K线起有两次上推，而第15根K线是一个更大的低2中的第一次上推）以及楔形熊旗（第13根K线之后那根K线是第一次上推）；买入第19根K线的更高的低点主要趋势反转；买入第21根K线的高2（它与第20根K线之后那根多头内包K线构成微型双底）；以及买入第25根K线在移动平均线处的三角形（或楔形牛旗），那里有许多K线带多头实体（买压）。


> As shown in Figure 24.13, the best trade setups on this daily chart of Cemex (CX), the large cement producer in Mexico, include the bar 2 final flag reversal and micro double top with bar 1, shorting during any of the three following bars during the bear spike, the bar 4 wedge bear flag pullback to the moving average, buying above the small bull inside bar after the bar 5 sell climax (failed bear breakout) and double bottom, shorting below the bar 7 low 2 and micro double top or as it went below the low of the bar before it (since that was a low 2 sell signal bar), buying the bar 8 triple bottom and bull reversal bar, shorting the bar 10 double top bear flag (with bar 9) at the moving average (which was also a bear reversal bar low 2 at the moving average in a bear trend), shorting the bar 12 micro channel failed breakout and breakout pullback from the breakout below the triple bottom buying the bar 14 micro double bottom bull flag, and failed low 2 after the strong bar 13 bull reversal bar and big two-legged move down (an approximate leg 1 = leg 2 move, where leg 1 was the spike from bar 2 to bar 3, and leg 2 was the bear channel from bar 9 to bar 13, which had three pushes; bar 7 was a smaller bear spike and it shared the same bear channel), and shorting below the bar 15 moving average gap bar, buying above the bar 16 higher low, shorting the bar 17 low 2 (there were two pushes up from bar 16, and bar 15 was the first push up of a larger low 2) and wedge bear flag (the bar after bar 13 was the first push up), buying the bar 19 higher low major trend reversal, buying the bar 21 high 2 (it was a micro double bottom with the bull inside bar after bar 20), and buying the bar 25 triangle (or wedge bull flag) at the moving average where many bars had bull bodies (buying pressure).


当出现强劲的空头急速行情、交易者预期还有更多卖盘时，市场就是始终做空，交易者会去找做空机会。CX 有一段强劲的空头急速行情，一路跌到第3根K线。交易者预期价格会更低，都在找机会做空上涨。他们做空了第4根K线那波走到移动平均线的两段式小上涨。有些交易者用限价单在移动平均线处做空，因为这是强空头急速行情之后第一次回到移动平均线的回调。另一些交易者用止损单在第4根K线下方做空。第4根K线跌破了它前一根K线，属于一次首次入场做空；而在第4根K线下方做空的人，做的是二次入场。


> When there is a strong bear spike and traders expect more selling, the market is always-in down and traders will look for shorts. CX had a strong bear spike down to bar 3. Traders were expecting lower prices and were looking to short rallies. They shorted the small two-legged rally to the moving average at bar 4. Some traders shorted with limit orders at the moving average because this was the first pullback to the moving average after a strong bear spike. Other traders shorted on stops below bar 4. Bar 4 traded below the bar before it and was a first-entry short, and the traders who shorted below bar 4 were taking the second entry.


第7根K线那波更大的两段式上涨是一个低2做空建仓形态。激进的空头在前一根K线高点上方、以及第4根K线上方用限价单做空；另一些人则在K线跌破前一根K线低点、产生二次入场做空信号时做空（第6根K线是第一个信号）。许多交易者更愿意在强劲空头趋势K线下方做空，于是在第7根K线下方做空。想在那里做空的人太多了，以至于市场第二天直接跳空低开。


> The larger two-legged rally at bar 7 was a low 2 short setup. Aggressive bears shorted on limit orders above the high of the prior bar and above bar 4, and others shorted as the bar fell below the low of the prior bar and generated a second-entry short signal (bar 6 was the first signal). Many traders prefer to short below strong bear trend bars and shorted below bar 7. There were so many traders looking to short there that the market gapped down the next day.


跌到第11根K线有一段强劲的空头急速行情，而第12根K线向上突破了微型通道。空头在第12根K线下方做空，预期微型通道的第一次突破尝试会失败。


> There was a strong bear spike down to bar 11, and bar 12 broke above the micro channel. Bears shorted below bar 12, expecting the first micro channel breakout attempt to fail.


虽然横盘走到第17根K线的走势突破了一条陡峭的空头趋势线，但跌到第13根K线的走势远在第8根K线低点之下，交易者于是重新开始寻找底部。他们需要再来一波上涨突破空头趋势线，然后再来一次对趋势低点的测试，才会愿意认为市场正在反转，而不只是在形成又一轮空头反弹。涨到第17根K线的两段式上涨强到明显突破移动平均线，因此是买压的迹象。交易者在第17根K线那根空头反转K线下方做空，因为他们把它看作一波大的两段式上涨的终点，因而是一个低2做空建仓形态。它同时还是空头趋势里的一次均线缺口K线做空——这波空头趋势当时还没有明确翻成始终做多的多头趋势。


> Although the sideways move to bar 17 broke above a steep bear trend line, the move down to bar 13 was so far below the bar 8 low that traders began the process of looking for a bottom all over again. They needed another rally to break above a bear trend line and then another test of the trend's low before they would be willing to think that the market was reversing and not just forming another bear rally. The two-legged move up to bar 17 was strong enough to break well above the moving average and was therefore a sign of buying pressure. Traders shorted below the bar 17 bear reversal bar because they saw it as the end of a large two-legged rally and therefore a low 2 short setup. It was also a moving average gap bar short in a bear trend that had yet to clearly flip into an always-in bull trend.


第19根K线那根外包十字星K线并不是一根强劲的更高的低点买入信号K线，但有些交易者在这根K线上方买入，也在随后那根突破空头趋势线的强劲多头趋势K线上方买入。它是对第14根K线上方多单的一次突破回测，打掉了那些多单的保本止损。一次突破回测先打掉保本止损、随后又朝新趋势的方向反转向上，是一个风险回报比很好的建仓形态。风险在信号K线底部，回报则是一段新的多头趋势所带来的，要大许多倍。


> The bar 19 outside doji bar was not a strong higher low buy signal bar, but some traders bought above it and above the strong bull trend bar that followed it, which broke above a bear trend line. It was a breakout test of the longs above bar 14, and it ran the breakeven stops on those longs. A breakout test that runs breakeven stops and then reverses back up in the direction of the new trend is a good risk/reward setup. The risk is to the bottom of the signal bar, and the reward is that of a new bull trend, which is many times larger.


涨到第20根K线的多头急速行情强势突破了移动平均线和一条长期空头趋势线。有些交易者把这看成对一条倾斜的头肩底颈线的突破。大多数交易者认为自第19根K线到第20根K线的多头急速行情足够强，之后应该会有更高的价格。这意味着他们认为市场已经始终做多。他们在第21根K线那个高2建仓形态上方买入，又在第24根K线的高2上方买入。在第25根K线那面楔形牛旗回调到移动平均线处、买在多头K线上方，则更安全。


> The bull spike up to bar 20 broke strongly above the moving average and above a long bear trend line. Some traders saw this as a break above the neckline of a sloping head and shoulders bottom. Most traders saw the bull spike from bar 19 to 20 as strong enough so that it should be followed by higher prices. This means that they saw the market as always-in long. They bought above the bar 21 high 2 setup and again above the bar 24 high 2. It was safer to buy above the bull bars at the bar 25 wedge bull flag pullback to the moving average.


另一些交易者把跌到第23根K线的走势解读为一段空头微型通道，但由于它仍在移动平均线上方、且处在强多头趋势里，他们相信它很可能会成为牛旗的一部分。因此，与其等突破失败后在它下方做空，不如假定突破会失败、但失败之后走不远、反而会变成突破回调买入信号——这样更合理。记住，当一次空头微型通道的突破失败之后，这次失败本身就变成了突破回调做多入场。第24根K线就是那次突破回调，但它带空头实体，所以大多数交易者不会在它高点上方买入。不过，这次回调随后变成了回到第25根K线的两段式回调，那里同时也是双底牛旗。


> Other traders interpreted the move down to bar 23 as a bear micro channel, but since it was still above the moving average and in a strong bull trend, they believed that it was likely to become part of a bull flag. Therefore, rather than looking for the breakout to fail and then shorting below it, it made more sense to assume that the breakout would fail but the failure would not go far and instead would become a breakout pullback buy signal. Remember, when a failed breakout of a bear micro channel fails, it becomes a breakout pullback long entry. Bar 24 was the breakout pullback, but it had a bear body, so most traders would not have bought above its high. However, the pullback became a two-legged pullback to bar 25, which was also a double bottom bull flag.

**图 24.14　GOOG 的最佳交易**


如图 24.14 所示，在这张 Google（GOOG）的5分钟图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第2和第3根K线回到移动平均线的低2回调；买入第4根K线的最终旗形与楔形底部反转；做空第7根K线的均线缺口K线、低2和双顶；买入第9根K线的更低的低点主要趋势反转；以及买入第10根K线的更高的低点以及打掉止损的突破回测。


> As shown in Figure 24.14, the best trade setups on this 5 minute chart of Google (GOOG) include the bar 2 and bar 3 low 2 pullbacks to the moving average; buying the bar 4 final flag and wedge bottom reversal; shorting the bar 7 moving average gap bar, low 2, and double top; buying the bar 9 major trend reversal lower low; and buying the bar 10 higher low and stop-running breakout test.


当出现对空头趋势线的强劲向上突破时，交易者会找机会买入对空头低点的测试，只要这次测试没有跌得太远。GOOG 有一波涨到第7根K线的强劲上涨，由带小影线的多头趋势K线组成。它突破了空头趋势线和移动平均线；而在自第1根K线向下那波空头急速行情之后的下跌中，已经出现过好几根强劲的多头趋势K线。那些带小影线的大号多头趋势K线，意味着多头愿意买入。这种买压是累积的，到某个时点，它能把空头消耗到足以让多头掌控市场的程度。


> When there is a strong break above the bear trend line, traders will look to buy a test of the bear low, as long as the test does not fall too far below. GOOG had a strong rally to bar 7, composed of bull trend bars with small tails. It broke above the bear trend line and above the moving average, and there had been several strong bull trend bars in the move down after the bear spike down from bar 1. Those large bull trend bars with small tails signify that the bulls are willing to buy. That buying pressure is cumulative and, at some point, it can wear down the bears enough so that the bulls can take control of the market.


激进的交易者本会在第5根K线之后那根空头K线的高点用限价单做空。那里有三根连续重叠的K线，任何多单都被迫在这个交易区间的顶部买入。考虑到那正好位于空头日的移动平均线底部，这尤其是个坏主意。既然这个买入点很可能会失败，精明的交易者反而恰恰在弱势多头买入的位置做空。


> Aggressive traders would have shorted on a limit order at the high of the bear bar after bar 5. There were three consecutive overlapping bars, and any longs were being forced to buy at the top of this trading range. That is an especially bad idea, given that it was right at the bottom of the moving average in a bear day. Since it was likely to fail as a buy, astute traders instead shorted just where the weak bulls were buying.


自第7根K线起的抛售里有许多相互重叠的K线，还有好几根多头K线，说明存在双向交易。空头并没有完全掌控局面。市场一跌破第4根K线那个空头低点，第8根K线就有买盘进来。他们没能把市场反转，市场再次跌破空头低点。第8根K线是自第7根K线起的空头通道的第一次向上突破，因此不太可能有后续行情。不过，在第9根K线这第二次反转趋势的尝试中，多头拿下了接下来三根K线。第9根K线是自第8根K线突破空头微型通道之后的突破回调，而空头通道就是一面牛旗。当空头试图把自第9根K线起的上涨变成一面三根K线的熊旗时，多头在第10根K线那个更高的低点处压倒了他们。第10根K线在比第9根K线做多的信号K线高8美分（对一只 $500 的股票来说，8美分微不足道）处反转向上，是一次极好的突破回测，让交易者可以在它高点上方加仓。它还把多头关在了场外，他们现在只能追高。多头认为第9根K线很可能至少引出两段上涨，因此在接下来几根K线里，他们把限价买单挂在或挂在前一根K线低点下方。他们预期任何低1做空都会失败，并变成一个更高的低点。他们的限价买单会在第10根K线成交，保护性止损则放在第9根K线低点下方。


> The sell-off from bar 7 had many overlapping bars and several bull bars, which indicated that there was two-sided trading. The bears were not in total control. As soon as the market fell below the bar 4 bear low, buyers came in on bar 8. They were not able to reverse the market, and the market fell again below the bear low. Bar 8 was the first break above the bear channel down from bar 7 and therefore not likely to have follow-through. However, on the bar 9 second attempt to reverse the trend, the bulls were able to own the next three bars. Bar 9 was a breakout pullback from the bar 8 breakout above the bear micro channel, and a bear channel is a bull flag. When the bears tried to turn the rally from bar 9 into a three-bar bear flag, the bulls overwhelmed them at the bar 10 higher low. Bar 10 reversed back up at 8 cents (8 cents is tiny for a $500 stock) above the signal bar for the bar 9 long and was an excellent breakout test, allowing traders to add on above its high. It also trapped longs out, and they would now chase the market higher. The bulls saw bar 9 as likely leading to at least two legs up, and they therefore placed limit orders to buy at or below the low of the prior bar during the next several bars. They expected any low 1 short to fail and to become a higher low. Their buy limit orders would have been filled on bar 10. Their protective stops would have been below the bar 9 low.


空头在当天早些时候有不错的做空机会。市场跳空低开，并在第1根K线处、就在移动平均线下方形成了一个低2做空。激进的空头本会在自第1根K线向下那两根大号空头趋势K线形成过程中做空——在它们的收盘价处，以及在它们低点下方一个最小报价单位处。


> The bears had good shorts earlier in the day. The market gapped down and formed a low 2 short just below the moving average at bar 1. Aggressive bears would have shorted during the formation of the two large bear trend bars down from bar 1, on their closes, and at one tick below their lows.


那段空头急速行情非常强，很可能会有后续卖盘，最可能以空头通道的形式出现，而且当天很可能会变成急速与通道空头趋势日。空头本会找机会卖出上涨——也就是在正在形成的空头通道顶部卖出。第2根K线是移动平均线处的一个低2做空，也是对跌破当天第一根K线之后的一次测试。


> The bear spike was so strong that there was likely to have been follow-through selling, most likely in the form of a bear channel, and the day would probably become a spike and channel bear trend day. The bears would have looked to sell rallies, which would be at the top of the developing bear channel. Bar 2 was a low 2 short at the moving average and a test of the breakout below the first bar of the day.


第3根K线是移动平均线处的又一个低2做空，尽管这面熊旗里出现了强劲的多头趋势K线。


> Bar 3 was another low 2 short at the moving average, despite the strong bull trend bars in this bear flag.


第4根K线是从一面两根K线的最终熊旗、以及空头通道中第三次下推处向上反转，而这往往会引出至少一次两段式反转。至少，这个楔形底部很可能表现得像空头楼梯形态，去测试上一次下推的低点（自第2根K线起那波抛售底部的摆动低点）。它同时也是第二次尝试向上反转，第一次在两根K线之前。虽然十字星信号K线并不理想，但这波抛售里有许多多头趋势K线，所以不需要太大的力量就能让市场转向上。这波空头趋势并没有那么强，里面有很多双向交易。


> Bar 4 was a reversal up from a two-bar final bear flag and the third push down in the bear channel, which often leads to at least a two-legged reversal. At a minimum, this wedge bottom was likely to behave like a bear stairs pattern and test the low of the prior push down (the swing low at the bottom of the sell-off from bar 2). It was also a second attempt to reverse up where the first was two bars earlier. Although a doji signal bar is not ideal, the sell-off had many bull trend bars, so not as much force was needed to turn the market up. The bear trend was not all that strong and had a lot of two-sided trading within it.


在空头趋势里买低点时，通常最好至少剥头皮平掉一部分，所以交易者本会在测试移动平均线时平掉一些——那里也刚好在前一个摆动低点上方。接着他们本可以把保护性止损移到保本。大多数交易者会在市场跌破自第5根K线开始的那两根空头趋势K线时离场，但有些人会继续把止损放在第4根K线那个空头低点下方。这还不是一个强底部，因为涨到第5根K线的上涨只勉强突破趋势线，因此市场仍然始终做空。多头保持谨慎、早早离场是明智的。


> When buying a low in a bear trend, it is usually good to scalp at least a part of the trade so traders would have exited some on the test of the moving average, which was also just above the prior swing low. They then could have moved their protective stops to breakeven. Most traders would have exited once the market fell below the two bear trend bars that began with bar 5, but some would have kept their stops below the bar 4 bear low. This was not yet a strong bottom because the rally to bar 5 barely broke above the trend line, and therefore the market was still always-in short. It was prudent for bulls to be cautious and get out early.


第7根K线是一次可以接受的均线缺口做空，是与第3根K线构成的双顶熊旗，也是空头趋势里的两段上涨。不过，在一根多头趋势K线下方做空是有风险的，尤其是在一段三根K线的多头急速行情之后。更好的做法是找机会买入对空头低点的更高的低点或更低的低点测试。


> Bar 7 was an acceptable moving average gap short, a double top bear flag with bar 3, and two legs up in a bear trend. However, it would have been risky to short below a bull trend bar, especially following a three-bar bull spike. It would have been better to look to buy a higher low or lower low test of the bear low.


![图 24.15](figures/fig-24-15.jpg)


**图 24.15　AAPL 的一个更低的高点**


如图 24.15 所示，在这张 Apple（AAPL）的5分钟图上，最佳交易建仓形态是第4根K线的更低的高点主要趋势反转，以及跌到第3根K线那波空头急速行情之后的突破回测。激进的交易者本可以在自第1根K线起那段多头急速行情中的任意一根多头趋势K线上买入，但由于他们的保护性止损会离得更远，交易者需要做更小的仓位。


> As shown in Figure 24.15, the best trade setup on this 5 minute chart of Apple (AAPL) was the bar 4 lower high major trend reversal and breakout test after the bear spike down to bar 3. Aggressive traders could have bought during any of the bull trend bars in the bull spike up from bar 1, but since their protective stops would have been further away, traders needed to trade smaller positions.


一旦市场在一段急速与通道顶部之后跌破一条陡峭的通道，交易者往往会找机会做空一个更低的高点。跌到第3根K线的走势动能很强，并且明显跌破多头趋势线。交易者怀疑始终入场方向已经翻成做空，于是在找更低的高点做空。涨到第4根K线的那波两段式更低的高点上涨，是对跌破第2根K线那个两根K线反转之后的一次测试，也是一个低风险做空信号，目标至少是第二段下跌，也可能是趋势反转。


> Once the market breaks below a steep channel after a spike and channel top, traders will often look to short a lower high. The move down to bar 3 had strong momentum and broke well below the bull trend line. Traders suspected that the always-in position had flipped to short and were looking for a lower high sell. The two-legged lower high rally to bar 4 was a test of the breakout below the bar 2 two-bar reversal, and it was a low-risk sell signal for at least a second leg down and possibly a trend reversal.


![图 24.16](figures/fig-24-16.jpg)


**图 24.16　AMZN 的最佳交易**


如图 24.16 所示，在这张 Amazon（AMZN）的日线图上，最佳交易建仓形态是第10根K线那个两段式的更低的高点主要趋势反转，它还有几项其它支撑特征，将在下面几段里描述。其它不错的交易包括：楔形牛旗、均线缺口K线、第2根K线处的双底牛旗，以及第3根K线的最终旗形与楔形顶部。有些交易者把第一次上推看作第2根K线抛售之前那个多头趋势高点。另一些交易者把那看作第二次上推，而把6月份的高点看作第一次上推。


> As shown in Figure 24.16, the best trade setup on this daily chart of Amazon (AMZN) was the bar 10 two-legged lower high major trend reversal, which had several other supportive features that are described in the next paragraphs. Other good trades included the wedge bull flag, moving average gap bar, double bottom bull flag at bar 2, and the bar 3 final flag and wedge top. Some traders saw the first push up as the bull trend high before the bar 2 sell-off. Other traders saw that as the second push up and the June high as the first push up.


在强势跌破一条多头趋势线之后，交易者会找机会做空一个更低的高点。AMZN 日线图在第10根K线出现了一次回到更低的高点的两段式回调。有些交易者把它看作与第3根或第4根K线高点构成的双顶，并肯定与第6根K线高点构成双顶。它与第6根K线构成双顶熊旗，因此是一个二次入场做空信号。第6根K线是第一次信号，但涨到第6根K线的这波上涨动能太足，不太可能成为空头趋势的起点。另一些交易者把第4根K线当作异常值忽略，把涨到第10根K线的走势看作一个大型楔形顶部的某种形式，其中第2根K线之前那个高点是第一次上推，第3根K线是第二次，第10根K线是第三次。


> After a strong break below a bull trend line, traders will look to short a lower high. The AMZN daily chart had a two-legged pullback to a lower high at bar 10. Some traders saw it as a double top with the bar 3 or bar 4 high and certainly with the bar 6 high. It formed a double top bear flag with bar 6 and was therefore a second-entry short signal. Bar 6 was the first, but the move up to bar 6 had too much momentum to have much likelihood of being the start of the bear trend. Other traders ignored bar 4 as an outlier and saw the move up to bar 10 as a form of a large wedge top where the high before bar 2 was the first push, bar 3 was the second, and bar 10 was the third.


第7根K线突破了一条较小的多头趋势线，说明空头更强了；随后在涨到第10根K线的上涨中，市场又一次测试了第3和第4根K线的高点。


> Bar 7 broke a smaller bull trend line, indicating more bearish strength, and then again tested the bars 3 and 4 highs on the rally to bar 10.


第10根K线自第7根K线起的急剧上涨之后走出了三次上推，而这永远都必须被当作某种形式的楔形反转形态。这已经是一个交易者所能期望找到的最好的二次入场做空了：一面由小幅楔形构成的双顶熊旗，出现在一次测试趋势高点（第4根K线）的两段式上涨中，而这一切发生在一次主要趋势线突破（跌到第5根K线）之后，并且当时交易者正想找一个风险有限的做空建仓形态。


> Bar 10 was three pushes up from a sharp rally off bar 7, and this always has to be considered a form of a wedge reversal pattern. This was as good a second-entry short that a trader could hope to find: a double top bear flag made of a small wedge in a two-legged rally to test the trend high (bar 4) after a major trend line break (to bar 5), all occurring at a time when traders were looking for a setup to allow them to go short with limited risk.

如图 24.17 所示，在这张 Goldman Sachs Group（GS）的日线图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第3根K线的更高的高点主要趋势反转和小型楔形顶部；第4根K线卖出高潮之后的更高的低点和小型双底牛旗；第7根K线的更高的高点（高于第5根和第3根K线）、最终旗形和扩张三角形顶部（它是一个大型扩张三角形的二次入场，其中第1根K线是第一次上推、第3根K线是第二次；同时它也是一个小型扩张三角形的首次入场，其中第5根K线之前的停顿是第一次上推、第5根K线是第二次）；第8根K线的更低的高点；第9根K线之后的低2和楔形熊旗；第10根K线在移动平均线附近的低2；以及第11根K线的岛形底部和扩张三角形牛旗（第2根K线是第一次下推、第4根K线是第二次；记住，扩张三角形牛旗常常出现在扩张三角形顶部之后）。


> As shown in Figure 24.17, the best trade setups on this daily chart of Goldman Sachs Group (GS) include the bar 3 higher high major trend reversal and small wedge top, the higher low and small double bottom bull flag after the bar 4 sell climax, the bar 7 higher high (above bar 5 and bar 3), final flag, and expanding triangle top (it was the second entry for a large expanding triangle where bar 1 was the first push and bar 3 was the second, and it was the first entry for a small expanding triangle where the pause before bar 5 was the first push and bar 5 was the second), the bar 8 lower high, the low 2 and wedge bear flag after bar 9, the bar 10 low 2 near the moving average, and the bar 11 island bottom and expanding triangle bull flag (bar 2 was the first push down and bar 4 was the second; remember, expanding triangle bull flags often follow expanding triangle tops).


虽然一波强劲上涨可以是多头趋势的一部分，它也可能仅仅是一次由下跌真空造成的、对交易区间顶部的测试。空头预期市场会涨到第3根K线高点上方，所以一直等到它到达那里才做空。从第4根K线一路上来他们就看空，但在等到预期中的突破第3根K线高点之前，做空对他们来说并不合理。如果他们相信市场还要走高，那么在市场到达他们认为不会再涨多少的位置之前做空就是愚蠢的——而那个位置就是新高处。他们看到涨到第3根K线的上涨越过了前一根第1根K线高点之后市场就抛售，于是预期这次也会一样。由于这是第三次上推，他们可能正在一轮应该至少有两段行情的长期抛售的起点处做空。由于这是一个扩张三角形顶部（第1、2、3、4、7根K线），一个合理的目标是跌到第4根K线下方，市场可能在那里形成一面扩张三角形牛旗。


> Although a strong rally can be part of a bull trend, it can also simply be a test of the top of a trading range, created by a sell vacuum. The bears expected the market to move above the bar 3 high, so they waited to short until it got there. They were bearish all the way up from bar 4, but it did not make sense for them to short until they got the expected breakout above the bar 3 high. If they believe that the market is going higher, it is foolish for them to short until it reaches a level where they think it will not go much higher, which was at a new high. They saw the market sell off when the rally to bar 3 moved above the prior bar 1 high, and they expected the same to happen this time as well. Since this was the third push up, they might have been shorting at the start of a protracted sell-off that should have at least two legs. Since it was an expanding triangle top (bars 1, 2, 3, 4, and 7), a reasonable objective was a move to below bar 4, where the market might then form an expanding triangle bull flag.


第11根K线是扩张三角形牛旗中做多入场的信号。虽然那是一笔合理的交易，但它没有本章其它反转那么强。


> Bar 11 was a signal for a long entry in the expanding triangle bull flag. Although that was a reasonable trade, it was not as strong as the other reversals in this chapter.

虽然涨到第3根K线的上涨明显突破了空头趋势线，但跌到第4根K线的抛售随后走得远在第2根K线之下，以至于交易者需要看到一个更高的低点，才会认为趋势反转可能正在展开。第6根K线是一个更高的低点、也是一次两根K线反转，警觉的交易者在第二天第一根K线突破那次两根K线反转时买入。


> Although the rally to bar 3 broke well above the bear trend line, the sell-off down to bar 4 then went far enough below bar 2 so that traders needed a higher low before thinking that a trend reversal might be underway. Bar 6 was a higher low and a two-bar reversal, and alert traders bought on the first bar of the next day as it traded above the two-bar reversal.


涨到第9根K线的这波上涨，是在跌到第8根K线的走势跌破多头趋势线之后的两段式更高的高点。它同时还是自第4根K线低点起的三次上推，其中第5和第7根K线是前两次上推。有些交易者把这波上涨看成一面大型楔形熊旗，其中第3根K线结束了第一次上推，第7根K线是第二次。


> The rally to bar 9 was a two-legged higher high after the move down to bar 8 broke below the bull trend line. It was also three pushes up from the bar 4 low, with bars 5 and 7 being the first two pushes. Some traders saw the rally as a large wedge bear flag where bar 3 ended the first push and bar 7 was the second.


![图 24.19](figures/fig-24-19.jpg)


**图 24.19　ORCL 的最佳交易**


如图 24.19 所示，在这张 Oracle（ORCL）的5分钟图上，最佳交易建仓形态包括：第1根K线的更低的低点主要趋势反转（自前一个低点起的上涨突破了一条陡峭的空头趋势线），以及第4根K线的两段式更高的高点主要趋势反转和小型楔形顶部。


> As shown in Figure 24.19, the best trade setups on this 5 minute chart of Oracle (ORCL) include the bar 1 lower low major trend reversal (the rally off the prior low broke above a steep bear trend line) and the bar 4 two-legged higher high major trend reversal and small wedge top.


一波急剧上涨冲到交易区间顶部，通常是由上涨真空造成的，而不是新趋势。市场有惯性；当它处在交易区间里时，大多数突破尝试都会失败。空头预期市场会测试 Oracle 过去几天那个5分钟交易区间的顶部，所以在市场到达那片区域之前，他们没有理由做空。这使得涨到第2根K线的上涨变成单向的，可一旦市场到达交易区间顶部，空头就像从地里冒出来一样。此时他们怀疑市场不经过回调不可能再涨多少，于是不停地做空。涨到第4根K线的那波三次推进上涨，是一个极好的做空建仓形态，入场点就在那根两根K线反转下方。


> A sharp rally to the top of a trading range is usually due to a buy vacuum instead of a new trend. The market has inertia, and when it is in a trading range, most attempts to break out fail. The bears expected a test of the top of Oracle's 5 minute trading range of the past couple of days, so there was no reason to short until the market reached that area. This made the market one-sided in the rally up to bar 2, but once the market reached the top of the trading range, the bears appeared as if out of nowhere. They now doubted the market would go much higher without a pullback, and they shorted relentlessly. The three-push rally to bar 4 was an excellent setup to short below the two-bar reversal.


![图 24.20](figures/fig-24-20.jpg)


**图 24.20　Emini 开盘反转**


图 24.20 右侧那张5分钟 Emini 图上的最佳交易建仓形态包括：第6根K线的开盘反转；第7根K线的最终旗形顶部与楔形顶部（第6根K线之前那根K线的高点是第一次上涨段，尽管那是一根空头K线）；第8根K线的楔形牛旗与更高的低点；第10根K线自第9根K线突破空头微型通道之后的突破回调；第11根K线的低2与双顶（与跌到第8根K线那个楔形的顶部构成双顶）；第12根K线那个大幅两段式（第10根K线是第一次下推）的更高的低点主要趋势反转（第12根K线是从跌到第10根K线的小型空头趋势、以及结束于第6根K线的大型空头趋势中反转向上）；以及第14根K线的更高的低点主要趋势反转和二次入场的突破回调买入信号（它同时还是一个头肩底的右肩，其中第10根K线是左肩）。


> The best trade setups on the 5 minute Emini chart on the right in Figure 24.20 include the bar 6 opening reversal, the bar 7 final flag top and wedge top (the high of the bar before bar 6 was the first leg up, even though it was a bear bar), the bar 8 wedge bull flag and higher low, the bar 10 breakout pullback from the bar 9 breakout above the bear micro channel, the bar 11 low 2 and double top (with the top of the wedge down to bar 8), the bar 12 large two-legged (bar 10 was the first push down) higher low major trend reversal (bar 12 was reversing up from the small bear trend down to bar 10 and from the large bear trend that ended at bar 6), and the bar 14 higher low major trend reversal and second entry breakout pullback buy signal (it was also the right shoulder of a head and shoulders bottom, where bar 10 was the left shoulder).


虽然大多数学者和电视评论员都主张，整体市场的所有走势都基于个股的综合基本面，但政治常常会制造出巨大的行情。一个明显的例子是1994年共和党掌控国会时出现的那轮惊人的多头市场，它常被称为克林顿超级多头市场。2008年的崩盘是另一个例子。这轮空头趋势和恐慌性抛售，是次贷危机造成的，还是全国意识到巴拉克·奥巴马将要赢得白宫的直接结果？虽然你必须按照走势图所显示的来交易，但去理解政治如何影响市场，在智识上很有意思——不管你的政治倾向如何。


> Although most academics and television pundits argue that all moves in the overall market are based on the composite fundamentals of the individual stocks, politics often creates huge moves. An obvious example is the incredible bull market that took place when the Republicans took control of Congress in 1994, often referred to as the Clinton super bull market. The crash of 2008 is another example. Was this bear trend and panic sell-off caused by the subprime mess, or was it the direct result of the country realizing that Barack Obama was going to win the White House? Although you have to trade the charts based on what they show, it is intellectually interesting to try to understand how politics can influence the market, regardless of your political leanings.


多么完美的一天！如果你看右边那张5分钟图，它的形状对于一个更高的低点空头趋势反转来说并不起眼，但从那张图右侧的价格刻度可以看出，有些K线的幅度超过30个点，而平常日子的K线平均波动区间大约只有两个点。这是市场在道琼斯工业平均指数于2008年崩盘中一周下跌20%之后，试图至少先做出一只暂时性底部的努力。一年多来我一直跟朋友们说，道指会在2008年跌破10,000点，因为看起来我们可能已经进入了一个持续多年的交易区间。我们也许已经做出了一个顶部，而这波抛售可能带来低得多的价格，但交易区间是更常见、因而也更可能的结果。


> Such a perfect day! If you look at the 5 minute chart on the right, the shape is unremarkable for a higher low bear trend reversal, but you can see from the price scale on the right of that chart that some of the bars were more than 30 points tall, in contrast to a normal day when the bars might have an average range of about two points. This is the market's attempt to put at least a temporary bottom in after the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 20 percent this week in the crash of 2008. I had been telling my friends for over a year that the Dow would fall below 10,000 in 2008, because it appeared that we might have entered a multiyear trading range. We might have put in a top and the selling could lead to much lower prices, but a trading range is a more common and therefore more likely outcome.


尽管道指今天波动了1,000点，对一位价格行为交易者来说，这不过是又一个平常的工作日。我把仓位规模削减到只有平常的20%，因为我在每笔 Emini 交易上得冒大约10个点的风险；即便如此，我当天的利润仍然比平常的日子更多。


> Even though the Dow had a range of 1,000 points today, it was still just another day at the office for a price action trader. I cut my position size down to just 20 percent of normal because I had to risk about 10 points on each Emini trade, yet I still ended the day with more profit than on an average day.


今天是星期五，本周道指每天都下跌200到700点，所以出现一次反转尝试是很有可能的。不过，你得有耐心，并且去找标准的价格行为建仓形态。


> Today was Friday and the Dow had been down 200 to 700 points every day this week, so an attempt at a reversal was likely. However, you had to be patient and look for standard price action setups.


左边那张图是60分钟图，第D根K线（它同时也是右边5分钟图上的第6根K线）跌穿了以第A和第C根K线（它们也是5分钟图上的第1根K线）为基础画出的趋势通道线，随后反转向上。


> The chart on the left is a 60 minute chart, and bar D (it is also bar 6 on the 5 minute chart on the right) fell through the trend channel line built off bars A and C (it is also bar 1 on the 5 minute chart), and then reversed up.


在5分钟图上，第6根K线在市场跌破第2根到第4根K线那条趋势通道线之后形成了一根巨大的十字星K线。十字星不是很好的信号K线，但市场同时在5分钟图和60分钟图上反转趋势通道线突破，而且道指下跌了700点，所以出现一波可交易的上涨是很有可能的。


> On the 5 minute chart, bar 6 formed a huge doji bar after the market fell below the bar 2 to bar 4 trend channel line. Dojis are not great signal bars, but the market was reversing trend channel line breakouts on both the 5 and 60 minute charts and the Dow was down 700 points, so a tradable rally was likely.


第7根K线突破了空头趋势线，但形成了一个最终旗形顶部和两段上涨，所以很可能出现回调。不过，自第6根K线低点起的这波上涨非常猛烈，所以在测试空头趋势低点之后很可能还会有第二段上涨。明智的做法就是耐心等一个更高的低点（在那么强的向上动能下，更低的低点不太可能出现）。


> Bar 7 broke above the bear trend line but formed a final flag top and two legs up, so a pullback was likely. However, the move up from the bar 6 low was violent, so it was likely that there would be a second leg up after a test of the bear trend low. It was prudent to just patiently wait for a higher low (with that much upward momentum, a lower low was not likely).


第10根K线可能是一个底部，因为它是自第9根K线突破那个楔形之后的更低的低点突破回调。不过，自第7根K线起的下跌持续了一个多小时，而且非常深，所以在最终底部成形之前很可能还有第二段下跌。


> Bar 10 was a possible bottom since it was a lower low breakout pullback from the bar 9 breakout of the wedge. However, the move down from bar 7 lasted more than an hour or so and was very deep, so a second leg down was likely before the final bottom was in.


涨到第11根K线的上涨又突破了一条空头趋势线，所以多头正在变强。


> The move up to bar 11 broke another bear trend line, so the bulls were gaining strength.


与第10根K线相比，第12根K线是一个更低的低点，因此可能是当天的一个更高的低点；但跌到第12根K线的走势动能太强，所以很可能会出现一次测试。


> Bar 12 was a lower low compared to bar 10 and therefore a possible higher low on the day, but the move down to bar 12 had too much momentum, so a test was likely.


涨到第13根K线的多头行情段里有好几根多头趋势K线，并且又突破了一条多头趋势线。


> The bull leg to bar 13 had several bull trend bars and broke another bull trend line.


第14根K线是一根幅度可观的多头反转K线，也是一次微型趋势线回调；与第12根K线相比，它是一个更高的低点，所以这有可能就是最终的低点——而它确实是。这使得第12根K线变成了自第6根K线之后的第一个强劲的更高的低点，也是对那个空头低点的一次极好测试。这就是当天的关键交易，也是自强势上涨到第7根K线之后你就应该整天等待的那一笔。今天还有很多其它交易，但这一笔容易预判，而且展开得完美无缺。5分钟图和60分钟图上都出现了趋势通道线过靶，涨到第7根K线的巨幅上涨使更高的低点很可能出现，跌到第12根K线的两段式回调可能构成一个60分钟图上的更高的低点，随后第14根K线处5分钟图上的更高的低点确认了第12根K线那个更高的低点。做这笔交易并不需要60分钟图，我也没有用它。我把它放进来，是为了说明这里也有更长时间级别的力量在起作用，而且从成交量可以清楚看出，机构在关注它们。


> Bar 14 was a good-sized bull reversal bar and a micro trend line pullback, as well as a higher low compared to bar 12, so this could have been the final low, which it was. This turned bar 12 into the first strong higher low after bar 6 and an excellent test of that bear low. This was the trade of the day and the one that you needed to be waiting for all day after the strong move up to bar 7. There were many other trades today, but this one was easy to anticipate and it unfolded perfectly. There were trend channel line overshoots on the 5 and 60 minute charts, a huge move up to bar 7 making a higher low likely, a two-legged pullback to bar 12 forming a possible 60 minute higher low, followed by a 5 minute higher low at bar 14 that confirmed the bar 12 higher low. You did not need the 60 minute chart to make this trade, and I did not use it. I am including it to show that there were longer time frame forces at work here as well and it is clear from the volume that institutions were paying attention to them.


第15根K线在当天创新高之后反转下跌。第10根K线那个两根K线反转的向上反转，是一个约有60%概率赚到波段利润的建仓形态的例子，因此对所有交易者——包括新手——来说都是极好的建仓形态。第4根K线是空头趋势里的均线缺口K线，而这往往会带来一次对空头低点（此时是第2根K线）的测试，随后是一波大约10根K线、两段行情作为最低目标的上涨。跌到第6根K线的那段空头急速行情太强，交易者不该买。第8根K线是一个合理的买入点，因为它是自跌破第2根K线以来的第二次反转尝试，是一个扩张三角形底部（当天第三根K线是第一次下推，第2根K线是第二次），是从第7根K线熊旗开始的最终旗形反转，而且它是一根强劲的多头反转K线。扩张三角形底部永远是主要趋势反转建仓形态。不过，由于涨到第4根K线和跌到第6根K线的两段行情都太大，大多数交易者不会称之为主要趋势反转，而会用别的说法来指它（尽管在15分钟图上它几乎可以肯定是一个形态漂亮的主要趋势反转）。第10根K线已经是一个很强的形态中的二次入场。交易者在第10根K线高点——也就是那根两根K线反转的第二根K线——上方买入，初始保护性止损放在它的低点下方。市场走到风险的两倍时，他们部分或全部止盈，让剩下的仓位向上做波段，并把止损沿着最近的更高的低点往上移。有些人会在第19根K线那个双顶（与第4根K线构成）以及楔形（第12、14、19根K线和第14、16、19根K线）下方离场，另一些人则会继续持有，把止损放在第17根K线下方。


> Bar 15 reversed down after a new high on the day. The reversal up at the bar 10 two-bar reversal was an example of a setup with about a 60 percent chance of making a swing profit, and therefore was a great setup for all traders, including beginners. Bar 4 was a gap bar in a bear trend, and that often leads to a test of the bear low (bar 2, as this point) and then a rally that has about ten bars and two legs as minimum objectives. The bear spike down to bar 6 was too strong for traders to buy. Bar 8 was a reasonable buy, since it was a second reversal attempt from the breakout below bar 2, an expanding triangle bottom (the third bar of the day was the first push down and bar 2 was the second), a final flag reversal from the bar 7 bear flag, and a strong bull reversal bar. Expanding triangle bottoms are always major trend reversal setups. However, since the legs up to bar 4 and down to bar 6 were so large, most traders would not call this a major trend reversal and instead would refer to it in other terms (although it was almost certainly a great looking major trend reversal on the 15 minute chart). Bar 10 was the second entry in an already strong pattern. Traders bought above the bar 10 high, which was the second bar of the two-bar reversal, and their initial protective stop was below its low. They took partial or full profits once the market reached twice the risk, and let the remainder of their position swing up, trailing stops below the most recent higher low. Some would have exited below the bar 19 double top (with bar 4), and wedge (bars 12, 14, and 19, and bars 14, 16, and 19), and others would have held, keeping their stops below bar 17.
